descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Are you passionate about transforming data into business value? Do you enjoy working closely with senior stakeholders and influencing business decisions through analytics, insights, and emerging technologies?
At Sulzer, we're embarking on an exciting journey from traditional Business Intelligence towards Artificial Intelligence-powered solutions. We're looking for an experienced Inhouse Consultant BI & Analytics to join our Global IT BI & Analytics team in Madrid and help drive our data-driven transformation.
This is not a pure IT development role. We are looking for someone who can combine strong technical expertise with business consulting skills, building trusted relationships with senior leaders across the business while delivering innovative analytics solutions.
As part of our global BI & Analytics team, you will work closely with business stakeholders across Sulzer to understand challenges, identify opportunities, and deliver solutions that drive better decision-making.

Key responsibilities include:

• Partnering with business leaders to understand requirements and translate them into scalable analytics solutions

• Designing, developing and enhancing enterprise BI applications using Qlik Sense

• Delivering meaningful insights and dashboards that support strategic and operational decision-making

• Working with Snowflake and modern data platforms to create trusted, scalable data solutions

• Supporting Sulzer's "One Sulzer" harmonisation strategy through standardised reporting and analytics

• Driving self-service analytics and data literacy across the organisation

• Exploring and implementing emerging technologies including AI, Generative AI, Copilots and Agentic AI solutions

• Building intelligent applications and data products that connect to Sulzer's modern data platform

• Collaborating with Data Engineering teams to develop robust data models and scalable solutions

• Acting as a trusted advisor to both business and IT stakeholders globally

• Essential Skills & Experience

• Minimum 5 years' experience in a Business Intelligence, Analytics or Inhouse Consulting role

• Strong hands-on experience with Qlik Sense

• Advanced SQL skills

• Experience working with senior business stakeholders

• Strong business consulting and stakeholder management skills

• Experience gathering business requirements and translating them into technical solutions

• Excellent communication and presentation skills

• Highly Desirable

• Experience with Snowflake

• Knowledge of modern data warehousing concepts

• Experience with dbt

• Exposure to Power BI, Tableau or Looker

• Experience in AI, Generative AI, Copilots or emerging analytics technologies

• Experience working within an international or global organisation

The Opportunity

This is a unique opportunity for someone who enjoys operating at the intersection of business, data, analytics and AI. You'll play a key role in helping Sulzer evolve from traditional reporting and dashboards towards intelligent, AI-enabled business solutions that create measurable value across the organisation.
If you're excited by modern analytics, emerging AI technologies, and partnering with senior business leaders to drive transformation, we'd love to hear from you.

What we offer you

Permanent position within a globally recognised industrial technology leader
Competitive salary
Annual bonus scheme
Meal vouchers
Flexible benefits package including health insurance, transport and childcare options
Opportunity to work with cutting-edge Data & AI technologies
Be part of a highly experienced team
International exposure working with stakeholders across multiple business domains
Career growth opportunities within a global organisation
Modern offices located in Nuevos M

Sulzer est une société d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Êtes-vous passionné par la transformation des données en valeur commerciale? Aimez-vous travailler en étroite collaboration avec les principaux intervenants et influencer les décisions d'affaires par l'analyse, les idées et les technologies émergentes?

• Travailler avec Snowflake et des plateformes de données modernes pour créer des solutions de données fiables et évolutives

• Soutenir la stratégie d'harmonisation « One Sulzer » de Sulzer par des rapports et des analyses normalisés

• Diriger l'analyse en libre-service et la connaissance des données dans l'ensemble de l'organisation

• Explorer et mettre en œuvre des technologies émergentes, y compris l'IA, l'IA Generative, les copilotes et les solutions d'IA Agentic

• Construire des applications intelligentes et des produits de données qui se connectent à la plate-forme de données moderne de Sulzer

• Collaborer avec les équipes de Data Engineering pour développer des modèles de données robustes et des solutions évolutives

• Agir en tant que conseiller de confiance auprès des intervenants du monde des affaires et des TI

• Compétences et expérience essentielles

• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans un rôle de Business Intelligence, Analytics ou Inhouse Consulting

• Forte expérience pratique avec Qlik Sense

• Compétences avancées SQL

• Expérience de travail avec les principaux intervenants commerciaux

• Renforcement des compétences en conseil aux entreprises et en gestion des intervenants

• Expérience de la collecte des exigences commerciales et de leur traduction en solutions techniques

• Excellentes compétences en communication et présentation

• Très désirable

• Expérience avec Snowflake

• Connaissance des concepts modernes d'entreposage des données

• Expérience avec dbt

• Exposition à Power BI, Tableau ou Looker

• Expérience dans l'IA, l'IA Generative, les copilotes ou les technologies d'analyse émergentes

• Expérience de travail au sein d'une organisation internationale ou mondiale

L'opportunité

C'est une occasion unique pour quelqu'un qui aime opérer à l'intersection des affaires, des données, de l'analyse et de l'IA. Vous jouerez un rôle clé en aidant Sulzer à évoluer de rapports traditionnels et tableaux de bord vers des solutions d'affaires intelligentes et adaptées à l'IA qui créent une valeur mesurable dans toute l'organisation.
Si vous êtes excité par l'analyse moderne, les technologies d'IA émergentes et les partenariats avec des chefs d'entreprise chevronnés pour stimuler la transformation, nous aimerions vous entendre.

At Sulzer GT Aero, we are specialists in the maintenance, repair, overhaul and life extension of aeroderivative gas turbines and associated rotating equipment. Supporting customers across the energy, industrial and marine sectors, we help keep critical assets operating safely, efficiently and reliably around the world.

Due to continued growth, we are seeking a commercially minded Project Manager to lead complex international projects from contract award through to successful completion The Role

We are looking for an individual who combines strong project execution skills with commercial awareness and customer focus.

You will manage multiple international projects involving gas turbines, rotating equipment and associated services, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget and with healthy profit margins.

Working closely with Sales, Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain and Customers, you will act as the focal point throughout the project lifecycle, driving collaboration and ensuring customer expectations are exceeded.

What You'll Be Doing

• Ability to manage customer relationships and confidently engage with senior stakeholders

• Strong negotiation and influencing skills

• Excellent communication and leadership capabilities

• Results-driven mindset with the ability to identify commercial opportunities beyond the original project scope

What we offer you

descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are looking for a Quality Control Coordinator to join our team in Burgos, Spain. In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring that incoming materials, manufacturing processes, and finished products meet internal, customer, and regulatory quality requirements.
As a quality professional, you will coordinate quality control activities throughout the production cycle, working closely with suppliers, production teams, engineering, procurement, and project stakeholders. Your contribution will help maintain product conformity, strengthen quality performance, and support operational excellence.
This is an excellent opportunity for an autonomous and detail-oriented professional who enjoys working in a manufacturing environment and influencing quality standards across the organization. What you will do:

• Review and validate supplier quality documentation, material certificates, and inspection records.

• Coordinate incoming quality control activities and support supplier quality issue resolution.

• Define and maintain quality control standard operating procedures across production activities.

• Lead critical quality inspections and support in-process inspections.

• Monitor manufacturing quality performance and identify deviations from requirements.

• Ensure compliance with internal procedures, customer specifications, and applicable standards.

• Document inspection results and maintain accurate quality records.

• Collaborate with production, engineering, procurement, and project teams to ensure product conformity.

• Coordinate interactions with external inspectors when required.

What you need to succeed:

• Experience in manufacturing quality control environments.

• Strong knowledge of quality control practices and quality documentation processes.

• Experience reviewing material certificates and supplier quality documentation.

• Experience using ERP systems and quality management systems.

• Ability to interpret technical specifications, test certificates, and quality standards.

• Experience conducting incoming, in-process, and final inspections.

• Familiarity with welding, painting, dimensional inspections, and manufacturing processes.

• Strong organizational and documentation skills.

• Ability to work independently and manage priorities effectively.

• Fluent Spanish and professional English.

What we offer you

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Meal vouchers.

• Access to a voluntary flexible compensation scheme allowing employees to optimize their salary package, such as health insurance, transport, or childcare.

• Be part of an experienced and international team.

• A good vibe working environment.

• The opportunity to grow your career within a solid and well-established international company.

• Be part of a dynamic organization undergoing continuous transformation and improvement.

• Office location: Burgos, Spain.

• Additional benefits may apply depending on the position and location.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Unisciti al team Business Intelligence & Analytics di Sulzer e gioca un ruolo chiave nell'accelerare la nostra trasformazione dei dati in tutta la Divisione Servizi. Siamo alla ricerca di un professionista di dati proattivo e orientato al business che gode di trasformare i dati complessi in insight attuabili. Il candidato ideale combina forti capacità analitiche con una mentalità di costruttore, costantemente alla ricerca di modi più intelligenti, più veloci e più efficaci di lavorare attraverso la tecnologia e l'innovazione.
In questo ruolo altamente visibile, si partnerrà con le parti interessate attraverso Vendite, Operazioni, Finanza e Supply Chain, aiutando i team a sbloccare il pieno valore dei dati, promuovendo una cultura del processo decisionale basato sui dati. Cosa farai:

• Sviluppare, migliorare e mantenere dashboard di business intelligence, garantendo coerenza, usabilità e esperienze utente di alta qualità.

• Costruire una forte comprensione delle fonti di dati, delle strutture e dei flussi attraverso piattaforme CRM, ERP e cloud.

• Assicurarsi che i cruscotti siano intuitivi, utilizzabili e accessibili agli utenti aziendali con una formazione minima.

• Mantenere la documentazione per dashboard, modelli di dati e processi correlati.

• Partecipa alle attività di ERP, CRM e BI governance e funge da punto di riferimento regionale per gli utenti aziendali.

• Identificare i problemi di qualità dei dati e collaborare con gli stakeholder per implementare soluzioni di miglioramento sostenibile.

• Partner con i team di gestione regionale e subregionale per comprendere le priorità aziendali e consentire il processo decisionale informato.

• Guidare e sostenere gli utenti regionali nell'adottare ed efficacemente utilizzando strumenti e dashboard BI.

• Progettare e fornire sessioni di formazione che aumentano l'alfabetizzazione dei dati e l'adozione degli utenti.

• Sostenere i team di leadership con narrazioni e raccomandazioni convincenti e guidati dai dati.

• Esperienza di collaborazione con funzioni aziendali come vendite, operazioni, finanza, o Supply Chain.

Preferito:

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Join Sulzer’s Business Intelligence & Analytics team and play a key role in accelerating our data transformation across the Services Division. This position sits at the crossroads of business intelligence, analytics, and technology, providing an exciting opportunity to influence how data is leveraged to support strategic and operational decisions across the region.
We are looking for a proactive and business-oriented data professional who enjoys turning complex data into actionable insights. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical capabilities with a builder mindset, constantly seeking smarter, faster, and more effective ways of working through technology and innovation.
In this highly visible role, you will partner with stakeholders across Sales, Operations, Finance, and Supply Chain, helping teams unlock the full value of data while promoting a culture of data-driven decision making. What you will do:

• Gather and translate business requirements into clear, decision-enabling dashboards and analyses.

• Develop, enhance, and maintain business intelligence dashboards, ensuring consistency, usability, and high-quality user experiences.

• Manage analytics and dashboard development projects from scope definition through delivery and continuous improvement.

• Build a strong understanding of data sources, structures, and flows across CRM, ERP, and cloud platforms.

• Ensure dashboards are intuitive, actionable, and accessible to business users with minimal training.

• Maintain documentation for dashboards, data models, and related processes.

• Participate in ERP, CRM, and BI governance activities and serve as a regional point of reference for business users.

• Identify data quality issues and collaborate with stakeholders to implement sustainable improvement solutions.

• Analyze trends across regions, product lines, and business areas to uncover actionable insights and opportunities.

• Support stakeholders with ad hoc analyses and deep-dive investigations to address complex business questions.

• Partner with regional and sub-regional management teams to understand business priorities and enable informed decision-making.

• Guide and support regional users in adopting and effectively utilizing BI tools and dashboards.

• Design and deliver training sessions that increase data literacy and user adoption.

• Support leadership teams with compelling, data-driven narratives and recommendations.

• Identify opportunities to automate, simplify, and improve existing reporting and analytics processes through emerging technologies and tools.

What you need to succeed:
Required:

• 3 to 6 years of experience in a data analytics, business intelligence, or related role.

• Proven experience developing dashboards that support real business decision-making.

• Advanced Excel and Power Pivot skills, including complex data models, pivot tables, and data analysis techniques.

• Hands-on experience with a major BI platform such as Qlik Sense, Power BI, Tableau, or similar.

• Strong understanding of data structures, data modelling, and working with multiple data sources.

• Experience partnering with business functions such as Sales, Operations, Finance, or Supply Chain.

• Experience collaborating with both business stakeholders and technical or IT teams.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.

• Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts to diverse audiences.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

Preferred:

• Experience in an industrial, manufacturing, B2B environment, or consultancy.

• Exposure to CRM systems such as Salesforce.

• Experience working with ERP systems such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365, or similar.

• Familiarity with cloud

descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are looking for a Credit Manager to join our Group Treasury team in Madrid. In this role, you will play a key part in managing and strengthening Sulzer's global credit risk framework while supporting strategic treasury initiatives across the organization.
This is an exciting opportunity for a finance professional who enjoys working in an international environment, leading cross-functional projects, and influencing decision-making at a global level. You will collaborate with senior stakeholders across the business to ensure effective credit risk management, support factoring activities, and contribute to treasury transformation initiatives. What you will do:

• Support the establishment and development of the HUB credit risk management team.

• Drive the creation of standardized and harmonized credit risk management processes across the organization.

• Manage global service contracts related to credit risk management, including relationships with external credit rating agencies and tender processes.

• Lead the assessment and design of credit risk management technologies supporting multiple ERP platforms.

• Collaborate with IT and business stakeholders to define and implement standard SAP credit risk management templates.

• Evaluate high-value credit limit requests and provide recommendations to Division CFOs and the Group CFO.

• Deliver training and guidance to internal stakeholders on credit risk assessment and banking policies.

• Support and further develop the company's global factoring processes.

• Manage the global bank account structure and maintain operational banking relationships.

• Coordinate access management for centrally controlled bank accounts.

• Participate in treasury projects and continuous improvement initiatives across the organization.

What you need to succeed:
Required:

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in a similar role within an international organization, ideally in a regional or group treasury environment.

• Strong experience in credit risk management and third-party risk assessment.

• Proven success in managing complex cross-functional and international projects.

• Excellent organizational and planning skills.

• Ability to work effectively under pressure and manage priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to build relationships across all levels of the organization.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.

• Professional proficiency in English.

• Ability to work independently and take ownership of responsibilities.

Preferred:

• Experience with integrated ERP systems.

• Exposure to SAP credit risk management solutions.

• Experience in global treasury or shared services environments.

What we offer you

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Meal vouchers.

• Access to a voluntary flexible compensation scheme allowing employees to optimize their salary package, such as health insurance, transport, or childcare.

• Be part of an experienced and international team.

• A good vibe working environment.

• The opportunity to grow your career within a solid and well-established international company.

• Be part of a dynamic organization undergoing continuous transformation and improvement.

• Office location: Nuevos Ministerios, Madrid, Spain.

Additional benefits may apply depending on the position and location.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Responsabile di tutti gli aspetti dell'esecuzione del progetto Tower Field Service (TFS) tra cui la stima, le riunioni pre-lavoro e i negoziati, la supervisione assicurata ha una chiara portata di lavoro, completando il file di progetto e la documentazione, e fatturando il progetto. Responsabile per il mantenimento o il miglioramento del margine lordo del progetto e per l'esecuzione complessiva del contratto e il successo di tutti i progetti TFS assegnati. I gestori gestiranno contemporaneamente molti ordini, sia nazionali che internazionali, compresi i progetti più complessi che abbiamo, che possono variare in valore fino a diversi milioni di dollari. FUNZIONI ESSENTIALI:

• Responsabile per l'accettazione del progetto e per la verifica che l'ordine di acquisto del cliente corrisponda al campo di lavoro citato, e che termini e condizioni sono negoziati per la reciproca soddisfazione del cliente e Sulzer Chemtech.

• Agisce come collegamento primario tra cliente e Sulzer TFS. Gestisce la pianificazione generale del progetto.

• Assesse l'impatto delle richieste di cambiamento e rivede il programma e il prezzo del progetto come appropriato. Determina l'impatto generato dal cambiamento delle richieste e comunica informazioni al cliente e a tutti gli utenti effetti interni.

• Responsabile delle comunicazioni giornaliere e delle revisioni formali del progetto con il cliente, la gestione interna, informandoli di pietre miliari, problemi, situazioni che aumentano il rischio su un progetto, azioni correttive e risultati. Fornisce la direzione alle varie aree funzionali all'interno dell'organizzazione sul loro contributo individuale nell'ambito di fornitura, programma e budget dell'ordine.

• Responsabile per la massimizzazione del margine lordo dell'ordine attraverso gli ordini di cambiamento/adders e garantire che tutte le opportunità siano prese per ottenere riduzioni dei costi per Sulzer TFS.

• Conduce valutazioni lorde dei margini per spiegare deviazioni da margine lordo pianificato, informazioni reali contro i costi stimati, ordini di cambiamento, problemi, azioni correttive e risultati. Assicura l'ordine è chiuso nel computer in modo tempestivo, e che tutta la fatturazione appropriata viene inviata al cliente.

QUALIFICA:

• diploma di scuola superiore o equivalente richiesto.

• Sette anni di esperienza nella gestione dei progetti in questo simile processo di produzione di prodotti ingegnerizzati.

• Molto forte atteggiamento del servizio clienti e buone capacità di negoziazione sono essenziali.

• Analitica e problem solving competenze, per lo sviluppo e l'attuazione di soluzioni ai problemi con i progetti assegnati è importante.

• Forte capacità interpersonali e di comunicazione come richiesto nel comunicare con il personale in altri dipartimenti, supervisionando i risultati delle loro attività di lavoro, e ottenendo risultati desiderati attraverso gli altri.

• Le competenze di comunicazione orale e scritta efficaci dimostrate sono critiche, come richiesto per incontrare i clienti, relay stato del progetto o informazioni di cambiamento, e mantenere un'immagine professionale che riflette positivamente sull'organizzazione.

• Forte competenze informatiche, come richiesto nel lavoro con l'elaborazione delle parole, database e applicazioni foglio di calcolo. La capacità di utilizzare con successo MS Project o altri simili software di gestione del progetto è essenziale.

• La conoscenza dei requisiti di gestione dei contratti, compresa la familiarità con i termini e le condizioni di vendita è importante.

• Gestione dei costi e conoscenza generale della gestione aziendale per massimizzare il completamento efficiente dei progetti assegnati.

• Capacità di leggere e interpretare correttamente la torre di ingegneria e disegni interni.

TRAVEL: Questa posizione richiede occasionali viaggi d'affari. I progetti più grandi possono richiedere che i manager siano sul posto per tutta la durata del turnaround (che variano di lunghezza da una a più settimane), compreso il lavoro sette giorni alla settimana e spesso oltre 12 ore al giorno. Alcuni viaggi internazionali possono essere richiesti, e i dipendenti saranno tenuti a mantenere un passaporto valido e ottenere il visto di lavoro
descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Responsible for all aspects of Tower Field Service (TFS) project execution including the estimate, pre-job meetings and negotiations, insuring supervision have a clear scope of work, completing the project file and documentation, and invoicing the project. Responsible for maintaining or improving the project gross margin and for overall contract execution and success of all assigned TFS projects. Managers will manage many orders at once, both domestic and international, including the most complex projects we have which may range in value up to several million dollars. ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

• Responsible for project acceptance and for verification that the customer Purchase Order matches the quoted work scope, and that terms and conditions are negotiated to mutual satisfaction of the customer and Sulzer Chemtech.

• Acts as primary liaison between customer and Sulzer TFS. Manages overall project scheduling.

• Assesses the impact of change requests and revises the project schedule and price as appropriate. Determines the impact created by change requests and communicates information to the customer and all effected internal individuals.

• Responsible for daily communications and formal project reviews with the customer, internal management, informing them of milestones, problems, situations which increase the risk on a project, corrective actions, and results. Provides direction to the various functional areas within the organization on their individual contribution within the order’s scope of supply, schedule, and budget.

• Responsible for maximizing order gross margin through change orders/adders and ensuring that all opportunities are taken to achieve cost reductions for Sulzer TFS.

• Conducts gross margin reviews to explain deviations from planned gross margin, actual versus estimated cost information, change orders, problems, corrective actions, and results. Ensures order is closed in the computer in a timely manner, and that all appropriate invoicing is sent to customer.

QUALIFICATIONS:

• High School diploma or equivalent required.

• Seven years of project management experience in this similar engineered product manufacturing operation.

• Very strong customer service attitude and good negotiating skills are essential.

• Analytical and problem-solving skills, for developing and implementing solutions to problems with assigned projects is important.

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills as required in communicating with personnel in other departments, overseeing the results of their work activities, and accomplishing desired results through others.

• Demonstrated effective oral and written communication skills are critical, as required to meet with customers, relay project status or change information, and maintain a professional image that reflects positively on the organization.

• Strong computer skills, as required in working with word processing, database and spreadsheet applications. The ability to successfully use MS Project or other similar project management software is essential.

• Knowledge of contract management requirements including familiarity with terms and conditions of sale is important.

• Cost management and general business management knowledge to maximize efficient completion of assigned projects.

• Ability to read and correctly interpret engineering tower and internals drawings.

TRAVEL: This position requires occasional business travel. Larger projects may require Managers to be on site for the entire turnaround duration (which vary in length from one to several weeks), including working seven days a week and often over 12 hours a day. Some international travel may be required, and employees will be required to maintain a valid passport and obtain work visa

Über die Rolle

Manager werden viele Aufträge auf einmal verwalten, sowohl national als auch international, einschließlich der komplexesten Projekte, die wir haben, die bis zu mehreren Millionen Dollar wert sein können. WESENTLICHE FUNKTIONEN

• Verantwortlich für die Projektabnahme und die Überprüfung, dass der Kundenauftrag dem angegebenen Arbeitsumfang entspricht und dass die Bedingungen zur gegenseitigen Zufriedenheit des Kunden und von Sulzer Chemtech ausgehandelt werden.

• Verantwortlich für die tägliche Kommunikation und formale Projektüberprüfungen mit dem Kunden, das interne Management, die Information über Meilensteine, Probleme, Situationen, die das Risiko für ein Projekt erhöhen, Korrekturmaßnahmen und Ergebnisse. Bietet den verschiedenen Funktionsbereichen innerhalb der Organisation eine Orientierung für ihren individuellen Beitrag innerhalb des Lieferumfangs, des Zeitplans und des Budgets des Auftrags.

• Führt Brutto-Margin-Überprüfungen durch, um Abweichungen von geplanter Brutto-Margin, tatsächlichen versus geschätzten Kosteninformationen, Änderungsaufträgen, Problemen, Korrekturmaßnahmen und Ergebnissen zu erklären. Stellt sicher, dass die Bestellung rechtzeitig im Computer geschlossen wird und dass alle entsprechenden Rechnungen an den Kunden gesendet werden.

QUALIFIKATIONEN:

• High School Diplom oder gleichwertig erforderlich.

• Die Kenntnis der Vertragsmanagementanforderungen, einschließlich der Vertrautheit mit den Verkaufsbedingungen, ist wichtig.

• Kostenmanagement und allgemeines betriebswirtschaftliches Wissen zur Maximierung des effizienten Abschlusses zugewiesener Projekte.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Responsable de tous les aspects de l'exécution du projet du Service mobile de la tour, y compris l'estimation, les réunions préalables à l'emploi et les négociations, assurant la supervision ont une portée claire du travail, complétant le dossier et la documentation du projet, et facturer le projet. Responsable du maintien ou de l'amélioration de la marge brute du projet et de l'exécution globale des contrats et du succès de tous les projets de SFT assignés. Les gestionnaires géreront de nombreuses commandes à la fois nationales et internationales, y compris les projets les plus complexes dont nous disposons et dont la valeur peut atteindre plusieurs millions de dollars. FONCTIONS ESSENTIELLES:

• Responsable de l'acceptation du projet et de la vérification que le bon de commande du client correspond à la portée de travail citée, et que les conditions sont négociées à la satisfaction mutuelle du client et de Sulzer Chemtech.

• Fonctionne comme liaison principale entre le client et Sulzer TFS. Gérer le calendrier global du projet.

• Évaluer l'incidence des demandes de changement et réviser le calendrier et le prix du projet, selon le cas. Déterminer l'incidence créée par les demandes de changement et communiquer l'information au client et à toutes les personnes internes effectuées.

• Responsable des communications quotidiennes et des examens officiels des projets avec le client, la direction interne, les informant des étapes, des problèmes, des situations qui augmentent le risque d'un projet, des mesures correctives et des résultats. Fournit une orientation aux divers secteurs fonctionnels de l'organisation sur leur contribution individuelle dans le cadre de l'ordre de fourniture, du calendrier et du budget.

• Responsable de la maximisation de la marge brute des commandes par l'entremise des commandes ou des adders de changement et s'assurer que toutes les possibilités sont prises pour obtenir des réductions de coûts pour Sulzer TFS.

• Effectuer des examens de la marge brute pour expliquer les écarts par rapport à la marge brute prévue, les renseignements sur les coûts réels et les coûts estimatifs, les ordres de modification, les problèmes, les mesures correctives et les résultats. S'assure que la commande est fermée dans l'ordinateur en temps opportun, et que toute facturation appropriée est envoyée au client.

QUALIFICATIONS:

• Diplôme d'études secondaires ou équivalent requis.

• Sept ans d'expérience en gestion de projet dans cette opération similaire de fabrication de produits.

• Une attitude très forte du service à la clientèle et de bonnes compétences de négociation sont essentielles.

• Il est important d'acquérir des compétences en analyse et en résolution de problèmes pour élaborer et mettre en œuvre des solutions aux problèmes liés aux projets assignés.

• Fortes compétences en relations interpersonnelles et en communication, au besoin, pour communiquer avec le personnel d'autres ministères, surveiller les résultats de leurs activités de travail et obtenir les résultats souhaités par l'entremise d'autres ministères.

• Les compétences de communication orale et écrite éprouvées sont essentielles, au besoin, pour rencontrer les clients, transmettre l'état du projet ou modifier l'information, et maintenir une image professionnelle qui reflète positivement l'organisation.

• Fortes compétences en informatique, au besoin, dans le traitement de texte, la base de données et les applications de tableur. La capacité d'utiliser avec succès MS Project ou d'autres logiciels de gestion de projet similaires est essentielle.

• Il est important de connaître les exigences en matière de gestion des marchés, y compris la connaissance des modalités de vente.

• Gestion des coûts et connaissances générales en gestion des activités pour maximiser l'efficacité des projets assignés.

• Capacité de lire et d'interpréter correctement les dessins de tour d'ingénierie et d'intérieur.

VOYAGE: Ce poste nécessite des déplacements occasionnels en affaires. Les projets plus importants peuvent exiger que les gestionnaires soient sur place pendant toute la durée du processus (d'une à plusieurs semaines), y compris travailler sept jours par semaine et souvent plus de 12 heures par jour. Certains voyages internationaux peuvent être requis, et les employés devront conserver un passeport valide et obtenir un visa de travail

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are looking for an experienced Document Controller to join our Project Management team and support our growing project portfolio. This role plays a critical part in ensuring that technical and project documentation is accurately managed, controlled, and delivered throughout the lifecycle of complex pump manufacturing projects.
As a key member of the team, you will collaborate closely with engineering, procurement, manufacturing, quality, suppliers, and customers to ensure documentation is complete, compliant, approved, and available when needed. Your expertise will help maintain project quality, support contractual requirements, and contribute to successful project execution.
This is an exciting opportunity to join a specialized industrial environment during an important SAP transformation, offering exposure to international stakeholders and challenging cross-functional projects. What you will do:

• Manage project and engineering documentation throughout the full project lifecycle.

• Participate in project kick-off meetings and prepare Vendor Document Requirement Lists (VDRLs).

• Coordinate document submission, review, approval, and distribution activities.

• Maintain document registers, status reports, and document tracking systems.

• Control document revisions and ensure obsolete documentation is removed from circulation.

• Manage transmittals and document exchanges with customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.

• Maintain documentation within SharePoint, SAP, and other document management systems.

• Monitor documentation schedules and proactively follow up on outstanding deliverables.

• Support audits and final project documentation close-out activities.

• Prepare KPI reports and document control performance dashboards.

• Coordinate technical documentation across engineering, procurement, manufacturing, and quality functions.

• Ensure compliance with internal processes, contractual requirements, and document management standards.

What you need to succeed:
Required:

• Minimum 2 years of experience in document control within an industrial environment.

• Strong understanding of document management processes, document numbering, revision control, and document workflows.

• Experience working with SharePoint, SAP, EDMS platforms, or similar document management tools.

• Ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and manage competing priorities effectively.

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• Good English communication skills, both written and spoken, for interactions with international customers and suppliers.

• Ability to work independently and manage deadlines proactively.

Preferred:

• Diploma or Engineering degree.

• Experience within manufacturing, engineering, EPC, oil and gas, pumps, rotating equipment, or related industrial sectors.

• Experience with Aconex, TeamBinder, ProArc, or similar document management systems.

• Exposure to SAP implementation projects.

• Experience managing technical documentation in project-based environments.

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Meal vouchers.

• Access to a voluntary flexible compensation scheme allowing employees to optimize their salary package, such as health insurance, transport, or childcare.

• Be part of an experienced and international team.

• A good vibe working environment.

• The opportunity to grow your career within a solid and well-established international company.

• Be part of a dynamic organization undergoing continuous transformation and improvement.

• Office location: Burgos, Spain.

• Additional benefits may apply depending on the position an

Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP)

• Convert sales forecasts into executable manufacturing plans.

• Drive closure of shortages affecting assembly schedules.

• Align purchase schedules with sales forecasts and assembly requirements.

• Drive timely availability of long lead and critical materials.

• Proactively manage supply chain risks and escalations.
Project Planning & Customer Deliveries

• Define and monitor key milestones from Engineering Release through Invoicing.

• Work closely with Project Managers to ensure customer commitments are achieved.

• Support customer reviews by providing reliable execution and delivery forecasts.
Cross Functional Leadership

• Lead Tier-2 Operations Meetings and drive action closure.

• Coordinate with Sales, Project Management, Engineering, Procurement, Stores, Manufacturing, Quality, Logistics, and Finance teams.

• Drive organization-wide alignment towards achievement of business sales plans.
Inventory & MRP Management

• Execute and monitor Daily MRP Runs in SAP.

• Review and close MRP exception messages on a daily basis.

• Responsible for Packing Slip Creation in SAP to support dispatch and delivery activities.

• Drive material availability while optimizing inventory levels and working capital.

• Strong experience in Pump Manufacturing / Engineered-to-Order (ETO) Environment

At Sulzer Leeds, we design and build some of the world’s most advanced engineered pump packages — the kind that keep global infrastructure moving and can weigh anything up to 150 tonnes. Required Skills & Experience

Chez Sulzer Leeds, nous concevons et construisons quelques-uns des ensembles de pompes les plus perfectionnés du monde, le genre de pompes qui font bouger l'infrastructure mondiale et qui peuvent peser jusqu'à 150 tonnes. Alors que nous continuons à nous développer et à apporter des capacités clés à l'interne, nous sommes maintenant à la recherche d'un coordonnateur des expéditions de fret pour nous aider à prendre le plein contrôle de notre logistique d'importation, d'exportation et de transport lourd. Si vous vous développez dans des environnements d'ingénierie complexes et de grande valeur et que vous aimez le défi de l'out-of-gauge et de briser le fret en vrac, c'est l'occasion de jouer un rôle central dans la façon dont nous déplaçons certains des plus gros kits de l'industrie. Principales fonctions

• Coordonner les expéditions mondiales d'importation et d'exportation, en veillant au respect des règlements douaniers et des lois commerciales.

• Gérer les OOG et briser les expéditions en vrac, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les transporteurs spécialisés, les exploitants portuaires et les transitaires.

Compétences et expérience requises

• Expérience de la coordination du fret, de la planification du transport ou de la logistique – idéalement dans le domaine de l'ingénierie lourde ou du fret de projet.

• Connaissance de la manutention des marchandises hors jauge, en vrac ou surdimensionnée (route, mer ou multimodal).

• Une bonne compréhension des procédures douanières, des Incoterms et de la conformité au commerce international.

• Excellente organisation, communication et résolution de problèmes.

• Capacité de gérer plusieurs priorités dans un environnement accéléré et axé sur les projets.

Ce que nous vous offrons

Nous avons récemment investi considérablement dans la modernisation de notre installation Leeds, en créant un espace de travail plus lumineux, plus efficace et plus avancé, conçu pour soutenir un travail de haute qualité et une grande expérience des employés. Avantages de base

• Un salaire compétitif

• Un régime de bonus à l'échelle de l'entreprise

• Medicash Health Cash Plan (couverture des frais de soins de santé quotidiens tels que les services dentaires, optiques et GP)

• 33 jours

• Cotisations définies

• Programmes d'aide aux employés

• Réductions sur le shopping, le divertissement et le style de vie

• Location de voiture personnelle à rabais pour vous, famille et amis

• Apprentissage continu par les voies d'apprentissage Sulzer

• Soutien des forces armées – En tant que récipiendaire du Prix d'argent du Programme de reconnaissance des employeurs de la Défense, nous appuyons activement les anciens combattants, les réservistes et les bénévoles adultes cadets. Cela comprend des politiques qui permettent de disposer de temps pour l'entraînement, les camps et le déploiement, ainsi que l'accès à un réseau militaire interne croissant.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Manager to build and oversee a Field Service team. The team will be responsible for the installation, maintenance, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment across multiple client sites. The ideal candidate will possess solid technical expertise and strong leadership abilities, managing a team of field technicians, optimizing service processes, and ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction. This position requires frequent site visits, coordination with engineering and operations teams, and the ability to address complex technical and operational challenges efficiently.
Key Responsibilities

• Oversee profit and loss (P&L) responsibilities for the EMS field service operations, including budget management, cost control, and financial reporting.

• Collaborate with engineering, project management, and sales teams to support client projects and technical proposals.

• Serve as the primary technical escalation point for complex field service issues

• Lead, mentor, and manage a team of field service technicians specializing in electrical and mechanical equipment.

• Plan, assign, and optimize work orders, routes, and schedules to maximize efficiency and meet service deadlines.

• Coordinate installation, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of electrical and mechanical systems.

• Ensure compliance with safety regulations, company policies, and industry standards (OSHA, NEC, NFPA, etc.).

• Maintain accurate records of service activities, parts usage, and site documentation.

• Analyze performance metrics, including first-time fix rates, system uptime, and response times, and implement process improvements.

• Develop and maintain strong client relationships to ensure service satisfaction and promote additional service opportunities.

• Conduct site audits, field inspections, and on-the-job training for technicians.

• Develop and manage operational budgets, review cost efficiency, and ensure profitability of service operations.

Required Qualifications & Skills

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related technical field preferred. Equivalent experience in field services may be considered.

• Minimum of 5 to 7 years experience in field service management or equivalent technical supervision role supporting electrical and/or mechanical equipment.

• Strong technical knowledge of electrical systems, mechanical systems, PLCs, motor controls, power distribution, and industrial equipment.

• Proven experience in team leadership, performance management, and personnel development.

• Excellent problem-solving and decision-making skills under pressure.

• Proficient in field service management software, CRM systems, and route optimization tools .

• Strong verbal and written communication skills; ability to interact effectively with clients, team members, and management.

• Valid driver’s license with willingness to travel extensively to client sites.

• Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and manage operations across multiple sites.

Preferred Skills

• Experience in project management , equipment commissioning, and technical training.

• Knowledge of regulatory compliance for industrial electrical and mechanical systems.

• Experience managing budgets, service KPIs, and operational performance analytics.

Le superviseur des opérations, de la fabrication et de la production est chargé de superviser les activités quotidiennes de production ou de centre de service, en veillant à ce que les processus se déroulent en douceur, efficacement et en toute sécurité. Ce rôle supervise le personnel de niveau professionnel et assure le respect des normes de qualité et des calendriers de production ou de service.

Diriger la fonction d'entretien du site en fournissant un service d'entretien réactif et proactif et polyvalent sur tous les équipements et installations opérationnels. Responsable de l'établissement du calendrier prévu et de la supervision du respect et de l'achèvement en temps voulu des travaux. Augmenter l'efficacité opérationnelle du site, améliorer l'exécution du projet, prévoir un délai entre l'échec et la réduction des temps d'arrêt, gérer et mettre en oeuvre des plans d'amélioration, conduire des indicateurs de rendement clés (ICP) pour s'assurer que les exigences en matière de santé, de sécurité et d'environnement sont respectées. Gérer l'équipe sur les meilleures pratiques techniques.
Principaux points de vente de l'emploi
Sulzer étant une société multinationale, la fabrication de pompes centrifuges et ayant deux unités de fabrication peut offrir de nombreuses possibilités d'apprentissage dans le domaine de l'électricité, de la mécanique et de l'instrumentation.

Principales responsabilités et tâches

• 3. Veiller à ce que les exigences d'étalonnage et d'entretien de routine de divers systèmes électromécaniques, hydrauliques et pneumatiques soient respectées
4. Gérer le processus d'introduction de nouvelles machines, installations et équipements, de l'élaboration des spécifications à la gestion des fournisseurs jusqu'à l'installation complète en collaboration avec toutes les parties concernées
5. Gérer les entrepreneurs sur place pour s'assurer qu'ils satisfont aux exigences légales et à celles de l'entreprise
6. Veiller à ce que la fonction d'entretien fonctionne conformément aux politiques et procédures relatives à la santé, à la sécurité et à l'environnement du site pour assurer la sécurité du personnel et des visiteurs

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer, we're looking for a talented Manufacturing Engineer to join our Wexford team and play a critical role in shaping the future of our electronic and digital product manufacturing.

This is an exciting opportunity to become the Subject Matter Expert for electronic and digital products, working at the heart of innovation, production excellence, and continuous improvement. About Sulzer Wexford

Sulzer Wexford is a global centre of excellence for the design and manufacture of advanced pump control, monitoring, and digital solutions that help customers improve efficiency, reliability, and sustainability across water, wastewater, industrial, and commercial applications. Our products combine engineering expertise with smart technology to deliver world-class solutions used around the globe.

The Opportunity

As a key member of our Manufacturing Engineering team, you'll support both daily manufacturing operations and long-term strategic initiatives. You'll work closely with colleagues across Production, Product Development, Procurement, Quality, and Supply Chain, while also collaborating with suppliers and global teams to optimise manufacturing processes throughout the product lifecycle.

From supporting exciting new product launches to driving continuous improvement projects, you'll have a direct impact on how we manufacture and deliver innovative electronic products to customers worldwide.

What You'll Be Doing

• Act as the manufacturing engineering lead for electronic and digital products, supporting production performance, quality, and continuous improvement across the value stream.

• Support the introduction of new products into manufacturing, ensuring efficient, cost-effective production while providing design-for-manufacture feedback to Product Development teams.

• Carry out testing, validation, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis of electronic products, embedded systems, and pump control equipment.

• Collaborate with suppliers and internal stakeholders to resolve technical issues, manage component lifecycles, and drive product and process improvements.

• Maintain and enhance production test systems, including LabVIEW applications, firmware updates, functional testing procedures, and operator training.

• Create and maintain technical documentation, ensure compliance with quality and manufacturing standards, and support strategic projects that improve safety, quality, delivery, and cost performance.

What We're Looking For

Essential Qualifications & Experience

• Experience in the production or manufacture of electronic and digital products.

• Strong understanding of electronic schematics and PCB layouts.

• Experience testing and debugging embedded systems.

• Knowledge of electronic test equipment and testing methodologies.

• Familiarity with manufacturing standards such as IPC, ISO, RoHS and REACH.

• Experience applying Root Cause Corrective Action (RCCA) techniques.

• Proven ability to promote and support continuous improvement initiatives.

Desirable Skills

• Experience with NI LabVIEW test software.

• Knowledge of PCB CAD tools such as Altium.

• Electronic component lifecycle management experience.

• Familiarity with SAP ERP systems.

• Experience supporting New Product Introduction (NPI) programmes.

• Knowledge of Lean manufacturing tools and methodologies.

• Understanding of EMC and product safety standards.

• Experience with DraftSight, SolidWorks or NX.

What we offer you

• A competitive base salary

• Flex time with core hours of 09:30–14:30

• 26 days annual leave

• A defined pension contribution

• Free on‑site parking with reduced‑rate EV charging

• Subsidised on‑site canteen

• Maternity/paternity leave top‑up

• Access to Sulzer Learning Pathways for continuo

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Design Engineer is responsible for the design, construction, maintenance, and repair of plant buildings and machinery. This role ensures that engineering solutions meet operational, safety, and environmental standards while supporting continuous improvement in plant infrastructure and equipment.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Position Summary:
This position operates within the Order Related Engineering (ORE) department and is responsible for designing Sales Order specific motor control electrical schematics and entering the associated bill of material (BOM) into the ERP system. This position closely works with Project Engineer to support the submittal package and provide electrical expertise to the customers. Upon approval of the submittal package, this position is accountable for generating part numbers in the ERP system and releasing the finalized package to production. Furthermore, this position provides electrical engineering expertise to Tendering and Operations by reviewing project specifications and offering recommendations

Principal Duties and Responsibilities:

• Review project scope and specifications. Collaborate with Mechanical Engineer to organize hand-off meetings as necessary to ensure alignment and clarity.

• Design motor control electrical schematics to support production sales orders by reading and understanding specifications, quotes, purchase orders, or company scope worksheets.

• Enter parts and create assemblies of the motor control designs in the ERP system for procurement and production electrical assembly.

• Support Project Engineer with motor control design documentation required for sales order submittal packages.

• Check sales order specific electrical schematics (Drawings and BOM) created by other team members in ORE.

• Provides electrical review of specifications for Tendering, as assigned by ORE Manager.

• Provides electrical review and support to other departments, as assigned by ORE Manager

• Provide electrical support to field service technicians during installation and acceptance of products.

• Perform additional duties and participate in special projects as assigned.

Education & Experience:
Required:
Associate’s degree in electrical design with 5+ years of experience in motor control design.

Desired:
Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering with 2+ years of experience in motor control design.

Skills:
Required:

• CAD Experience in electrical schematic design

• ERP System Experience

• Ability to use technology and analysis tools (Excel, Outlook, web, databases).

Desired: AutoCAD Electrical and Vault
Knowledge of NEC Code

Decision Authority:
Accountability: Position is accountable for ensuring the accuracy and OTD of submittal package, fabrication drawings and Visual BOM updates. It is also accountable to maintain compliance with company standards and its safety policies

Responsibility: This position is responsible for making decisions related to electrical design, drawing creation, BOM verification and co-ordination between different departments. Also responsible for collaborating with Project Engineer during submittal approval process and support Operations.

Delegation: May delegate tasks such as Drawing checks and BOM verification to other team members within the ORE department, under the guidance of ORE Manager.

Approval Process: This position is responsible for approving electrical components and drawings before release to production. Collaborate with Project Engineer in the customer approval process for Submittal packages.

About the role

Job Summary
The MTCS Operations & Chemtech General Manager provides strategic and operational leadership for the MTCS manufacturing operations across the Americas, including full responsibility for the Mexico manufacturing facility and oversight of the Humble, Texas operation. This role is accountable for operational excellence, manufacturing strategy, customer delivery, financial performance, and continuous improvement while ensuring a safe, compliant, and high-performing organization.
• Lead all manufacturing and operational functions including Production, Project Management, Supply Chain, Quality, Business Improvement, and QESH to ensure safe, efficient, and customer-focused operations.

• Own operational performance, financial results, manufacturing strategy, and continuous improvement initiatives across the region.

• Drive operational excellence by improving quality, on-time delivery, cost, inventory, productivity, and cash performance.

• Partner closely with commercial leadership to align manufacturing capacity with customer demand and support profitable business growth.

• Build and develop high-performing leadership teams while fostering a culture of accountability, safety, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

• Ensure compliance with all corporate policies, regulatory requirements, environmental standards, and health & safety expectations across regional operations.

Qualifications & Criteria

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline; MBA preferred.

• 15+ years of progressive leadership experience within industrial manufacturing or engineered equipment environments.

• Proven experience leading manufacturing operations with full P&L, operational, and cost accountability.

• Strong background in supply chain management, project execution, lean manufacturing, and continuous improvement methodologies.

• Demonstrated success leading organizational transformation, operational excellence, and change management initiatives within global organizations.

• Exceptional leadership, financial, and strategic planning skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and deliver sustainable business results.

• National and international job growth options

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The IT Lead Expert is responsible for leading complex IT initiatives and providing expert-level guidance in the design, implementation, and optimization of IT systems and infrastructure. This role ensures alignment of IT solutions with business objectives and drives innovation across the organization. This job profile is intended for recognized subject matter experts in a job area. Required to manage large projects or processes with limited oversight from manager. Coaches, reviews and delegates work to lower level professionals. We are looking for an experienced IT Project Manager SAP S/4HANA to join our Business Transformation Program and play a key role in one of Sulzer's most strategic global initiatives.
In this position, you will help shape and drive the design, implementation, and rollout of Sulzer's global SAP S/4HANA template. Working closely with program leadership, business stakeholders, and implementation partners, you will provide expert guidance, governance, and quality assurance to ensure successful project delivery and long-term business value.
This is an exciting opportunity for a seasoned SAP transformation professional who enjoys operating at a strategic level while influencing solution design, governance, and delivery across a complex international environment.

What you will do:

• Lead quality assurance activities across all phases of the SAP S/4HANA transformation program.

• Establish and manage quality gates, review frameworks, and deliverable acceptance criteria.

• Review solution designs and technical deliverables to ensure alignment with business requirements and SAP best practices.

• Promote SAP Clean Core principles and support scalable, sustainable solution design.

• Conduct phase-gate and readiness reviews across program milestones.

• Assess project risks, dependencies, open issues, and mitigation plans.

• Provide expert advice and recommendations to program leadership and key stakeholders.

• Facilitate collaboration between business teams, IT functions, SAP specialists, and implementation partners.

• Review implementation partner deliverables, estimates, and design recommendations.

• Challenge solutions that introduce unnecessary complexity, risk, or long-term maintenance effort.

• Support future-state process design and operating model decisions.

• Contribute industry best practices from engineering, manufacturing, project-based, and service organizations.

• Drive continuous improvement by introducing lessons learned and proven practices from large transformation programs.

• Support knowledge transfer and capability development across the organization.

• Promote a collaborative One Sulzer culture focused on teamwork, customer value, and continuous improvement.

What you need to succeed:
Required:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.

• More than 15 years of experience in SAP consulting, solution architecture, transformation leadership, or program governance.

• Minimum 5 to 6 years of SAP S/4HANA implementation experience, including large-scale global transformation programs.

• Strong knowledge of SAP S/4HANA, SAP Activate methodology, global template design, integration, data migration, testing, cutover, and deployment.

• Experience supporting global template design, fit-to-standard workshops, solution governance, and design reviews.

• Deep understanding of manufacturing, engineering, project-based, Engineered-to-Order (ETO), Configured-to-Order (CTO), and service business environments.

• Experience working with senior business stakeholders and major ERP implementation partners.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.

• Excellent stakeholder man

Wir suchen einen erfahrenen IT-Projektmanager SAP S/4HANA, der an unserem Business Transformation Program teilnimmt und eine Schlüsselrolle in einer der strategischsten globalen Initiativen von Sulzer spielt.

In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Programmleitung, Geschäftsinteressenten und Implementierungspartnern bieten Sie fachkundige Beratung, Governance und Qualitätssicherung, um eine erfolgreiche Projektabwicklung und einen langfristigen Geschäftswert zu gewährleisten.

• Führen Sie Qualitätssicherungsaktivitäten in allen Phasen des SAP S/4HANA Transformationsprogramms.

• Etablieren und verwalten Sie Qualitätsgates, Review-Frameworks und lieferbare Akzeptanzkriterien.

• Überprüfen Sie Lösungsdesigns und technische Ergebnisse, um die Übereinstimmung mit den Geschäftsanforderungen und den Best Practices von SAP sicherzustellen.

• Durchführung von Phase-Gate- und Bereitschaftsüberprüfungen über Meilensteine des Programms hinweg.

• Bewerten Sie Projektrisiken, Abhängigkeiten, offene Probleme und Minderungspläne.

• Bieten Sie fachkundige Beratung und Empfehlungen für die Programmführung und die wichtigsten Stakeholder.

• Erleichterung der Zusammenarbeit zwischen Geschäftsteams, IT-Funktionen, SAP-Spezialisten und Implementierungspartnern.

• Überprüfen Sie die Ergebnisse der Implementierungspartner, Schätzungen und Designempfehlungen.

• Herausfordern von Lösungen, die unnötige Komplexität, Risiken oder langfristigen Wartungsaufwand mit sich bringen.

• Unterstützen Sie zukünftige Prozessdesign- und Betriebsmodellentscheidungen.

• Tragen Sie Best Practices aus den Bereichen Engineering, Fertigung, projektbasierte und Serviceorganisationen bei.

• Steigern Sie kontinuierliche Verbesserungen durch die Einführung von Lektionen und bewährten Praktiken aus großen Transformationsprogrammen.

• Unterstützung des Wissenstransfers und der Entwicklung von Fähigkeiten im gesamten Unternehmen.

• Förderung einer kollaborativen One-Sulzer-Kultur, die sich auf Teamarbeit, Kundennutzen und kontinuierliche Verbesserung konzentriert.

Was Sie brauchen, um erfolgreich zu sein:

• Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Informatik, Informationstechnologie oder einer verwandten Disziplin.

• Mehr als 15 Jahre Erfahrung in SAP-Beratung, Lösungsarchitektur, Transformation Leadership oder Programm Governance.

• Mindestens 5 bis 6 Jahre Erfahrung in der Implementierung von SAP S/4HANA, einschließlich groß angelegter globaler Transformationsprogramme.

• Umfangreiche Kenntnisse über SAP S/4HANA, SAP Activate-Methodik, globales Template-Design, Integration, Datenmigration, Testen, Cutover und Deployment.

• Erfahrung in der Unterstützung von globalem Template-Design, Fit-to-Standard-Workshops, Solution Governance und Design Reviews.

Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Résumé de l'emploi
L'expert principal en TI est chargé de diriger des initiatives complexes en TI et de fournir des conseils de niveau expert dans la conception, la mise en oeuvre et l'optimisation des systèmes et infrastructures de TI. Ce rôle assure l'alignement des solutions informatiques sur les objectifs opérationnels et stimule l'innovation dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. Ce profil d'emploi est destiné aux experts reconnus dans un domaine d'emploi. Requis pour gérer de grands projets ou processus avec une surveillance limitée de la part du gestionnaire. Les entraîneurs, les critiques et les délégués travaillent pour les professionnels de niveau inférieur. Nous cherchons un gestionnaire de projet informatique expérimenté SAP S/4HANA pour rejoindre notre programme de transformation opérationnelle et jouer un rôle clé dans l'une des initiatives mondiales les plus stratégiques de Sulzer.
Dans cette position, vous aiderez à façonner et piloter la conception, la mise en œuvre et le déploiement du modèle SAP S/4HANA global de Sulzer. En étroite collaboration avec le leadership du programme, les intervenants en affaires et les partenaires de mise en oeuvre, vous fournirez des conseils d'experts, une gouvernance et une assurance de la qualité pour assurer la réussite de l'exécution des projets et la valeur opérationnelle à long terme.
C'est une occasion passionnante pour un professionnel chevronné de la transformation SAP qui aime fonctionner à un niveau stratégique tout en influençant la conception de solutions, la gouvernance et la prestation dans un environnement international complexe.

Ce que vous ferez :

• Diriger les activités d'assurance de la qualité à toutes les étapes du programme de transformation SAP S/4HANA.

• Établir et gérer des portes de qualité, des cadres d'examen et des critères d'acceptation livrables.

• Examiner les conceptions de solutions et les livrables techniques afin d'assurer l'harmonisation avec les exigences opérationnelles et les pratiques exemplaires du SAP.

• Promouvoir les principes de base de SAP Clean et soutenir la conception de solutions évolutives et durables.

• Effectuer des examens de phase et de préparation à tous les jalons du programme.

• Évaluer les risques, les dépendances, les questions en suspens et les plans d'atténuation.

• Fournir des conseils et des recommandations d'experts au leadership du programme et aux intervenants clés.

• Faciliter la collaboration entre les équipes d'affaires, les fonctions informatiques, les spécialistes du SAP et les partenaires de mise en oeuvre.

• Examiner les produits livrables, les estimations et les recommandations de conception des partenaires de mise en oeuvre.

• Défier les solutions qui introduisent une complexité inutile, des risques ou des efforts d'entretien à long terme.

• Soutenir la conception des processus à l'avenir et les décisions relatives aux modèles d'exploitation.

• Contribuer aux pratiques exemplaires de l'industrie en matière d'ingénierie, de fabrication, de projets et de services.

• Favoriser l'amélioration continue en introduisant les leçons apprises et les pratiques éprouvées des grands programmes de transformation.

• Appuyer le transfert des connaissances et le développement des capacités dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.

• Promouvoir une culture collaborative One Sulzer axée sur le travail d'équipe, la valeur client et l'amélioration continue.

Ce que vous devez réussir:
Requis :

• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en informatique, technologie de l'information ou discipline connexe.

• Plus de 15 ans d'expérience en conseil SAP, en architecture de solutions, en leadership de transformation ou en gouvernance de programmes.

• Au moins 5 à 6 ans d'expérience de mise en œuvre de SAP S/4HANA, y compris des programmes de transformation mondiale à grande échelle.

• Forte connaissance de SAP S/4HANA, de la méthodologie SAP Active, de la conception de modèles globaux, de l'intégration, de la migration des données, des tests, de la réduction et du déploiement.

• Expérience appuyant la conception de modèles mondiaux, des ateliers adaptés aux normes, la gouvernance des solutions et des examens de conception.

• Connaissance approfondie de la fabrication, de l'ingénierie, du projet, de l'ingénierie à la commande (ETO), de la configuration à la commande (CTO) et des environnements d'affaires de service.

• Expérience de la collaboration avec les principaux intervenants commerciaux et les principaux partenaires de mise en oeuvre du PGI.

• Fortes capacités d'analyse, de résolution de problèmes et de prise de décisions.

• Excellent acteur

Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

A Sulzer, l'innovazione è stata al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo da quasi 200 anni. Come leader globale nei servizi di ingegneria dei fluidi e attrezzature rotanti, progettiamo, produciamo e manteniamo pompe critiche, agitatori, compressori, motori, generatori e turbomacchine che mantengono le industrie essenziali in movimento. Dal trattamento delle acque e delle acque reflue all'energia, ai prodotti chimici, alla produzione di energia e alla produzione industriale, le nostre tecnologie aiutano i clienti a migliorare l'efficienza, l'affidabilità e la sostenibilità nelle loro operazioni.

Stiamo ora creando un nuovo ruolo che contribuirà a plasmare il futuro della conformità ambientale e delle prestazioni energetiche nel nostro business UK & Irlanda. Questa è un'opportunità entusiasmante per un esperto professionista ambientale per sviluppare e guidare un'agenda ambientale strategica in più sedi di produzione e servizi, garantendo l'eccellenza della conformità, supportando le ambizioni di sostenibilità di Sulzer. • Sostenere la riduzione del carbonio, la riduzione dei rifiuti e i progetti di efficienza delle risorse.

• Partner con i team del sito, i leader operativi e gli organismi esterni per integrare le migliori pratiche.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer, innovation has been at the heart of everything we do for nearly 200 years. As a global leader in fluid engineering and rotating equipment services, we design, manufacture and maintain critical pumps, agitators, compressors, motors, generators and turbomachinery that keep essential industries moving. From water and wastewater treatment to energy, chemicals, power generation and industrial manufacturing, our technologies help customers improve efficiency, reliability and sustainability across their operations.

We are now creating a new role that will help shape the future of environmental compliance and energy performance across our UK & Ireland business. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Environmental professional to develop and drive a strategic environmental agenda across multiple manufacturing and service locations, ensuring compliance excellence while supporting Sulzer's sustainability ambitions. What You'll Do

• Manage and continuously improve Sulzer's ISO 14001 Environmental Management System across UK & Ireland sites.

• Ensure compliance with environmental legislation, permits and regulatory requirements.

• Help shape and deliver environmental and energy initiatives that support Sulzer's sustainability ambitions.

• Conduct audits, assessments and compliance reviews across multiple locations.

• Monitor environmental and energy performance, identifying opportunities for improvement.

• Support carbon reduction, waste minimisation and resource-efficiency projects.

• Investigate environmental incidents and drive corrective actions.

• Partner with site teams, operational leaders and external bodies to embed best practice.

• Keep the business informed of emerging environmental legislation and compliance requirements.

What We're Looking For

• Experience in environmental compliance within manufacturing, engineering or industrial environments.

• Strong knowledge of UK environmental legislation and management systems.

• Proven experience managing or supporting ISO 14001.

• ISEP membership (or working towards it).

• Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.

• The confidence to challenge, influence and drive improvements across multiple sites.

• A proactive mindset and passion for sustainability.

What we offer you

Core Benefits

• A competitive basic salary

• Annual personal bonus scheme based on company and personal performance

• Private Medical Insurance

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.

• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.

• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.

• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• As a Silver Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we welcome and support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers with policies for training, camps and deployment, plus a growing internal military network.

We’ve recently invested significantly in modernising our Leeds facility — creating a brighter, more efficient, and more advanced workspace designed to support high‑quality work and a great employee experience. Alongside our upgraded facilities, you’ll benefit from:

• Free, secure parking with EV charging

• Multi-faith prayer room

• Newly modernised work areas

• Lively Sports & Social Club with events & prize draws

• 24/7 onsite gym

• Subsidised vending machines

• Subsidised Canteen offering hot and cold food
