Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Bei Sulzer steht Innovation seit fast 200 Jahren im Mittelpunkt von allem, was wir tun. Als weltweit führender Anbieter von Dienstleistungen im Bereich Fluidtechnik und Rotationsmaschinen entwerfen, fertigen und warten wir kritische Pumpen, Rührer, Kompressoren, Motoren, Generatoren und Turbomaschinen, die wichtige Industrien in Bewegung halten. Von der Wasser- und Abwasseraufbereitung bis hin zu Energie, Chemikalien, Stromerzeugung und industrieller Fertigung helfen unsere Technologien unseren Kunden, Effizienz, Zuverlässigkeit und Nachhaltigkeit im gesamten Betrieb zu verbessern.

Wir schaffen jetzt eine neue Rolle, die dazu beitragen wird, die Zukunft der Umweltkonformität und der Energieeffizienz in unserem britischen und irischen Geschäft zu gestalten. Dies ist eine aufregende Gelegenheit für einen erfahrenen Umweltexperten, eine strategische Umweltagenda an mehreren Produktions- und Servicestandorten zu entwickeln und voranzutreiben, um Compliance-Exzellenz zu gewährleisten und gleichzeitig die Nachhaltigkeitsziele von Sulzer zu unterstützen. Was du tun wirst

• Verwalten und kontinuierlich verbessern Sulzer ISO 14001 Umweltmanagementsystem in Großbritannien und Irland Standorten.

• Gewährleistung der Einhaltung von Umweltgesetzen, Genehmigungen und regulatorischen Anforderungen.

• Helfen Sie bei der Gestaltung und Umsetzung von Umwelt- und Energieinitiativen, die die Nachhaltigkeitsziele von Sulzer unterstützen.

• Durchführung von Audits, Assessments und Compliance-Reviews an mehreren Standorten.

• Überwachung der Umwelt- und Energieeffizienz und Ermittlung von Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten.

• Unterstützung von Projekten zur CO2-Reduktion, Abfallminimierung und Ressourceneffizienz.

• Untersuchen Sie Umweltvorfälle und führen Sie Korrekturmaßnahmen durch.

• Zusammenarbeit mit Standortteams, Betriebsleitern und externen Stellen, um Best Practices einzubetten.

• Halten Sie das Unternehmen über neue Umweltgesetze und Compliance-Anforderungen auf dem Laufenden.

Was wir suchen

• Erfahrung in der Umweltkonformität in Fertigungs-, Ingenieur- oder Industrieumgebungen.

• Starke Kenntnisse der britischen Umweltgesetzgebung und Managementsysteme.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Verwaltung oder Unterstützung von ISO 14001.

• ISEP-Mitgliedschaft (oder darauf hinarbeiten).

• Hervorragende Kommunikation und Stakeholder Engagement Fähigkeiten.

• Das Vertrauen, Verbesserungen an mehreren Standorten herauszufordern, zu beeinflussen und voranzutreiben.

• Eine proaktive Denkweise und Leidenschaft für Nachhaltigkeit.

Was wir Ihnen bieten

Kernvorteile

• Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Grundgehalt

• Jährliches persönliches Bonussystem basierend auf Unternehmens- und persönlicher Leistung

• Vertrauliche Unterstützung über Employee Assistance Programme.

Wir haben vor kurzem erheblich in die Modernisierung unserer Leeds-Anlage investiert und einen helleren, effizienteren und fortschrittlicheren Arbeitsplatz geschaffen, der qualitativ hochwertige Arbeit und eine großartige Mitarbeitererfahrung unterstützt. Sulzer Pumps (Canada) Inc. - Flow Equipment, is a division of Sulzer Ltd, and is a global leader in the development and supply of pumping solutions and related equipment to its key markets oil and gas, power, general industries (mining, metals, food, CPI & fertilizers) and water. We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Area Sales Manager to join our team in the sales and services (parts and repairs) of Sulzer Pumps / Water & Industrial Business Unit products (pumps, mixers, agitators, compressors etc.). descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Key
• Responsibilities

Perform inspection of incoming gas turbine components, materials, and assemblies to ensure compliance with engineering drawings, specifications, purchase orders, OEM requirements, and customer standards.
Conduct dimensional, visual, and documentation inspections using appropriate measuring equipment and inspection techniques.
Review and verify material certificates, certificates of conformity, inspection reports, and supplier documentation to ensure compliance and traceability requirements are met.
Inspect turbine rotors, casings, shafts, blades, vanes, bearings, fasteners, and associated components for conformity prior to release into production.
Identify, document, and support the resolution of non-conforming materials through established quality management processes.
Maintain accurate inspection records and support internal, customer, and third-party quality audits.
Support the implementation and continuous improvement of QA/QC procedures, standards, and inspection practices.
Monitor and provide feedback on supplier quality performance and incoming product quality trends.
Liaise with the Inspection Supervisor, Engineering, Procurement, Project Engineers, and Production teams to resolve quality-related issues and minimise disruption to repair and overhaul activities.
Ensure all inspection activities are performed in accordance with Sulzer quality procedures, customer requirements, and applicable industry standards.

Required Skills:

Experience in a Quality Control, QA/QC, or Inspection role within an engineering or manufacturing environment.
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, technical documentation, and manufacturing standards.
Experience using precision measuring equipment such as verniers, micrometres, bore gauges, height gauges.
Understanding of material certification, traceability, and quality documentation requirements.
Knowledge of dimensional inspection techniques and engineering tolerances.
Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach to inspection activities.
Good communication and documentation skills.
Familiarity with supplier quality management, non-conformance reporting, and root cause investigations.
Competent in Microsoft Office applications.

Desirable Skills

Experience inspecting gas turbine, steam turbine, compressor, pump, or other rotating equipment components.
Understanding of OEM quality requirements and repair documentation.
Knowledge of ISO 9001 quality management systems.
Experience using quality management systems.

What we offer you

Competitive base salary
Inclusion in a company-wide bonus program
Attractive overtime pay scheme
33 days of annual leave
Private medical insurance
On-site parking
Access to various discounts on everyday shopping, entertainment, and lifestyle
An Employee Assistance Programme offering confidential support services, including counselling and resources to help manage personal and work-related issues, enhancing overall well-being and productivity
Continuous learning and development opportunities through on-the-job training and Sulzer Learning Pathways, our dedicated online platform for professional growth

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

About the role

Job Summary
Responsible for end-to-end Procure-to-Pay (P2P) process, ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant supplier transactions in line with company policies, internal controls, IFRS, and KSA regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities

• Execute the full P2P cycle, including invoice processing and 3-way matching (PO, GR, Invoice).

• Record supplier invoices accurately in SAP with correct coding and project allocations.

• Resolve invoice discrepancies and coordinate with Procurement, Supply Chain, and business stakeholders.

• Ensure compliance with Purchase Order policies and the "No PO, No Pay" principle.

• Prepare and process payment runs in compliance with Delegation of Authority (DoA) and internal controls.

• Maintain AP aging reports and support cash flow forecasting activities.

• Ensure compliance with KSA VAT, Withholding Tax (WHT), and ZATCA Phase 2 e-Invoicing requirements.

• Reconcile vendor statements, AP sub-ledger accounts, and GR/IR balances, resolving outstanding items promptly.

• Support month-end and year-end close activities, including AP-to-GL reconciliations.

• Provide required documentation and support for internal and external audits.

• Drive process improvements, automation initiatives, and P2P efficiency enhancements.

• Collaborate with Finance, Treasury, Operations, Procurement, and external vendors to ensure smooth AP operations.

Qualifications / Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in accounting, Finance, or related field.

• 3-5 years of experience in Accounts Payable, General Ledger, or similar finance roles.

• Strong SAP and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

• Knowledge of KSA VAT, WHT, and ZATCA e-Invoicing requirements.

• Experience with international procurement, Incoterms, LCs, and intercompany accounting is preferred.

Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Il Manufacturing Supervisor è responsabile delle principali operazioni di produzione giornaliere presso la struttura Humble, mentre guida obiettivi di sicurezza, qualità, consegna, produttività e miglioramento continuo. Il ruolo fornisce la leadership di prima linea ai dipendenti di produzione attraverso la fabbricazione, la saldatura, la lavorazione, l'assemblaggio e le relative attività di produzione, supportando la collaborazione regionale, le iniziative di eccellenza operativa e gli impegni dei clienti. La posizione collabora strettamente con i team Engineering, Planning, Supply Chain, Quality, Maintenance, Project Management e Operations in tutte le Americhe per migliorare il throughput, ottimizzare l'utilizzo delle capacità, ridurre i rifiuti, rafforzare l'esecuzione e sostenere la crescita redditizia. Funzioni essenziali

• Condurre attività di produzione quotidiana attraverso la fabbricazione, la saldatura, la lavorazione, l'assemblaggio e i relativi centri di lavoro di produzione.

• Assicurare il rispetto dei requisiti di sicurezza, standard di qualità, istruzioni di lavoro e procedure di produzione.

• Allocare il lavoro e le risorse per sostenere i programmi di produzione e gli impegni di consegna del cliente.

• Monitorare le prestazioni e le problematiche relative alla sicurezza, qualità, produttività o consegna.

• Implementare e sostenere le pratiche di Lean Manufacturing tra cui 5S, gestione visiva, lavoro standard, Kaizen e iniziative di riduzione dei rifiuti.

• Facilitate l'analisi delle cause della radice e le azioni correttive relative a rottami, rielaborazione, downtime, strozzature, e il programma manca.

• Partner con Manutenzione per migliorare l'affidabilità delle apparecchiature tramite TPM, manutenzione preventiva e programmi di riduzione dei tempi di fermo.

• Pianificazione della capacità di supporto, utilizzo del lavoro, gestione del backlog e attività di bilanciamento del carico di lavoro.

• Sviluppare la capacità dei dipendenti attraverso formazione, coaching, cross-training e sviluppo di matrice di competenze.

• Collabora con team di produzione, ingegneria, pianificazione e supply chain in tutte le Americhe per condividere le migliori pratiche e sostenere il miglioramento delle prestazioni regionali.

• Partner con i team di Project Management, Customer Service e Sales per garantire le priorità di produzione in linea con i requisiti del cliente e gli impegni del progetto.

• Supporta l'implementazione di iniziative di eccellenza operativa, miglioramenti dei processi e programmi di miglioramento della produttività.
Qualifiche

• Grado tecnico, grado associato, laurea o esperienza di produzione equivalente richiesto.

• Minimo 5 anni di esperienza nella fabbricazione, saldatura, assemblaggio, lavorazione o operazioni industriali.

• Precedente supervisione o esperienza di leadership del team richiesto.

• Esperienza di applicazione dei principi di Lean Manufacturing e metodi di miglioramento continuo.

• Forte problem solving, comunicazione, coaching e capacità organizzative.

• Esperienza interpretando disegni di produzione, metriche di produzione e dati operativi.

• bilingue in spagnolo e inglese

• Esperienza di lavoro con sistemi ERP come SAP, IFS o equivalente preferito.

• Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, TPM, OEE o altre certificazioni di eccellenza operative preferite.

Cosa ti offriamo

• 15 giorni di tempo libero e 12 giorni festivi

• 401k piano con una partita del 6%

• Piano sanitario completo tra cui medico, dentale, visione, vita, disabilità a breve e a lungo termine

• Programma benessere stimolante

descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Bilingual Manufacturing Manager/Supervisor is responsible for leading daily manufacturing operations at the Humble facility while driving safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and continuous improvement objectives. The role provides frontline leadership to production employees across fabrication, welding, machining, assembly, and related manufacturing activities while supporting regional collaboration, operational excellence initiatives, and customer commitments. The position partners closely with Engineering, Planning, Supply Chain, Quality, Maintenance, Project Management, and Operations teams across the Americas to improve throughput, optimize capacity utilization, reduce waste, strengthen execution, and support profitable growth. Essential Functions

• Lead daily manufacturing activities across fabrication, welding, machining, assembly, and related production work centers.

• Ensure compliance with safety requirements, quality standards, work instructions, and manufacturing procedures.

• Allocate labor and resources to support production schedules and customer delivery commitments.

• Monitor manufacturing performance and address issues affecting safety, quality, productivity, or delivery.

• Implement and sustain Lean Manufacturing practices including 5S, visual management, standard work, Kaizen, and waste reduction initiatives.

• Facilitate root cause analysis and corrective actions related to scrap, rework, downtime, bottlenecks, and schedule misses.

• Partner with Maintenance to improve equipment reliability through TPM, preventive maintenance, and downtime reduction programs.

• Support capacity planning, labor utilization, backlog management, and workload balancing activities.

• Develop employee capability through training, coaching, cross-training, and skills matrix development.

• Collaborate with manufacturing, engineering, planning, and supply chain teams across the Americas to share best practices and support regional performance improvement.

• Partner with Project Management, Customer Service, and Sales teams to ensure manufacturing priorities align with customer requirements and project commitments.

• Support implementation of operational excellence initiatives, process improvements, and productivity enhancement programs.
Qualifications

• Technical degree, Associate degree, Bachelor degree, or equivalent manufacturing experience required.

• Minimum 5 years of manufacturing experience in fabrication, welding, assembly, machining, or industrial operations.

• Previous supervisory or team leadership experience required.

• Experience applying Lean Manufacturing principles and continuous improvement methodologies.

• Strong problem-solving, communication, coaching, and organizational skills.

• Experience interpreting manufacturing drawings, production metrics, and operational data.

• Bilingual in Spanish and English

• Experience working with ERP systems such as SAP, IFS, or equivalent preferred.

• Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, TPM, OEE, or other operational excellence certifications preferred.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Le superviseur de la fabrication est responsable de diriger les opérations quotidiennes de fabrication à l'installation Humble tout en conduisant des objectifs de sécurité, de qualité, de livraison, de productivité et d'amélioration continue. Ce rôle fournit un leadership de première ligne aux employés de production dans les activités de fabrication, de soudage, d'usinage, d'assemblage et de fabrication connexes, tout en appuyant la collaboration régionale, les initiatives d'excellence opérationnelle et les engagements des clients. Le poste s'associe étroitement avec les équipes d'ingénierie, de planification, de chaîne d'approvisionnement, de qualité, d'entretien, de gestion de projet et d'exploitation des Amériques pour améliorer le rendement, optimiser l'utilisation des capacités, réduire les déchets, renforcer l'exécution et soutenir une croissance rentable. Fonctions essentielles

• Diriger les activités quotidiennes de fabrication à travers la fabrication, le soudage, l'usinage, le montage et les centres de production connexes.

• Assurer le respect des exigences de sécurité, des normes de qualité, des instructions de travail et des procédures de fabrication.

• Allouer du travail et des ressources pour soutenir les calendriers de production et les engagements de livraison des clients.

• Surveiller la performance de la fabrication et régler les problèmes de sécurité, de qualité, de productivité ou de livraison.

• Faciliter l'analyse des causes profondes et les mesures correctives liées à la ferraille, au retravail, aux temps d'arrêt, aux goulets d'étranglement et aux retards dans le calendrier.

• Partenaire avec les équipes de gestion de projet, de service à la clientèle et de vente pour s'assurer que les priorités de fabrication correspondent aux exigences du client et aux engagements du projet.

• Appuyer la mise en oeuvre d'initiatives d'excellence opérationnelle, d'amélioration des processus et de programmes d'amélioration de la productivité.

• Expérience de l'application des principes de la fabrication du plomb et des méthodes d'amélioration continue.

• Forte capacité de résolution de problèmes, de communication, de coaching et d'organisation.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Stiamo cercando un individuo orientato al dettaglio e orientato alla qualità per unire il nostro team come ispettore di qualità per motori elettrici e attrezzature rotanti. Il candidato di successo sarà responsabile per l'ispezione di prodotti, materiali e processi per garantire l'adesione a standard di qualità stabiliti e specifiche del cliente. Responsabilità:

• Condurre ispezioni approfondite di materiali in entrata, lavorazione e prodotti finiti per verificare la conformità a standard e specifiche di qualità.

• Utilizzare vari strumenti di ispezione e attrezzature per valutare la qualità del prodotto, come pinze, micrometri e manometri.

• Identificare e documentare difetti di qualità, discrepanze e non conformità.

• Iniziare azioni correttive per problemi di qualità in collaborazione con team di produzione e ingegneria.

• Mantenere registri e report di ispezione precisi e dettagliati.

• Condurre l'analisi della causa principale per problemi di qualità e attuare misure preventive.

• Collabora con altri dipartimenti per migliorare i processi e le procedure di qualità.

• Resta aggiornato sugli standard e sulle normative di qualità del settore.

• Volontà di lavorare straordinario come necessario.

Qualifiche:

• Almeno 1 anno di esperienza nell'ispezione di qualità relativa alla lavorazione.

• Forte attenzione ai dettagli e alle capacità di problem solving.

• Capacità di leggere e interpretare progetti, disegni di ingegneria e specifiche.

• Capace di utilizzare strumenti di ispezione e attrezzature.

• Conoscenza dei principi e metodologie di controllo della qualità.

• Ottima comunicazione e competenze interpersonali.

• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e come parte di una squadra.

• Diploma di scuola superiore o equivalente.

• Motore elettrico / attrezzatura rotante esperienza di riparazione preferita.

DEMANAZIONI PHYSICHE

• Durante l'esecuzione dei compiti di questo lavoro, a volte sarebbe richiesto di stare in piedi, camminare, sedersi, raggiungere con mani e braccia, salire o equilibrio, stoop o ginocchio, parlare e sentire, e utilizzare le dita e le mani per sentire oggetti.

• Capacità di sollevare e/o muoversi fino a 50 libbre

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are seeking a detail-oriented and quality-focused individual to join our team as a Quality Inspector for electric motors and rotating equipment. The successful candidate will be responsible for inspecting products, materials, and processes to ensure adherence to established quality standards and customer specifications. Responsibilities:

• Conduct thorough inspections of incoming materials, work-in-progress, and finished products to verify conformance to quality standards and specifications.

• Utilize various inspection tools and equipment to assess product quality, such as calipers, micrometers, and gauges.

• Identify and document quality defects, discrepancies, and non-conformances.

• Initiate corrective actions for quality issues in collaboration with production and engineering teams.

• Maintain accurate and detailed inspection records and reports.

• Conduct root cause analysis for quality problems and implement preventive measures.

• Collaborate with other departments to improve quality processes and procedures.

• Stay updated on industry quality standards and regulations.

• Willingness to work overtime as needed.

Qualifications:

• At least 1 year experience in quality inspection related to machining.

• Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to read and interpret blueprints, engineering drawings, and specifications.

• Capable in using inspection tools and equipment.

• Knowledge of quality control principles and methodologies.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

• High school diploma or equivalent.

• Electric motor / rotating equipment repair experience preferred.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

• While performing duties of this job, would occasionally be required to stand, walk, sit, reach with hands and arms, climb or balance, stoop or kneel, talk and hear, and use fingers and hands to feel objects.

• Ability to lift and/or move up to 50 pounds

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sintesi del lavoro
L'ingegnere meccanico è responsabile per la ricerca, la pianificazione, la progettazione e lo sviluppo di prodotti e sistemi meccanici. Questo include strumenti, controlli, motori e macchine utilizzate nella produzione, trasmissione e misura di energia.
Questo profilo di lavoro è destinato a professionisti precoci che applicano una vasta conoscenza teorica e richiedono la capacità di indagare e analizzare i problemi. Le soluzioni sono tipicamente discusse/verificati con un membro più anziano. Posizione Riepilogo:
Questa posizione opera all'interno del reparto Order Related Engineering (ORE) ed è responsabile dell'ambito di progetto di comprensione completo per determinare il requisito per lo sviluppo di un pacchetto di presentazione. Il pacchetto include la progettazione meccanica, i disegni General Arrangement (GA) e la preparazione di componenti meccanici specifici per gli ordini di vendita individuali. Il ruolo riguarda la compilazione e il coordinamento dello sviluppo di Pacchetti Presentatali in stretta collaborazione con Motor Control Designers e ORE Manager. Inoltre, questa posizione gestirà il processo di approvazione di presentazione con i clienti, garantendo feedback tempestivo e risoluzione. Dopo l'approvazione, la posizione è responsabile per la generazione di disegni di fabbricazione, la creazione di numeri di parte all'interno del sistema ERP, e la pubblicazione del pacchetto finalizzato alla produzione. Inoltre, la posizione fornisce competenze ingegneristiche meccaniche a Tendering rivedendo le specifiche del progetto e offrendo raccomandazioni.

Principali doveri e responsabilità:

• Rivedere il campo di applicazione e le specifiche del progetto e organizzare riunioni di hand-off se necessario per garantire l'allineamento e la chiarezza.

• Progettazione di componenti meccanici, assemblaggi e disegni di disposizione generali specifici per gli ordini di vendita utilizzando Autodesk Inventor e mantenere i file associati all'interno del sistema di gestione di Autodesk Vault.

• Creare e gestire i pacchetti presenti attraverso il processo di approvazione del cliente, garantendo il rilascio tempestivo e accurato.

• Aggiornare e mantenere i flussi di lavoro degli ordini di vendita all'interno del sistema Visual ERP.

• Verificare e verificare disegni meccanici e bollette di materiali (BOM) preparati da altri membri del team all'interno del reparto ORE per garantire precisione e conformità.

• Condurre le revisioni delle specifiche meccaniche per sostenere le attività di tendering, come assegnato dal ORE Manager.

• Fornire supporto tecnico ad altri dipartimenti come diretto dal ORE Manager.

• Assist tecnici di produzione e assistenza sul campo offrendo supporto meccanico durante la fabbricazione e l'installazione dei prodotti.

• Eseguire ulteriori compiti e partecipare a progetti speciali come assegnato.

Istruzione e esperienza:
Richiesto:
Laurea in ingegneria meccanica con 2+ anni di esperienza.

Desired:
Laurea in ingegneria meccanica e gestione del progetto certificazione professionale (PMP) con 2 anni di esperienza.

Competenze:
Richiesto:

• CAD Experience nella modellazione e nella stesura 3D

• ERP System Experience.

• Capacità di utilizzare strumenti di tecnologia e analisi (Excel, Outlook, web, database).

Desired:

• Autodesk Inventore

• Conoscenza degli standard ASME Y 14.5M 2018.

Autorità di decisione:
Responsabilità: La posizione è responsabile per garantire l'accuratezza e OTD del pacchetto di presentazione, disegni di fabbricazione e aggiornamenti di Visual BOM. Questa posizione è anche responsabile per mantenere il rispetto degli standard aziendali e delle sue politiche di sicurezza.

Responsabilità: Questa posizione è responsabile di prendere decisioni relative alla progettazione meccanica, alla creazione di disegni, alla verifica BOM e al coordinamento tra diversi dipartimenti. Responsabile anche della gestione del processo di approvazione del cliente e del supporto Operazioni.

Delegazione: Questa posizione può delegare compiti come il disegno di assegni e la verifica BOM ad altri membri del team all'interno dell'O

About the role

Job Summary
The Mechanical Engineer is responsible for researching, planning, designing, and developing mechanical products and systems. This includes instruments, controls, engines, and machines used in energy production, transmission, and measurement.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Position Summary:
This position operates within the Order Related Engineering (ORE) department and is responsible for comprehensive understanding project scope to determine the requirement for developing a Submittal Package. Submittal package includes mechanical design, General Arrangement (GA) drawings and the preparation of mechanical components specific to individual sales orders. The role involves compiling and coordinating the development of Submittal Packages in close collaboration with Motor Control Designers and the ORE Manager. Additionally, this position will manage the submittal approval process with customers, ensuring timely feedback and resolution. Upon approval, the position is accountable for generating fabrication drawings, creating part numbers within the ERP system, and releasing the finalized package to production. Furthermore, the position provides mechanical engineering expertise to Tendering by reviewing project specifications and offering recommendations.

Principal Duties & Responsibilities:

• Review project scope and specifications and organize hand-off meetings as necessary to ensure alignment and clarity.

• Create and manage submittal packages through the customer approval process, ensuring timely and accurate release.

• Update and maintain sales order workflows within the Visual ERP system.

• Review and verify mechanical drawings and bills of materials (BOMs) prepared by other team members within the ORE department to ensure accuracy and compliance.

• Conduct mechanical specification reviews to support tendering activities, as assigned by the ORE Manager.

• Provide mechanical engineering support to other departments as directed by the ORE Manager.

• Assist Production and field service technicians by offering mechanical support during fabrication and product installation.

• Perform additional duties and participate in special projects as assigned.

Education & Experience:
Required:
Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering with 2+ years of experience.

Desired:
Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering and project management professional certification (PMP) with 2+ years of experience.

Skills:
Required:

• CAD Experience in 3D modeling and drafting

• ERP System Experience.

• Ability to use technology and analysis tools (Excel, Outlook, web, databases).

Desired:

• Autodesk Inventor

• Knowledge of ASME Y 14.5M 2018 standards.

Decision Authority:
Accountability: Position is accountable for ensuring the accuracy and OTD of submittal package, fabrication drawings and Visual BOM updates. This position is also accountable to maintain compliance with company standards and its safety policies.

Responsibility: This position is responsible for making decisions related to mechanical design, drawing creation, BOM verification and co-ordination between different departments. Also responsible for managing the customer submittal approval process and supporting Operations.

Delegation: This position may delegate tasks such as Drawing checks and BOM verification to other team members within the O

Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Stellenbeschreibung
Der Maschinenbauer ist verantwortlich für die Erforschung, Planung, Konstruktion und Entwicklung mechanischer Produkte und Systeme. Dazu gehören Instrumente, Steuerungen, Motoren und Maschinen, die bei der Energieerzeugung, -übertragung und -messung eingesetzt werden.
Dieses Stellenprofil richtet sich an Berufseinsteiger, die ein breites theoretisches Wissen anwenden und die Fähigkeit benötigen, Probleme zu untersuchen und zu analysieren. Lösungen werden in der Regel mit einem älteren Mitglied diskutiert / verifiziert. Positionsübersicht:
Diese Position ist innerhalb der Order Related Engineering (ORE) -Abteilung tätig und ist für das umfassende Verständnis des Projektumfangs verantwortlich, um die Anforderungen für die Entwicklung eines Einreichungspakets zu ermitteln. Das Einreichungspaket umfasst mechanisches Design, General Arrangement (GA)-Zeichnungen und die Vorbereitung von mechanischen Komponenten, die für individuelle Verkaufsaufträge spezifisch sind. Die Aufgabe besteht darin, die Entwicklung von Submittal Packages in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Motor Control Designers und dem ORE Manager zusammenzustellen und zu koordinieren. Darüber hinaus wird diese Position den einreichenden Genehmigungsprozess mit den Kunden verwalten und eine rechtzeitige Rückmeldung und Lösung gewährleisten. Nach der Genehmigung ist die Position für die Erstellung von Fertigungszeichnungen, die Erstellung von Teilenummern im ERP-System und die Freigabe des fertigen Pakets in die Produktion verantwortlich. Darüber hinaus stellt die Position dem Tendering Maschinenbau-Know-how zur Verfügung, indem sie Projektspezifikationen überprüft und Empfehlungen anbietet.

Hauptpflichten und Zuständigkeiten:

• Überprüfen Sie den Projektumfang und die Spezifikationen und organisieren Sie bei Bedarf Übergabesitzungen, um die Ausrichtung und Klarheit zu gewährleisten.

• Entwerfen Sie mechanische Komponenten, Baugruppen und allgemeine Anordnungszeichnungen, die für Verkaufsaufträge mit Autodesk Inventor spezifisch sind, und pflegen Sie die zugehörigen Dateien innerhalb des Autodesk Vault-Managementsystems.

• Erstellen und Verwalten von Einsendungspaketen durch den Kundengenehmigungsprozess, um eine zeitnahe und genaue Freigabe zu gewährleisten.

• Aktualisieren und Pflegen von Bestellungsworkflows innerhalb des Visual ERP-Systems.

• Überprüfen und überprüfen Sie mechanische Zeichnungen und Stücklisten, die von anderen Teammitgliedern in der ORE-Abteilung erstellt wurden, um Genauigkeit und Konformität zu gewährleisten.

• Führen Sie mechanische Spezifikationen durch, um die vom ORE-Manager zugewiesenen Ausschreibungsaktivitäten zu unterstützen.

• Unterstützung des Maschinenbaus für andere Abteilungen, wie vom ORE-Manager geleitet.

• Unterstützen Sie Produktions- und Außendiensttechniker, indem Sie mechanische Unterstützung bei der Herstellung und Produktinstallation anbieten.

• Führen Sie zusätzliche Aufgaben aus und nehmen Sie wie zugewiesen an speziellen Projekten teil.

Bildung & Erfahrung:
Vorgeschrieben:
Bachelor-Abschluss in Maschinenbau mit 2+ Jahren Erfahrung.

Gewünscht:
Bachelor-Abschluss in Maschinenbau und Projektmanagement Professional Certification (PMP) mit 2+ Jahren Erfahrung.

Fähigkeiten:
Vorgeschrieben:

• CAD Erfahrung in der 3D-Modellierung und -Zeichnung

• ERP System Erfahrung.

• Fähigkeit, Technologie und Analysetools (Excel, Outlook, Web, Datenbanken) zu verwenden.

Gewünscht:

• Autodesk Erfinder

• Kenntnisse der ASME Y 14.5M 2018 Standards.

Entscheidungsbehörde:
Verantwortlichkeit: Position ist verantwortlich für die Gewährleistung der Genauigkeit und OTD von Einsendungspaket, Herstellungszeichnungen und Visual BOM-Updates. Diese Position ist auch verantwortlich für die Einhaltung der Unternehmensstandards und ihrer Sicherheitsrichtlinien.

Verantwortung: Diese Position ist verantwortlich für Entscheidungen in Bezug auf mechanisches Design, Zeichnungserstellung, Stücklistenprüfung und Koordination zwischen verschiedenen Abteilungen. Auch verantwortlich für die Verwaltung des einreichenden Genehmigungsprozesses des Kunden und die Unterstützung des Betriebs.

Delegation: Diese Position kann Aufgaben wie Zeichnungsprüfungen und Stücklistenüberprüfung an andere Teammitglieder innerhalb des O delegieren.

Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Résumé de l'emploi
L'ingénieur mécanique est responsable de la recherche, de la planification, de la conception et du développement de produits et de systèmes mécaniques. Cela comprend les instruments, les commandes, les moteurs et les machines utilisés dans la production, la transmission et la mesure de l'énergie.
Ce profil d'emploi est destiné aux professionnels en début de carrière qui appliquent de vastes connaissances théoriques et qui ont besoin de la capacité d'étudier et d'analyser les problèmes. Les solutions sont généralement discutées/vérifiées avec un membre plus âgé. Sommaire du poste :
Ce poste fonctionne au sein du département d'ingénierie liée à l'ordre (ORE) et est chargé de bien comprendre la portée du projet pour déterminer l'exigence d'élaborer un dossier de soumission. Le colis de soumission comprend la conception mécanique, les dessins d'arrangement général (GA) et la préparation de composants mécaniques propres aux commandes individuelles. Le rôle consiste à compiler et à coordonner le développement des packs de soumission en étroite collaboration avec Motor Control Designers et le gestionnaire ORE. De plus, ce poste gérera le processus d'approbation des soumissions avec les clients, en assurant la rétroaction et la résolution en temps opportun. Une fois approuvé, le poste est responsable de la production de dessins de fabrication, de la création de numéros de pièces dans le système PGI et de la libération du colis final à la production. De plus, le poste fournit une expertise en génie mécanique à l'appel d'offres en examinant les spécifications du projet et en proposant des recommandations.

Principales fonctions et responsabilités :

• Examiner la portée et les spécifications du projet et organiser des réunions de remise au besoin pour assurer l'alignement et la clarté.

• Concevoir des composants mécaniques, des assemblages et des dessins d'arrangements généraux spécifiques aux commandes de vente à l'aide d'Autodesk Inventor et gérer les fichiers associés dans le système de gestion d'Autodesk Vault.

• Créer et gérer des paquets de soumission par le biais du processus d'approbation des clients, en assurant une diffusion rapide et précise.

• Mettre à jour et maintenir les flux de travail des commandes dans le système ERP Visual.

• Examiner et vérifier les plans mécaniques et les factures de matériaux (BOM) préparés par d'autres membres de l'équipe au sein du service ORE pour assurer l'exactitude et la conformité.

• Effectuer des examens mécaniques des spécifications pour appuyer les activités d'appel d'offres, comme l'a assigné le gestionnaire de l'ORE.

• Fournir un soutien en génie mécanique aux autres ministères, conformément aux directives du gestionnaire de l'ORE.

• Aider les techniciens de production et de service sur le terrain en offrant un soutien mécanique pendant la fabrication et l'installation du produit.

• Exécuter des tâches supplémentaires et participer à des projets spéciaux selon les affectations.

Éducation et expérience :
Requis :
Baccalauréat en génie mécanique avec 2+ ans d'expérience.

Désiré :
Baccalauréat en génie mécanique et certification professionnelle de gestion de projet (PMP) avec 2+ années d'expérience.

Compétences :
Requis :

• CAD Expérience de la modélisation et de la rédaction 3D

• Expérience du système ERP.

• Capacité d'utiliser la technologie et les outils d'analyse (Excel, Outlook, web, bases de données).

Désiré :

• Inventeur automatique

• Connaissance des normes ASME Y 14,5M 2018.

Autorité décisionnelle:
Responsabilité : Le poste est responsable d'assurer l'exactitude et la DTO du dossier de soumission, des dessins de fabrication et des mises à jour visuelles du BOM. Ce poste est également responsable du respect des normes de l'entreprise et de ses politiques de sécurité.

Responsabilité : Ce poste est chargé de prendre les décisions relatives à la conception mécanique, à la création de dessins, à la vérification du BOM et à la coordination entre les différents ministères. Également responsable de la gestion du processus d'approbation de la soumission des clients et des Opérations d'appui.

Délégation : Ce poste peut déléguer des tâches telles que des vérifications de dessin et de BOM à d'autres membres de l'équipe au sein de l'O

L'ingénieur en développement de produits est chargé d'améliorer ou de développer de nouveaux produits, composants, équipements, systèmes, technologies ou procédés. Principales tâches et responsabilités
1. Programmes nouveaux et étend le logiciel existant dans C#.net pour la génération de modèles 3D et de dessins 2D sur l'interface ouverte NX et suit un concept de programmation existant.
2. Analyse et débogue les erreurs de programme jusqu'à la solution finale.
3. Documenter et démontrer les solutions en développant la documentation, les commentaires de code et le code clair.
4. Mettre à jour les connaissances professionnelles en étudiant les outils de développement 3D et les techniques de programmation connexes au NX.
5. Maintenir les logiciels en étudiant les besoins des utilisateurs, en leur conférant des compétences, en étudiant le flux des systèmes, l'utilisation des données et les processus de travail.
6. Le développement suit le cycle de vie du développement logiciel.
Réalisation de la mission d'ingénierie et d'organisation en accomplissant les tâches connexes au besoin

• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience prouvée en génie mécanique

• 3 ans d'expérience dans le développement d'applications NXOpen en utilisant C#

• Expérience dans la conception de logiciels, la programmation, le débogage, la documentation et les essais

• L'exposition à la méthodologie de développement logiciel Agile et Azure DevOps est bénéfique.

• Expérience avec le CAO paramétrique 3D et 2D et la manipulation d'expression

• Au moins 2 ans d'expérience dans la modélisation de surface.

• Analyse de l'information, résolution structurée des problèmes, communication efficace et travail d'équipe.

• Bonnes compétences en anglais (écrites et verbales) requises.

• Expérience en Turbo Machinery Engineering ou volonté de se développer dans ce domaine

Le responsable mondial des opérations commerciales est chargé de diriger la gestion commerciale du portefeuille mondial de réclamations de Sulzer, ce qui entraîne de solides résultats commerciaux et clients dans des projets complexes et de grande valeur dans les secteurs du pétrole et du gaz, de l'industrie et de l'énergie. Il s'agit d'un rôle principal, stratégique et opérationnel qui dirige une équipe de gestionnaires de contrats commerciaux, assurant une interprétation solide des contrats, un positionnement commercial et la réalisation d'objectifs commerciaux, tout en opérant à l'interface entre les clients, les partenaires EPC et les intervenants internes. En étroite collaboration avec le responsable mondial de l'excellence juridique, ce rôle combine la gestion stratégique de la relation client et l'engagement pratique dans des questions commerciales complexes, exigeant une solide expérience internationale, un jugement solide et une approche collaborative de leadership dans des environnements dynamiques et rapides.

Principales responsabilités et tâches

Ce rôle consiste à rendre compte directement de l'amélioration mesurable de la contribution et de l'EBITDA grâce à une gestion rigoureuse et axée sur les données.

Gestion du portefeuille des réclamations mondiales

• Diriger et gérer l'ensemble du portefeuille mondial des créances, en assurant le traitement efficace des créances complexes, de grande valeur et transfrontalières, en produisant des résultats financiers solides et en réduisant l'exposition aux créances. Responsabilité de gestion de ligne directe pour l'équipe de garantie après-vente globale.
Stratégie commerciale et positionnement contractuel

• Définir et orienter les stratégies commerciales et les positions contractuelles, y compris l'approche de négociation, les décisions de règlement et les possibilités de recouvrement des clients, des EPC et des fournisseurs.
Gestion des relations client & EPC

• Les relations avec le client principal et l'EPC, qui constituent la principale interface commerciale pour résoudre les revendications accrues tout en maintenant la confiance et la valeur du client à long terme.

• Leadership d'équipe et gestion du rendement

• Diriger, développer et gérer une équipe mondiale de gestionnaires de contrats commerciaux, diriger la responsabilisation, la capacité et la prestation par rapport aux objectifs opérationnels et aux ICR.
Alignement et intégration interfonctionnels

• Aligner le génie, la qualité, la chaîne d'approvisionnement, les services juridiques, les finances et les opérations pour assurer le règlement rapide et efficace des réclamations.

• Traduction technique à commerciale

Questo profilo di lavoro è destinato a professionisti specializzati che applicano conoscenze avanzate di un'area di lavoro. Richiesto di gestire progetti / processi indipendentemente con supervisione limitata. In genere, allenatori e recensioni il lavoro di professionisti di livello inferiore.

Il Partnering Manager porterà la funzione commerciale per i servizi di attrezzature rotanti, garantendo una crescita redditizia attraverso la gestione strategica dei contratti, i prezzi e l'impegno del cliente. Questo ruolo si concentra sulla fornitura di soluzioni di servizio a valore aggiunto per compressori, turbine, pompe e altre apparecchiature rotanti, pur mantenendo la conformità e la guida di eccellenza operativa.

Principali responsabilità
Strategia commerciale e sviluppo del mercato

• Sviluppare ed eseguire strategie commerciali su misura per il mercato del servizio attrezzature rotanti.

• Identificare opportunità per servizi post-vendita, aggiornamenti e accordi di servizio a lungo termine (LTSA).

• Monitorare le tendenze del settore, la concorrenza dell'OEM e il cliente ha bisogno di posizionare l'azienda come fornitore di servizi preferito.

•

Gestione dei contratti e dei titoli

• Negoziati di piombo per i contratti di servizio, accordi di manutenzione, e grandi revisioni.

• Assicurare una valutazione accurata dei costi e dei rischi per le offerte e le proposte.

• Gestisci il ciclo di vita del contratto, compresi i rinnovi e le variazioni, garantendo il rispetto dei termini tecnici e commerciali.

Prestazioni finanziarie

• Aumentare la crescita dei ricavi attraverso modelli di prezzi ottimizzati per parti di ricambio, servizi sul campo e riparazioni.

• Preparare bilanci, previsioni e analisi dei margini per i progetti di servizio.

• Monitorare i KPI come la redditività del contratto, i tassi di utilizzo e i costi per il servizio.

• Collabora con team di gestione, ingegneria e supply chain per garantire che la consegna dei servizi soddisfi gli obblighi contrattuali.

• Promuovere una cultura di sicurezza, conformità e customer-centricity.

• Miglioramento continuo dei processi e degli strumenti commerciali.

• Corso di laurea in business, ingegneria o campo relativo (MBA preferito).

• Forte conoscenza dei modelli di servizio OEM e aftermarket.

• Provato record di traccia nella negoziazione dei contratti e la gestione di accordi di servizio ad alto valore.

Operating in a strict Business-to-Business (B2B) environment, this leader will drive strategic Growth Driver Plans (GDP), champion channel partner and distributor networks, and directly oversee and mentor our Regional Marketing Team and our Order Entry/Sales Support Processing Team .

If you possess a strong commercial background rooted in pumps and fluid handling, combined with process optimization (LEAN/VBSS) and team leadership—and are based within practical traveling distance of our Easley, SC facility—we want to hear from you.

Key Accountabilities & Responsibilities:

• Spearhead business development tailored specifically to the municipal and industrial water/pumping markets, partnering with Regional Sales Heads and Segment Heads to execute monthly Growth Driver Plans (GDP).

• Optimize, support, and expand our network of distributors and channel partners across the industrial and municipal space to maximize market reach.

• Direct, mentor, and align the Regional Marketing team and the Order Entry Processing team to ensure seamless workflow, high morale, and tight coordination between marketing, sales operations, and order fulfillment.

• Drive the execution and high user adoption of sales optimization tools (Salesforce CRM, CPQ, SAPConf), monitoring utilization and resolving roadblocks to internal efficiency.

• Oversee data mining, ERP data accessibility, and management-level dashboards to track Order Intake (OI), Sales, and rolling forecasts.

• Liaise with Finance and Strategy to support budgeting, regular pipeline reviews, CRM maintenance, and the preparation of high-level corporate presentations.

• Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Marketing, or a related commercial/technical field (Master’s / MBA preferred).

• 8+ years of progressive commercial experience— with a mandatory, hands-on background in the municipal or industrial pumping world (B2B) . Must possess a thorough, practical comprehension of industrial channel partners, manufacturer's reps, and equipment distributors.

• Proven track record of managing, developing, and motivating cross-functional teams (specifically including marketing professionals and order entry/processing or customer service operations).

Location & Travel Requirements:

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer, we are driving exciting transformation projects across our manufacturing operations. As part of our SAP implementation journey, we are looking for a motivated MRP Controller to join our Burgos site and support the development of our planning capabilities.
This is an excellent opportunity for a planning professional who wants to build expertise in production planning, ERP systems, and manufacturing operations while contributing to a key business transformation project.
Key Responsibilities

• Run the MRP system on a daily basis, ensuring that planned production orders and requisitions are aligned with the Master Production Plan.

• Perform capacity analysis by regularly assessing workload versus the plant’s installed capacity, identifying bottlenecks and recommending additional shifts or resource reallocation through the system when needed.

• Monitor production plan compliance by tracking actual manufacturing progress against the scheduled plan, analyzing deviations such as scrap, mechanical failures, absenteeism or delays, and promptly rescheduling the system to keep it updated.

• Update and manage key performance indicators (KPIs).

To succeed in this role, you will need

• Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field.

• 1-3 years of experience in production planning, materials planning, supply chain, manufacturing operations, or similar environments.

• Experience working with ERP systems.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to manage priorities in a dynamic manufacturing environment.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills.

• Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel.

• Fluent Spanish and a good level of English.

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Meal vouchers.

• Be part of an experienced and international team.

• Be part of a dynamic organization undergoing continuous transformation and improvement.

Sur le rôle

Chez Sulzer, nous menons des projets de transformation passionnants dans nos activités de fabrication. Dans le cadre de notre parcours de mise en œuvre SAP, nous recherchons un contrôleur MRP motivé pour rejoindre notre site Burgos et soutenir le développement de nos capacités de planification.
C'est une excellente occasion pour un professionnel de la planification qui veut acquérir une expertise dans la planification de la production, les systèmes ERP et les opérations de fabrication tout en contribuant à un projet clé de transformation opérationnelle.
Principales responsabilités

• Exécuter quotidiennement le système MRP, en veillant à ce que les commandes et les demandes de production prévues soient conformes au plan directeur de production.

• Effectuer une analyse de la capacité en évaluant régulièrement la charge de travail par rapport à la capacité installée de l'usine, en identifiant les goulets d'étranglement et en recommandant des changements supplémentaires ou une réaffectation des ressources par l'intermédiaire du système, au besoin.

• Mettre à jour et gérer les indicateurs de rendement clés (ICP).

Pour réussir dans ce rôle, vous aurez besoin

• 1-3 ans d'expérience dans la planification de la production, la planification des matériaux, la chaîne d'approvisionnement, les opérations de fabrication ou des environnements semblables.

• Expérience de travail avec les systèmes ERP.

• Fortes compétences en communication et en collaboration.

• Behaviour requirement: Achievement Orientation, communication for result, teamwork, active learning, business awareness, problem solving and analytical thinking

• Ability to read and comprehend engineering drawings and data

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Description Summary
Machinist is responsible for machining and refurbishing turbine and rotating‑equipment components using conventional machine tools. This role requires hands‑on experience with manual lathes, HBM, VTL, 4‑jaw chuck setups, precision measuring tools, and the ability to consistently hold tight tolerances on critical turbine parts. Key Responsibilities

• Set up and operate manual lathes, mills, horizontal boring mills (HBM), vertical turret lathes (VTL), and related machining equipment.

• Perform advanced 4‑jaw chuck setups, indicating, and alignment of irregular, heavy, and split components.

• Machine turbine components including IGVs, diaphragms, rings, shafts, sleeves, and split casings.

• Achieve and verify tight machining tolerances (typically ±0.001" or as specified by drawings and procedures).

• Conduct dimensional inspections using micrometers, dial indicators, calipers, bore gauges, and other precision instruments.

• Read and interpret blueprints, repair drawings, travelers, and work instructions.

• Select correct tooling, speeds, feeds, and machining methods for each job.

• Safely handle large and heavy components using overhead cranes, lifts, and rigging
equipment.

Required Qualifications

• Ability to work a 12‑day, 10‑hour minimum schedule with 12‑day, 12‑hour schedules during outage seasons .

• 3–5+ years of experience operating manual lathes, mills, and conventional machining equipment.

• Strong proficiency with 4‑jaw chuck setups and precision indicating.

• Skilled in the use of precision measuring instruments (micrometers, indicators, bore gauges, etc.).

• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, blueprints, and repair procedures.

• Must supply basic personal hand tools.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in turbine repair, power generation, or heavy‑industrial machining.

• Knowledge of machining tolerances, fits, and GD&T.

• Experience operating overhead cranes and/or forklifts.

• Ability to machine large, heavy, and split turbine components.

Competencies

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

• Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment.

• Effective communication and problem‑solving skills.

• Strong commitment to safety and proper machining practices.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

matériel.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sintesi del lavoro
L'Industrial Motor & Generator Mechanic disassembla, ispezioni, pulisce, ripara, riassembla e supporta la sperimentazione di motori, generatori, pompe e relative attrezzature rotanti. Questo ruolo supporta le attrezzature mission-critical per utenze, infrastrutture idriche, estrazione mineraria, produzione, semiconduttore, aerospaziale, agricoltura, produzione alimentare e altri mercati industriali.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Industrial Motor & Generator Mechanic disassembles, inspects, cleans, repairs, reassembles, and supports testing of heavy-industrial motors, generators, pumps, and related rotating equipment. This role supports mission-critical equipment for utilities, water infrastructure, mining, manufacturing, semiconductor, aerospace, agriculture, food production, and other industrial markets.

Mechanically inclined candidates from developing technicians to experienced mechanics are encouraged to apply; direct motor shop experience is helpful but not required for all candidates.

Mechanics work in a skilled, team-oriented shop alongside winders, machinists, welders, test technicians, engineers, and supervisors to solve challenging repair problems together. Phoenix, Arizona

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Disassemble, inspect, repair, test, and reassemble mission-critical industrial motors, generators, pumps, gearboxes, and related electromechanical equipment used in heavy industry.

• Work on high-value rotating equipment serving power, water, mining, manufacturing, semiconductor, aerospace, agriculture, food production, and other industrial markets.

• Inspect and evaluate equipment condition, damage, failure evidence, repair requirements, and serviceability.

• Perform low-voltage and high-voltage electrical diagnostic testing and related electrical inspections on motors and generators.

• Troubleshoot mechanical and electromechanical problems using test results, inspection findings, drawings, repair history, and hands-on experience.

• Remove, install, fit, adjust, and repair mechanical components during disassembly, reassembly, shop repair, and on-site service.

• Inspect mechanical and electrical components for wear, damage, overheating, tracking, contamination, fit issues, and other repair concerns.

• Measure, verify, and record critical dimensions using micrometers, calipers, dial indicators, bore gauges, and other precision measuring tools.

• Identify, match-mark, organize, protect, clean, and document parts during teardown and repair.

• Perform alignment, fit checks, mechanical inspection, electrical checks, operational checks, and final inspection.

• Operate industrial motor repair tools and equipment after proper training.

• Read and apply work instructions, repair scopes, drawings, customer specifications, and quality requirements.

• Work directly with skilled teams to complete repairs correctly and efficiently.

• Document inspection results, test results, measurements, repair findings, and work performed.

• Follow all safety, quality, environmental, electrical test, lifting, rigging, and shop procedures.

• Maintain tools, equipment, parts, and work areas in a clean, organized, and safe condition.

• Perform other related duties as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

• Strong mechanical aptitude.

• Safe use of hand tools, power tools, and measuring instruments.

• Ability to follow verbal and written instructions, work instructions, and safety procedures.

• Strong organization, documentation habits, and attention to detail.

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team after proper training.

• Clear communication with supervisors and coworkers.

• Strong attention to safety, quality, and workmanship.

Minimum Qualifications

• High school diploma or equivalent.

• Mechanical aptitude and strong willingness to learn.

• Ability to safely perform physical work in an industrial shop environment.

• Ability to follow safety procedures, work instructions, and quality requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in industrial maintenance, mechanical repair, rotating equipment repair, automotive, diesel, heavy equipment, aviation, military, manufact

About the role

At Sulzer Leeds, we don't just manufacture pumps. We engineer some of the world's most advanced pumping solutions for critical applications across energy, water, infrastructure, industrial processing and emerging technologies.

Our Leeds facility is a global centre of excellence for the design, engineering and manufacture of highly specialised pumps and pumping systems. From bespoke, large-scale engineered solutions to complex rotodynamic technologies, our teams tackle some of the most demanding technical challenges in the industry.

As we continue to invest in our people, technology and capabilities, we are looking for talented individuals who want to make a real impact and build a rewarding career within a world-class engineering environment. Key Duties

• Assemble, build and fit complex centrifugal pump assemblies and associated equipment in line with engineering drawings, specifications and quality standards.

• Carry out mechanical fitting activities including bearing installation, shaft assembly, impeller fitting, seal installation and final pump build.

• Interpret engineering drawings, assembly instructions and technical documentation to ensure accurate assembly of components.

• Use precision measuring equipment to verify dimensions, tolerances and alignment

What We're Looking For

• Time-served Mechanical Fitter, Mechanical Assembly Technician, or equivalent mechanical engineering apprenticeship.

• Experience assembling rotating equipment such as pumps, compressors, gearboxes, turbines or similar precision-engineered machinery.

• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical specifications.

• Skilled in the use of hand tools, mechanical assembly equipment and precision measuring instruments.

• Strong understanding of mechanical tolerances, fits, alignments and assembly techniques.

• Experience working within a manufacturing, engineering or heavy industrial environment.

• A proactive approach to problem-solving with excellent attention to detail.

Operative Exzellenz

Sulzer est une société d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Résumé de l'emploi
Responsable de l'exécution réussie, de la gouvernance, du rendement commercial et de la réalisation de plusieurs projets au sein de l'organisation.
Ce rôle assure le leadership des coordonnateurs de projets, des ingénieurs et des gestionnaires de projets, s'assurant que les projets sont exécutés en toute sécurité, dans les délais prévus, dans les limites du budget et conformément aux obligations contractuelles et aux attentes des clients.
Le titulaire joue le rôle de principal point d'escalade pour les questions liées aux projets, stimule l'état de préparation des projets aux examens du Comité directeur, gère les risques commerciaux, y compris les dommages liquidés, les réclamations et les ordres de modification, et veille à ce que les projets soient terminés efficacement et à ce que les enseignements tirés soient mis en œuvre.

Principales responsabilités

Gestion d'équipe

• Diriger, coacher et superviser une équipe d'ingénieurs de projet et de gestionnaires de projet.

• Établir des stratégies d'exécution des projets, des priorités et des objectifs de rendement.

• Attribuer les ressources et équilibrer la charge de travail dans l'ensemble du portefeuille de projets.

• Procéder à des examens du rendement, à la planification du perfectionnement et à la planification de la relève du personnel du projet.

• Servir de premier niveau d'escalade pour les questions liées aux projets.

• Favoriser une culture de responsabilisation, de collaboration, de sécurité et d'amélioration continue.

Gestion de l'exécution des projets

• Superviser l'exécution de plusieurs projets EPC, Énergie, Infrastructure ou Industriel.

• Veiller à ce que les projets soient exécutés dans les limites du calendrier, du budget, de la qualité et des exigences en matière de SST.

• Surveiller les ICR, les progrès, les risques et l'utilisation des ressources.

• Effectuer des examens hebdomadaires des projets et des examens mensuels du portefeuille.

• Veiller à ce que les plans, les calendriers, les plans de rétablissement et les stratégies d'exécution demeurent à jour et réalisables.

• Favoriser l'identification proactive et l'atténuation des risques du projet.

Gestion commerciale et contractuelle

• Diriger la gestion des obligations contractuelles et des expositions commerciales.

• Examiner et traiter les risques liés aux dommages liquidés et élaborer des stratégies d'atténuation.

• Gérer les ordres de modification de contrat, les demandes de modification, les demandes de prorogation de délai et les négociations commerciales.

• Appuyer les activités d'évitement et de règlement des différends.

• Assurer la conformité contractuelle avec les clients, les partenaires et les fournisseurs.

• Participer aux négociations commerciales avec les clients et les sous-traitants au besoin.

• Coordonner avec les services juridiques et financiers les questions contractuelles.

Gouvernance du projet et préparation du comité directeur

• Établir des processus de gouvernance pour tous les projets.

• Veiller à ce que le projet soit prêt pour les examens du Comité directeur et de la haute direction.

• Valider les tableaux de bord, les prévisions, les registres des risques, les mises à jour commerciales et les plans d'atténuation avant la présentation.

• Présenter le rendement du projet, les risques, les possibilités et les mesures correctives à la haute direction.

• Veiller à ce que les décisions de gestion soient mises en oeuvre et suivies efficacement.

Clôture du projet et leçons retenues

• Diriger les activités officielles de clôture du projet.

• Veiller à ce que les listes de perforations, la documentation finale et les exigences de transfert soient remplies.

• Surveiller les règlements définitifs des comptes et la clôture commerciale.

• Saisir et institutionnaliser les enseignements tirés et les pratiques exemplaires.

Gestion des parties prenantes

• Agir comme interface principale entre les clients et les intervenants internes.

• Maintenir des relations solides avec les clients, les consultants, les fournisseurs et les sous-traitants.

• Coordonner les activités entre le génie, l'approvisionnement, la production, la planification, l'AQ/CQ, le HSE et les finances.

• Veiller à ce que les préoccupations des clients soient traitées rapidement et professionnellement.

• Conduire la satisfaction des clients et de répéter les opportunités d'affaires.

Excellence opérationnelle

• Favoriser la mise en œuvre des normes de gestion de projet et des meilleures pratiques.

• Surveiller les ICR du projet et les paramètres du portefeuille.

• Assurer le respect des procédures et des exigences de l'entreprise.

Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sintesi del lavoro
L'ingegnere meccanico è responsabile per la ricerca, la pianificazione, la progettazione e lo sviluppo di prodotti e sistemi meccanici. Questo include strumenti, controlli, motori e macchine utilizzate nella produzione, trasmissione e misura di energia.
Questo profilo di lavoro è destinato a professionisti precoci che applicano una vasta conoscenza teorica e richiedono la capacità di indagare e analizzare i problemi. Le soluzioni sono tipicamente discusse/verificati con un membro più anziano. Sulzer offre un'opportunità unica per gli ingegneri di pronto soccorso per avviare il loro viaggio professionale attraverso un programma di rotazione biennale dinamico. Questa esperienza immersiva fornisce un'esposizione diretta tra i principali dipartimenti della divisione Servizi di Sulzer, con l'obiettivo di un posizionamento permanente del reparto al completamento del programma.

Riepilogo della posizione: Il programma Rotational Engineer è un programma rotazionale di due anni progettato per attirare, sviluppare e mantenere ingegneri altamente potenziali e trasformativi attraverso l'esperienza rotazionale migliore in industria e lo sviluppo professionale. Questo programma supporta la Divisione Servizi nelle Americhe con importanti iniziative pratiche e strategiche che valorizzano l'eccellenza commerciale e operativa. Agisce come un ponte tra ingegneria, commerciale e operazioni – progettazione e realizzazione di soluzioni per il pavimento del negozio, automazione, supporto della documentazione tecnica, collaborazione con i fornitori e miglioramento continuo. I partecipanti ruotano attraverso quattro aree specializzate, concentrandosi su vendite, operazioni o ingegneria, ogni sei mesi:

• Turbine di vapore e compressore: revisioni e riparazioni, rotore e componenti, reverse engineering e parti di produzione, rerate di prestazioni, test di qualificazione delle prestazioni, soluzioni di ingegneria personalizzate e servizio di campo

• Turbina a gas (Industrial and Aeroderivative): revisioni e riparazioni, rotore e componenti, valutazioni metallurgiche, test delle prestazioni e assistenza sul campo

• Pompe: revisioni e riparazioni, rotore e componenti, reverse engineering e parti di produzione, ottimizzazione delle prestazioni, retrofit, collaudo idraulico e servizio di campo

• Servizi elettromeccanici: revisioni e riparazioni di motori e generatori, rewind generatore, produzione di bobina ad alta tensione, servizi di ingegneria e servizi di campo

Rotazioni I & II: accuratamente selezionati per abbinare le tue attuali competenze e future ambizioni, garantendo un inizio personalizzato e arricchinte al programma.

Rotazioni III & IV: Si prende la ruota - scegliere da una serie di opportunità tra i dipartimenti per approfondire le competenze, esplorare nuovi interessi e modellare il vostro percorso unico.

I candidati saranno considerati per tutti i luoghi del Service Center di assunzione che includono ma non limitato alle seguenti città:

Houston, TX, Margate, FL, Chattanooga, TN, Barboursville, WV, Los Angeles, CA, Joliet, IL, Aurora, CO, Baton Rouge, LA, Piemonte, SC, Odessa, TX, Mobile, AL, Salt Lake City, UT, Phoenix, AZ, Gillette, WY, Colton, CA e Orange, TX.

Tutti i candidati devono essere disposti a trasferirsi in uno di questi luoghi, o altri siti Sulzer mentre nel programma. Sulzer fornisce una indennità di alloggio regolata localmente e un rimborso di chilometraggio alla prossima posizione di rotazione, insieme a cinque giorni lavorativi di tempo di trasferimento (esclusi i posizionamenti a casa).

Funzioni

• Partecipare o condurre compiti di lavoro, doveri di produzione e iniziative di miglioramento del processo identificate e assegnate dal Supervisore.

• Progettare, sviluppare, implementare o aggiornare disegni, istruzioni di lavoro, procedure, documentazione tecnica, strumenti e miglioramenti di correzione.

• Collabora con i team interni e i fornitori esterni per la fonte e qualificare le soluzioni.

• Equilibrare immediatamente il supporto per la risoluzione dei problemi con progetti strategici a lungo termine.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Mechanical Engineer is responsible for researching, planning, designing, and developing mechanical products and systems. This includes instruments, controls, engines, and machines used in energy production, transmission, and measurement.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Sulzer is offering a unique opportunity for early-career engineers to jumpstart their professional journey through a dynamic two-year rotational program. This immersive experience provides direct exposure across key departments within Sulzer’s Services Division, with the goal of permanent department placement upon program completion.

Position Summary: The Rotational Engineer program is a two-year rotational program designed to attract, develop, and retain high-potential, transformative engineers through best-in-industry rotational experience and professional development. This program supports the Services Division in the Americas by leading hands-on and strategic initiatives that enhance commercial and operational excellence. Acts as a bridge between engineering, commercial, and operations – designing and implementing shop-floor solutions, automation, supporting technical documentation, collaborating with vendors, and driving continuous improvement. Participants will rotate through four specialized areas, focusing on sales, operations, or engineering, each lasting six months:

• Steam Turbines and Compressor: Overhauls and assembly, rotor and component repairs, reverse engineering and parts manufacturing, performance rerates, performance qualification tests, custom engineering solutions, and field service

• Gas Turbine (Industrial and Aeroderivative): Overhauls and assembly, rotor and component repairs, metallurgical evaluations, performance testing, and field service

• Pumps: Overhauls and assembly, rotor and component repairs, reverse engineering and parts manufacturing, performance optimization, retrofits, hydraulic testing, and field service

• Electro-Mechanical Services: Overhauls and repairs of motors and generators, generator rewind, high voltage coil manufacturing, engineering services, and field services

Rotations I & II : Carefully selected to match your current skills and future ambitions, ensuring a personalized and enriching start to the program.

Rotations III & IV : You take the wheel—choose from a range of opportunities across departments to deepen expertise, explore new interests, and shape your unique path.

Candidates will be considered for all hiring Service Center locations which include but not limited to the following cities:

Houston, TX, Margate, FL, Chattanooga, TN, Barboursville, WV, Los Angeles, CA, Joliet, IL, Aurora, CO, Baton Rouge, LA, Piedmont, SC, Odessa, TX, Mobile, AL, Salt Lake City, UT, Phoenix, AZ, Gillette, WY, Colton, CA, and Orange, TX.

All candidates must be willing to relocate to any of these locations, or other Sulzer sites while in the program. Sulzer provides a locally adjusted housing allowance and mileage reimbursement to next rotation location, along with five business days of transfer time (excluding home-based placements).

Functions

• Participate or lead job tasks, production duties, and process improvement initiatives identified and assigned by Supervisor.

• Design, develop, implement, or upgrade drawings, work instructions, procedures, technical documentation, tooling and fixturing improvements.

• Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors to source and qualify solutions.

• Balance immediate troubleshooting support with long-term strategic projects.

Über die Rolle

Stellenbeschreibung
Der Maschinenbauer ist verantwortlich für die Erforschung, Planung, Konstruktion und Entwicklung mechanischer Produkte und Systeme. Dazu gehören Instrumente, Steuerungen, Motoren und Maschinen, die bei der Energieerzeugung, -übertragung und -messung eingesetzt werden.

Lösungen werden in der Regel mit einem älteren Mitglied diskutiert / verifiziert. Diese immersive Erfahrung bietet eine direkte Präsenz in wichtigen Abteilungen innerhalb der Sulzer Services Division, mit dem Ziel der dauerhaften Abteilung Platzierung nach Abschluss des Programms.

Dieses Programm unterstützt die Services Division in Amerika durch praktische und strategische Initiativen, die die kommerzielle und operative Exzellenz verbessern. • Pumpen: Überholungen und Montage, Rotor- und Komponentenreparaturen, Reverse Engineering und Teileherstellung, Leistungsoptimierung, Nachrüstungen, hydraulische Prüfungen und Außendienst

• Elektromechanische Dienstleistungen: Überholungen und Reparaturen von Motoren und Generatoren, Generatorrückwicklung, Herstellung von Hochspannungsspulen, technische Dienstleistungen und Außendienste

Rotations III & IV: Sie nehmen das Steuer – wählen Sie aus einer Reihe von Möglichkeiten in allen Abteilungen, um Fachwissen zu vertiefen, neue Interessen zu erkunden und Ihren einzigartigen Weg zu gestalten.

Alle Kandidaten müssen bereit sein, an einen dieser Standorte oder andere Sulzer-Standorte umzuziehen, während sie sich im Programm befinden. Sulzer bietet eine lokal angepasste Wohnzulage und Kilometererstattung an den nächsten Rotationsstandort sowie fünf Werktage Transferzeit (ausgenommen Heimplatzierungen).

Funktionen

Sur le rôle

Résumé de l'emploi
L'ingénieur mécanique est responsable de la recherche, de la planification, de la conception et du développement de produits et de systèmes mécaniques. Cela comprend les instruments, les commandes, les moteurs et les machines utilisés dans la production, la transmission et la mesure de l'énergie.

Fonctions
