descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sintesi del lavoro
Il Project Engineer è responsabile del supporto alla pianificazione, esecuzione e monitoraggio dei progetti tecnici. Il ruolo consiste nel lavorare in modo indipendente con la supervisione generale e contribuire al successo del progetto attraverso il supporto tecnico e analitico.
Questo profilo di lavoro è destinato a professionisti esperti che applicano la conoscenza pratica di un'area di lavoro e lavorano indipendentemente con la supervisione generale. SUMMARY:
La posizione ingegneristica del progetto verifica che i componenti e le assemblee soddisfino tutti i requisiti di progettazione applicabili, gli standard di ingegneria, le specifiche del cliente e i codici e gli standard ASME applicabili. Questo ruolo svolge calcoli, valutazioni tecniche e recensioni dettagliate di disegno per confermare il rispetto degli standard di ingegneria, documentazione di progettazione e codici ASME. L'ingegnere contribuisce a garantire che le parti, i materiali e le assemblee selezionate soddisfino i requisiti funzionali e normativi dell'applicazione nucleare.
FUNZIONI ESSENTIALI:

DEUXIÈME RESPONSABILITÉS:

Ce profil d'emploi est destiné aux professionnels expérimentés qui appliquent les connaissances pratiques d'un domaine d'emploi et travaillent indépendamment avec une supervision générale. À propos de nous

Chez Sulzer, vous êtes habilité à donner des résultats supérieurs. En tant que pionnier de l'industrie, nous avons un fier héritage d'innovation et nous continuons d'évoluer pour l'avenir. Rejoignez notre histoire et créez votre propre impact en développant votre expertise et en construisant des solutions qui contribuent à rendre nos vies plus sûres, plus intelligentes et plus durables.
Sulzer est un leader mondial en ingénierie des fluides. Nous nous spécialisons dans les technologies de pompage, d'agitation, de mélange, de séparation et de purification pour les fluides de tous types. Nos clients bénéficient de notre engagement en matière d'innovation, de performance et de qualité et de notre réseau réactif de 180 usines et centres de services de calibre mondial. Sulzer a son siège social à Winterthur, en Suisse, depuis 1834.
Rejoignez notre équipe APAC dans la division Flow en Australie en tant qu'ingénieur de projet.

Que ferez-vous ?

En tant qu'ingénieur de projet, vos responsabilités quotidiennes comprendront :

• Gérer et coordonner les projets des clients depuis la réception des commandes jusqu'à la livraison, en veillant à ce que la portée, la qualité, le budget et les exigences du calendrier soient atteints.

• Fournir un appui technique en matière d ' ingénierie, y compris la configuration de l ' équipement (SAP), examiner la conception des fiches de données en fonction des spécifications du client et préparer la documentation et les rapports relatifs au projet

• Agir comme interface principale entre les clients, les ventes, l'ingénierie, la fabrication et les fournisseurs pour assurer la réussite de l'exécution du projet.

• soutenir l'équipe de vente afin d'atteindre la croissance divisionnaire et les objectifs financiers.

• Promouvoir et maintenir l'engagement de Sulzer envers la sécurité, la qualité et l'amélioration continue de toutes les activités du projet.

Ce que vous apporterez à Sulzer

Pour être un ingénieur de projet réussi, vous aurez idéalement :

• Baccalauréat en génie mécanique ou équivalent.

• Expérience démontrée en matière de rédaction de rapports techniques / documentation technique

• Exposition et expérience à SAP, D365 ERP, logiciel de contrôle de projet comme ACONEX, etc

• Responsabilité en matière d'exécution du projet (échéancier, contrôle des coûts, documentation et facturation en temps voulu).

• Fortes compétences en communication.

• Capacité de s'engager et de travailler avec les autres.

• Expérience dans la prise de responsabilité de l'exécution des commandes et le maintien des relations avec les parties prenantes

Ce que nous vous offrons

• Régime de bonus annuel.

Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

• Perform maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of machine tools including manual lathes, surface grinders, milling machines, CNC equipment, and horizontal and vertical machining centers.

• Diagnose mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic issues.

• Perform machine alignments, calibrations, and precision adjustments.

• Install, test, and commission new or rebuilt equipment.

• Maintain preventive maintenance schedules for shop equipment.

• Read and interpret mechanical drawings, blueprints, and technical manuals.

• Support production teams to minimize downtime.

• Ensure compliance with safety policies and OSHA standards.

• Maintain accurate maintenance records and documentation.

• Assist with equipment upgrades and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Observe Company Safety Policy and Procedures; follow and support all STS Safety Policies and ISO Procedures.

• Complete and properly document all tasks assigned by the Maintenance Supervisor.

• Report any mechanical issues identified during inspections to the Maintenance Supervisor.

• Work closely and maintain clear communication with other departments, mechanical personnel, Leadman, and Supervisors.

• Complete all company-required training programs.
Required Qualifications

• High School Diploma or GED required.

• Technical or vocational training in machining, industrial maintenance, or related field preferred.

• 7–10 years’ experience maintaining machine tools or industrial equipment.

• Strong knowledge of machining operations and precision measurement tools.

• Experience with CNC troubleshooting preferred.

• Ability to read schematics and technical drawings.

• Strong mechanical aptitude and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work independently and within a team environment.
Preferred Skills

• Experience in turbomachinery, rotating equipment, or heavy industrial repair.

• Familiarity with vibration analysis or alignment practices.

• PLC troubleshooting experience is a plus.

• Forklift or overhead crane experience preferred.
Physical Requirements

• Ability to lift up to 50 lbs.

• Standing, bending, and working in an industrial shop environment.

• Ability to work around rotating machinery and heavy equipment.
Work Environment

• Industrial repair and machine shop setting.

• Exposure to noise, moving equipment, oils, and machining materials.

• PPE required at all times.

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Join Sulzer’s Flow Equipment division and play a key role in delivering competitive and technically robust solutions for large-scale infrastructure and energy projects. Working closely with Sales, Engineering, Project Management, and our global manufacturing network, you will lead the preparation of complex tenders, develop technical solutions, assess project risks, and support customers throughout the bidding process. This is an excellent opportunity for an engineering professional who enjoys combining technical expertise with commercial insight in an international environment. Main responsibilities:

• Prepare high-quality technical and commercial tenders for infrastructure and energy projects, ensuring accuracy, competitiveness, and on-time delivery.

• Review customer specifications and analyze technical requirements to develop optimal pumping solutions.

• Collaborate with specialist departments and manufacturing sites to define and configure pumps, accessories, and related systems.

• Evaluate technical and commercial project risks and develop mitigation strategies during the bidding phase.

• Support customers and sales teams with technical consultations, specifications, and proposal presentations.

• Manage supplier and subcontractor enquiries, evaluate quotations, and lead technical discussions when required.

• Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders throughout the tender preparation process to ensure a competitive and compliant offer.

• Participate in customer negotiations and ensure a smooth handover from tendering to project execution teams after contract award.

• Maintain accurate data and documentation within sales and tendering systems.

What you need to succeed:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Process Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in tendering, sales engineering, project management, pump engineering, or a related field.

• Strong technical knowledge of pumps, rotating equipment, and associated systems.

• Experience in complex technical tenders and commercial proposal preparation.

• Knowledge of desalination and water transport applications will be considered a strong advantage.

• Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across international and multidisciplinary teams.

• Strong commercial awareness combined with a customer-focused mindset.

• Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and solve complex technical challenges.

• Fluent English.

• Availability to travel within Spain and internationally when required

What we offer you

• A permanent contract.

• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.

• Meal vouchers.

• Access to a voluntary flexible compensation scheme allowing employees to optimize their salary package (e.g. health insurance, transport, childcare)

• Be part of an experienced and international team.

• A good vibe working environment.

• The opportunity to grow your career within a solid and well-established international company.

• Be part of a dynamic organization undergoing continuous transformation and improvement.

• Offices location: Chamartín, Madrid.

Informazioni sul ruolo

A Sulzer, siamo specializzati nella fornitura di servizi di alto livello ai nostri clienti attraverso il settore petrolifero e del gas, della produzione di energia e delle rinnovabili. Con il nostro recente investimento di 1 milione di sterline, la nostra struttura Ellon è ora un centro di eccellenza, fornendo un supporto all'avanguardia per motori elettrici, pompe, cambio e turbocompressori. Stiamo cercando un esperto gas compressore tecnico per unirsi al nostro team.

Come tecnico del compressore a gas, lavorerai direttamente sulla riparazione, la revisione e la manutenzione dei compressori a gas. Si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nel garantire che le attrezzature dei nostri clienti sono serviti ai più elevati standard, soddisfare le specifiche del settore e mantenere l'efficienza operativa Le vostre attività e responsabilità principali:

• Smontaggio, ispezione e ricostruzione dei compressori di gas e dei loro componenti

Per avere successo in questo ruolo, avrete bisogno di:

• Esperienza nella revisione e manutenzione dei compressori a gas o simili attrezzature rotanti

• Proficienza nel montaggio meccanico, nel montaggio e nella diagnosi dei guasti

• Forte attenzione ai dettagli e all'impegno per la qualità

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer, we specialise in delivering top-tier service to our customers across the oil & gas, power generation, and renewable sectors. With our recent £1 million investment, our Ellon facility is now a Centre of Excellence, providing cutting-edge support for electric motors, pumps, gearboxes, and turbo-compressors. We are looking for a skilled Gas Compressor Technician to join our team.

As a Gas Compressor Technician, you will be working directly on the repair, overhaul, and maintenance of gas compressors. You will play a key role in ensuring that our customers' equipment is serviced to the highest standards, meeting industry specifications and maintaining operational efficiency Your Main Tasks and Responsibilities:

• Disassembling, inspecting, and rebuilding gas compressors and their components

• Diagnosing and repairing mechanical faults in a variety of compressor types

• Precision fitting, machining, and assembly work as required

• Performing dynamic and functional testing on overhauled equipment

• Collaborating with engineering and quality teams to ensure compliance with technical specifications

• Maintaining a clean and safe working environment in line with HSE requirements

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Experience in the overhaul and maintenance of gas compressors or similar rotating equipment

• Proficiency in mechanical fitting, assembly, and fault diagnosis

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality

• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical manuals

• Good communication skills and a proactive attitude to teamwork

• Awareness of Health, Safety, and Environmental regulations

What we offer you

• Competitive basic salary.

• 33 days of annual leave.

• Defined pension contribution.

• Confidential support and guidance through our Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to a wide range of discounts on everyday shopping, entertainment, and lifestyle.

• Discounted Personal Car Leasing - available for you, your family, and friends.

• Long Service Awards to celebrate your dedication.

• Ongoing learning and development through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• Free and secure onsite parking, with electric charging facilities.

Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Gaskompressortechniker, der unserem Team beitritt.

Als Gaskompressortechniker arbeiten Sie direkt an der Reparatur, Überholung und Wartung von Gaskompressoren. Sie werden eine wichtige Rolle dabei spielen, sicherzustellen, dass die Ausrüstung unserer Kunden nach den höchsten Standards gewartet wird, die Industriespezifikationen erfüllt und die Betriebseffizienz erhalten bleibt Ihre Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

• Präzisionsmontage-, Bearbeitungs- und Montagearbeiten nach Bedarf

• Zusammenarbeit mit Ingenieur- und Qualitätsteams, um die Einhaltung der technischen Spezifikationen sicherzustellen

• Aufrechterhaltung einer sauberen und sicheren Arbeitsumgebung gemäß den HSE-Anforderungen

Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, benötigen Sie:

• Erfahrung in der Überholung und Wartung von Gaskompressoren oder ähnlichen rotierenden Geräten

• Kenntnisse in der mechanischen Montage, Montage und Fehlerdiagnose

• Starke Liebe zum Detail und Engagement für Qualität

• Fähigkeit, technische Zeichnungen und technische Handbücher zu lesen und zu interpretieren

The Machinery Mechanic is responsible for performing routine maintenance and minor repairs on industrial machinery to ensure smooth and safe operations. This role supports the maintenance team by identifying mechanical issues and assisting in equipment upkeep.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer, we don't just manufacture pumps—we engineer and build critical equipment that keeps vital industries moving across the globe. From power generation and water infrastructure to energy, chemicals and industrial processing, our pumps are trusted in some of the world's most demanding applications. Our Leeds facility is one of Sulzer's flagship pump manufacturing centres, combining decades of engineering expertise with modern manufacturing technology following significant investment and refurbishment.

We're looking for an experienced Final Inspection Lead to join our recently refurbished, state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Leeds, where you'll play a pivotal role in ensuring every pump package leaves our site meeting the highest standards of quality, safety and customer satisfaction. This is not a typical inspection role. You'll be working alongside teams who design, manufacture, assemble and test some of the largest and most technically advanced pumps in the industry. Some of our products weigh up to 150 tonnes, requiring exceptional coordination, precision and engineering excellence to take them from concept to customer delivery. What You'll Be Doing

• Leading final inspection activities for complete pump packages and rotating equipment.

• Coordinating the final assembly verification process before customer dispatch.

• Reviewing and approving final manufacturing records and quality documentation.

• Ensuring products comply with ISO 9001 standards and internal quality requirements.

• Verifying that all customer specifications, technical requirements and contractual obligations have been fulfilled.

• Overseeing and signing off complete pump packages and bareshaft assemblies.

• Working closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Project Management and Quality teams to resolve issues and ensure on-time delivery.

• Supporting customer inspections and witness activities where required.

• Driving a culture of quality, accountability and continuous improvement across the operation.

What We're Looking For

• Experience within heavy engineering, rotating equipment, pumps, turbines, motors or similar manufacturing environments.

• Strong understanding of final inspection, quality assurance and documentation control processes.

• Knowledge of ISO 9001 quality management systems.

• Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications and manufacturing documentation.

• Experience coordinating inspections involving large, complex engineered products.

• Excellent communication and organisational skills.

• A proactive approach with the confidence to make critical quality decisions.

What we offer you

Core Benefits

• A competitive salary

• A company wide bonus scheme

• 33 days’ holiday

• You will be eligible to join the Company’s Medicash health cash plan, which allows you to claim back the cost of everyday healthcare expenses such as dental, optical and GP services.

• Defined pension contribution

• Employee Assistance Programmes

• Discounts on shopping, entertainment & lifestyle

• Costco membership option

• Discounted personal car leasing for you, family & friends

• Long Service Awards

• Ongoing learning through Sulzer Learning Pathways

• Armed Forces Support – As a Silver Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we actively support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers. This includes policies that enable time for training, camps and deployment, alongside access to a growing internal military network.

Onsite Perks

• Free, secure parking with EV charging

• Multi-faith prayer room

• Newly modernised work areas

• Community & Wellbeing

• Lively Sports & Social Club with events & prize draws

• 24/7 onsite gym

Our newly refurbished Leeds facility our Advanced Pump Design and Manufacturing Centre of Excellence, where highly engineered, bespoke pumping solutions are designed, built and delivered for some of the world’s most demanding applications. Our pumps operate in environments where failure isn’t an option — from energy, oil & gas, chemicals, water, nuclear and heavy industry, serving global customers who expect absolute precision, reliability and performance.

We’re looking for an experienced Project Scheduler to take ownership of planning and scheduling across large, complex engineering projects — the kind with long lead times, multiple workstreams and a lot of moving parts. You’ll be at the heart of the project lifecycle, building and maintaining detailed schedules that align engineering, procurement, manufacturing, testing and delivery. This is a role for someone who enjoys turning complexity into clarity.

What you’ll be doing

• Developing, maintaining and controlling end‑to‑end project schedules using MS Project

• Working closely with Project Managers, Engineering, Supply Chain and Manufacturing to ensure plans are realistic, integrated and achievable

• Managing schedule risk, critical paths and dependencies across complex, multi‑discipline projects

• Using SAP to track progress, materials, production milestones and performance

• Providing clear schedule reporting, forecasts and insights to support decision‑making

• Driving continuous improvement in planning standards, tools and processes

What we’re looking for

• Proven experience as a Project Scheduler / Planner within large, complex engineering or manufacturing projects

• Strong, hands‑on experience with MS Project

• Working knowledge of SAP within a project or manufacturing environment

• Comfortable managing projects with many interdependencies, long lead items and competing priorities

• Confident communicator who can challenge constructively and influence stakeholders

• A structured, detail‑driven mindset with the ability to see the bigger picture

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer, innovation and excellence are at the heart of everything we do. Our Ellon Service Centre is one of Sulzer's flagship rotating equipment service facilities, providing world-class repair, maintenance and engineering solutions for critical turbomachinery and gas compression equipment across a wide range of industries.

As the Technical Focal Point for Gas Compression, you will serve as the first point of contact for technical guidance relating to gas compression equipment and workshop procedures. You will work closely with customers, workshop personnel, field service teams and engineering colleagues to deliver technically sound recommendations and exceptional customer support.

This is a highly visible role requiring strong technical knowledge, excellent communication skills and a customer-focused approach. Your Responsibilities

• Act as the primary technical focal point for gas compression activities within the service centre.

• Provide technical guidance to workshop teams regarding repair methods, procedures and best practices.

• Support the wider engineering team in determining the optimum approach to work execution.

• Provide troubleshooting expertise for complex repair and operational issues.

• Liaise closely with engineering colleagues and other technical specialists when required.

• Attend customer meetings as the technical representative for gas compression projects.

• Accompany customers during witness testing activities, providing technical advice and support.

• Present technical findings, recommendations and repair solutions to customers.

• Build strong customer relationships through professional technical support and expertise.

• Review workshop findings and provide recommendations for repair solutions.

• Participate in failure investigations within Sulzer service centres and at customer sites.

• Deliver technical advice, coaching and training to internal teams where required.

What You Bring

Qualifications

• HNC, HND or Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.

Experience & Technical Knowledge

• Significant experience with gas compression equipment.

• Previous engineering experience within rotating equipment, turbomachinery or related industries.

• Understanding of vibration analysis and machinery diagnostics.

• Experience preparing technical reports and presenting engineering recommendations.

• Knowledge of repair methodologies and failure investigation practices.

Skills & Behaviours

• Strong influencing and persuasion skills.

• Comfortable engaging with customers and presenting technical information.

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to interact at all levels.

• Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities.

• Effective time management skills with flexibility to adapt to changing business demands.

• High attention to detail and commitment to quality.

• Ability to work collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams.

• Competent user of Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel and Outlook.

• Committed to adhering to company standards, procedures and safety requirements.

Travel Requirements
The successful candidate must be willing to travel to customer sites and Sulzer locations as required, both within the UK and occasionally internationally.

What we offer you

• A competitive basic salary

• Annual bonus scheme

• Car/Car Allowance

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

The Lead (Field) Service Technician is responsible for installing, configuring, calibrating, and repairing technical products and systems at customer field locations. This job profile is intended for experienced support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations. About the role

As part of the Water & Industrial Business Unit of Sulzer AG, Sulzer Flow Germany GmbH distributes products and solutions for the mechanical and biological cleaning of municipal and industrial wastewater.

As a service technician, you are our face to the customer. On daily Mondays, you investigate and solve any problems that arise in customer facilities. descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

In the role (Probation, 6 months), you will be a member of the Group Treasury Team Pune and in charge of various treasury topics. You will work in a global team of treasury professionals with specific responsibilities, and you will assume regular as well as ad-hoc tasks. Main tasks and responsibilities:

• Invoice Management: Operationally support the financing programs with invoice collection, accounts payable oversight, reports to service providers and banks and constant communication to Group Treasury

• Regular balance sanity & checks: Regularly perform sanities on reported Balances and loans from subsidiaries, report findings to Group Treasury

• Bank Account Management: Execute regular bank A/Cs & signatory rights check and perform the bank A/C reconciliation.

• Regular Sanity Checks: Aligning and analyzing the reported figures between different treasury tools.

• FX/Loan Management: Collect, sanitize, correct, and upload transactions from subsidiaries into the treasury management system.

• Knowledge of Intercompany reconciliation & Intercompany netting.

• Ad-hoc tasks, initiatives & database management.

Key Interfaces:

• Group Treasury Team (Switzerland/Spain/USA/Mexico)

• Regional Treasury Managers

• GTR Pune

• Service Providers
Education requirements:

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in finance/accounting or equivalent experience

descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Define and govern the adoption of AI across Workplace and platform-based solutions, with a strong focus on out-of-the-box capabilities, integrations, and security. Act as the orchestration point across Software Development, Data & Analytics, business users, and platform owners, ensuring consistent routing of AI initiatives. Drive the transition from ad-hoc usage to controlled, scalable adoption through clear governance, measurement, and chargeback, positioning AI as an extension of existing platforms rather than a parallel capability. The role focuses on Workplace AI platforms and embedded capabilities such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, AI assistants, and collaboration tools.

Main accountabilities and tasks

• AI Roadmap & Out-of-the-Box Ownership: Own the AI roadmap for Workplace and platform-based AI capabilities and the adoption of out-of-the-box solutions; contribute to the cross-functional definition of AI architecture; establish AI as a coherent enterprise capability.

• Platform-First, Preview & Early-Access Ownership: Prioritise out-of-the-box capabilities over new builds; own the evaluation, piloting, and rollout of preview features and vendor early-access programmes; track and govern AI features increasingly embedded in existing enterprise services.

• Governance of Services, Integrations & Agents: Establish a single enterprise entry point and a risk-based approval process, supported by self-service guardrails and clear approval timelines so the front door enables rather than blocks; govern AI services, integrations, APIs, and the lifecycle of AI agents; ensure every AI asset is inventoried, owned, and operated within agreed controls.

• Routing of AI Initiatives Across Delivery Tracks: Define and govern how AI initiatives are routed across delivery tracks - out-of-the-box, preview, and early-access (this role); citizen development (business users, against standards set by this role); custom development and advanced integrations (Software Development); and analytics-driven solutions (Data & Analytics).

• Security, Risk & Compliance (with Infosec): Together with Infosec, define and enforce AI-specific controls under a clear split of accountability for who defines, approves, and enforces; ensure compliance with GDPR and the EU AI Act; govern third-party AI usage and minimise shadow-AI risk.

• AI Lifecycle Management: Govern the full lifecycle covering build, publish, operate, and retire; ensure ownership, inventory, and transparency for every AI solution; enforce environment-based controls across experiment, managed, and production.

• Business Value, Chargeback & Adoption: Define how AI business value is measured; build and operate a chargeback model so consumption is transparent and costs sit with the consuming business; drive adoption and track it against value realisation.

• User Support, Enablement & Training: Act as the primary point of contact for AI adoption; provide patterns, guardrails, and reusable templates so users can build safely; deliver training, documentation, and onboarding paths that build AI literacy across the organisation.

Desired experience and qualifications

• Work experience: 8-10+ years in enterprise IT, architecture, or transformation roles, with experience in governance, platform strategy, or large-scale adoption.

• Expertise: Senior expert / enterprise architect level. Strong understanding of enterprise AI platforms (e.g. Microsoft 365 Copilot) and assistant and agent-based tooling, and of GenAI / agent-based architectures; deep knowledge of platform vs. custom-development trade-offs and licensing models; experience defining operating models and governance standards.

• Governance & regulation: Proven experience defining and rolling out enterprise AI governance

À propos du rôle

Résumé du poste

L'administrateur est responsable de fournir un soutien administratif de base en suivant les procédures établies. Ce rôle travaille sous une supervision étroite et gère les tâches de routine pour soutenir les opérations du bureau.

Répondra au téléphone, accueillera et enregistrera tous les visiteurs.

Ce profil d'emploi s'adresse au personnel de soutien qui suit les procédures établies et travaille sous étroite supervision. Les décisions plus petites/plus faciles sont prises de manière autonome. Caroline du Sud : Phoenix, Arizona

FONCTIONS PRINCIPALES :

• Maintenir une attitude et une apparence professionnelles

• Excellentes compétences en communication et en organisation

• Effectuer de manière indépendante des travaux de bureau et de bureau substantiels

• La capacité d'utiliser efficacement un système téléphonique multiligne, un ordinateur, un photocopieur et d'autres équipements de bureau.

• Être une personne motivée, dotée d'initiative et capable d'effectuer plusieurs tâches à la fois.

• Orienté vers l'équipe et capable d'interagir avec plusieurs départements

Informazioni sul ruolo

Il Coordinatore Credit & Collections Order to Cash (OTC) Ã ̈ responsabile della valutazione dell'affidabilitÃ creditizia dei clienti attuali e potenziali e della consulenza sulla configurazione dei nuovi clienti, sulla gestione del rischio di credito e sul supporto del processo OTC complessivo in stretta collaborazione con i Project Manager del paese e i Credit Control Manager. Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Order to Cash (OTC) Credit & Collections Coordinator is responsible for assessing the creditworthiness of current and potential customers and advice on the setup of new customers, managing credit risk, and supporting the overall OTC process in close collaboration with the country Project Managers and Credit Control Managers. Moreover, the professional is responsible for managing and executing the collections process to ensure timely payments from customers, maintaining healthy cash flow and minimizing risk of bad debts. The Credit & Collections Accountant will play a crucial role in maintaining financial stability of the organization by ensuring that receivables are collected in a timely manner.

Key Responsibilities:

• Evaluate customer credit applications using credit scoring models and financial analysis to determine the degree of risk involved in extending the credit

• Analyze new customer and advise on the acceptance/rejection for the setup in the Master Data

• Conduct thorough financial analysis, including reviewing financial statements, credit reports and payment history to set and adjust credit limits

• Monitor and analyze customers’ credit exposures and make recommendations to minimize risk and optimize accounts receivables

• Collaborate closely with the Senior Credit & Collection Accountants, local Project Managers, sales and customer service teams to resolve credit issues and support business growth while managing credit risk as well as to address any disputes or issues that delay payments

• Execute collections strategies to reduce Days of Sales Outstanding (DSO) and improve cash flow

• Engage with customers via phone, email or other communication channels to negotiate timely payments and resolve outstanding receivables

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all credit & collections-related activities, including credit review, limits and terms

• Communicate credit policies and procedures to relevant stakeholders within the organization

• Support the collections process, ensuring timely payments from customers

• Prepare credit & collections reports and risk assessments for management, highlighting trends, potential risks and opportunities for improvement

• Support the OTC and Reporting & Analytics team with the month-end closing activities, ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting related to credit and accounts receivable

• Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance credit processes and systems

• Ensure OTC internal controls are in place in the CoE and followed for the processes performed by this role

Minimum Job Requirements/Skillset:

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field

• Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in OTC, credit analysis, risk assessment or a similar role

• Experience within the manufacturing or industrial sectors is preferred

• Strong understanding of financial analysis, credit scoring, and risk management principles as well as the collection processes

• Proficiency in financial statement analysis and interpreting credit reports

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills

• Proficient in ERP systems (relevant to your business unit; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or iScala )

• Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills

• Experience with Tagetik and Qlik Sense is a plus

What we offer you

• 30 days Christmas Bonus ( Aguinaldo )

• Savings Fund: 8% monthly matching

• Pension Plan & Seniority Recognition

• Major Medical Insurance (Individual)

• Life, Dental, and Vision Insurance

• 12 days of vacation to start with a 50% vacation premium

Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Erbe an Innovationen. Schließen Sie sich unserem globalen Team an, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine prosperierende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Der Order to Cash (OTC) Credit & Collections Coordinator ist verantwortlich für die Bewertung der Kreditwürdigkeit aktueller und potenzieller Kunden und die Beratung bei der Einrichtung neuer Kunden, dem Management des Kreditrisikos und der Unterstützung des gesamten OTC-Prozesses in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Projektmanagern und Credit Control Managern des Landes. Darüber hinaus ist der Fachmann für die Verwaltung und Durchführung des Inkassoprozesses verantwortlich, um rechtzeitige Zahlungen von Kunden zu gewährleisten, einen gesunden Cashflow aufrechtzuerhalten und das Risiko von Fehlschulden zu minimieren. Der Credit & Collections Accountant wird eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Aufrechterhaltung der finanziellen Stabilität der Organisation spielen, indem er sicherstellt, dass Forderungen rechtzeitig erhoben werden.

Wichtigste Aufgaben:

• Bewerten Sie Kundenkreditanträge mit Kredit-Scoring-Modellen und Finanzanalysen, um den Grad des Risikos bei der Kreditverlängerung zu bestimmen

• Analysieren Sie neue Kunden und beraten Sie bei der Annahme/Ablehnung für die Einrichtung in den Stammdaten

• Durchführung einer gründlichen Finanzanalyse, einschließlich der Überprüfung von Abschlüssen, Kreditberichten und Zahlungshistorie, um Kreditlimits festzulegen und anzupassen

• Überwachen und analysieren Sie die Kreditrisikopositionen von Kunden und geben Sie Empfehlungen zur Minimierung des Risikos und zur Optimierung der Forderungen

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Senior Credit & Collection Accountants, lokalen Projektmanagern, Vertriebs- und Kundenserviceteams, um Kreditprobleme zu lösen und das Geschäftswachstum bei der Verwaltung des Kreditrisikos zu unterstützen sowie Streitigkeiten oder Probleme anzugehen, die Zahlungen verzögern

• Führen Sie Inkassostrategien aus, um Days of Sales Outstanding (DSO) zu reduzieren und den Cashflow zu verbessern

• Engagieren Sie sich mit Kunden über Telefon, E-Mail oder andere Kommunikationskanäle, um rechtzeitige Zahlungen auszuhandeln und offene Forderungen zu lösen

• Pflegen Sie genaue und aktuelle Aufzeichnungen aller Kredit- und Inkassoaktivitäten, einschließlich Kreditprüfung, Limits und Bedingungen

• Kommunikation von Kreditrichtlinien und -verfahren an relevante Stakeholder innerhalb der Organisation

• Unterstützen Sie den Inkassoprozess und gewährleisten Sie rechtzeitige Zahlungen von Kunden

• Erstellung von Kredit- und Inkassoberichten und Risikobewertungen für das Management, wobei Trends, potenzielle Risiken und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten hervorgehoben werden

• Unterstützen Sie das OTC- und Reporting & Analytics-Team bei den Abschlussaktivitäten zum Monatsende und gewährleisten Sie eine genaue und zeitnahe Finanzberichterstattung in Bezug auf Kredit- und Debitorenkonten

• Teilnahme an kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen zur Verbesserung der Kreditprozesse und -systeme

• Sicherstellen, dass interne OTC-Kontrollen im CoE vorhanden sind und für die von dieser Rolle durchgeführten Prozesse befolgt werden

Mindestanforderungen an den Arbeitsplatz/Skillset:

• Universitätsabschluss in Finanzen, Rechnungswesen, Betriebswirtschaft oder verwandten Bereichen

• Mindestens 1-2 Jahre Erfahrung in OTC, Kreditanalyse, Risikobewertung oder einer ähnlichen Rolle

• Erfahrung in der Fertigung oder Industrie wird bevorzugt

• Starkes Verständnis von Finanzanalysen, Kredit-Scoring und Risikomanagement-Prinzipien sowie der Inkassoprozesse

• Kenntnisse in der Bilanzanalyse und Interpretation von Kreditberichten

• Ausgezeichnete analytische, Problemlösungs- und Entscheidungsfähigkeiten

• Proficient in ERP-Systemen (relevant für Ihre Business Unit; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 oder iScala)

• Starke MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) Fähigkeiten

• Erfahrung mit Tagetik und Qlik Sense ist ein Plus

Was wir Ihnen bieten

• 30 Tage Weihnachtsbonus ( Aguinaldo)

• Sparkasse: 8% monatliches Matching

• Pensionsplan und Altersanerkennung

• Hauptkrankenversicherung (einzeln)

• Life, Dental und Vision Versicherung

• 12 Tage Urlaub, um mit einer 50% Urlaubsprämie zu beginnen

Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Le coordonnateur du crédit et des recouvrements de l'Ordre d'encaissement est chargé d'évaluer la solvabilité des clients actuels et potentiels et de fournir des conseils sur la configuration des nouveaux clients, la gestion du risque de crédit et l'appui au processus global de l'OTC en étroite collaboration avec les gestionnaires de projet et de contrôle du crédit du pays. De plus, le professionnel est responsable de la gestion et de l'exécution du processus de recouvrement afin d'assurer le paiement en temps opportun des clients, de maintenir des flux de trésorerie sains et de réduire le risque de créances douteuses. Le comptable des créances et recouvrements jouera un rôle crucial dans le maintien de la stabilité financière de l'organisation en veillant à ce que les créances soient perçues en temps opportun.

Principales responsabilités :

• Évaluer les demandes de crédit à la clientèle à l'aide de modèles de notation et d'analyse financière pour déterminer le degré de risque associé à l'extension du crédit

• Analyser le nouveau client et conseiller sur l'acceptation/rejection de l'installation dans le Master Data

• Effectuer une analyse financière approfondie, notamment en examinant les états financiers, les rapports de crédit et les antécédents de paiement afin de fixer et d'ajuster les limites de crédit

• Surveiller et analyser les expositions de crédit des clients et faire des recommandations pour minimiser les risques et optimiser les comptes débiteurs

• Collaborer étroitement avec les comptables principaux du crédit et de la perception, les gestionnaires de projet locaux, les équipes de vente et de service à la clientèle pour résoudre les problèmes de crédit et soutenir la croissance des entreprises tout en gérant le risque de crédit ainsi que pour régler les différends ou les problèmes qui retardent les paiements

• Exécuter des stratégies de recouvrement pour réduire les jours de vente en circulation et améliorer les flux de trésorerie

• Faire appel aux clients par téléphone, par courriel ou par d'autres moyens de communication pour négocier les paiements en temps opportun et régler les créances impayées

• Tenir des registres précis et à jour de toutes les activités liées au crédit et aux recouvrements, y compris l'examen du crédit, les limites et les modalités

• Communiquer les politiques et les procédures de crédit aux intervenants pertinents de l'organisation

• Soutenir le processus de collecte, en assurant le paiement en temps opportun des clients

• Préparer des rapports de crédit et de recouvrement et des évaluations des risques pour la gestion, en mettant en évidence les tendances, les risques potentiels et les possibilités d'amélioration

• Appuyer l'équipe du CTO et de l'analyse et des rapports dans les activités de clôture de fin de mois, en veillant à ce que les rapports financiers relatifs au crédit et aux comptes débiteurs soient exacts et opportuns

• Participer à des initiatives d'amélioration continue pour améliorer les processus et les systèmes de crédit

• S'assurer que les contrôles internes de l'OTC sont en place dans le Conseil de l'Europe et suivis pour les processus exécutés par ce rôle

Exigences et compétences minimales en matière d'emploi :

• Diplôme universitaire en finance, comptabilité, administration des affaires ou domaine connexe

• Minimum de 1 à 2 ans d'expérience en CTO, en analyse de crédit, en évaluation des risques ou dans un rôle similaire

• L'expérience dans les secteurs manufacturier ou industriel est privilégiée

• Connaissance approfondie des principes d'analyse financière, de notation et de gestion du risque ainsi que des processus de collecte

• Compétence en analyse des états financiers et en interprétation des rapports de crédit

• Excellente capacité d'analyse, de résolution de problèmes et de prise de décisions

• Compétence en systèmes ERP (pertinents pour votre unité commerciale; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 ou iScala)

• Fortes compétences de MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint)

• Expérience avec Tagetik et Qlik Sense est un plus

Ce que nous vous offrons

• 30 jours Bonus de Noël ( Aguinaldo )

• Caisse d'épargne : 8 % par mois

• Reconnaissance du régime de retraite et de l'ancienneté

• Assurance maladie majeure (individuelle)

• Assurance vie, soins dentaires et assurance vision

• 12 jours de vacances pour commencer avec une prime de 50 %

Concepteur mécanique - Temps plein - Whitby, Canada

Chez Sulzer, vous êtes en mesure de fournir des résultats supérieurs. En tant que pionnier de l’industrie, nous sommes fiers de notre héritage d’innovation et continuons d’évoluer pour l’avenir. Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable de :

Sul ruolo

Riepilogo del lavoro
Il supervisore macchinista dell'assistenza (sul campo) è responsabile della gestione delle operazioni di lavorazione in loco in ambienti industriali esigenti. Questo ruolo è responsabile della supervisione del personale sul campo, della garanzia che il lavoro di lavorazione di precisione soddisfi tolleranze rigorose e della consegna dei progetti in modo sicuro, puntuale e nel rispetto del budget. Il candidato ideale combina una forte esperienza nella lavorazione tecnica con una comprovata leadership e capacità di affrontare il cliente. Responsabilità chiave
Configurare e utilizzare torni con apparecchiature di lavorazione portatili, alesatura in linea, sfacciatura di flange, fresatura, foratura e maschiatura.
Interpretare progetti, disegni tecnici e specifiche.
Misurare e ispezionare i componenti utilizzando calibri, comparatori, ecc.
Assicurarsi che siano raggiunti il corretto allineamento e le tolleranze.
Mantenere le attrezzature e gli strumenti sul campo.
Comunicare con clienti e supervisori in merito all'avanzamento del lavoro e ai problemi.

Competenze e qualifiche
Diploma di scuola superiore o formazione tecnica equivalente.
Comprovata esperienza come macchinista, preferibilmente sul campo o in ambiente industriale.
Capacità di leggere e interpretare progetti e schemi.
Attitudine meccanica e capacità di problem solving.
Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente con una supervisione minima.
Disponibilità a viaggiare frequentemente e lavorare in diverse condizioni all'aperto, spazi ristretti e altezze.
Capacità fisica di sollevare attrezzature pesanti e di stare in piedi per lunghi periodi.

Job Summary
The (Field) Service Machinist Supervisor is responsible for managing on-site machining operations in demanding industrial environments. This role is responsible for supervising field personnel, ensuring precision machining work meets strict tolerances, and delivering projects safely, on time, and within budget. The ideal candidate combines strong technical machining expertise with proven leadership and customer-facing skills. Key Responsibilities
Set up and operate portable machining equipment lathes, line boring, flange facing, milling, drilling, and tapping.

Ability to read and interpret blueprints and schematics.
Mechanical aptitude and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
Willingness to travel frequently and work in varying conditions outdoors, confined spaces, and heights.
Physical ability to lift heavy equipment and stand for long periods.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società leader nel settore dell'ingegneria con un orgoglioso patrimonio di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Sul ruolo

Riepilogo del lavoro
Il contabile è responsabile del supporto delle operazioni contabili, tra cui l'immissione dei dati, le riconciliazioni e l'assistenza nella rendicontazione finanziaria. Questo ruolo garantisce l'accuratezza dei registri finanziari e supporta la conformità agli standard contabili. Questo profilo professionale è destinato a professionisti all'inizio della carriera che applicano ampie conoscenze teoriche e richiedono la capacità di indagare e analizzare i problemi. Le soluzioni vengono generalmente discusse/verificate con un membro più esperto. Il Senior Accountant RTR presso il Centro di Eccellenza (CoE) lavora in un team RTR assegnato a più paesi, supportando i team Record to Report (RTR), ad esempio con vari compiti ad hoc, registrazioni complesse o la manutenzione del piano dei conti.

Responsabilità chiave

• Servire come membro del team RTR nel CoE, fornendo supporto su argomenti ad hoc e questioni contabili

• Supporto nelle attività di contabilizzazione finanziaria, garantendo l'accuratezza e la conformità agli International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) e alle normative Sulzer

• Gestire la compensazione, comprese riconciliazioni e aggiustamenti, per mantenere registri finanziari accurati

• Utilizzare la conoscenza avanzata dei sistemi ERP per semplificare i processi contabili

• Supportare il Global Process Owner (GPO) con le implementazioni del sistema

• Mantenere e aggiornare il piano dei conti e le gerarchie, assicurandosi che rifletta l'attuale struttura aziendale e i requisiti di reporting

• Collaborare a stretto contatto con i team finanziari locali nei paesi e con i team di servizi finanziari condivisi/fornitore di Business Process Outsourcing (BPO).

• Coordinarsi con gli altri dipartimenti e i team dei servizi finanziari condivisi per garantire che tutte le transazioni finanziarie siano adeguatamente contabilizzate e riflesse nella contabilità generale

• Supporta la chiusura di fine periodo, inclusa la chiusura del registro secondario dei conti clienti/debiti e la riconciliazione con la contabilità generale; chiudere la contabilità generale, aprire un nuovo periodo finanziario, chiudere la contabilità patrimoniale (AA)

• Supporto nella preparazione delle scritture contabili, riconciliazioni di bilancio e analisi degli scostamenti

• Contribuire al miglioramento continuo del processo RTR, sfruttando la tecnologia e le migliori pratiche; mantenere politiche, procedure e modelli

• Garantire che i controlli finanziari interni siano in atto e seguiti per i processi svolti da questo ruolo

• Eseguire tutte le attività tecniche di chiusura di fine anno, come il riporto del saldo, la creazione di intervalli di numeri, la chiusura di AA

• Supportare il processo di riconciliazione interaziendale in Coprocess e Tagetik (correzione delle varianze)

Formazione ed esperienza

• Laurea in Finanza, Contabilità, Amministrazione aziendale o settore correlato

• Minimo 2-3 anni di esperienza in contabilità con una forte attenzione alla contabilità generale e al reporting finanziario

• Preferibile certificazione CPA, ACCA, CMA o equivalente

Fattori critici di successo

• Forti capacità analitiche, di problem solving e di gestione

• Eccellente attenzione ai dettagli e impegno per l'accuratezza e l'integrità nel reporting finanziario

• Comprovata capacità di gestire più priorità in un ambiente basato sulle scadenze

• Forti capacità di comunicazione per fornire informazioni chiave alla leadership senior

Competenze tecniche e linguistiche

• Competente nei sistemi ERP (pertinenti alla vostra business unit; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 o iScala) e nei software di contabilità

• Ottime competenze in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint).

• L'esperienza con Tagetik, Coprocess e Qlik Sense costituisce un vantaggio

• Conoscenza della lingua inglese

Si interfaccia con

• Squadre contabili

• Team di reporting e analisi

• Responsabili Contabilità Locali

• Responsabili finanziari nazionali

• Oggetto Criteri di gruppo RTR

• Stakeholder esterni (ad esempio revisori, autorità fiscali, ecc.)

Cosa ti offriamo

Assicurazione medica per sé e per la famiglia
Struttura di trasporto sponsorizzata dall'azienda durante i giorni feriali

descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Accounting Officer is responsible for supporting accounting operations including data entry, reconciliations, and assisting with financial reporting. This role ensures accuracy in financial records and supports compliance with accounting standards. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. The RTR Senior Accountant in the Center of Excellence (CoE) works in a RTR team assigned to multiple countries, supporting the Record to Report (RTR) teams for example with various ad hoc tasks, complex bookings, or the maintenance of the chart of accounts.

Key responsibilities

• Serve as a member of the RTR team in the CoE, providing support on ad hoc topics and accounting issues

• Support with financial booking activities, ensuring accuracy and compliance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and Sulzer regulations

• Manage clearing, including reconciliations and adjustments, to maintain accurate financial records

• Utilize advanced knowledge of ERP systems to streamline accounting processes

• Support the Global Process Owner (GPO) with system implementations

• Maintain and update the chart of accounts and hierarchies, ensuring it reflects the current business structure and reporting requirements

• Collaborate closely with local Finance Teams in countries and Finance Shared Services teams / Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) provider

• Coordinate with other departments and the Finance Shared Services teams to ensure all financial transactions are properly accounted for and reflected in the general ledger

• Supports the period end close, including closing the accounts receivable/payable subledger and reconcile with the general ledger; close general ledger, open new financial period, close Asset Accounting (AA)

• Support with the preparation of journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations and variance analysis

• Contribute to the continuous improvement of the RTR process, leveraging technology and best practices; maintain policies, procedures and templates

• Ensure financial internal controls are in place and followed for the processes performed by this role

• Do all technical Year End Closing activities such as balance carry forward, number range creations, close of AA

• Support Intercompany reconciliation process in Coprocess and Tagetik (fix variances)

Education and experience

• University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field

• Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in Accounting with a strong focus on general ledger and financial reporting

• CPA, ACCA, CMA or equivalent certification preferred

Critical success factors

• Strong analytical, problem-solving and management skills

• Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and integrity in financial reporting

• Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment

• Strong communication skills for delivering key insights to senior leadership

Technical & language skills

• Proficient in ERP systems (relevant to your business unit; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or iScala) and accounting software

• Strong MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) skills

• Experience with Tagetik, Coprocess and Qlik Sense is a plus

• Proficiency in English

Interfaces with

• Accounting teams

• Reporting & Analytics team

• Local Accounting Managers

• Country Finance Heads

• RTR GPO

• External stakeholders (i.e. auditors, tax authorities etc.)

What we offer you

Medical insurance for self and family
Company sponsored transportation facility during week days

descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einer stolzen Tradition der Innovation. Werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams, um Ihr Fachwissen zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine wohlhabende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen.

Über die Rolle

Jobzusammenfassung
Der Rechnungsführer ist für die Unterstützung der Buchhaltungsvorgänge verantwortlich, einschließlich Dateneingabe, Abstimmungen und Unterstützung bei der Finanzberichterstattung. Diese Rolle stellt die Genauigkeit der Finanzunterlagen sicher und unterstützt die Einhaltung von Buchhaltungsstandards. Dieses Berufsbild richtet sich an Berufseinsteiger, die über ein breites theoretisches Wissen verfügen und über die Fähigkeit verfügen, Probleme zu untersuchen und zu analysieren. Lösungen werden in der Regel mit einem erfahreneren Mitglied besprochen/überprüft. Der RTR Senior Accountant im Center of Excellence (CoE) arbeitet in einem länderübergreifenden RTR-Team und unterstützt die Record to Report (RTR)-Teams beispielsweise bei verschiedenen Ad-hoc-Aufgaben, komplexen Buchungen oder der Pflege des Kontenplans.

Hauptverantwortlichkeiten

• Als Mitglied des RTR-Teams im CoE fungieren und Unterstützung bei Ad-hoc-Themen und Rechnungslegungsfragen leisten

• Unterstützung bei Finanzbuchungsaktivitäten, Sicherstellung der Genauigkeit und Einhaltung der International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) und der Sulzer-Vorschriften

• Verwalten Sie das Clearing, einschließlich Abstimmungen und Anpassungen, um genaue Finanzunterlagen zu führen

• Nutzen Sie fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse über ERP-Systeme, um Buchhaltungsprozesse zu optimieren

• Unterstützen Sie den Global Process Owner (GPO) bei Systemimplementierungen

• Pflegen und aktualisieren Sie den Kontenplan und die Hierarchien und stellen Sie sicher, dass er die aktuelle Geschäftsstruktur und die Berichtsanforderungen widerspiegelt

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit lokalen Finanzteams in den Ländern und Finance Shared Services-Teams/Business Process Outsourcing (BPO)-Anbietern

• Koordinieren Sie sich mit anderen Abteilungen und den Finance Shared Services-Teams, um sicherzustellen, dass alle Finanztransaktionen ordnungsgemäß verbucht und im Hauptbuch widergespiegelt werden

• Unterstützt den Periodenabschluss, einschließlich der Schließung des Debitoren-/Verbindlichkeitsnebenbuchs und der Abstimmung mit dem Hauptbuch; Hauptbuch schließen, neue Finanzperiode eröffnen, Anlagenbuchhaltung (AA) schließen

• Unterstützung bei der Erstellung von Journalbuchungen, Bilanzabstimmungen und Abweichungsanalysen

• Beitrag zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung des RTR-Prozesses durch Nutzung von Technologie und Best Practices; Pflegen Sie Richtlinien, Verfahren und Vorlagen

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass interne Finanzkontrollen für die von dieser Rolle durchgeführten Prozesse vorhanden sind und befolgt werden

• Führen Sie alle technischen Aktivitäten zum Jahresabschluss durch, z. B. Saldoübertrag, Erstellung von Nummernkreisen und AA-Abschluss

• Unterstützung des Intercompany-Abstimmungsprozesses in Coprocess und Tagetik (Behebung von Abweichungen)

Ausbildung und Erfahrung

• Universitätsabschluss in Finanzen, Rechnungswesen, Betriebswirtschaft oder einem verwandten Bereich

• Mindestens 2-3 Jahre Erfahrung im Rechnungswesen mit starkem Fokus auf Hauptbuchhaltung und Finanzberichterstattung

• CPA, ACCA, CMA oder gleichwertige Zertifizierung bevorzugt

Kritische Erfolgsfaktoren

• Starke Analyse-, Problemlösungs- und Managementfähigkeiten

• Ausgezeichnete Liebe zum Detail und Engagement für Genauigkeit und Integrität in der Finanzberichterstattung

• Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten in einer termingesteuerten Umgebung zu verwalten

• Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten zur Vermittlung wichtiger Erkenntnisse an die Geschäftsleitung

Technische und sprachliche Fähigkeiten

• Kenntnisse in ERP-Systemen (relevant für Ihre Geschäftseinheit; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 oder iScala) und Buchhaltungssoftware

• Gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse (Excel, PowerPoint).

• Erfahrung mit Tagetik, Coprocess und Qlik Sense ist von Vorteil

• Englischkenntnisse

Schnittstellen mit

• Buchhaltungsteams

• Reporting- und Analyseteam

• Lokale Buchhaltungsmanager

• Landesfinanzleiter

• RTR-Gruppenrichtlinienobjekt

• Externe Stakeholder (z. B. Wirtschaftsprüfer, Steuerbehörden usw.)

Was wir Ihnen bieten

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une société d'ingénierie leader avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

À propos du rôle

Résumé du poste
Le comptable est chargé de soutenir les opérations comptables, y compris la saisie des données, les rapprochements et de contribuer à l'élaboration des rapports financiers. Ce rôle garantit l'exactitude des dossiers financiers et soutient la conformité aux normes comptables. Ce profil d'emploi est destiné aux professionnels en début de carrière qui appliquent de vastes connaissances théoriques et nécessitent la capacité d'enquêter et d'analyser des problèmes. Les solutions sont généralement discutées/vérifiées avec un membre plus expérimenté. Le Comptable Senior RTR du Centre d'Excellence (CoE) travaille au sein d'une équipe RTR affectée à plusieurs pays, en supportant les équipes Record to Report (RTR) par exemple avec diverses tâches ponctuelles, des réservations complexes, ou la maintenance du plan comptable.

Principales responsabilités

• Servir en tant que membre de l'équipe RTR au sein du CoE, en fournissant un soutien sur des sujets ad hoc et des questions comptables.

• Soutenir les activités de comptabilité financière, en garantissant l'exactitude et la conformité aux normes internationales d'information financière (IFRS) et aux réglementations Sulzer.

• Gérer la compensation, y compris les rapprochements et les ajustements, pour maintenir des dossiers financiers précis.

• Utiliser une connaissance avancée des systèmes ERP pour rationaliser les processus comptables

• Soutenir le propriétaire du processus global (GPO) avec la mise en œuvre du système.

• Maintenir et mettre à jour le plan comptable et les hiérarchies, en s'assurant qu'il reflète la structure actuelle de l'entreprise et les exigences en matière de reporting.

• Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes financières locales dans les pays et les équipes de services financiers partagés / fournisseur d'externalisation des processus métiers (BPO).

• Coordonner avec les autres départements et les équipes des services financiers partagés pour garantir que toutes les transactions financières sont correctement comptabilisées et reflétées dans le grand livre général.

• Prend en charge la clôture de fin de période, y compris la clôture du grand livre auxiliaire des comptes clients/payeurs et le rapprochement avec le grand livre général ; clôturer le grand livre, ouvrir une nouvelle période financière, clôturer la comptabilité des immobilisations (AA)

• Support à la préparation des écritures de journal, des rapprochements de bilan et des analyses d'écarts

• Contribuer à l'amélioration continue du processus RTR, en tirant parti de la technologie et des meilleures pratiques ; maintenir les politiques, les procédures et les modèles

• S'assurer que les contrôles financiers internes sont en place et suivis pour les processus exécutés par ce rôle.

• Effectuer toutes les activités techniques de clôture de fin d'année telles que le report de solde, la création de tranches de numéros, la clôture de l'AA.

• Supporter le processus de rapprochement inter-entreprises dans Coprocess et Tagetik (corriger les écarts)

Formation et expérience

• Diplôme universitaire en finance, comptabilité, administration des affaires ou dans un domaine connexe

• Minimum de 2 à 3 ans d'expérience en comptabilité avec une forte concentration sur le grand livre général et les rapports financiers

• Certification CPA, ACCA, CMA ou équivalente préférée.

Facteurs critiques de succès

• Solides compétences en analyse, en résolution de problèmes et en gestion

• Excellente attention aux détails et engagement envers l'exactitude et l'intégrité des rapports financiers.

• Capacité avérée à gérer plusieurs priorités dans un environnement axé sur les délais

• Solides compétences en communication pour fournir des informations clés à la haute direction

Compétences techniques et linguistiques

• Maîtrise des systèmes ERP (pertinents pour votre unité commerciale ; SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 ou iScala) et des logiciels de comptabilité.

• Solides compétences en MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint)

• Une expérience avec Tagetik, Coprocess et Qlik Sense est un plus

• Maîtrise de l'anglais

Interfaces avec

• Équipes comptables

• Équipe de reporting et d'analyse

• Responsables comptables locaux

• Responsables financiers pays

• Objet de stratégie de groupe RTR

• Parties prenantes externes (c'est-à-dire auditeurs, autorités fiscales, etc.)

Ce que nous vous proposons

Installation de transport sponsorisée par l'entreprise en semaine

• Be part of an experienced, international team.

• A good vib

Stellt die Einhaltung der OEM-, Kunden- und internationalen Sulzer-Standards sicher und unterstützt gleichzeitig Inspektionen, Reparaturlösungen und Qualitätsverfahren. Bietet technisches Feedback, erstellt Inspektionsberichte und entwickelt und implementiert erforderliche Standards.

Hauptaufgaben

• Durchführung von Eingangs-, Zwischen- und Endinspektionen rotierender Geräte und Komponenten.

• Erstellen und überprüfen Sie Überholungsberichte mit technischen Empfehlungen.

• Auf der Grundlage der Erkenntnisse Arbeitsanweisungen, Zeichnungen und Reparaturmethoden entwickeln.

• Pflegen Sie Auftragspakete, Checklisten, Inspektionsaufzeichnungen und SOPs.

• Erstellen und führen Sie gemeinsam mit den Beteiligten Inspektions- und Testpläne (ITPs) aus.

• Bereitstellung technischer Qualitätsunterstützung, einschließlich WPS/PQR-Überprüfung und Materialauswahl.

• Führen Sie Maß-, Geometrie- und Demontageprüfungen durch.

• Verwalten Sie NCRs, einschließlich RCA, CAPA und gewonnene Erkenntnisse.

• Koordinieren und überwachen Sie zerstörungsfreie Prüfungen und Spezialprüfungen mit Dritten.

• Gewährleisten Sie die Kalibrierung, Kontrolle und Rückverfolgbarkeit der Inspektionsausrüstung.

• Unterstützen Sie Vorgänge/Projekte, einschließlich Fortschrittsaktualisierungen und der Lösung technischer Probleme.

• Schulung der Mitarbeiter hinsichtlich Qualitätsstandards und Unterstützung von LEAN und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung.

• Stellen Sie die Einhaltung von EHS, Qualitätsverfahren und 5S-Praktiken sicher.

• Fördern Sie ein sicheres, sauberes und positives Arbeitsumfeld.

Qualifikationen/Anforderungen

• Bachelor-Abschluss in Ingenieurwissenschaften

• Mindestens 7 Jahre Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen oder verwandten Rolle

• Guter Hintergrund in der Kreiselpumpe erforderlich; Erfahrung im Kompressor-/Turbinenbereich ist von Vorteil.

• Fähigkeit, technische Zeichnungen, Handbücher und technische Spezifikationen zu interpretieren

• Erfahrung in der Verfahrensentwicklung und NCR-Handhabung

• Kenntnisse in Präzisionsmessungen und Werkstattinspektion

• Solides Verständnis der Pumpenhydraulik, mechanischen Dichtungen und rotierenden Geräten

• NDT-Zertifizierung (LPT/MPI/UT Level 2); Eine LEAA-Zertifizierung zum Heben/Rigging ist von Vorteil

• Kenntnisse der OEM-Standards und -Praktiken wünschenswert

Was wir Ihnen bieten

• Hervorragende Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten sowie ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt und ein betriebliches Bonusprogramm.

• Ein tolles Arbeitsumfeld.

• Arbeitsort: Riad – Industriegebiet 2

Sulzer setzt sich als Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit ein. Wir glauben an die Stärke einer vielfältigen Belegschaft und setzen uns dafür ein, ein integratives Arbeitsumfeld zu bieten.

Wir sind stolz darauf, in Brasilien, Kanada, China, Finnland, Deutschland, Irland, Mexiko, der Schweiz, Südafrika, dem Vereinigten Königreich und den USA als Top-Arbeitgeber 2026 ausgezeichnet zu werden.

À propos du rôle

Résumé du poste

Assure la qualité et la conformité technique de l’entretien des équipements rotatifs, notamment les pompes, les turbines et les compresseurs. Garantit le respect des normes Sulzer OEM, clients et internationales, tout en prenant en charge les inspections, les solutions de réparation et les procédures de qualité. Fournit des commentaires techniques, prépare des rapports d’inspection et élabore et met en œuvre les normes requises.

Principales responsabilités

• Effectuer des inspections entrantes, en cours et finales des équipements et composants rotatifs.

• Préparer et examiner les rapports de révision avec des recommandations techniques.

• Élaborer des instructions de travail, des dessins et des méthodes de réparation basés sur les résultats.

• Tenir à jour les dossiers de tâches, les listes de contrôle, les dossiers d'inspection et les SOP.

• Préparer et exécuter des plans d'inspection et de test (ITP) avec les parties prenantes.

• Fournir un support technique de qualité, y compris l'examen WPS/PQR et la sélection des matériaux.

• Effectuer des inspections dimensionnelles, géométriques et de démontage.

• Gérer les NCR, y compris les RCA, CAPA et les leçons apprises.

• Coordonner et superviser les essais non destructifs et spécialisés avec des tiers.

• Assurer l'étalonnage, le contrôle et la traçabilité des équipements d'inspection.

• Soutenir les opérations/projets, y compris les mises à jour des progrès et la résolution des problèmes techniques.

• Former le personnel aux normes de qualité et soutenir le LEAN et l'amélioration continue.

• Assurer le respect des normes EHS, des procédures qualité et des pratiques 5S.

• Promouvoir un environnement de travail sûr, propre et positif.

Qualifications/Exigences

• Baccalauréat en ingénierie

• Minimum de 7 ans d'expérience dans un rôle similaire ou connexe

• Une solide expérience en pompes centrifuges est requise ; Une expérience en compresseur/turbine est un avantage.

• Capacité à interpréter des dessins techniques, des manuels et des spécifications techniques

• Expérience dans le développement de procédures et la gestion des NCR

• Maîtrise des mesures de précision et de l'inspection d'atelier

• Solide compréhension de l'hydraulique des pompes, des garnitures mécaniques et des équipements rotatifs

• Certification CND (LPT/MPI/UT niveau 2) ; La certification LEAA en levage/gréage est un plus

• Connaissance des normes et pratiques OEM souhaitées.

Ce que nous vous proposons

• D'excellentes opportunités de développement, ainsi qu'un salaire compétitif et un système de primes d'entreprise.

• Un excellent environnement de travail.

• Lieu de travail : Riyad - Zone industrielle 2

• Garantire il rispetto degli standard di salute, sicurezza e ambiente, sia internamente che presso le sedi dei clienti

• Esperienza pratica nell'assemblaggio, riparazione e collaudo di macchinari – idealmente anche in un ambiente di officina

• Buona padronanza dell'inglese e uso sicuro degli strumenti IT comuni

• Modo di lavorare indipendente, strutturato e orientato alla soluzione

• Forte orientamento al cliente e al servizio

• Flessibile e adattabile con disponibilità a viaggiare

• Giocatore di squadra con buone capacità di comunicazione e una presenza sicura sul posto

• Idealmente certificazione VCA ed esperienza iniziale nella supervisione o guida di altri

• 8% di indennità di ferie e fino a 40 giorni di ferie annuali

• Un solido regime pensionistico con un contributo interessante da parte del datore di lavoro

• Parcheggio gratuito in loco

• Un'associazione del personale che offre attività sociali e regali stagionali

• Opportunità di formazione e sviluppo in linea con il tuo ruolo e il tuo piano di sviluppo personale

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

As a Field Service Technician, you will be responsible for the installation, commissioning, maintenance and repair of pump systems both at customer sites and in the workshop. Working in a hands-on environment, you will ensure reliable operation of equipment, support troubleshooting activities and contribute to high service quality and customer satisfaction. This role requires a practical mindset, technical expertise and a strong commitment to safety, as well as the flexibility to work across different locations and applications.
Key Responsibilities

• Installation, commissioning, maintenance and repair of pumps and associated equipment at customer sites as well as in the workshop

• Disassembly, inspection and reassembly of machinery based on defined work scopes or independently in case of unplanned repairs or troubleshooting

• Execution of work in line with specified tolerances and manufacturer guidelines or established engineering standards

• Performing safety assessments at the worksite (e.g. when changing activities)

• On-site activities including coordination and supervision of customer-provided personnel when required

• Preparation of service and repair reports as well as required documentation after completion of work

• Ensuring compliance with health, safety and environmental standards – both internally and at customer sites

Your Profile

• Experience in installation, commissioning and maintenance of pumps and associated equipment

• Hands-on experience in assembly, repair and testing of machinery – ideally also in a workshop environment

• Good command of English and confident use of common IT tools

• Independent, structured and solution-oriented way of working

• Strong customer and service orientation

• Flexible and adaptable with willingness to travel

• Team player with good communication skills and a confident presence on site

• Ideally VCA certification and initial experience in supervising or guiding others

What we offer you

• 8% holiday allowance and up to 40 days of annual leave

• A solid pension scheme with attractive employer contribution

• Travel allowance for commuting (EUR 0.23/km, tax-free)

• Free coffee, tea and water , plus access to an on-site canteen with fresh and affordable meals

• Free parking on-site

• Employee benefit programs such as Bike leasing with tax advantages and Gym contribution

• A staff association offering social activities and seasonal gifts

• Training and development opportunities aligned with your role and personal development plan

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sul ruolo

Stiamo cercando un controller FP&A dinamico da inserire nel nostro team Finance & Controlling a Madrid, Spagna.

Questa è un'entusiasmante opportunità per collaborare con stakeholder internazionali, sfruttare la tua esperienza nell'analisi finanziaria, contribuendo al tempo stesso al successo di un ufficio di nuova costituzione nel centro di Madrid. • Preparare e consolidare il budget annuale, garantendo l'allineamento con gli obiettivi aziendali e finanziari.

• Aggiornare e aggiornare periodicamente le previsioni finanziarie predittive per riflettere le ultime tendenze aziendali e le condizioni di mercato.

• Condurre report approfonditi sulla redditività e sulle prestazioni, identificando i principali parametri finanziari.

• Eseguire analisi dettagliate dei piani e valutazioni del rischio, migliorando continuamente i processi di pianificazione e analisi finanziaria.

• Fornire raccomandazioni all'azienda basate su un'analisi finanziaria approfondita, supportando il processo decisionale strategico.

• Gestire il reporting e l'analisi delle collezioni, garantendo informazioni accurate e tempestive a supporto dei processi decisionali.

• Fornire report e analisi completi sulle attività di approvvigionamento, contribuendo a decisioni di acquisto informate.

• Supervisionare i processi di chiusura del periodo, generando report finanziari e analisi di fine periodo accurati e approfonditi per garantire l'integrità finanziaria.

• Gestire la chiusura di fine periodo e le relative analisi, garantendo un monitoraggio finanziario e un reporting accurato e preciso per i progetti.

• Supervisionare la pianificazione, le previsioni, la strategia di investimento, le attività di chiusura del periodo e il reporting del CAPEX.

• Rispettare le normative QESH pertinenti, mantenendo i più elevati standard di conformità finanziaria.

• Laurea in finanza, contabilità, amministrazione aziendale o campi correlati.
