Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The Legal / Compliance Sr. Specialist is responsible for applying advanced legal and compliance knowledge to manage projects independently, ensuring the organization’s adherence to laws and internal policies. This role also supports junior professionals through coaching and review. This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level experts. Main tasks and responsibilities:

• Patent and Trademark Pros ecution: Manage and assess IP disclosures. Assist Business Units in the decision as to whether to seek patent protection. Responsible for drafting and filing patent and trademark registration applications internally, while also managing and supervising related applications handled by outside counsel, incl. related costs. Responsibility for local priority applications

• IP Operational Management: Effectively manag e the entire IP lifecycle by leveraging internal systems and tools.

• Intellectual Property Right Searching: Manage and control the process for searching patent information databases for patentability, validity, IP landscape, freedom to operate and infringement assessment purposes

• Infringement Opinions: Procure and provide infringement, validity, freedom-to-operate (FTO) and trademark availability clearance opinions, either internally or with the use of outside counsel/IP search service provider

• Third Party IP Conflicts: Contribute to the process for resolving conflicts with third parties concerning own or third-party IP rights or misappropriated own IP, in particular via third party observations, oppositions, C&D letters and negotiated settlement agreements

• Contract Advice: Provide advice on IP aspects for confidentiality agreements and contribute to setting up licensing agreements and IP conflict settlement agreements

• Prepare and deliver IP education in the form of seminars or presentations for engineers, sales and marketing managers and senior business leaders and provide guidance and support for all IP-related questions of the business

Qualifications:

• University-level education in chemistry, chemical or process engineering and Patent bar qualification

• At least 5 years working experience in IP, preferably in the chemistry or chemical/process engineering domain

• Experienced in patent prosecution and FTO

• Previous exposure to trademark and/or trade secret is a plus

• Highly organized professional with the ability to effectively manage multiple tasks and priorities

• Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in all aspects of work

• Demonstrated ability to negotiate and draft IP agreements

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills to build and maintain professional relationships

• A strategic mindset

• Fluency in English

• Flexibility to travel on demand

• Bereiten Sie IP-Schulungen in Form von Seminaren oder Präsentationen für Ingenieure, Vertriebs- und Marketingmanager und leitende Unternehmensleiter vor und unterstützen Sie alle IP-bezogenen Fragen des Unternehmens

Qualifikationen:

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im IP, vorzugsweise im Bereich Chemie oder Chemie/Verfahrenstechnik

• Erfahrung in Patentverfolgung und FTO

• Frühere Exposition gegenüber Marke und / oder Geschäftsgeheimnis ist ein Plus

Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Le spécialiste en droit / conformité est chargé d'appliquer les connaissances juridiques et de conformité avancées pour gérer les projets de façon indépendante, en assurant l'adhésion de l'organisation aux lois et aux politiques internes. Ce rôle appuie également les jeunes professionnels par le biais de l'encadrement et de l'examen. Ce profil d'emploi est destiné aux professionnels spécialisés qui appliquent des connaissances avancées d'un domaine d'emploi. Requis pour gérer les projets/processus de façon indépendante avec une supervision limitée. En général, entraîne et examine le travail des experts de niveau inférieur. Principales tâches et responsabilités:

• Prosécution en matière de brevets et de marques: gérer et évaluer les divulgations de propriété intellectuelle. Aider les unités commerciales à décider s'il convient de demander la protection par brevet. Responsable de la rédaction et du dépôt des demandes de brevet et d'enregistrement des marques à l'interne, tout en gérant et en supervisant les demandes connexes traitées par des conseils extérieurs, y compris : dépenses connexes. Responsabilité pour les demandes prioritaires locales

• Gestion opérationnelle de la propriété intellectuelle: gérer efficacement l'ensemble du cycle de vie de la propriété intellectuelle en tirant parti des systèmes et outils internes.

• Recherche sur les droits de propriété intellectuelle : gérer et contrôler le processus de recherche des bases de données d'information sur les brevets à des fins de brevetabilité, de validité, de protection de la propriété intellectuelle, de liberté de fonctionnement et d'évaluation des infractions

• Avis d'infraction : Procurez-vous et fournissez des avis d'infraction, de validité, de liberté d'exploitation (FTO) et de disponibilité des marques de commerce, soit à l'interne, soit avec l'aide d'un avocat ou d'un fournisseur de services de recherche externe

• Conflits entre tiers en matière de propriété intellectuelle: contribuer au processus de règlement des conflits avec des tiers concernant des droits de propriété intellectuelle propres ou tiers ou des droits de propriété intellectuelle détournés, notamment par des observations de tiers, des oppositions, des lettres de C&D et des accords de règlement négociés

• Conseils en matière de contrats : Fournir des conseils sur les aspects relatifs à la propriété intellectuelle pour les accords de confidentialité et contribuer à l'établissement d'accords de licence et d'accords de règlement des conflits de propriété intellectuelle

• Préparer et dispenser des cours de propriété intellectuelle sous forme de séminaires ou de présentations à l'intention des ingénieurs, des directeurs des ventes et du marketing et des chefs d'entreprise et fournir des conseils et un soutien pour toutes les questions de propriété intellectuelle de l'entreprise

Qualifications

• Enseignement universitaire en chimie, chimie ou génie des procédés et brevet

• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans le domaine de la propriété intellectuelle, de préférence dans le domaine de la chimie ou de l'ingénierie chimique/procédure

• Expérience en matière de poursuites en matière de brevets et de FTO

• L'exposition antérieure à la marque et/ou au secret commercial est un plus

• Professionnel hautement organisé avec la capacité de gérer efficacement plusieurs tâches et priorités

• Une attention exceptionnelle au détail et à la précision dans tous les aspects du travail

• Capacité démontrée de négocier et de rédiger des accords de propriété intellectuelle

• Fortes compétences en communication et en relations interpersonnelles pour établir et maintenir des relations professionnelles

• Une mentalité stratégique

• Connaissance de l'anglais

• Flexibilité aux déplacements sur demande

About the role

Job Summary
The Jr. Machine Operator is responsible for assisting in the operation of manufacturing machinery under supervision. This entry-level role supports production by performing basic tasks and learning to operate equipment safely and efficiently.
This job profile is intended for entry-level support staff who follow specific instructions and procedures, with supervision provided for non-routine situations. Tasks can be carried out after basic training or demonstration.

This job and its associated grade are specifically aligned with roles that have the following scope of responsibility: Small, Medium, Large, Division / Extra Large organization.

Key Responsibilities
Assist in setting up and operating machinery.
Monitor equipment and report issues to supervisors.
Perform basic maintenance and cleaning of machines.
Follow safety and operational procedures.
Record production data and support quality checks.
Learn and apply standard operating procedures.

Willingness to learn and follow instructions.
Basic mechanical aptitude.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sintesi del lavoro
Responsabile del raggiungimento dei ricavi (nuove unità e servizi) e degli obiettivi di qualità dei prezzi per un determinato territorio su base trimestrale attraverso la gestione strategica e tattica delle imprese rappresentative/distribuzioni all'interno della data geografia, attraverso la gestione attiva dei partner esistenti e l'aggiornamento a nuovi partner, se del caso. La strategia deve affrontare i fattori di motivazione, gli investimenti (livello di lavoro e di attività rispetto ad altre linee) e la competenza (formazione e disponibilità) delle imprese rappresentative. L'aspetto tattico della posizione comprende la regia e la presenza di appuntamenti sul campo presso impianti di acque reflue e aziende di ingegneria, ospitando incontri di formazione/vendita regionali e requisiti di comprensione per vincere opportunità. Questa persona deve essere rispettata come un livello paritario dai principi delle imprese rappresentative e vista come valore aggiunto quando nel settore. Duties e responsabilità del principio:

• Positivamente impatto comportamento rappresentativo e tenere se stessi e l'azienda rappresentativa responsabile per le previsioni concordate.

• Sviluppare relazioni interne ed esterne per creare un'atmosfera di compagni, influenza e responsabilità.

• Tenere riunioni mensili strategiche con i principi delle aziende rappresentative per discutere le prestazioni MTD e YTD, così come le prestazioni previste per i prossimi mesi. Riunioni di documenti e piani d'azione, se del caso. Seguire le attività e le società di consulenza, se del caso.

• Sviluppi e piani strategici con le imprese rappresentative per raggiungere gli obiettivi

• Sviluppare una pipeline di prospettive abbastanza grande da sostenere le aspettative dei ricavi. Dirige l’attività delle imprese rappresentative e sostiene di conseguenza attraverso le risorse interne.

• Valuta le tendenze del mercato che influiscono sui prodotti attuali di JWC o sulle opportunità future per guidare l'innovazione

• Capisce bene tutti i prodotti di JWC ed è visto come un esperto

• Fornisce un feedback tempestivo alla gestione senior per quanto riguarda le prestazioni del mercato, le prestazioni aziendali rappresentative e le potenziali opportunità o minacce durante le riunioni di vendita settimanali e aggiorna il CRM di conseguenza

• Coordinate la risoluzione completa dei problemi del servizio clienti che si innalzano al livello di questa posizione a causa delle dimensioni, della pervasività o dell'egregiousness

• Rappresentare la Società in selezionati fiere e conferenze regionali e nazionali guidando

• Mantenere un'immagine professionale come rappresentante della Società

• Esegui altri compiti e progetti speciali assegnati.

• Corso di laurea

• Storia del raggiungimento costante degli obiettivi di reddito attraverso aziende rappresentative e di distribuzione

• 5+ anni di esperienza nella vendita di attrezzature per le acque reflue comunali

• Capacità di parlare in modo intelligente di prodotti, servizi e società JWC

• Forti competenze personali interpersonali

• Autodidatta e imprenditoriale con un elevato senso di urgenza e reattività

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
Responsible for achieving revenue (new unit & service) and pricing quality objectives for a given territory on a quarterly basis through strategic and tactical management of the representative/distribution firms within the given geography, through active management of existing partners and upgrading to new partners, when appropriate. The strategy must address the motivation factors, investment (staffing & activity level versus other lines) and competency (training and willingness) of the representative firms. The tactical aspect of the position includes directing and attending field appointments at wastewater plants and engineering firms, hosting regional training/sales meetings and understanding requirements to win opportunities. This person must be respected as a peer-level by representative firms’ principles and seen as adding value when in the field. Principle Duties and Responsibilities:

• Positively impact representative behavior and hold themselves and the representative firm accountable to the agreed upon forecast.

• Develop internal and external relationships to create an atmosphere of comradery, influence and accountability.

• Hold strategic monthly meetings with the principles of the representative firms to discuss MTD and YTD performance, as well as expected performance for the coming months. Document meetings and develop action plans, where appropriate. Follow-up on action items and counsel firms, where appropriate.

• Develop budgets and strategic plans with the representative firms to achieve objectives

• Develop a pipeline of prospects large enough to support revenue expectations. Directs representative firms’ activity and supports accordingly through internal resources.

• Assess market trends that affect JWC’s current products or future opportunities in order to drive innovation

• Thoroughly understands all of JWC’s products and is seen as an expert

• Provides timely feedback to senior management regarding market performance, representative firm performance and potential opportunities or threats during the weekly sales meetings and updates the CRM accordingly

• Coordinate complete resolution of customer service issues that rise to the level of this position because of size, pervasiveness or egregiousness

• Represent the Company at selected regional and national trade shows and conferences by driving leads

• Maintain a professional image as a representative of the Company

• Performs other duties and special projects as assigned.

Experience, Education & Skills:

• Bachelor’s Degree

• History of consistently achieving revenue targets through representative and distribution firms

• 5+ years of experience in municipal wastewater equipment sales

• Ability to speak intelligently about JWC products, services and company

• Must be able to travel 50%-75% of the time

• Ability to hold monthly performance meetings and hold under-performers accountable

• Strong interpersonal personal skills

• High degree of likeability to drive rep firm openness and partnering

• Expert organizational and time management skills

• Ability to use technology and analysis tools (CRM, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, etc.),

• Self-driven and entrepreneurial with a high sense of urgency and responsiveness

• Ability to be able to work out of a home satellite office effectively

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

Treffen dokumentieren und gegebenenfalls Aktionspläne ausarbeiten. Gegebenenfalls Folgemaßnahmen zu Aktionspunkten und Beratungsfirmen.

• Versteht alle Produkte von JWC und wird als Experte angesehen

• Bietet zeitnahes Feedback an die Geschäftsleitung bezüglich Marktperformance, repräsentativer Unternehmensperformance und potenzieller Chancen oder Bedrohungen während der wöchentlichen Verkaufssitzungen und aktualisiert das CRM entsprechend

• Koordinieren Sie die vollständige Lösung von Kundendienstproblemen, die aufgrund von Größe, Durchdringung oder Ungeheuerlichkeit auf das Niveau dieser Position steigen

• Repräsentieren Sie das Unternehmen auf ausgewählten regionalen und nationalen Messen und Konferenzen, indem Sie Leads fahren

• Pflegen Sie ein professionelles Image als Vertreter des Unternehmens

• Führt andere Aufgaben und spezielle Projekte wie zugewiesen aus.

Erfahrung, Ausbildung & Fähigkeiten:

• Bachelor-Abschluss

• Geschichte der konsequenten Erreichung der Umsatzziele durch Vertretungs- und Vertriebsgesellschaften

• 5+ Jahre Erfahrung im Verkauf von kommunalen Abwasseranlagen

• Fähigkeit, intelligent über JWC Produkte, Dienstleistungen und Unternehmen zu sprechen

• Muss in der Lage sein, 50%-75% der Zeit zu reisen

• Fähigkeit, monatliche Performance-Meetings abzuhalten und Under-Performer zur Rechenschaft zu ziehen

• Starke zwischenmenschliche persönliche Fähigkeiten

• Hohes Maß an Sympathie, um die Offenheit und Partnerschaft der Vertreter zu fördern

• Fachkundige organisatorische und Zeitmanagementfähigkeiten

• Fähigkeit, Technologie und Analysetools (CRM, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook usw.) zu verwenden,

• Selbstgesteuert und unternehmerisch mit einem hohen Gefühl der Dringlichkeit und Reaktionsfähigkeit

About the role

Project Buyer with Supply Chain mindset to Nordic Water Products AB

You are a proactive and self-driven purchasing professional with experience from project-driven manufacturing or industrial environments. You combine strong analytical skills with commercial awareness and technical understanding, enabling you to manage complex sourcing activities and support successful project execution.

You have experience in project purchasing, supplier negotiations, and supply chain management, and are comfortable working closely with project managers, engineering, production, and suppliers. You take ownership, prioritize effectively, and thrive in a role with a high degree of independence.

As a person, you are a collaborative team player who builds strong relationships, drives continuous improvement, and delivers results in a dynamic environment.

To succeed in this role, you have:

• Experience in project purchasing within manufacturing or industrial businesses

• Strong negotiation and supplier management skills

• An analytical and structured approach to problem-solving

• Technical understanding and commercial acumen

• Knowledge of industrial manufacturing processes, sheet metal fabrication and stainless-steel products is meritorious

• A proactive mindset, ability to work independently, and strong teamwork skills

• Fluent in Swedish and English, both spoken and written

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys combining commercial responsibility, technical challenges, and project-driven work in a dynamic international environment.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Sulzer ist ein führendes Engineering-Unternehmen mit einer reichen Innovationstradition. Werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams, um Ihre Expertise zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine wohlhabende und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen. Sulzer Chemtech liefert weltweit hochpräzise Komponenten und Systeme für die chemische und petrochemische Industrie. Unsere Logistik- und Einkaufsabteilung sorgt dafür, dass die richtigen Materialien zur richtigen Zeit am richtigen Ort sind – effizient, kostengünstig und nachhaltig. Gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der industriellen Lieferketten. Ihre Aufgaben
• 2nd-Level-Support für unsere Fachbereiche in Produktion und Verwaltung (Client- und Mobile-Device-Management)
• Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung der Hyper-V-Infrastruktur in Zusammenarbeit mit dem zentralen Rechenzentrumsteam und der lokalen IT an den Standorten Bruchsal und Bonn
• Sicherstellung der Backup-Compliance unter Berücksichtigung der regulatorischen Anforderungen der chemischen Industrie (Backup und Wiederherstellung mit Commvault, B2D und B2T)
• Netzwerkadministration mit Schwerpunkt auf Cisco-Komponenten, VLAN-Management und strukturierte Verkabelung
• Verantwortung für die Dokumentation von Systemkonfigurationen und Änderungen
• Lokale IT-Business-Partnerschaft für die Fachbereiche
• Aktive Teilnahme und Unterstützung von Unternehmensinitiativen
• Mitarbeit in bereichsübergreifenden Teams, z. B. Client-Management, Netzwerk, Rechenzentrum oder IT-Sicherheit bei entsprechender Eignung möglich Ihr Profil
• Berufserfahrung: ca. 3–5 Jahre in der IT-Systemadministration
• Ausbildung: Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im IT-Bereich (z. B. Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration) oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
• Expertise: Fundierte Kenntnisse in Microsoft Hyper-V, Windows Server, Client-Management und Netzwerktechnik (Cisco, VLAN)
• Zertifikate: Cisco- oder Microsoft-Zertifizierungen wünschenswert, aber nicht zwingend erforderlich
• Sprachen:
• Deutsch: mind. A2
• Englisch: B2 oder höher
• Zusätzliche Sprachkenntnisse (Spanisch oder Finnisch) von Vorteil
• Soft Skills:
• Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeit
• Lösungs- und kostenorientiertes Arbeiten
• Zuverlässigkeit und Teamfähigkeit
• Flexibilität
• Sie wissen sich in einer arbeitsteiligen Konzernumgebung zu bewegen What we offer you Wir bieten
• Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Top ausgestattete Arbeitsplätze, kostenlose Parkplätze sowie Kaffee und Wasser.
• Flexibilität für Ihre Work-Life-Balance: Gleitzeitsystem und flexible Arbeitszeiten für eine optimale Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben.
• Attraktive Zusatzleistungen: JobRad-Leasing, Corporate Benefits, Betriebsrente und weitere Vergünstigungen für Mitarbeitende.
• Globale Perspektive & Zusammenarbeit: Enge Kooperation mit der zentralen IT und Anbindung an internationale Konzernstrukturen.
• Wir bieten darüber hinaus: Verantwortungsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben in einem internationalen Umfeld, Zusammenarbeit mit einem engagierten Team und modernen Technologien, Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und Entwicklungsperspektiven sowie eine attraktive Vergütung und Sozialleistungen. Position: Designer I

Currently, we have an immediate opening for a Designer I at our Burnaby facility.

As a member of our Engineering Department you will assist, at a junior level, in the design and order processing of centrifugal pumps, components and equipment; prepare design layouts; interpret design requirements; perform calculations; create and modify drawings; create Bills of Materials (BOM) and create other engineering related documentation in accordance with customer specifications and company policies.

• Prepare Bills of Materials within the ERP system (SAP)

• May contact suppliers and other departments with respect to the coordination of design work and clarification of requirements.

• May work from more detailed design requirements laid down by others in the form of notes, layouts and verbal instruction.

• May perform stress analysis.

• May assign and check the work of others.

• May prepare design reports or notes.

• Handle special engineering tasks as assigned by the supervisor.

• Support, cooperate with, and participate in company-wide EHS Management System which includes following all safety, health and environmental policies and procedures.

• Perform other duties as necessary.

Qualifications:
Our ideal candidate will have:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering or Diploma in Mechanical Design Technology, including such courses as mechanical design, hydraulics, computer-aided drafting (2D/3D), etc.

• One to two years of experience in a design and manufacturing environment using techniques applicable to product design and order processing.

• SAP and Teamcenter experience is an asset.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Sulzer è un leader industriale globale con una rete mondiale di oltre 100 centri di servizio che offrono pezzi di ricambio all'avanguardia, soluzioni di manutenzione e assistenza per pompe, turbine, compressori, motori e generatori. Nel nostro Global Parts Pricing & Projects Team stiamo costruendo prezzi come una capacità commerciale strategica - e stiamo cercando un talento analitico eccezionale per accelerare questo viaggio.

Il ruolo
Questa non è una tipica posizione di prezzi o analisi. Ti siederai all'intersezione della scienza dei dati, della strategia commerciale e della trasformazione digitale — modellando le decisioni sui prezzi in un ~ CHF 1.4B+ Portafoglio di servizi con 45 paesi e 100+ centri di assistenza in tutto il mondo. Potrai lavorare direttamente con il Global Pricing Head e la leadership regionale per chiudere le lacune dei prezzi, costruire infrastrutture di visibilità e guidare un impatto commerciale misurabile su scala.
Se avete una fondazione di ingegneria premier, una mentalità di consulenza e l'ambizione di costruire qualcosa che conta a livello globale - questo ruolo è progettato per voi.

Il tuo
• responsabilità

Strategia e analisi dei prezzi
● Progettare e ottimizzare una strategia globale dei prezzi per l'aftermarket di Sulzer — coprendo ricambi OEM, prezzi di riparazione e modelli VBP in tutte le linee di prodotto
● Costruire e distribuire modelli di prezzi basati sui dati che chiudono il divario di copertura di CHF 1.4B+: identificare dove il margine viene lasciato sulla tabella e quantificare l'impatto finanziario completo
● Sviluppare strumenti e framework di prezzi che consentono decisioni di prezzi coerenti e rispondenti al mercato in tutte le regioni, linee di prodotti e segmenti dei clienti
● Analisi della redditività del piombo e governance dei prezzi del contratto — trasformando i dati in piani d'azione chiari e pronti per l'esecutivo
● Costruire cruscotti di prezzi che danno visibilità in tempo reale di leadership nel tasso di successo, GP end-to-end e l'impatto di aumento di prezzo attraverso il pieno
Portafoglio servizi
Scienza dei dati e intelligenza artificiale
● Applicare tecniche di machine learning e AI per l'ottimizzazione dei prezzi, l'analisi dei tassi di successo e la segmentazione dei clienti - utilizzando Python, R e moderni strumenti AI
● Progettazione e costruzione di API di prezzi e datadotti che collegano la logica dei prezzi ai sistemi operativi, tra cui SAP, Qlik e ZEST attraverso la rete di servizi globale
● Sviluppare motori di raccomandazione dei prezzi assistiti da AI e logica di escalation automatizzata che riduce l'intervento manuale e migliora la velocità delle decisioni
● Crea dashboard e visualizzazioni di dati Qlik che portano i KPI di prezzi chiave — tasso di successo, GP, prezzi contrattuali e impatto aumento dei prezzi — alla vita per gli utenti di affari a livello globale
● Servire come centro interno di eccellenza per la scienza dei dati — eseguire workshop, formare i team aziendali e costruire l'infrastruttura dei dati che rende i prezzi un motore commerciale proattivo
Progetti globali e trasformazione digitale
● Condurre e contribuire a progetti di digitalizzazione in tutta la rete globale del Service Centre di Sulzer, dalla ricerca e dal business case fino all'implementazione e all'adozione
● Tradurre complessi problemi di business in soluzioni analitiche strutturate — sviluppare l'idea, costruire il caso di business, sicuro stakeholder buy-in e la consegna del drive
● Guidare iniziative di eccellenza commerciale, tra cui prezzi urgenti, modelli di moltiplicatore clienti e capacità di margine stimata — costruzione dell'infrastruttura dei prezzi per 2027 e oltre

Il tuo
• Profilo
Il candidato ideale combina eccezionale capacità quantitativa e analitica con una capacità di consulenza di strutturare i problemi, comunicare intuizioni e guidare il cambiamento di business. Le prime basi ingegneristiche e le competenze pratiche di data science sono il nucleo di ciò che stiamo cercando.

● B.Tech / M.Tech da IIT, NIT, BITS Pilani, o equivalente — solide basi quantitative non negoziabili; MBA da Tier 1 college è un vantaggio mentre non mand

About the role

Sulzer is a global industrial leader with a worldwide network of over 100 service centres offering state-of-the-art spare parts, maintenance and service solutions for pumps, turbines, compressors, motors and generators. In our Global Parts Pricing & Projects Team we are building pricing as a strategic commercial capability — and we are looking for exceptional analytical talent to accelerate that journey.

The Role
This is not a typical pricing or analytics position. You will sit at the intersection of data science, commercial strategy and digital transformation — shaping pricing decisions across a ~ CHF 1.4B+ Services portfolio spanning 45 countries and 100+ service centres worldwide. You will work directly with the Global Pricing Head and regional leadership to close pricing gaps, build visibility infrastructure and drive measurable commercial impact at scale.
If you have a premier engineering foundation, a consulting mindset and the ambition to build something that matters globally — this role is designed for you.

Your
• Responsibilities

Pricing Strategy & Analytics
● Design and optimize a global pricing strategy for Sulzer's aftermarket — covering OEM spares, repair pricing and VBP models across all product lines
● Build and deploy data-driven pricing models that close the CHF 1.4B+ coverage gap — identifying where margin is left on the table and quantifying the full financial impact
● Develop pricing tools and frameworks enabling consistent, market-responsive pricing decisions across all regions, product lines and customer segments
● Lead profitability analyses, and contract price governance — turning data into clear, executive-ready action plans
● Build pricing dashboards giving leadership real-time visibility into hit rate, end-to-end GP and price increase impact across the full
Services portfolio

● Apply machine learning and AI techniques to pricing optimisation, hit rate analysis and customer segmentation — using Python, R and modern AI tooling
● Design and build pricing APIs and data pipelines that connect pricing logic to operational systems including SAP, Qlik and ZEST across the global service network
● Develop AI-assisted price recommendation engines and automated escalation logic that reduce manual intervention and improve decision speed
● Create Qlik dashboards and data visualisations that bring key pricing KPIs — hit rate, GP, contract prices and price increase impact — to life for business users globally
● Serve as the internal centre of excellence for data science — run workshops, train business teams and build the data infrastructure that makes pricing a proactive commercial engine
Global Projects & Digital Transformation
● Lead and contribute to digitalisation projects across Sulzer's global Service Centre network — from scoping and business case through to implementation and adoption
● Translate complex business problems into structured analytical solutions — develop the idea, build the business case, secure stakeholder buy-in and drive delivery
● Drive commercial excellence initiatives including urgency pricing, customer multiplier models and estimated margin capability — building the pricing infrastructure for 2027 and beyond

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Sulzer est un leader industriel mondial avec un réseau mondial de plus de 100 centres de services offrant des solutions de rechange, d'entretien et de service de pointe pour les pompes, turbines, compresseurs, moteurs et générateurs. Dans notre équipe Global Parts Pricing & Projects, nous construisons la tarification comme une capacité commerciale stratégique — et nous recherchons un talent analytique exceptionnel pour accélérer ce voyage.

Le rôle
Ce n'est pas une position typique en matière de prix ou d'analyse. Vous serez à l'intersection de la science des données, de la stratégie commerciale et de la transformation numérique — façonnant les décisions de tarification à travers un ~ CHF 1.4B+ Portefeuille de services couvrant 45 pays et 100 centres de services dans le monde entier. Vous travaillerez directement avec le responsable des prix mondiaux et les dirigeants régionaux pour combler les écarts de prix, construire une infrastructure de visibilité et générer un impact commercial mesurable à l'échelle.
Si vous avez une fondation d'ingénierie de premier plan, un état d'esprit-conseil et l'ambition de construire quelque chose qui compte au niveau mondial, ce rôle est conçu pour vous.

Votre
• Responsabilités

Stratégie de tarification et d'analyse
● Concevoir et optimiser une stratégie de tarification mondiale pour le marché de l'après-vente de Sulzer — couvrant les pièces détachées d'OEM, les prix de réparation et les modèles VBP pour toutes les gammes de produits
● Élaborer et mettre en place des modèles de tarification fondés sur les données qui comblent l'écart de couverture de CHF 1.4B+, en identifiant où la marge reste sur le tableau et en quantifiant l'impact financier complet
● Élaborer des outils et des cadres de tarification qui permettent de prendre des décisions de tarification cohérentes et adaptées au marché dans toutes les régions, les gammes de produits et les segments de clients
● Analyses de rentabilité et gouvernance des prix contractuels - transformation des données en plans d'action clairs et prêts à l'exécution
● Construire des tableaux de bord des prix donnant une visibilité en temps réel au leadership dans le taux de succès, le GP de bout en bout et l'impact de la hausse des prix
Portefeuille des services
Science des données et intelligence artificielle
● Appliquer les techniques d'apprentissage automatique et d'IA à l'optimisation des prix, à l'analyse des taux de frappe et à la segmentation des clients — en utilisant Python, R et les outils modernes d'IA
● Concevoir et construire des API de tarification et des pipelines de données qui relient la logique de tarification aux systèmes opérationnels, y compris SAP, Qlik et ZEST, à travers le réseau mondial de services
● Développer des moteurs de recommandation de prix assistés par l'IA et une logique d'escalade automatisée qui réduisent l'intervention manuelle et améliorent la vitesse de décision
● Créer des tableaux de bord et des visualisations de données de Qlik qui apportent aux utilisateurs d'affaires à l'échelle mondiale des prix clés des KPI (taux de succès, prix de vente, prix contractuels et impact sur la hausse des prix)
● Servir de centre d'excellence interne pour la science des données — organiser des ateliers, former des équipes d'affaires et construire l'infrastructure de données qui fait de la tarification un moteur commercial proactif
Projets mondiaux et transformation numérique
● Diriger et contribuer à des projets de numérisation dans l'ensemble du réseau mondial des centres de services de Sulzer, depuis la cadrage et l'analyse de rentabilisation jusqu'à la mise en œuvre et l'adoption
● Traduire des problèmes d'affaires complexes en solutions analytiques structurées — développer l'idée, construire l'analyse de rentabilisation, sécuriser l'adhésion des parties prenantes et conduire la livraison
● Encourager les initiatives d'excellence commerciale, y compris les prix d'urgence, les modèles multiplicateurs de clients et la capacité de marge estimée, en renforçant l'infrastructure de tarification pour 2027 et au-delà

Votre
• Profil
Le candidat idéal combine une capacité quantitative et analytique exceptionnelle avec une capacité de conseil pour structurer les problèmes, communiquer des idées et stimuler le changement d'entreprise. Les fondations d'ingénierie de premier plan et l'expertise pratique en sciences des données sont au cœur de ce que nous cherchons.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Unisciti al nostro team di marketing digitale e aiutaci a rendere il marketing digitale eccellente.

Siamo alla ricerca di un Digital Marketing Manager che possiede un mix di pensiero strategico, creatività e competenze tecniche. Il candidato ideale avrà una forte comprensione dei canali di marketing digitale, automazione di marketing utilizzando Hubspot e l'ottimizzazione data-driven delle attività di marketing.

Nel complesso, stiamo cercando qualcuno che possa guidare iniziative digitali d'impatto, migliorare la visibilità del marchio, e in particolare contribuire alla crescita aziendale in una forte collaborazione con l'azienda.
Lo farai:

• Hands-on Awareness and Lead Generation Campaigns

• Creazione di campagne multicanale complete per la sensibilizzazione, la generazione di piombo e la retargeting

• Ottimizzazione del contenuto e del ripristino del sito

• Definire nuovi componenti della pagina web per ottimizzare la pagina web UI / UX

• Migliorare i contenuti in base alla ricerca delle parole chiave, agli aspetti SEO / GEO / AEO, coerente con le linee guida del marchio Sulzer e dello stile.

• Ottimizzare la struttura del sito web e le basi tecniche per garantire che tutti i contenuti siano altamente visibili agli utenti e AI

• Reporting e Metrics

• Segnala e sviluppi indicatori chiave rilevanti (KPI) per garantire l'impatto aziendale delle attività di marketing digitale

È necessario avere successo:

• Conoscenze pratiche nella campagna digitale impostata & esecuzione e monitoraggio delle prestazioni

• Esperienza di lavoro comprovata nella creazione e manutenzione del sito web, automazione di marketing, marketing dei contenuti e social media marketing

• Ottima comprensione Hubspot è un must; buona comprensione del sistema CRM

• Esperienza minima di 3 5 anni nella gestione dei lead, nell'automazione del marketing e nella gestione dei progetti di marketing digitale

• Conoscenza eccellente nell'analisi del sito web (Google Analytics, Tag Manager) , Google Ads , SEO / GEO

• In grado di lavorare efficacemente e comunicare a tutti i livelli all'interno di un'organizzazione di matrice

• Set mentale analitico

• Alto grado di indipendenza e pragmatismo

• Accesso a un regime volontario di compensazione flessibile che consente ai dipendenti di ottimizzare il loro pacchetto salariale (ad esempio assicurazione sanitaria, trasporto, assistenza all'infanzia)

• Partecipa a un team esperto e internazionale.

• Un ambiente di lavoro di buona atmosfera.

• L'opportunità di crescere la tua carriera all'interno di una solida e consolidata società internazionale.

About the role

Join our Digital Marketing team and help us make Digital Marketing excellent.

We are seeking a Digital Marketing Manager who possesses a blend of strategic thinking, creativity, and technical expertise. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of digital marketing channels, marketing automation using Hubspot and the data-driven optimization of marketing activities.

Overall, we are looking for someone who can drive impactful digital initiatives, enhance brand visibility, and in particular contribute to business growth in a strong collaboration with the business.
You will do:

• Hands-on Awareness and Lead Generation Campaigns

• Setting up comprehensive multi-channel campaigns for awareness, lead generation and retargeting

• Creation of landing pages, paid ads (Google, Linkedin and others), webinars, newsletters

• Monitor and manage lead lifecycle, lead scoring, nurturing, contact segmentation, and data cleansing

• Development and execution of compelling lead nurture programs across target business segments and sales funnel stages

• Sales Enablement and Integration

• Educate, enable and encourage the sales teams regarding demand generation processes and tools to ensure leads generation and conversion to opportunities

• Ensure sound integration of marketing automation tools with CRM for end-to-end processing of leads

• Reporting and Metrics

You need to succeed:

• Hands-on knowledge in digital campaign set up & execution and performance tracking

• Proven work experience in website creation and maintenance, marketing automation, content marketing and social media marketing

• Excellent understanding Hubspot is a must ; good understanding of CRM system

• Minimum of 3- 5 years experience in lead management, marketing automation and digital marketing project management

• Excellent knowledge in website analytics (Google Analytics, Tag Manager) , Google Ads , SEO / GEO

• Able to effectively work and communicate at all levels within a matrix organization

• Analytical mindset

• High degree of independence and pragmatism

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
Oversee and resolve warranty claims for pumps, mechanical seals, drivers, and auxiliary systems through technical investigation, root cause analysis, and corrective actions to enhance reliability, reduce warranty costs, and improve customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

• Oversee the complete warranty claim lifecycle from receipt to closure.

• Evaluate warranty entitlement and determine liability based on contractual terms and technical findings.

• Lead claim investigations and Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA).

• Coordinate corrective and preventive actions with Engineering, QA/QC, Production, Procurement, Service, suppliers, and other stakeholders.

• Serve as the primary customer contact for warranty-related matters.

• Maintain clear communication with customers and provide regular claim status updates.

• Participate in customer meetings and present investigation findings and recommendations.

• Conduct site visits, inspections, and troubleshooting activities as required.

• Support field service teams during warranty investigations.

This role involves analyzing customer requirements, preparing technical proposals, and delivering product demonstrations. The Sr. Sales Engineer ensures that solutions are technically sound and aligned with customer needs. Location: Almaty, Kazakhstan
We are looking for a technically strong Sales Engineer for industrial pumps and rotating equipment.
This role is not a pure sales position. The successful candidate should be able to understand customer processes, read technical documentation, discuss operating conditions, prepare technically correct offers, and support customers during project execution.
At the same time, the role requires commercial initiative: regular customer visits, development of new opportunities, follow-up of installed base, preparation of technical presentations/seminars, and active contribution to order intake growth in Kazakhstan and Central Asia.
The role is approximately 60–70% technical/application engineering and 30–40% commercial sales development.

Main responsibilities/Technical/Application sales

• Analyze customer requests, technical specifications, data sheets, operating conditions, and tender requirements.

• Prepare technically and commercially correct offers for industrial pumps, rotating equipment, and spare parts.

• Clarify technical requirements with customers, Sulzer factories, tendering teams, engineering teams, and service teams.

• Support the technical documentation approval process between customers and Sulzer factories.

• Review customer comments to technical/commercial documents and coordinate required changes.

• Participate in technical discussions with customers, design institutes, EPCs, and end users.

Customer and business development

• Develop regional sales in Kazakhstan and Central Asia with focus on mining, metallurgy, chemical industry, mineral fertilizers, and general industry.

• Maintain and develop relationships with existing customers.

• Search for new customers, applications, projects, and installed-base opportunities.

• Plan customer visits, technical meetings, seminars, webinars, and product presentations.

• Build opportunity pipeline and contribute to order intake growth.

Tendering, order execution, and coordination

• Prepare tender documentation, including work with electronic tender platforms.

• Review commercial conditions and support contract approval with customers.

• Register orders in SAP and coordinate order execution.

• Monitor delivery timelines and communicate with customers, factories, logistics, accounting, and tendering teams.

• Report activities, maintain forecasts, and provide regular updates on sales opportunities.

Requirements

• Higher technical education: mechanical engineering, hydraulic engineering, process engineering, materials science, or similar.

• Minimum 3 years of experience with industrial equipment, preferably pumps, compressors, rotating equipment, process equipment, or engineered products.

• Ability to read and understand technical specifications, pump data sheets, drawings, and customer RFQs.

• Understanding of centrifugal pump principles: flow, head, efficiency, NPSH, pump curves, operating point, cavitation risk.

• Basic understanding of industrial materials: cast iron, carbon steel, stainless steel, duplex/superduplex, elastomers, coatings.

• Experience with industrial customers in mining, metallurgy, chemical industry, oil & gas, power, water/wastewater, or general industry.

• Working professional English and fluent Russian. Kazakh is an advantage.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable.

Sur le rôle

Technical Sales Engineer est chargé de fournir une expertise technique et un soutien tout au long du processus de vente, de l'engagement initial du client à la mise en œuvre après la vente. Ce rôle consiste à analyser les besoins des clients, à préparer des propositions techniques et à fournir des démonstrations de produits. Le Sr. Sales Engineer veille à ce que les solutions soient techniquement saines et alignées sur les besoins des clients. Lieu: Almaty, Kazakhstan
Nous sommes à la recherche d'un ingénieur de vente techniquement solide pour les pompes industrielles et les équipements rotatifs.
Ce rôle n'est pas une simple position de vente. Le candidat retenu devrait être en mesure de comprendre les processus du client, de lire la documentation technique, de discuter des conditions d'exploitation, de préparer des offres techniquement correctes et de soutenir les clients pendant l'exécution du projet.
Dans le même temps, le rôle exige une initiative commerciale : visites régulières des clients, développement de nouvelles possibilités, suivi de la base installée, préparation de présentations techniques/séminaires et contribution active à la croissance des entrées au Kazakhstan et en Asie centrale.
Le rôle est d'environ 60 à 70 % d'ingénierie technique/application et 30 à 40 % de développement commercial des ventes.

Principales responsabilités/ventes techniques/applications

• Analyser les demandes des clients, les spécifications techniques, les fiches techniques, les conditions d'exploitation et les exigences d'appel d'offres.

• Préparer des offres techniquement et commercialement correctes pour les pompes industrielles, les équipements rotatifs et les pièces de rechange.

• Clarifier les exigences techniques avec les clients, les usines Sulzer, les équipes d'appel d'offres, les équipes d'ingénierie et les équipes de service.

• Soutenir le processus d'approbation de la documentation technique entre les clients et les usines de Sulzer.

• Examiner les commentaires des clients sur les documents techniques et commerciaux et coordonner les changements requis.

• Participer aux discussions techniques avec les clients, les instituts de conception, les EPC et les utilisateurs finaux.

Développement des clients et des entreprises

• Développer les ventes régionales au Kazakhstan et en Asie centrale en mettant l'accent sur les mines, la métallurgie, l'industrie chimique, les engrais minéraux et l'industrie générale.

• Maintenir et développer des relations avec les clients existants.

• Rechercher de nouveaux clients, applications, projets et possibilités de base installée.

• Planifiez des visites de clients, des réunions techniques, des séminaires, des webinaires et des présentations de produits.

• Bâtir un pipeline d'opportunités et contribuer à la croissance des entrées de commandes.

Appel d'offres, exécution des ordres et coordination

• Préparer la documentation relative aux appels d'offres, y compris les travaux sur les plateformes électroniques d'appel d'offres.

• Examiner les conditions commerciales et l'approbation du contrat de soutien avec les clients.

• Enregistrer les commandes dans SAP et coordonner l'exécution des commandes.

• Surveiller les délais de livraison et communiquer avec les clients, les usines, la logistique, la comptabilité et les équipes d'appels d'offres.

• Faire rapport des activités, maintenir les prévisions et fournir des mises à jour régulières sur les possibilités de vente.

Exigences

• Enseignement technique supérieur: génie mécanique, génie hydraulique, génie des procédés, sciences des matériaux ou similaire.

• Au moins 3 ans d'expérience avec des équipements industriels, de préférence des pompes, des compresseurs, des équipements rotatifs, des équipements de procédé ou des produits d'ingénierie.

• Capacité de lire et de comprendre les spécifications techniques, les fiches de données de pompe, les dessins et les RFQ clients.

• Comprendre les principes de la pompe centrifuge : débit, tête, efficacité, NPSH, courbes de la pompe, point de fonctionnement, risque de cavitation.

• Connaissance de base des matériaux industriels: fonte, acier au carbone, acier inoxydable, duplex/superduplex, élastomères, revêtements.

• Expérience avec des clients industriels dans les mines, la métallurgie, l'industrie chimique, le pétrole et le gaz, l'électricité, l'eau et les eaux usées, ou l'industrie générale.

• Travail professionnel anglais et couramment russe. Kazakh est un avantage.

• Préparation pour des voyages d'affaires réguliers à travers le Kazakhstan

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile.

Informazioni sul ruolo

Stiamo cercando un esperto e motivato Fabricator / Press Brake Operator per unirsi al nostro team di produzione. Questa posizione è principalmente responsabile per l'operazione NC Press Brake per produrre componenti in acciaio inox di alta qualità secondo disegni e specifiche di ingegneria. Il candidato ideale sarà anche aiutare con una varietà di compiti di fabbricazione, tra cui il funzionamento di una cinghia manuale, laminatoio, trapano, e seghe di taglio in metallo. Principali responsabilità

• Impostare e utilizzare l'apparecchiatura di freno di pressa NC per formare componenti in lamiera di acciaio inossidabile.

• Leggere, interpretare e seguire disegni di ingegneria, progetti, istruzioni di lavoro e specifiche.

• Misurare, marcare, e stendere tagli e curve su materiali metallici con precisione.

• Operare una macchina manuale di taglio per tagliare il metallo alle dimensioni richieste.

• Utilizzare utensili manuali e di potenza, tra cui smerigliatrici angolari e strumenti di sbavatura, per finire parti fabbricate.

• Apparecchiature di fabbricazione di funzionamento come:
• Macchine per la laminazione

• Presse per trapano

• Seghe a banda larga e/o seghe fredde

• Altre attrezzature per la fabbricazione di lamiera come necessario

• Ispezionare parti finite per garantire che soddisfino i requisiti dimensionali e di qualità.

• Eseguire l'impostazione di base della macchina, le modifiche degli utensili e la manutenzione delle attrezzature di routine.

• Mantenere una zona di lavoro organizzata e sicura.

• Seguire tutte le procedure di sicurezza dell'azienda e indossare PPE richiesto.

• Lavorare in collaborazione con i supervisori e i membri del team per soddisfare i programmi di produzione e gli standard di qualità.
Qualifiche
Competenze e Esperienze necessarie

• Esperienza precedente nella fabbricazione di metallo, nella produzione di lamiera o nel funzionamento del freno di pressa.

• Capacità di leggere e interpretare progetti, disegni di negozio e ordini di lavoro.

• Forte comprensione degli strumenti di misura, comprese le misure a nastro, pinze, quadrati e altri strumenti di misura di precisione.

• Esperienza di misurazione, marcatura, e la posa di materiale per la fabbricazione.

• Capacità di operare in modo sicuro attrezzature di fabbricazione e lavorazione dei metalli.

• Esperienza utilizzando utensili manuali e di potenza, tra cui smerigliatrici angolari.

• Abilità meccanica di base e capacità di problem solving.

• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e come parte di una squadra.
Qualificazioni predestinate

• Esperienza di lavoro con lamiera di acciaio inossidabile.

• Sperimenta l'impostazione e il funzionamento dei freni di pressione NC o CNC.

• Certificazione o esperienza del carrello elevatore (se applicabile).

• Conoscenza delle migliori pratiche di fabbricazione e metodi di ispezione di qualità.
Requisiti fisici

• Capacità di stare e camminare per lunghi periodi durante la giornata di lavoro.

• Capacità di piegare, raggiungere, stoop e sollevare materiali.

• Drill presses

• Large band saws and/or cold saws

• Experience using hand and power tools, including angle grinders.

• Basic mechanical aptitude and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working with stainless steel sheet metal.

• Experience setting up and operating NC or CNC press brakes.

• Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds on a regular basis.

• Safety glasses

• Steel-toed footwear

• Hearing protection

• Cut-resistant gloves

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer is a global leader in fluid engineering, specialising in the design and manufacture of pumps and associated equipment for some of the world’s most critical industries. Founded in 1834 and headquartered in Switzerland, we employ over 13,500 people worldwide, operating in more than 40 countries, generating annual sales of approximately CHF 3.6 billion. Our pumping technologies support customers across the energy, water and wastewater, chemicals, industrial manufacturing, life sciences and food markets, enabling safe, reliable and efficient fluid handling in demanding applications.

The Wexford site is a key contributor to Sulzer’s global pumping portfolio, with a strong focus on product development and engineering support for pumps and associated mechanical equipment. The team works closely with international stakeholders, supporting the design and development of products supplied to customers across global markets About the Role & Opportunity

We are seeking a Mechanical Design Technician to join our Product Development team in Wexford. This role plays an important part in supporting the design and development of engineered pump solutions and related equipment, working closely with experienced Project Manager's.

You will be involved throughout the design lifecycle, contributing to products that are used worldwide in process‑critical environments. This is a development‑focused role within a structured engineering organisation, offering long‑term technical growth and progression opportunities.

Key Duties

• Create and maintain 3D models and 2D engineering drawings for pumps and associated mechanical equipment

• Produce detailed manufacturing drawings, assemblies and bills of materials

• Support engineering change requests, design updates and product improvements

• Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, testing and quality teams

• Ensure compliance with engineering standards, procedures and documentation requirements

What We’re Looking For

• A qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Mechanical Design or a related discipline

• Experience creating engineering drawings and CAD models within a mechanical or manufacturing environment

• Understanding of mechanical assemblies, components and technical documentation

• A structured, detail‑orientated approach with good communication skills

• Motivation to learn, develop and build a long‑term career within engineering

Über die Rolle & Gelegenheit Wir suchen einen Mechaniker, der unserem Produktentwicklungsteam in Wexford beitritt. Diese Rolle spielt eine wichtige Rolle bei der Unterstützung des Designs und der Entwicklung von technischen Pumpenlösungen und zugehörigen Geräten und arbeitet eng mit erfahrenen Projektmanagern zusammen. Sie sind während des gesamten Design-Lebenszyklus beteiligt und tragen zu Produkten bei, die weltweit in prozesskritischen Umgebungen eingesetzt werden. Dies ist eine entwicklungsorientierte Rolle innerhalb einer strukturierten Engineering-Organisation, die langfristiges technisches Wachstum und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten bietet. Schlüsselaufgaben

• Herstellung detaillierter Fertigungszeichnungen, Baugruppen und Stücklisten
• Support Engineering Change Requests, Design Updates und Produktverbesserungen
• Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering-, Fertigungs-, Test- und Qualitätsteams

• Verständnis von mechanischen Baugruppen, Komponenten und technischer Dokumentation

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle Sulzer est un leader mondial de l'ingénierie des fluides, spécialisé dans la conception et la fabrication de pompes et d'équipements connexes pour certaines des industries les plus critiques du monde. Fondée en 1834 et basée en Suisse, nous employons plus de 13 500 personnes dans le monde, opérant dans plus de 40 pays, générant des ventes annuelles d'environ 3,6 milliards de francs suisses. Nos technologies de pompage soutiennent les clients sur les marchés de l'énergie, de l'eau et des eaux usées, des produits chimiques, de la fabrication industrielle, des sciences de la vie et de l'alimentation, permettant une manipulation sûre, fiable et efficace des fluides dans des applications exigeantes. Le site de Wexford est l'un des principaux contributeurs au portefeuille mondial de pompage de Sulzer, en mettant l'accent sur le développement de produits et le soutien technique pour les pompes et l'équipement mécanique connexe. L'équipe travaille en étroite collaboration avec les parties prenantes internationales, soutenant la conception et le développement de produits fournis aux clients sur les marchés mondiaux À propos du rôle et des possibilités Nous cherchons un technicien en conception mécanique pour rejoindre notre équipe de développement de produits à Wexford. Ce rôle joue un rôle important dans la conception et le développement de solutions de pompes et d'équipements connexes, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec des gestionnaires de projet expérimentés. Vous serez impliqué tout au long du cycle de vie de la conception, contribuant à des produits qui sont utilisés dans le monde entier dans des environnements critiques. Il s'agit d'un rôle axé sur le développement au sein d'une organisation d'ingénierie structurée, offrant des possibilités de croissance et de progression techniques à long terme. Principales fonctions
• Créer et entretenir des modèles 3D et des dessins d'ingénierie 2D pour pompes et équipements mécaniques associés
• Produire des dessins de fabrication détaillés, des assemblages et des factures de matériaux
• Soutenir les demandes de changement d'ingénierie, les mises à jour de conception et les améliorations de produit
• Collaborer avec des équipes d'ingénierie, de fabrication, d'essais et de qualité
• Veiller au respect des normes techniques, des procédures et des exigences en matière de documentation Ce que nous cherchons
• Une qualification en génie mécanique, conception mécanique ou une discipline connexe
• Expérience dans la création de dessins d'ingénierie et de modèles CAO dans un environnement mécanique ou manufacturier
• Compréhension des assemblages mécaniques, composants et documentation technique
• Une approche structurée et axée sur les détails, avec de bonnes compétences en communication
• Motivation pour apprendre, développer et construire une carrière à long terme en ingénierie Ce que nous vous offrons
• Salaire de base compétitif
• Congé annuel: Profitez de 26 jours de vacances
• Flexibilité: Des modalités de travail flexibles
• Pension: prestation d'un régime de pension à cotisations déterminées
• Stationnement sur place
• Cantine subventionnée sur place
• Congé de maternité/paternité
• Charge d'EV sur place (à taux réduit)
• Long Service Award : Nous reconnaissons et célébrons vos années de service.
• Programme d'aide aux employés : Privilégier le bien-être avec un soutien et des conseils confidentiels.
• Possibilités de croissance et de perfectionnement professionnels : Accès à des programmes d'apprentissage et de perfectionnement continus, offrant aux employés de précieuses possibilités d'amélioration des compétences et de progression de carrière. Competenze meccaniche e utensili di base.

Volontà di seguire le procedure e soddisfare gli obiettivi di produzione.

Teamwork and communication abilities.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The (Mechanical) Engineering Specialist is responsible for researching, designing, and developing mechanical systems and components. This role applies advanced engineering knowledge to support the development and testing of mechanical and electromechanical systems.
This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. 1. Serves as technical specialist in one or more of the following areas:
Vane Department
• Blade Department
• Combustion Department
• Gas Turbine Rotors
• Houston Aero

2. View parts immediately upon arrival. Visually inspect and inventory as required.

3. Work with Gas Turbine Inside Sales Representative during the quoting process.

4. Ensure that job work order releases are prompt and in order. Become completely aware of sales efforts and goals for the job.

5. Become completely aware of the customer requirements for the job, including technical requirements, hold points, and delivery.

6. Ensure that job work scopes are complete and correct. Ensure that the job work scopes are promptly issued to the Production Supervisors.

7. Ensure that all job work scopes contain all pertinent information with regards to procedures, prints, tolerances, and critical dimensions.

8. Order all material/parts required to complete each job. Ensure that material/parts are expedited as required for timely delivery. Production Engineer is responsible for the quality of the material supplied.

9. Review any challenging issues with Division Superintendent and/or Engineering. All first time jobs must be reviewed by Superintendent and Engineering.

10. Work together with Production Supervisors to establish schedules for production that ensure on-time deliveries.

11. Work together with Production Supervisors to optimize, refine, and streamline production work-flow and all of its effects.

• 12. Constantly monitor/check the following items on all working jobs. Review these items with the Component Division Superintendent on a weekly basis.
• · Job cost
• · Delivery status
• · Quotation status

13. Responsible for job coordination and tracking profitability.

14. Attend weekly production meetings.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays
• 401k plan with a 6% match
• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability
• Health savings account matching
• Motivating wellness program

• Gym reimbursement
