descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role At Sulzer GT Aero, we are a recognised global leader in the maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO) of aero‑derivative gas turbines. Our Netherley, Aberdeenshire facility is a centre of excellence, supporting customers worldwide with innovative, responsive and reliable solutions that keep critical equipment running. With continued investment and growth across the business, this is an exciting opportunity to join a high‑performing team and play a key role in supporting our spares and repairs operations. We are looking for a Spares & Repairs Coordinator to support the effective handling of customer requests for spare parts and component repairs. In this role, you will work closely with customers, suppliers and internal teams to ensure enquiries are processed efficiently, quotations are prepared accurately, and orders are progressed smoothly from initial enquiry through to completion. You will be a vital part of the end‑to‑end process, helping deliver the high standards of service that Sulzer is known for globally. What you’ll be doing:
• Act as a first point of contact for customer spares and repairs enquiries, responding promptly and professionally
• Support the review of customer requirements with internal teams and external suppliers to confirm feasibility, lead times and costs
• Prepare accurate quotations for spares and repairs and issue them to customers in line with internal processes
• Coordinate orders from receipt through to completion, liaising with internal departments, suppliers and customers throughout
• Provide regular updates to customers, ensuring orders and repair activities are tracked and delivered on time
• Maintain accurate records within ERP and CRM systems, supporting reporting on order status, lead times and performance
• Assist with sales and tender activities where required, including preparing supporting information for spares and repairs opportunities What you bring:
• Experience in a spares, repairs, aftermarket, coordination or customer support role within an engineering or industrial environment
• Experience using ERP and CRM systems (Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Salesforce experience is desirable)
• Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively
• Good communication skills, confident working with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders
• Commercial awareness with an understanding of quotations, pricing and cost control
• A proactive, detail‑focused and solutions‑driven approach, with the ability to perform well in a fast‑paced environment What we offer you Joining Sulzer GT Aero means becoming part of a business with a strong reputation in the gas turbine sector, a clear growth strategy and a collaborative working culture. In return, we offer:
• Competitive base salary with participation in the company‑wide bonus programme
• 33 days’ annual leave (inclusive of bank holidays)
• Free on‑site parking
• Access to discounts on everyday shopping, entertainment and lifestyle services
• Confidential support through our Employee Assistance Programme
• Ongoing learning and development opportunities through on‑the‑job training and Sulzer Learning Pathways Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Responsible for the overhaul, repair, installation & commissioning of Electro Mechanical equipment to support our client. Preparing, coordinating and carrying out inspections and repairs of all Motor types and Generator at customer sites inside and outside the country, within the specified time and at the estimated cost. Main tasks and responsibilities
• Carrying out reparations and inspections inside and outside the country at customer sites.
• Provision of safe and effective site and workshop overhaul, repair, installation and commissioning services for Electro Mechanical family rotating equipment.
• Be the first point of contact for allocated customers in respect of any issues relating to agreed on-site scopes of work.
• Develop strong relationships with key client contacts.
• Be responsible for on-site Health & Safety.
• Compile on-site Risk Assessments for scopes of work.
• Lead and supervise on-site repair teams during site contract execution.
• Provide continuous improvement in repair, installation and commissioning activities.
• Develop and maintain good and effective relationships with clients to optimise further service opportunities.
• Liaise with technical departments within Sulzer to develop engineering solutions.
• Manage relevant suppliers and subcontractors.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

We are seeking a highly motivated and commercially minded Strategic Projects Manager to drive critical strategic initiatives across our global services organization. This is a high-impact role working closely with senior leadership to identify growth opportunities, lead transformational projects, support strategic decision-making, and enhance business performance across multiple regions.

The successful candidate will combine strong analytical capabilities, business acumen, and project management expertise to deliver initiatives that accelerate growth, improve operational effectiveness, and strengthen our competitive position in the market.

• Lead and drive cross functional and global strategic projects to ensure that high performance levels are attained

• Lead projects to support growth plans across all the regions of Services: projects include (but not limited to): footprint expansion, market assessment, partnerships, digitalization projects, operational excellence programs, etc.

• Participate and support the management team in the annual strategic planning and budgeting process

• Summarize industry M&A transactions by region and industry

• Support in drafting of Board and Executive committee documents

Requirements

• Proven experience in strategy, business transformation, corporate development, management consulting, project management, or a similar strategic role.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; additional languages are advantageous.

• Strong understanding of business financials, investment evaluation, and commercial performance metrics.

• Experience creating executive-level presentations and strategic recommendations.

• Strategic thinker with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights, High levels of accountability, integrity, and drive for results.

• Ability to synthesize complex information and communicate key conclusions effectively.

• Collaborative stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence across regions and functions.

• QlikView/Qlik Sens experience is a plus

• Excellent Excel and PowerPoint skills

Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Designs and delivers hands on mechanical training courses (1–2 weeks) that build foundational and advanced turbomachinery skills, guiding new hires through core concepts, job book exercises, and real-world inspection and assembly practices while evaluating their proficiency. Develops and continuously improves training curricula, materials, and programs to address skill gaps, enhance safety and productivity, and ensure effective onboarding and ongoing workforce upskilling. Responsibilities
• Leading novice mechanical training courses
• Helping to develop the next generation of mechanical talent within our organization
• Guiding groups through the critical job book exercises
• Teaching refined mechanical skills throughout the disassembly, inspection and reassembly stages of an overall
• Verifying an employee’s ability to apply measurement methods to real world inspection scenarios
• Guide new hires through basic terminology and turbomachinery overview
• Identify current and future training needs and create a curriculum to facilitate that training
• Refining and developing mechanical training materials
• Advancing the modules that have already been created
• Building out adjacent training modules for other equipment types
• Developing training aides for specialized tasks.
• Leading periodic advance mechanical upskilling training efforts
• Supporting aspects of new hire shop orientation
• Supporting occasional outage Production Supervision responsibilities/oversight
• Search for gaps in training content and materials that need updating to generate higher productivity and safety among staff
• Researching new training supplies and materials that can enhance Sulzer’s training procedures while providing value to employees
• Communicating with management, trainers, and team members to ensure that all training needs are met
• Conducting technical orientation programs and arranging on-the-job training for new hires as needed
• Resolving any specific problems and tailoring training programs as necessary
• Provide documentation of employees performance during training to supervision and upper management including aptitude, attitude, and academic performance.
• Maintain records from all training classes. Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Education, or similar related disciplines and/or a combination of training, experience, and education.
• 5 or more years of technical training experience in an industrial and/or manufacturing setting
• Significant experience creating technical training curriculums and programs
• Ability to plan, manage time, and multitask effectively
• Advanced database and computer skills
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills
• Advanced record-keeping skills
• Good decision-making, problem-solving, collaboration and teamwork skills
• Leadership and motivational skills are a plus What we offer you

This is a pivotal, multi-site leadership role shaping the future of our UK operations, combining strategic oversight, operational excellence, and cultural transformation. Our Southampton and Ipswich sites bring together skilled specialists delivering overhaul, repair, and upgrade services for pumps, turbines, compressors, and other rotating machinery. Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Assembler is responsible for putting together component parts or products according to blueprints or schematics. This role ensures that assembled items meet quality standards and supports the production line by maintaining efficiency and accuracy.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. Position Summary:
Under indirect supervision and following JWCE’s Standard Operating Procedures, reads electric schematics and interprets wiring diagrams to assemble, wire, troubleshoot, and complete low voltage, hydraulic package and final quality testing of electrical motor control panels and enclosures.
Principle Duties and Responsibilities:

• Performs essential wiring of control panels used in monitoring and controlling electric motors & hydraulic power packs.

• Performs final quality assurance of all series controls in accordance with company practices, and UL, NEMA, NEC and CSA requirements.

• Matches complex picking lists and motor control diagrams and review, correct and document discrepancies.

• Identifies problems and resolves issues to ensure system functions properly.

• Performs high pot testing of motor control.

• Assists QA technicians with basic inspection and testing of all model control panels.

• Maintains organized work station and area.

• Adheres to safety standards of facility.

• Performs other duties and special projects as assigned.

• Must be able to lift up to 35lbs.

• Must be able to stand for extended periods of time.
Experience, Education & Skills:
Required: High School Degree
Desirable: 2-year Vocational Certificate in HVAC, Electrical, or Electronics is a plus.

• 2+ years’ experience in a UL Motor Control Panel Shop or Hands-on in a class room setting.

• Knowledgeable using test meters to perform point-to-point continuity checks.

• Possess a thorough understanding of control theory and control concepts.

• Feels comfortable working with medium voltage (up to 120 VAC)

• Ability to read schematics and interpret wiring diagrams.

• Able to use basic electrical hand tools. (cutting, crimping, and stripping)

• Attention to detail.

• Highly self-motivated.

Pay Rate: $23/hr - 23.50/hr
We are equal opportunity/affirmative action employer.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Sulzer Chemtech’s Mass Transfer Components & Services (MTCS) division delivers advanced solutions that support refineries, petrochemical plants, renewables, bio‑based industries, and oil & gas operators worldwide. We are expanding our footprint in West Africa—and we’re looking for a technically driven, commercially sharp Regional Sales Manager to help us grow. As the Regional Sales Manager – MTCS, you will be the face of Sulzer Chemtech for customers across Nigeria and West Africa. This role blends technical expertise with strong business acumen. You’ll engage directly with engineering, operations, procurement, and leadership teams to understand process challenges, propose tailored solutions, and drive profitable long‑term partnerships. This is an opportunity to take ownership of a high‑impact region, shape market strategy, and work closely with global experts in mass transfer and separation technology. Key Responsibilities Customer & Market Engagement
• Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and potential customers.
• Conduct regular site visits and technical discussions to understand operational challenges.
• Position Sulzer Chemtech as a trusted technical advisor in the region. Business Development
• Identify and develop new opportunities across refineries, petrochemical plants, gas processing facilities, and bio‑based industries.
• Grow the sales pipeline and deliver sustainable business results. Technical & Commercial Activities
• Evaluate inquiries, analyse process data, and develop cost‑effective technical solutions.
• Prepare accurate proposals, cost estimations, and techno‑commercial presentations.
• Manage the full tendering process including clarifications, negotiations, and contract finalisation. What You’ll Bring Education
• A degree in Chemical Engineering or related Process Engineering field (beneficial). Experience
• Operational plants: process engineering, revamp projects, operations support in refineries, petrochemicals, gas processing, or chemical/biobased plants.
• Technology/service providers or EPCs: technical sales, proposal engineering, or project development.
• A blended background across both plant operations and technology providers is highly valued. Technical Skills
• Strong understanding of separation technologies, mass transfer equipment, and mixing technologies.
• Ability to interpret PFDs, P&IDs, and process data to deliver optimised solutions.
• Experience preparing tenders, proposals, and engaging in CAPEX project development. Soft Skills & Competencies
• Strong communication and relationship‑building abilities.
• Commercial awareness and negotiation skills.
• High level of organisation, independence, and initiative.
• Customer‑centric mindset and collaborative spirit. Other Requirements
• Willingness to travel frequently across Nigeria and West Africa.
• Fluent English (additional regional languages advantageous).
• Valid driver’s licence (or willingness to obtain). What we offer you
• Work for a globally recognised engineering leader.
• Be part of a dynamic, innovative, and supportive team.
• Gain comprehensive training in Sulzer technologies and tools.
• Shape high‑impact projects across energy, chemicals, and sustainable processing industries. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role The Equipment Service Technician provides first level customer support for rental units deployed in the field. You will test, diagnose, troubleshoot, repair, and debug electro-mechanical processing equipment and related systems. You must be able to communication and to work closely with Engineering, Project Management, and other Field Technicians on complex problems and assume responsibilities for continued customer satisfaction. This position requires frequent travel to customer sites to assist with installation, start-up, servicing/repairing Wastewater Treatment Equipment (WWTE) and related sub-systems, and Operator training. Principle Duties and Responsibilities:
• Assist the Service Technician at FRC2 with the refurbishment of rental units.
• Able and willing to travel 50% to 60% of the time to perform service-related tasks at customer sites.
• Troubleshoot a variety of Industrial WWTE and resolve mechanical, electrical, and performance issues.
• Assist customers on the phone and/or in the field with troubleshooting equipment.
• Prepare detailed reports related to site visits, equipment problems/concerns/recommendations.
• Adhere to safety policies and use of safety equipment.
• Adhere to Corporate credit card and travel procedures.
• Position requires the ability to work extensive hours outdoors in sometimes less than ideal situations (adverse weather, noise, and possibly wet conditions)
• Physical Demand – Move and/or lift up to 50lbs, constant movement – standing, climbing, and walking.
• FRC is a Drug-Free Workplace, Employment subject to passing a drug test. Education
• 2 years of technical trade or equivalent experience.
• Course work or prior verifiable work experience with installing, troubleshooting and/or repairing electrical/pneumatic/automated/industrial equipment.
• Must have mechanical aptitude with ability to use various hand/power tools to install/maintain equipment.
• Knowledge of electrical components and understanding of electrical current flow with ability to identify and troubleshoot the same. Requirements:
• Able and willing to travel a minimum 50% - 60% of the time.
• Able and willing to learn and apply required customer service skills.
• Able to learn, produce, and submit accurate service and expense reports in a timely manner.
• Prefer experience in mechanical and electrical repair on industrial wastewater equipment.
• Prefer knowledge of automated machine controls.
• Able to read and follow blueprints, machine drawings, and electrical drawings.
• Proficient in the use of a laptop computer and Microsoft Office suite.
• Able to use a variety of common power and hand tools.
• Able to work safely and efficiently according to industry standards.
• Valid driver’s license.
• Strong troubleshooting ability – The ability to look at the overall picture and determine source of problem/issue.
• Ability to qualify for a US passport. Working Conditions
• Requires about 50% - 60% travel and may include non-traditional work hours.
• Ready and willing to assist the service technician at the FRC 2 facility when not travelling.
• Industrial Wastewater Treatment facility which can be cold or hot and damp environment.
• Use of personal protection devices (ear plugs, hard hat, and eye protection).
• When not traveling, work may need to be completed from hotels, and/or office. What we offer you
• 12 Paid Holidays
• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days
• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability insurance
• 401k with 6% company match
• Employee Assistance Program
• Employee Wellness Program
• Bonus Programs Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role The Environmental, Safety & Health (ESH) Supervisor is responsible for leading safety initiatives, compliance programs, and environmental standards across multiple field service locations. This role provides direct supervision of safety processes, supports environmental compliance, and ensures field crews operate safely and in alignment with regulatory and customer requirements. Partnering with operations, HR, and corporate EHS to drive a proactive safety culture, oversee training and compliance systems, and provide hands-on job site support to protect people, equipment, and the environment. Responsibilities: Leadership & Program Oversight
• Supervise and guide ESH activities across Houston, New Orleans, and field service operations.
• Lead implementation of safety programs, SSE initiatives, and environmental compliance efforts.
• Ensure consistent execution of OSHA, DOT, ISO, and customer safety standards.
• Work with project managers, site supervisors, and contractors to integrate safety into operations and project planning.
• Conduct monthly safety meetings with supervisors and oversee annual safety goal setting, incentive programs, and continuous improvement projects. Environmental Compliance
• Ensure compliance with environmental regulations, permitting, and reporting requirements.
• Oversee hazardous waste management, spill kit inspections, and air/noise/chemical monitoring
• Support facility audits and ensure emergency environmental response plans are in place and tested. Safety Training & Records Management
• Manage new hire safety onboarding and orientation in partnership with HR and Medical.
• Oversee training compliance through TrainingToday, 360Training, and other platforms.
• Ensure OSHA 30, confined space, fall protection, rigging, and site-specific training are current.
• Coordinate external training such as NCCCO, NCCER, CSHO, and Safe Bolting - tracking completion rates against annual targets. Field Safety Leadership
• Conduct site visits for high-risk or large-scale jobs, near misses, or incidents.
• Participate in pre-job planning with operations and supervisors to evaluate scope, risks, and safety requirements.
• Develop, implement, and distribute Safety Execution Plans (SEPs) for each project, tailored to customer requirements and site-specific risks.
• Communicate plans to supervisors, crews, and subcontractors before mobilization.
• Provide onsite support for Daily Safety Meetings/Toolbox Talks, JSAs, WIP reports, PPE checks, inspections, and safety coaching.
• Inspect tool units and field equipment regularly to identify tools or equipment that may have slipped through initial inspections, ensuring unsafe items are removed from service immediately.
• Lead or support incident investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action tracking.
• Partner with Field Service Supervisors to ensure lockout/tagout (LOTO), lift plans, and job permits meet standards. Express any concern to the Supervisor and plan for any improvements.
• Support medical response and injury management in coordination with Prime GS and external providers. Compliance Systems & Reporting
• Ensure subcontractors and vendors follow site-specific safety plans and meet compliance requirements set by the customer.
• Conduct site audits, verify qualifications, and equipment maintenance/inspection records. (forklift, overhead crane, rigging, etc.).
• Oversee contractor compliance platforms (ISNetworld, Avetta, NCMS, Veriforce).
• Manage OSHA logs, DOT compliance, certificates of insurance, ISO requirements, and EMR reporting.
• Coordinate internal and external audits; oversee documentation and corrective action closeouts.
• Prepare monthly MIS reports, TRIR, injury rates, and observation st

Position Summary We are seeking a detail-oriented and technically proficient Tendering Engineer to support proposal development for equipment and services supplied to nuclear power plants. descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Mechanical Engineer is responsible for researching, planning, designing, and developing mechanical products and systems. This includes instruments, controls, engines, and machines used in energy production, transmission, and measurement. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyze problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. The Product Engineer reports to Team Leader ORE. Responsibilities:
• Management of the assigned mechanical design projects from Sales order review stage to handover to production.
• Undertake responsibility for order related design, processing and supporting activities for the assigned product range.
• Review of the customer project design specifications, communication with Sales/Tendering team to transform the customer requirements into product through order related engineering.
• Preparation of the customer facing documents as Pump Cross Section drawings, Pump General Arrangement drawings, P&ID drawings, Wiring diagram etc in 2D or 3D.
• Review and approval of buyout component drawings & documents related to Motor, Coupling, Mechanical Seal & Systems, ARC Valves, Gear box, VFD, Turbine etc.
• Review of the Instruments requirement & co-ordination with Instrumentation team.
• Preparation, check & release of the Bill Of Material (BOM) in SAP ERP.
• Communicate with Customers & sub-suppliers as necessary.
• Support & coordinate with different teams of Operations, Purchase, Sales, Quality & Testing during the complete cycle of the order execution.
• Provide engineering support to pump site commissioning team until successful operation of the equipment supplied.
• Proactively engage & support company initiatives designed to promote a culture of safe working, environmental protection and continual improvement. Qualification, Experience and Knowledge requirement
• Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering from reputed institute.
• 4-8 years of experience in Centrifugal Pump design field & API standards.
• Must have hands on experience on AutoCAD design software. Experience in Inventor, NX & Team center will be an added advantage.
• Conversant with the use of the SAP ERP tool.
• Independent and proactive with good communication & interpersonal skills.
• Managed and executed multiple tasks while taking direction from several sources.
• High sense of ownership, strong work ethic, focused on details and results oriented. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Informazioni sul ruolo Come Bid & Tendering Specialist sei un giocatore chiave nel tradurre i requisiti del cliente e le valutazioni del sito in costi di progetto dettagliati e precisi. Siete essenziali per garantire che le offerte per i servizi di attrezzature Steam Turbine & Compressor siano competitive, tecnicamente precise e commercialmente solide. Sarete responsabili dello sviluppo di proposte per progetti complessi, garantendo l'allineamento tra fattibilità tecnica, efficienza dei costi e successo commerciale. Role Location: Any Sulzer location. I vostri compiti principali e responsabilità:
• Garantire un'accurata definizione di portata tecnica e gestione del rischio per complessi progetti di servizio Steam Turbine & Compressor (ad esempio ispezioni, riparazioni, fornitura di parti, soluzioni multi-train, ritiri, aggiornamenti e modifiche)
• Preparare la stima dei costi end-to-end e le quotazioni commerciali per progetti Steam Turbine & Compressor basati su specifiche tecniche
• Coinvolgere e collaborare con successo con i clienti e i partner esterni (ad esempio venditori / subappaltatori) e con gli stakeholder interni
• Sostenere le attività post-tender, assicurando una transizione regolare dall'offerta all'esecuzione, compresa la validazione del campo e la briefing del progetto
• Contribuisci all'approvvigionamento e all'efficienza dei costi lavorando a stretto contatto con i fornitori per garantire prezzi ottimali, tempi di consegna e qualità per parti e servizi correlati
• Migliorare costantemente i metodi di stima dei costi per migliorare l'accuratezza e l'efficienza nelle strategie dei prezzi Per avere successo in questo ruolo, avrete bisogno di:
• Qualifica riconosciuta in ingegneria meccanica o disciplina correlata. Siamo anche aperti a considerare gli ingegneri di vendita o gli ingegneri di progetto con proposte / offerta / esperienza di offerta che stanno cercando un nuovo percorso di carriera.
• Forte esperienza nei servizi rotanti di attrezzature, bonifica di officina e processi di riparazione. Espulsione essenziale con Turbina a vapore / apparecchiature di compressione multistadio.
• Familiarità con catene di fornitura di servizio e riparazione.
• Competenze analitiche e mentalità commerciale
• Personalità attiva e orientata alla soluzione con forti capacità interpersonali Cosa ti offriamo
• Possibilità di avere un impatto significativo in una zona in rapida crescita del nostro business.
• Ambiente di lavoro collaborativo e di supporto con un focus sull'innovazione e l'eccellenza.
• Pacchetto di stipendio competitivo con benefici attraenti, regime pensionistico e programmi di assistenza ai dipendenti
• Opportunità emozionanti per la crescita e il progresso professionale in un settore dinamico ed in evoluzione Sulzer è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo. Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Sr. Manufacturing Quality Inspector is responsible for auditing, monitoring, and determining the quality of manufacturing processes and outputs. This role ensures compliance with internal and regulatory standards and supports the timely delivery of quality products. This job profile is intended for support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations. SUMMARY: Performs receipt and in-process dimensional and visual inspection of machined and fabricated parts, purchased items and finished assemblies. Create and record inspection results on appropriate inspection report using Microsoft Excel and Word. Reviews sub-contractor procedures and reports; and maintains department records and procedures for current code requirements. Position functions independently with occasional guidance from the Quality Assurance Manager. ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: % OF TIME 60% Performs dimensional and visual inspection of machined and fabricated parts, purchased items and finished assemblies in accordance with appropriate specifications. 10% Monitors for compliance to processes and procedures. 10% Communicate with manufacturing personnel concerning priority of inspection. 10% Perform surveillance activities at Supplier facilities to determine compliance and acceptability of equipment/process being supplied. 10% Interfaces with 3rd party and Customer inspectors as required. SECONDARY RESPONSIBILIES
• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in EHS Management System, including following safety, health and environmental policies and procedures.
• Sulzer procedure review and implementation assistance.
• Adheres to company and department policies, procedures, and standards
• Regular and reliable attendance with flexible work habits and schedule.
• Performs other duties as necessary SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES: None QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS:
• ASNT Certification for NDE Level I or Level II for PT, MT, UT and/or VT, preferred.
• Proficient in Microsoft and SAP applications
• Ability to read and interpret drawings, procedures, and specifications, define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions
• Understanding appropriate application of inspection techniques
• Working knowledge of ASME, ASTM, AWS and other relative codes, preferred.
• Good written and oral communication, organizational skills, and ability to perform basic math.
• High School Diploma required. What we offer you
• 12 Paid Holidays
• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days
• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability
• 401K with 6% company match
• Employee Assistance Program
• Employee Wellness Program
• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center) Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Are you passionate about developing early talent and supporting people at the start of their careers? We’re looking for a highly organised, people‑focused Early Careers Coordinator to join our team on a maternity cover basis, based in Leeds.
• Start date: June (to allow for handover)
• Contract: Fixed-term, 14 months
• Reporting to: Learning & Development Manager This role plays a key part in delivering a positive experience for our graduates and apprentices across Sulzer’s UK operations. It’s ideal for someone who enjoys responsibility, autonomy and being the central point of coordination for early careers programmes. What you’ll be doing
• Coordinating and supporting Sulzer’s early careers programmes, including graduates and apprentices
• Acting as a key point of contact for early careers participants, providing guidance and support throughout their journey
• Managing programme activities such as inductions, rotations, development milestones and key events
• Maintaining accurate early careers records and tracking progression and outcomes
• Building strong relationships with stakeholders across the business to ensure a smooth and consistent early careers experience
• Working closely with the Learning & Development Manager and the Leeds‑based L&D team to ensure programmes run effectively About you
• Highly organised with strong attention to detail
• Confident managing your own workload, diary and priorities
• A clear, professional communicator who enjoys working with people
• Comfortable using HR or learning systems (experience with learning platforms is a plus) Location, travel & flexibility
• Leeds will be your primary working location, with hybrid working available (office and home)
• Some UK travel required, primarily to Birmingham, with occasional travel to Aberdeen and other UK locations
• Planned travel only, with occasional overnight stays – no last‑minute “drop‑everything” requests
• Full UK driving licence required What we offer you
• Competitive base salary.
• Flexitime policy supporting a balanced and flexible approach to working hours.
• 33 days annual leave .
• Defined pension contribution.
• Medicash healthcare plan, helping cover everyday costs such as dental, optical and physiotherapy, plus a range of wellbeing benefits.
• Employee Assistance Programme, offering confidential support when you need it.
• Wide range of discounts on shopping, entertainment and lifestyle, with access to apply for Costco membership.
• Continuous learning and development through Sulzer Learning Pathways.
• Modern working environment – Our Leeds site is undergoing a significant renovation, creating a refreshed, high‑quality and modern workspace.
• Onsite facilities – Enjoy a 24/7 gym, subsidised canteen, vending machines, and an active Sports & Social Club.
• Support for veterans, reservists and cadet adult volunteers – Sulzer is a Bronze Award holder under the MoD’s Defence Employer Recognition Scheme and actively welcomes ex‑military personnel. Why join us?
• A meaningful role shaping the experience of future talent
• High levels of autonomy and trust in how you manage your time
• Supportive, collaborative L&D team with a structured handover
• Opportunity to gain broad exposure across learning and development activities About Sulzer Sulzer is a global engineering company specialising in fluid engineering and chemical processing solutions for industries that are essential to everyday life, including energy, water and manufacturing. descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role This role sits at the intersection of enterprise architecture, data governance, and business transformation. The Lead Architect – Data Quality works with business and IT leaders to redesign end-to-end processes and data flows so that high-quality data becomes the default outcome rather than a downstream correction effort. The position plays a central role in large-scale change initiatives (e.g., ERP modernization, MDM rollout, customer and material master harmonization, PLM integrations), providing a unique opportunity to create lasting architectural impact across Sulzer. Key Responsibilities
• Lead the design of enterprise data quality architecture and ensure preventive controls are embedded into processes and systems by default.
• Define and evolve enterprise data models, standards, critical data elements, and validation rules across priority domains (e.g., Customer, Material, Product).
• Drive root-cause elimination initiatives by redesigning processes, system interactions, and data ownership models.
• Define data quality KPIs and maturity tracking; monitor trends, risks, and progress and report transparently to governance bodies and management.
• Act as a key architectural contributor to data-related transformation programs (ERP, CRM, PLM, MDM, integration, analytics).
• Partner closely with Enterprise Architecture and IT leadership to shape future-state data and integration architecture decisions.
• Establish escalation mechanisms aligned with the enterprise data governance framework and enable consistent decision-making across Legal Entities.
• Contribute to evaluation and selection of data quality, governance, and MDM technologies and help define target-state capabilities. Candidate Profile
• University degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.
• Minimum 5+ years of experience in data architecture, data quality, data governance, or related enterprise transformation roles.
• Strong understanding of data quality management and controls, enterprise data flows, integrations, and end-to-end business processes.
• Proven ability to perform root-cause analysis beyond symptoms and drive structural remediation.
• Strong conceptual thinking combined with pragmatic execution and delivery focus.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills in English Preferred Qualifications
• Experience in a global industrial, engineering, or manufacturing environment.
• Hands-on exposure to enterprise application landscapes (SAP-centric environments such as S/4HANA/MDG, CRM, PLM, MDM).
• Experience working closely with Enterprise Architects or IT architecture teams.
• Relevant certification in data management, data governance, or architecture.
• Familiarity with modern integration patterns and data platforms (API-led integration, event-driven patterns, data lakes/warehouses) is a plus. Success Measures
• Recurring data quality issues are reduced through structural, preventive solutions.
• Data quality controls are embedded into business processes and system designs.
• Clear ownership and accountability for data quality issues are established and followed.
• Business and IT teams align on systemic data quality remediation rather than manual fixes.
• Enterprise data architecture decisions consistently reflect data quality and governance requirements What we offer you
• A permanent contract.
• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.
• Restaurant tickets
• Be part of an experienced, international team.
• A good vibe working environment.
• Enjoy great office facilities and a perfect location in Madrid Nuevos Ministerios , making

Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary To provide hands-on technical assistance in the repair and maintenance of various equipment in the workshop or at the customer sites. Main tasks and responsibilities
• Overhaul and repair of Various type of Turbine, gear boxes, pumps, compressors, and associated other equipment such auxiliary

• Behaviour requirement: Achievement Orientation, communication for result, teamwork, active learning, business awareness, problem solving and analytical thinking Qualifications/Experience and Knowledge Required
• Fresh Graduate are welcome., 1–2-year experience in machinist role or automotive mechanic is preferred

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Warranty Manager is responsible for the end‑to‑end management of complex warranty claims, acting as the primary interface between customers and internal stakeholders while applying advanced technical, commercial, and organizational expertise to ensure timely, compliant, and cost‑effective resolution, maintain customer satisfaction, prevent escalation, and protect the company’s commercial and reputational interests. Key Responsibilities Warranty Claims & Process Management
• Manage warranty claims as technical projects or standardized end-to-end processes from claim initiation through successful resolution and closure.
• Develop and maintain claim resolution plans, schedules, cost estimates, and closure criteria.
• Control and monitor claim progress against contractual obligations, internal policies, and agreed service levels (SLAs).
• Ensure full traceability, documentation integrity, and compliance throughout the warranty lifecycle. Customer & Stakeholder Interface
• Act as the single point of contact between the customer and internal stakeholders for all warranty-related matters.
• Maintain close, structured, and transparent communication with customers to manage expectations and avoid escalation.
• Coordinate internally with Engineering, Quality, Production, Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Legal, and Service teams to enable timely and aligned resolutions.
• Facilitate technical and commercial discussions to achieve balanced, win–win outcomes within contractual and financial boundaries. Warranty Cost Control & Financial Discipline
• Control and monitor warranty claim expenditures to ensure alignment with the approved and allocated budget.
• Track actual warranty costs versus provisions and budgets, identifying variances proactively.
• Implement cost containment and optimization measures without compromising resolution effectiveness or customer satisfaction.
• Coordinate with Finance and relevant stakeholders to ensure accurate cost allocation, forecasting, and reporting.
• Support recovery actions from suppliers, sub-vendors, or third parties, where applicable, to minimize net warranty exposure. Technical Analysis & Problem Resolution
• Lead technical investigations and root cause analysis for complex or recurring warranty issues.
• Validate corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to ensure sustainable resolution and risk reduction.
• Escalate critical technical, quality, or commercial risks with clear impact assessment and recommendations. Customer Satisfaction & Feedback Management
• Ensure customer satisfaction throughout the warranty claim lifecycle by delivering timely, high-quality, and transparent claim resolution.
• Own customer feedback related to warranty claims, including collection, analysis, response, and closure.
• Address customer concerns proactively to prevent dissatisfaction and preserve long-term customer relationships.
• Translate customer feedback into improvement actions in coordination with Engineering, Quality, and Service teams. Performance Management & Continuous Improvement
• Ensure warranty activities align with departmental KPIs, including Warranty Cost Control & Financial Discipline.
• Monitor performance indicators such as claim cycle time, escalation rate, customer satisfaction, and recurrence trends.
• Identify systemic issues and contribute to process, design, or quality improvements to reduce future warranty exposure.
• Capture and communicate lessons learned to relevant stakeholders and governance forums. Leadership & Capability Development
• Provide technical and process guidance to junior professionals involved in warranty claim execution.
• Review work outputs for accuracy, quality, and compliance with standar

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Join our Process Solutions team and play a central part in the success of our licensed technologies. We are looking for an experienced leader to manage and grow our global aftermarket business. This business supplies essential solvents and catalysts to our customers in the refining, petrochemical, biofuels, and chemical recycling sectors. This role is key to providing our customers with valuable, long-term solutions. You will be responsible for the success of this business line, shaping its strategy and driving its growth. The role can be based in a number of locations: Winterthur/Allschwil, Singapore, Shanghai, Houston, or fully remote. Key roles and contributions:
• Define and execute a winning strategy for our solvent and catalyst business, creating synergy with Sulzer's licensed technologies.
• Make our product offerings stronger through smart pricing, effective market positioning, and good supplier partnerships.
• Oversee our solvent and catalyst products from development to end-of-life, including driving new innovations.
• Work closely with our technology and process solution teams to increase aftermarket sales.
• Keep track of industry trends, competitors, and new opportunities for business growth.
• Collaborate across departments to ensure our products and services meet customer needs. To succeed in this role, you will need:
• A bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering, chemistry, or a similar field.
• 10-15 years of experience in the refining, petrochemical, or chemical processing industries.
• A strong background in selling catalysts, solvents, or other industrial chemicals to these markets.
• Proven success in growing an aftermarket business for industrial products.
• A good understanding of process technologies, product portfolio management, and how solvents and catalysts are used.
• Experience with extraction technologies (such as BTX extraction) is a major plus.
• Excellent skills in strategic thinking, communication, negotiation, and leadership.
• Fluency in English is required. Other languages are an asset. What we offer you
• Attractive compensation and vacation plan
• Excellent social benefits
• Global development opportunities
• A collaborative, diverse and innovation-driven culture
• Employee Assistance Program
• Long service awards Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Join our Process Solutions team and play a central part in the success of our licensed technologies. We are looking for an experienced leader to manage and grow our global aftermarket business. This business supplies essential solvents and catalysts to our customers in the refining, petrochemical, biofuels, and chemical recycling sectors. This role is key to providing our customers with valuable, long-term solutions. You will be responsible for the success of this business line, shaping its strategy and driving its growth. The role can be based in a number of locations: Winterthur/Allschwil, Singapore, Shanghai, Houston, or fully remote. Key roles and contributions:
• Define and execute a winning strategy for our solvent and catalyst business, creating synergy with Sulzer's licensed technologies.
• Make our product offerings stronger through smart pricing, effective market positioning, and good supplier partnerships.
• Oversee our solvent and catalyst products from development to end-of-life, including driving new innovations.
• Work closely with our technology and process solution teams to increase aftermarket sales.
• Keep track of industry trends, competitors, and new opportunities for business growth.
• Collaborate across departments to ensure our products and services meet customer needs. To succeed in this role, you will need:
• A bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering, chemistry, or a similar field.
• 10-15 years of experience in the refining, petrochemical, or chemical processing industries.
• A strong background in selling catalysts, solvents, or other industrial chemicals to these markets.
• Proven success in growing an aftermarket business for industrial products.
• A good understanding of process technologies, product portfolio management, and how solvents and catalysts are used.
• Experience with extraction technologies (such as BTX extraction) is a major plus.
• Excellent skills in strategic thinking, communication, negotiation, and leadership.
• Fluency in English is required. Other languages are an asset. What we offer you
• Attractive compensation and vacation plan
• Excellent social benefits
• Global development opportunities
• A collaborative, diverse and innovation-driven culture
• Employee Assistance Program
• Long service awards Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Group ESG Sr. Analyst is responsible for supporting ESG data management, reporting, and analysis. This role contributes to ESG initiatives by providing insights, tracking performance, and assisting in stakeholder communications. This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. The ESG Integration Manager plays a central role in integrating sustainability into Flow’s business processes in line with the Corporate ESG strategy. The position leads the deployment of ESG initiatives across Business Units and Legal Entities, supports the achievement of environmental targets, ensures robust ESG data and reporting, and promotes best practices, governance, and compliance. This role actively contributes to building a strong ESG culture across the organization. Main responsibilities:
• Deploy Flow sustainability roadmap in alignment with Corporate ESG strategy and Flow priorities
• Govern ESG within the division through the Sustainability Council
• Maintain and further develop ESG frameworks and lead implementation efforts
• Report, lead, prioritize, drive, and coordinate the division ESH related actions
• Actively manage ESG KPIs and ensure data integrity and availability
• Meet corporate environmental targets and track improvement projects reviews via project funnel
• Management and administration of the Flow Ideation platform in collaboration with other nominated colleagues and participation in the Flow Innovation Council.
• Propose necessary actions to achieve goal fulfillment and correct deviations
• Support as needed the non-financial reporting preparation
• Develop training material on safety awareness and environmental attention
• Communicate Sustainability targets, best practice and achievements
• Ensure compliance to ISO 14001, stay up to date on ESG regulation and legislation requirements
• Environment: coordinate the actions plans to reduce the environmental load as part of ESG program What you need to succeed:
• 5+ years of experience in Sustainability / ESG / ESH functions, gained in an in‑house or consulting environment, ideally with exposure to industrial or manufacturing sectors.
• Strong expertise in ESG project management, including sustainability KPIs, frameworks, governance, and reporting; solid understanding of global ESG trends and regulations.
• Proven knowledge of environmental management systems and processes, including ISO 14001 (internal auditor); experience with CSRD‑related data is a plus.
• Degree in Sustainability Management, Environmental Sciences, Engineering, or Business; Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification desired; SAP knowledge is an advantage.
• Excellent communication and leadership skills, fluent in English, with the ability to engage diverse stakeholders, lead workshops, and work effectively in global, cross‑functional teams. What we offer you
• A permanent contract.
• A competitive salary as well as participation in the variable remuneration system based on personal and financial objectives.
• Restaurant tickets
• Be part of an experienced, international team.
• A good vibe working environment.
• Enjoy great office facilities and a perfect location in Madrid Nuevos Ministerios , making your work experience both comfortable and convenient.
• Other fringe benefits Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role If you love administration and thrive on being part of a growing, energetic business, we’d love to welcome you to our team. Our Sulzer Brisbane Service Centre is fast‑paced, collaborative and on an exciting growth journey, and we’re looking for an experienced admin professional to grow with us and make a real impact. Your main tasks and responsibilities
• General office admin including but not limited to reception activities, personnel queries e.g. travel and expenses and team coordination.
• Job package creation and admin including PO’s and Invoicing. This includes ensuring that all materials are accurately booked from stock to each job.
• System admin for materials and stock management. You will take control of the stock and be responsible for adequate supply. It is imperative that you effectively liaise with warehouse staff, drivers, suppliers and internal management by email and phone tenaciously.
• Accounts payable and receivable tasks - processing suppliers' invoices and customers for payment of invoices.
• General filing (manual and digital), data entry including payroll and reviewing wage reports to ensure 100% accuracy in a timely manner.
• Weekly on hand stock checks from list to ensure workshop consumables are consistently topped up, liaise with Management on levels to be ordered.
• Provide administration assistance to the Leadership Team as required.
• Ensure all work is carried out in accordance with legislative requirements, Company policies and procedures. What you bring to Sulzer
• 5+ Years' experience in Office Administration with purchasing and stores know how.
• You combine meticulous clerical skills with the practical mindset of a logistics professional.
• Reliability, friendly attitude and ability to liaise with blue collar to senior management personnel.
• Attention to detail.
• Strong computer skills with Microsoft suite, Microsoft Dynamics or equivalent SAP/ERP systems.
• Strong communication skills.
• Sound ability to adapt in shared duties.
• High level skills in time management. What we offer you
• Be part of a fun, energetic and collaborative team.
• Annual salary reviews
• Employee Assistance Program
• On-site parking
• Work for a global organisation that values innovation, excellence and a commitment to the most important part of our business - our people and our customers. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Start your career at Sulzer’s Falkirk Service Centre, the specialist hub for high‑voltage testing, repair and refurbishment of large industrial equipment. This is where complex, heavy‑duty engineering comes to life - and as an apprentice, you’ll work alongside expert engineers and project managers, learning hands‑on skills and knowledge that help power major industries across the UK and beyond. Our Project Manager Apprenticeship gives you real life experience, exposure to a variety of business projects and the chance to build solid technical skills in a professional engineering environment. Key Responsibilities
• Provide day-to-day administrative support to teams or managers
• Assist with creating and updating project plans, schedules, and timelines
• Communicate project updates to stakeholders and team members
• Maintain accurate records, databases, and filing systems
• Input and update information using internal systems and spreadsheets
• Act as a first point of contact for internal and external enquiries
• Communicate professionally via email, phone, and face-to-face
• Support customer or stakeholder queries and escalate where required
• Assist with improving administrative processes and ways of working
• Support business operations such as procurement, invoicing, or project management
• Help monitor KPIs and produce basic performance reports What We’re Looking For We welcome applicants who are enthusiastic about engineering and ready to learn. You’ll be a great fit if you have:
• 3 National 5’s (passes) , including Maths and English
• Motivation to learn and develop new skills
• Good time ‑ management and organisational ability
• A positive, flexible attitude and strong attention to detail
• Prior business administration or project management experience isn’t required - just curiosity, commitment, and a willingness to get involved. What we offer you
• Competitive apprentice pay that increases as you progress
• Mentoring and support from experienced professionals
• Opportunities to work with modern technology and innovative applications
• Sponsored education with pathways to higher qualifications
• Potential short placements at other UK sites
• Opportunities to work with teams or customers internationally
• Strong potential for a permanent role on successful completion
• Long ‑ term development and progression routes within Sulzer
• A UK-wide apprentice community of more than 80 peers
• 33 days’ holiday (including bank holidays)
• Company pension scheme What Will Your Time as an Apprentice Look Like? Year 1 – Full‑Time College You’ll spend your first year at college working towards a Level 2 or Level 3 engineering qualification. This gives you the foundation knowledge and core skills you’ll need before joining the team on-site. Years 2, 3 & 4 – On‑Site Development From your second year onwards, you’ll be based within our engineering teams. You’ll gain hands‑on experience, apply what you’ve learned, and continue your studies towards a Level 3 qualification and your final Apprenticeship Standard. Throughout this time you’ll receive regular mentoring, internal training, and opportunities to broaden your experience across different engineering tasks. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary Join our Sulzer Turbo Services team, part of Sulzer Services, which is one of the world's most advanced independent providers of repair, overhaul, and maintenance within the turbine industry. From Venlo (Lomm) or on site, we provide our customers worldwide with solid, customer-oriented, and flexible support for their Compressors, Steam and Gas Turbines. Please join our proud and highly skilled international crew as a Technical Field Advisor.This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. In this role you will be accountable for:
• Providing mechanical on-site technical direction and supervision during maintenance events (inspections, revisions, commissioning) of customer owned Power Generation Facilities utilizing Gas Turbines manufactured by Siemens, Ansaldo, Alstom, General Electric and MHI.
• Ensuring accurate installation, trouble shooting, maintenance and diagnostics of gas turbines and other rotating equipment according to Sulzer specifications
• Managing site activities like planning, integration and monitoring of resources and technical assistance based on agreed contractual work scope
• Supervising contract employees, manpower by providing directions, instructions, monitor quality and progress during gas turbine overhauls
• Ensuring all field activities are carried out safely complying with Sulzer’s QESH guidelines and procedures
• Reporting of all required job documentation (protocols, inspection reports, as –built drawings, work instructions, daily progress, defects and non-conformity etc.) properly and timely To succeed in this role, you will need:
• A vocational degree as a Technician
• 10 + years hands-on gas turbine experience and proven track record of executing overhaul projects
• Very good English language skills
• A proactive, flexible, and problem-solving attitude
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills What we offer you
• A more than competitive salary
• A generous number of holidays (40)
• A solid pension scheme
• Training opportunities Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Siamo alla ricerca di un tecnico/tecnico di laboratorio per unire il nostro team di applicazioni e tecnologie in Allschwil. In questo ruolo emozionante si pianifica ed eseguirà le prove dei clienti, nonché il supporto attivo sui progetti di ricerca e sviluppo interni (R&D). Condurrai diversi lavori pratici nel campo R&D per migliorare la sostenibilità nell'industria chimica e sviluppare le tecnologie future. I vostri compiti principali e responsabilità:
• Analisi della caratterizzazione mediante tecniche chiave, tra cui: cromatografia a gas (GC) con campionamento a testa e liquido accoppiato a rilevatori di MS, FID e TCD; spettroscopia ottica a emissione plasmatica ad alte prestazioni (ICP-OES); spettrofotometria UV-Viss; spettrofotometria a scansione differenziale
• Responsabile del supporto analitico, garantendo l'implementazione e l'ottimizzazione dei metodi e dell'operabilità dei dispositivi corrispondenti durante le prove (compresa la preparazione degli strumenti, la calibrazione esterna, la preparazione dei campioni e le misurazioni di routine)
• Pianificazione, esecuzione, valutazione e rendicontazione delle prove del cliente (scala del banco a scala pilota).
• Supporto nell'esecuzione di prove interne ed esterne per lo sviluppo e l'ottimizzazione delle tecnologie Sulzer;
• Lavoro in stretta collaborazione con gli stakeholder aziendali interni;
• Assicurare e rispettare adeguate misure di ESH e "buona pratica di laboratorio" durante il commercio quotidiano. Contribuire attivamente alla gestione dei cambiamenti e delle valutazioni dei rischi. Rispetta le norme di sicurezza e le procedure di qualità, segnala le mancanze, gli incidenti e gli incidenti. Considerare gli aspetti LEAN al lavoro.
• Suggerire e implementare miglioramenti nel laboratorio analitico;
• Supporto e partecipazione alla distribuzione della strategia di digitalizzazione Technology & Innovation (T&I). Per avere successo in questo ruolo, avrete bisogno di:
• Diploma di laboratorio / tecnico chimico (apprendistato, diploma tecnico)
• 3-5 anni di esperienza in un ruolo simile
• Ottimo inglese. Tedesco e francese sono un bene
• Buona conoscenza tecnica nella chimica analitica è essenziale
• Altamente competente con vari strumenti e tecniche come GC (MS, FID e TCD), HPLC (UV e RI), ICP-OES, spettrofotometro UV-VIS, titolazione e misura di proprietà fisiche come densità e viscosità
• Consapevolezza per la gestione sicura di sostanze chimiche, materiali e attrezzature potenzialmente pericolosi
• Grande giocatore di squadra, forti capacità di comunicazione, forte capacità organizzativa, molto indipendente, flessibile, affidabile, orientata al cliente e adattabile. Cosa ti offriamo
• Compensazione attraente e piano di vacanza
• Ottimi benefici sociali
• Opportunità di sviluppo globali
• Una cultura innovativa, vibrante e agile
• Parcheggio gratuito e accesso ai mezzi pubblici
• Programma di assistenza ai dipendenti
• Premi di servizio lunghi Sulzer è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo. Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role We are looking for a Laboratory Technician / Chemical Technician to join our Applications & Technologies team in Allschwil. In this exciting role you will plan and execute customer trials as well as actively support on internal research and development (R&D) projects. You will conduct diverse practical lab work in the R&D field to improve sustainability in the chemical industry and develop future technologies. Your main tasks and responsibilities:
• Characterization analysis using key techniques, including: gas chromatography (GC) with headspace and liquid sampling coupled to MS, FID, and TCD detectors; high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) with UV and refractive index (RI) detection; inductively coupled plasma optical emission spectroscopy (ICP-OES); UV–Vis spectrophotometry; differential scanning calorimetry (DSC); optical microscopy; X‑ray powder diffraction (XRPD); Raman spectroscopy; as well as classical methods such as titration, water content determination, density, and viscosity measurements.
• Responsible for analytical support, ensuring the implementation and optimization of methods and operability of corresponding devices during trials (including instrument preparation, external calibration, sample preparation and routine measurements)
• Planning, execution, evaluation and reporting of customer trials (bench scale to pilot scale).
• Support in execution of internal and external trials for the development and optimization of Sulzer technologies;
• Work in close co-operation with internal company stakeholders;
• Ensure and respect appropriate ESH measures and "good laboratory practice" during daily business. Actively contribute to management of change and risk assessments. Respect safety regulations and quality procedures, report near misses, incidents and accidents. Consider LEAN aspects at work.
• Suggest and implement improvements in the analytical laboratory;
• Support and participate in the deployment of Technology & Innovation (T&I) Digitalization strategy. To succeed in this role, you will need:
• Diploma lab/ chemical technician (apprenticeship, technical degree)
• 3-5 years of experience in a similar role
• Excellent English. German and French are an asset
• Good technical knowledge in analytical chemistry is essential
• Highly proficient with various instruments and techniques such as GC (MS, FID and TCD), HPLC (UV and RI), ICP-OES, UV-VIS spectrophotometer, titration and measurement of physical properties such as density and viscosity
• Awareness for safe handling of chemicals, potentially hazardous materials and equipment
• Great team player, strong communication skills, strong organization ability, very independent, flexible, trustworthy, customer oriented and adaptable. What we offer you
• Attractive compensation and vacation plan
• Excellent social benefits
• Global development opportunities
• An innovative, vibrant and agile culture
• Free parking space and accessibility with public transportation
• Employee Assistance Program
• Long service awards Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Sulzer ist ein führendes Ingenieurunternehmen mit einem stolzen Innovationserbe. Begleiten Sie unser globales Team, um Ihr Know-how zu erweitern und innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln, die eine erfolgreiche und nachhaltigere Gesellschaft ermöglichen. Über die Rolle Wir suchen einen Labortechniker / Chemische Techniker, der unserem Applications & Technologies Team in Allschwil beitritt. In dieser spannenden Rolle planen und führen Sie Kundenversuche sowie aktiv Unterstützung bei internen Forschungs- und Entwicklungsprojekten (F&D). Sie werden verschiedene praktische Laborarbeiten im Bereich FuE durchführen, um die Nachhaltigkeit in der chemischen Industrie zu verbessern und zukünftige Technologien zu entwickeln. Ihre Hauptaufgaben und Aufgaben:
• Charakterisierungsanalyse mit Schlüsseltechniken, einschließlich: Gaschromatographie (GC) mit Kopf- und Flüssigkeitsprobenahme gekoppelt mit MS-, FID- und TCD-Detektoren; Hochleistungs-Flüssigchromatographie (HPLC) mit UV- und Brechungsindex (RI)-Detektion; induktiv gekoppelte plasmaoptische Emissionsspektroskopie (ICP-OES); UV-Vis-Spektrophotometrie; Differential Scanning Calorimetry (DSC); optische Mikroskopie als
• Verantwortlich für die analytische Unterstützung, die Durchführung und Optimierung von Methoden und die Bedienbarkeit entsprechender Geräte während der Versuche (einschließlich Instrumentenvorbereitung, externe Kalibrierung, Probenvorbereitung und Routinemessungen)
• Planung, Durchführung, Auswertung und Berichterstattung von Kundenstudien (Bench-Skala bis Pilot-Skala).
• Unterstützung bei der Durchführung interner und externer Versuche zur Entwicklung und Optimierung von Sulzer-Technologien;
• Arbeiten Sie in enger Zusammenarbeit mit internen Unternehmensgruppen;
• Gewährleistung und Einhaltung angemessener ESH-Maßnahmen und "guter Laborpraxis" während des täglichen Geschäfts. Aktiver Beitrag zur Verwaltung von Veränderungen und Risikobewertungen. Respektieren Sie Sicherheitsvorschriften und Qualitätsverfahren, melden Sie sich bei Misses, Vorfälle und Unfällen. Betrachten Sie LEAN-Aspekte bei der Arbeit.
• Verbesserung des analytischen Labors vorschlagen und umsetzen;
• Unterstützung und Teilnahme an der Einführung von Technologie & Innovation (T&I) Digitalisierungsstrategie. Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, benötigen Sie:
• Diplomlabor / Chemietechniker (Ausbildung, technischer Abschluss)
• 3-5 Jahre Erfahrung in einer ähnlichen Rolle
• Ausgezeichnetes Englisch. Deutsch und Französisch sind ein Vermögen
• Gute technische Kenntnisse in der analytischen Chemie ist unerlässlich
• Mit verschiedenen Instrumenten und Techniken wie GC (MS, FID und TCD), HPLC (UV und RI), ICP-OES, UV-VIS-Spektrophotometer, Titration und Messung physikalischer Eigenschaften wie Dichte und Viskosität
• Bewusstsein für eine sichere Handhabung von Chemikalien, potenziell gefährlichen Materialien und Geräten
• Großer Teamplayer, starke Kommunikationsfähigkeit, starke Organisationsfähigkeit, sehr unabhängig, flexibel, vertrauenswürdig, kundenorientiert und anpassungsfähig. Was wir Ihnen anbieten
• Attraktiver Ausgleichs- und Urlaubsplan
• Ausgezeichnete Sozialleistungen
