About the role Job Summary The workplace of this role is Xin Jiang, China. The role is responsible for supervising a team of technical professionals in delivering field service engineering support to customers, and responsible for the sales plans and budgets for the assigned area. This role ensures the effective execution of service operations, resolves complex technical issues, and maintains high levels of customer satisfaction. The manager plays a key role in setting team goals, managing performance, and ensuring compliance with service standards. Job Responsibilities
• Oversee the commissioning, installation, and testing of products and equipment at customer sites.
• Organize tenders/quotations and commercial negotiations; drive contract signing and order acquisition.
• Resolve technical issues and ensure timely and effective service delivery.
• Collaborate with internal teams to support product upgrades and customer training.
• Monitor service metrics and implement improvements to enhance efficiency and customer satisfaction.
• Manage service documentation, reporting, and administrative tasks.
• Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and regulatory standards. Qualifications
• Typically a University degree and 8+ years of relevant work experience.

• Experience in field service engineering or technical service management.
• Strong leadership and team supervision skills.
• Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
• Strong customer service orientation and communication skills.
• Knowledge of industry standards and safety regulations. What we offer you
• 11 days' public holidays and maximum 15 days' annual leave.

• Annual Physical Examination.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Bei Sulzer unterstützen wir Ihre kontinuierliche Entwicklung nicht nur durch Lernprogramme, sondern auch durch Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten am Arbeitsplatz. Treiben Sie Ihre Karriere proaktiv voran und entwickeln Sie Ihr Know-how weiter – so können Sie zu Lösungen beitragen, die unsere Leben sicherer, intelligenter und nachhaltiger gestalten. Sie suchen einen neuen Wirkungsbereich bei einem renommierten Unternehmen und sind bereit die berühmte Extrameile freiwillig mit Rückenwind zu gehen? Dann sind Sie bei uns im Team genau richtig: Als Area Sales Manager (m/w/d) betreuen Sie eigenverantwortlich Ihren bestehenden Kundenstamm im Flow Equipment Bereich (Vertriebsregion Süd-West) mit einem vielfältigen Produktportfolio und bauen diesen durch gezielte Vertriebsmaßnahmen weiter aus. Dabei werden Sie unterstützt durch unser Sulzer-internes Netzwerk, sowie durch unsere internen technischen Fachstellen. Ihre Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:
• Vertrieb aller Sulzer Produkte (Kreiselpumpen, Rührwerke, rotierende Maschinen in der Industriesparte etc,) in der der Region Süd-Westdeutschland (PLZ 6xxxx, 7xxxx). Vertriebsgebiet ist individuell je nach Wohnsitz leicht anpassbar in der angegebenen Vertriebsregion.
• Eigenverantwortliches Gebietsmanagement mit Verantwortung für den Auftragseingang (inkl. Großkundenbetreuung)
• Neukundenakquise sowie Pflege und Ausbau bestehender Kundenkontakte im Vertriebsgebiet
• Technische Ausarbeitung und Kalkulation von Angeboten sowie Verhandlungsführung bis zum Vertragsabschluss (unterstützt durch unseren Vertriebsinnendienst sowie unsere technischen Experten)
• Sicherstellen eines zielgerichteten Monitoring, Nachverfolgen und Forecasting der offenen Angebote

• Fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich Pumpentechnik und Zubehör sowie idealerweise im Tief- und Spezialtiefbau
• Abgeschlossene technische oder kaufmännische Ausbildung

Mansioni - Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. - Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Descrizione - I compiti e le responsabilità principali: - Guidare le vendite di Sulzer Sommergibili Pompe, Miscele & Grinders a nuovi e esistenti partner commerciali. - Pianificazione, supporto e follow-up delle attività di vendita in linea con la strategia di vendita e processi definiti. - Sviluppare e mantenere una formazione di prodotto per i partner esistenti e nuovi Flow Business. - Monitorare le prestazioni per i principali partner commerciali e prendere azioni correttive, se necessario, per garantire che gli obiettivi siano soddisfatti. - Liaise e lavorare a stretto contatto con il Sales Manager - Pacific e i Service team con i clienti. - Stabilire nuovi e mantenere relazioni esistenti e a lungo termine con i clienti. - Sostenere le attività di marketing partecipando a fiere, conferenze e altri eventi di marketing. - Assicurare ordini e progetti vengono lanciati in modo tempestivo e professionale. - Sviluppare e mantenere forti relazioni con clienti e fornitori al fine di ridurre il rischio commerciale e massimizzare le opportunità di business future. - Mantenere e monitorare la conoscenza aggiornata dei prodotti e delle attività concorrenti. - Identificare nuovi mercati e opportunità di business, massimizzando il potenziale dell'offerta completa di prodotti di Sulzer nei sottosegmenti mirati.
• Requisiti - 5+ anni di esperienza nelle vendite di prodotti Pump - Una conoscenza dettagliata e l'esperienza nella selezione e nella vendita di Pompe sommergibile, Miscelatori e Grinders. - Esperienza di vendita terziaria/commerciale e/o pompa molto apprezzata. - Forte capacità di comunicazione. - Capacità di negoziazione di alto livello. Cosa? - Annual Salary Recensioni - Bonus annuale - Auto Consentimento + Carte Carburante e Toll Pass - Parcheggio in loco - Lavorare per un'organizzazione globale che valorizzi veramente la crescita personale e lo sviluppo - Sulzer - Oltre 190 anni di eccellenza Contatto Sulzer è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo. Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Your main tasks and responsibilities:
• Driving sales of Sulzer Submersible Pumps, Mixers & Grinders to new and existing business partners.
• Planning, supporting and following-up of sales activities in-line with the sales strategy and defined processes.
• Developing and maintaining a product training for existing and new Flow Business partners.
• Monitor the performance for key business partners and take remedial action where necessary to ensure that targets are met.
• Liaise and work closely together with the Sales Manager - Pacific and the Service teams with customers.
• Establishing new, and maintaining existing, long-term relationships with customers.
• Supporting marketing activities by attending trade shows, conferences and other marketing events.
• Ensure orders and projects are launched in a timely and professional manner.
• Develop and maintain strong relationships with customers and suppliers in order to reduce commercial risk and to maximize future business opportunities.
• Maintain and monitor up to date knowledge of competitor products and activities.
• Identify new markets and business opportunities, maximizing the potential of Sulzer's complete product offering in the targeted sub-segments. To succeed in this role, you will need:
• 5+ years experience in Pump product sales
• A detailed knowledge and experience in the selection and selling of Submersible Pumps, Mixers & Grinders.
• Relevant tertiary/trade and/or pump sales experience highly regarded.
• Strong communication skills.
• High level negotiation skills. What we offer you

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Proporcionar diagnóstico, asistencia técnica, entrenamiento y servicios de mantenimiento para bombas y equipos relacionados en las instalaciones del cliente. El candidato puede estar basado en Lima o Arequipa. Funciones básicas
• Realizar la instalación, puesta en marcha y arranque de bombas y equipos asociados en las instalaciones del cliente.
• Realizar el mantenimiento preventivo y las inspecciones de las bombas para garantizar un desempeño y una fiabilidad óptimos.
• Diagnosticar y solucionar problemas mecánicos, eléctricos y del sistema de control con bombas y componentes relacionados.
• Utilizar documentación técnica, esquemas y herramientas de diagnóstico para identificar y resolver problemas de forma eficaz.
• Coordinarse con los clientes para programar visitas de servicio, comunicar actualizaciones de proyectos y abordar cualquier duda o pregunta.
• Proporcionar formación y asistencia in situ a los clientes sobre el funcionamiento correcto y los procedimientos de mantenimiento de las bombas.
• Colaborar con los equipos internos para escalar y resolver problemas técnicos complejos según sea necesario.
• Documentar las actividades de servicio, incluidas las tareas de mantenimiento, el uso de piezas y las interacciones con los clientes, de forma clara y organizada.
• Cumplir los protocolos de seguridad y las políticas de la empresa mientras se trabaja en las instalaciones del cliente.
• Actuar como enlace entre los clientes y la empresa para garantizar un alto nivel de satisfacción del cliente.
• Proveer de entrenamiento a los clientes en el mantenimiento y operación de las bombas
• Documentar oportunidades de desarrollo de servicios dentro de las cuentas clave de la compañía Condiciones de trabajo
• Este puesto requiere viajar con frecuencia a las instalaciones de los clientes, lo que puede implicar la exposición a diversas condiciones ambientales y exigencias físicas.
• Los ingenieros de servicio de campo pueden tener que trabajar en horarios flexibles, incluidas noches y fines de semana, para adaptarse a los horarios de los clientes y a las solicitudes de servicio urgentes Requisitos
• Licenciatura o experiencia equivalente en ingeniería mecánica, ingeniería electromecánica, ingeniería eléctrica o un campo relacionado.
• Inglés intermedio o avanzado, requerido.
• Experiencia demostrada trabajando con bombas, preferiblemente en un servicio de campo o mantenimiento.
• Conocimientos sólidos de principios mecánicos, dinámica de fluidos y sistemas eléctricos.
• Dominio de la localización y reparación de averías en equipos mecánicos y eléctricos.
• Excelentes dotes de comunicación, tanto verbal como escrita, con capacidad para interactuar profesionalmente con clientes y compañeros.
• Capacidad para trabajar de forma independiente y gestionar el tiempo eficazmente a fin de cumplir los plazos de servicio.
• Disponibilidad para viajar a las instalaciones de los clientes cuando sea necesario, a veces con poca antelación.
• Permiso de conducir válido y un historial de conducción limpio.
• Fuerte compromiso con la seguridad y cumplimiento de las directrices de seguridad.
• Se valorarán las certificaciones en mantenimiento de bombas o campos técnicos pertinentes.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Sulzer Flow is wereldwijd marktleider in de ontwikkeling en levering van o.m. pompen, roerwerken, vermalers en beluchting in geselecteerde industriële markten, met name in olie & gas, energie, water, afvalwater en de papierindustrie. De Sulzer Water & General Industry Business Unit heeft vestigingen in België en Nederland en is in deze regio met bijna 50 medewerkers actief in de verkoop, installatie en service van bovengenoemde producten. Kom werken bij Sulzer Flow in Maastricht als Field Service Technician (monteur) Flow Equipment Midden-Zuid NL en help onze service in de Benelux naar een next level te brengen. In deze rol word je verantwoordelijk voor:
• Preventief en correctief onderhoud aan onze producten: pompen, mixers en beluchters in afvalwater- en industriële toepassingen op locatie bij onze klanten in de Benelux. Dit betreft hoofdzakelijk mechanische en deels elektrotechnische en besturingstechnische werkzaamheden
• De uitvoering van renovatie- en nieuwbouwprojecten
• Als visitekaartje van Sulzer denk je proactief mee over potentële verbeteringen en commerciële kansen en ben je onze belangrijkste ambassadeur bij onze klanten
• Consignatie- / wachtdienst en af en toe een externe overnachting zijn voor jou geen probleem Om succesvol te zijn in deze functie heb je nodig:
• Een technische opleiding, bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van werktuigbouwkunde
• Ervaring met rotating equipment in een industri ë le setting is een pre
• Ervaring en affiniteit met elektrotechniek en PLC/ meet- en regeltechniek inzake toepassingen in (industriële) pompen/ rotating equipment is een pre
• Voldoende kennis van de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift is een must
• (Basis) kennis van de Franse en Engelse taal is zeer gewenst
• Uitstekend ontwikkelde communicatieve vaardigheden
• Affiniteit met een technisch commerciële serviceorganisatie
• Een zelfstandige, flexibele en klantgerichte instelling
• Een geldig rijbewijs CE/ C1E is een pre What we offer you Jouw Arbeidsvoorwaarden: Sulzer biedt je een meer dan goed salaris inclusief vakantiegeld
• Een jaarlijkse prestatiebonus
• Een royaal aantal vakantie- en ATV dagen (38)
• Een solide pensioenregeling (PMT)
• Een volledig ingerichte servicewagen, mobiele telefoon en laptop Locatie: Onze activiteiten vinden plaats in de Benelux en worden aangestuurd vanuit ons Service Center in Maastricht-Airport, waar je indien nodig aanwezig kunt zijn. Je vertrekt naar onze klantlocaties veelal vanuit thuis. Je bent woonachtig in de regio Midden NL (Nijmegen, Breda, Rotterdam, Utrecht, Eindhoven) of Zuid NL. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Sulzer is looking for a driven and commercially minded Account Manager to grow and develop our relationships with major Water Utility providers across the Southern Regions. You’ll manage an established customer base, identify new opportunities within those accounts, and take ownership for revenue growth across both Capital and Service & Aftermarket portfolios. This is a strategic, customer-facing role for someone who thrives on autonomy, consultative selling, and long-term partnership building — with a genuine opportunity to progress into leadership as the account base grows. Key Responsibilities
• Managing and developing existing Water Utility accounts across the Southern Regions.
• Identifying and converting new business opportunities within those accounts across Capital equipment and Aftermarket services.
• Acting as the primary point of contact, building strong technical and commercial relationships at multiple stakeholder levels.
• Owning the number: forecasting, pipeline management, and delivering against growth targets.
• Working closely with internal Engineering, Service, and Commercial teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
• Growing these accounts to a scale where you will have the opportunity to develop and lead your own team in future. What We’re Looking For
• Experience as an Account Manager, Sales Engineer, or Business Development professional within Water Utilities, Engineering, Pumps, Rotating Equipment, or related industrial sectors.
• A strong understanding of the Water sector’s operational and regulatory environment.
• Proven ability to grow accounts, uncover opportunities, and close technical solutions.
• Confident communicator with the ability to build trust and credibility.
• Commercially sharp, organised, and capable of managing a complex regional territory.
• Self-driven, proactive, and comfortable owning both the customer relationship and commercial outcomes. What we offer you
• A competitive base salary
• An annual scheme that rewards company success and individual impact, featuring significant multipliers for exceptional results and role-modeling our core values
• Company car or allowance, including EV options.
• 33 days annual leave and home-working flexibility with full diary autonomy.
• Defined contribution pension scheme and Long Service Awards.
• Continuous professional development through our dedicated Learning Pathways.
• Costco membership, discounted car leasing, and a wide range of retail/lifestyle discounts. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Join our team as Global Commercial Excellence Manager in our Water & Industry Business Unit and play a key role in driving growth and profitability. In this role, you will work closely with the Global Commercial Excellence team, contributing to global initiatives and strategies while driving pricing and value management, optimizing go-to-market models, and enabling sales teams with tools and insights for consistent execution within the Business Unit. The role can be based at any of our European Operations Your main tasks and responsibilities:
• Collaboration with sales leadership and commercial excellence teams to co-create Go-to-Market strategies in your business unit by driving channel strategy, key account management, business partner enablement, account and territory planning in collaboration with the global commercial excellence team.
• Ensure adoption of the global sales process and methodology within your business unit by promoting best practices, monitoring compliance, and identifying areas for improvement. Take ownership of driving corrective actions and implementing enhancements in collaboration with the global Commercial Excellence teams
• Establish and standardize robust data and analytics frameworks to support consistent pipeline reviews and accurate forecasting across commercial teams. Ensure alignment of tools, metrics, and methodologies to drive visibility, accountability, and strategic decision-making
• Drive Pricing & Value Management by implementing pricing governance, value-based pricing, discount controls, and margin optimization working in tandem with the global commercial excellence team.
• Ensure accurate and structured customer data in CRM systems to enable effective segmentation, precise targeting, and full sales lifecycle management. To succeed in this role, you will need:
• Master degree in Business, Marketing, or related field (MBA preferred) and 5+ years of relevant experience in commercial excellence, pricing, or sales operations.
• Knowledge of Pricing & Value Management, including value-based pricing, discount governance, and margin optimization.
• Strong understanding of sales processes, methodologies, and account management practices in B2B environments.
• Hands-on experience with CRM systems (Salesforce preferred) and data-driven forecasting.
• Advanced analytical skills with ability to perform analytics and build actionable insights.
• Excellent stakeholder management and change leadership skills to drive adoption across functions and regions. What we offer you
• Chance to make a significant impact and drive the global strategy
• Collaborative and supportive work environment with a focus on innovation and excellence.
• Competitive salary package with attractive benefits, pension scheme, and employee assistance program.
• Exciting opportunities for professional growth and advancement in a dynamic and evolving industry. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Bajo la posición de Orden entry & tendering, el Especialista en Entrada de Órdenes es responsable de ingresar, gestionar y dar seguimiento a todas las órdenes de materiales y servicios, asegurando el cumplimiento de los estándares establecidos, así como de las directivas, procedimientos de trabajo y políticas vigentes de la compañía. Adicionalmente, colabora en la generación de cotizaciones, brinda apoyo administrativo al equipo de ventas y, previa solicitud, realiza otras tareas relacionadas acordes a su función. Responsabilidades:
• Gestionar los pedidos de clientes desde la recepción de la orden hasta su correcta facturación.
• Asegurar la conciliación de los pedidos recibidos con las cotizaciones previamente emitidas o con las listas de precios vigentes.
• Ejecutar y controlar todas las funciones asociadas a la entrada de pedidos y facturación, incluyendo aquellos relacionados con la fabricación de productos para clientes.
• Realizar la entrada de pedidos en SAP, manteniendo comunicación permanente y coordinando la planificación con el equipo de ventas, hasta su facturación.
• Elaborar cotizaciones comerciales, asegurando el correcto uso de precios, condiciones comerciales y políticas internas.
• Brindar apoyo administrativo al equipo de ventas, incluyendo gestión documental, actualización de información en sistemas, apoyo en informes y coordinación interna.
• Elaborar y presentar informes de ventas periódicos.
• Demostrar habilidad para seguir métodos y procedimientos establecidos, trabajo en equipo, criterio profesional, atención al detalle y capacidad de comunicación clara y concisa, tanto oral como escrita.
• Asegurar la correcta calidad de la información comercial y contractual en SAP, cumpliendo con políticas internas y estándares de compliance.
• Apoyar análisis básicos de ventas, backlog y desempeño comercial, contribuyendo a la mejora continua de los procesos.
• Coordinar con fábrica y logística para validar fechas de entrega, disponibilidad y condiciones de despacho
• Colaborar en iniciativas de mejora continua en procesos de order entry, cotizaciones y tendering. Requisitos:
• Técnico de Nivel Superior o Universitario
• 5 años mínimos de experiencia previa contrastable en posición similar
• Tener habilidades sociales y capacidad para resolver problemas en un grupo de trabajo
• Manejo de idiomas español e inglés, competencias completas.
• Dedicación (aprender, adaptar, gestionar), Disposición y Compromiso.
• Buen conocimiento del entorno informático, incluido SAP y la suite Office. What we offer you Beneficios:
• Salario y prestaciones acordes con el mercado.
• Bonificación anual basada en los objetivos corporativos y personales.
• Seguro médico y dental. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role In dieser Rolle übernehmen Sie die Leitung des Tendering-Teams in Deutschland und entwickeln Strukturen, Prozesse und Pricing-Strategien gezielt weiter. Sie arbeiten eng mit internen und internationalen Stakeholdern zusammen und stellen eine effiziente, transparente Angebots- und Kalkulationssteuerung sicher. Ihre Aufgaben
• Fachliche und disziplinarische Leitung des Tendering-Teams Deutschland
• Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung von Angebots- und Kalkulationsprozessen
• Analyse und Optimierung von Pricing-Strategien sowie kommerziellen Rahmenbedingungen
• Sicherstellung von Margentransparenz und wirtschaftlicher Bewertung von Angeboten und Projekten
• Qualitätssicherung komplexer nationaler und internationaler Ausschreibungen
• Bewertung von kommerziellen und vertraglichen Risiken und Chancen
• Einführung und Implementierung von BIM in Angebots- und Projektprozessen
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Sales, Engineering, Controlling sowie internationalen Stakeholdern
• Repräsentation der Tendering-Funktion in Management-Gremien Ihr Profil
• Mehrjährige Führungserfahrung im Bereich Tendering, Bid Management oder Sales Engineering
• Erfahrung in Transformations- oder Interim-Mandaten
• Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Pricing, Kalkulation, Vertragsstrukturen und Discount-Modellen
• Hintergrund in einem technisch geprägten Industrieumfeld
• Erfahrung mit komplexen Angebots- und Projektstrukturen; BIM-Kenntnisse von Vorteil
• Strukturierte, ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise und souveränes Auftreten
• Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Management-Kompetenz, auch auf Executive-Level
• Fließendes Englisch sowie verhandlungssicheres Deutsch What we offer you
• Interim-Position mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und Entscheidungsspielraum
• Direkte Einbindung in nationale und internationale Managementprozesse
• Flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub
• Kostenloser Obstkorb, Kaffee und Wasser und vergünstigtes Mittagsmenü
• Ein starkes, hilfsbereites Team mit gutem Zusammenhalt
• Moderne Arbeitsmittel
• Attraktive Vergütung und Zusatzleistungen, u. a.: Vergünstigungen/Mitarbeiterrabatte, JobRad ‑ Programm, Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Betriebliche Sonderleistungen wie Familienservice ‑ Hotline Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role El/La Junior Logistics Officer da soporte a las operaciones logísticas, incluyendo transporte, almacén y seguimiento de inventario, contribuyendo a garantizar un flujo eficiente de mercancías y materiales. Esta posición está orientada a profesionales junior que, bajo supervisión, aplican conocimientos teóricos básicos y desarrollan sus capacidades analíticas para la resolución de problemas, en colaboración con perfiles más senior. Responsabilidades principales
• Coordinar el transporte y la entrega de mercancías (nacional e internacional)
• Dar soporte a procesos de importación/exportación y asegurar el cumplimiento normativo
• Realizar el seguimiento de envíos y mantener actualizados los sistemas logísticos
• Preparar documentación de envío (facturas, packing lists, documentación aduanera, etc.)
• Apoyar en la gestión de pedidos internos y expediciones
• Comunicarse con proveedores, transportistas y equipos internos
• Monitorizar niveles de inventario y dar soporte a operaciones de almacén
• Identificar oportunidades de mejora en procesos logísticos y optimización de costes Requisitos
• Formación Profesional o Grado en Logística, Supply Chain o similar
• Hasta 2 años de experiencia relevante (incluyendo prácticas)
• Conocimientos básicos de importación/exportación y procedimientos aduaneros
• Manejo de herramientas de gestión logística y Microsoft Office Competencias
• Buenas habilidades de comunicación y organización
• Atención al detalle y capacidad analítica
• Capacidad para trabajar bajo presión y cumplir plazos
• Actitud proactiva y orientación al trabajo en equipo Idiomas
• Inglés: nivel B2 (intermedio-alto) What we offer you
• Contrato indefinid o.
• Salario competitivo, así como participación en un sistema de remuneración variable basado en objetivos personales y financieros.
• Ticket restaurante.
• Acceso a un plan de retribución flexible voluntario que permite optimizar el paquete salarial (por ejemplo: seguro médico, transporte, guardería).
• Formar parte de un equipo experimentado e internacional.
• Un buen ambiente de trabajo.
• Oportunidades de desarrollo profesional dentro de una empresa internacional sólida y consolidada.
• Incorporación a una organización dinámica en constante transformación y mejora.
• Ubicación de las oficinas: RIVAS Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Sales Engineering Expert is responsible for providing technical expertise during the sales process, supporting the development of tailored solutions for clients, and ensuring alignment between customer needs and product capabilities. This job profile is intended for recognized subject matter experts in a job area. Required to manage large projects or processes with limited oversight from manager. Coaches, reviews and delegates work to lower level professionals. Role Overview In this role, you will actively shape and develop the Metals market in Mexico by working closely with end customers, EPCs, and distributors to create tailored technical and commercial solutions. Leveraging our portfolio of pumps, mixers, and water treatment solutions, you will help customers improve process efficiency, reliability, and sustainability , in line with the strategic objectives of the Flow Division within the Water & Industry business unit. Through regular customer engagement, strong technical understanding, and personal networking, you will build long‑term partnerships and position Sulzer as a trusted solution provider across the Mexican metals industry Key Responsibilities Market Development & Sales Strategy
• Implement and execute the sales strategy for the Metals segment in Mexico.
• Actively develop the market by identifying new opportunities, key accounts, and strategic projects.
• Build a sustainable pipeline that supports long‑term growth and profitability. Customer, EPC & Distributor Engagement
• Establish and maintain strong, trust‑based relationships with customers, EPCs, and selected distributors.
• Ensure early involvement in project development phases to influence technical solutions and specifications.
• Act as the main technical and commercial interface between Sulzer and assigned customers. Solution Development
• Analyze customer processes and operational challenges.
• Leverage deep knowledge of the Sulzer portfolio to develop customized, competitive, and value‑adding solutions.
• Demonstrate clear customer value through improved performance, reliability, lifecycle cost reduction, and sustainability. Proposals & Contract Management
• Prepare and manage formal technical and commercial proposals, ensuring clarity in scope, pricing, delivery, and contractual terms.
• Coordinate internally with engineering, product management, service, and operations teams to deliver accurate and competitive offers.
• Support negotiations and order intake in line with margin and risk guidelines. Market & Trend Monitoring
• Monitor market developments, customer investment plans, and competitor activity.
• Translate market intelligence into targeted sales and marketing actions.
• Contribute to segment strategy, forecasting, and opportunity planning. Success in This Role Looks Like
• Strong presence and credibility in the Mexican metals industry
• Early positioning in EPC‑driven projects
• Consistent opportunity creation and conversion
• Long‑term customer partnerships and repeat business
• Profitable growth aligned with Flow Division strategy What we offer you NA Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Responsabilités** * Superviser et encadrer une équipe d'ingénieurs et de techniciens en procédés. * Concevoir, développer, mettre en œuvre et optimiser des processus de fabrication pour améliorer la productivité, réduire les coûts et garantir la qualité des produits. * Analyser les données de production et identifier les opportunités d'amélioration continue des processus. * Élaborer et maintenir la documentation technique des procédés, y compris les schémas de tuyauterie et d'instrumentation (P&ID), les procédures opérationnelles standard (SOP) et les instructions de travail. * Participer à la sélection, à l'installation et à la mise en service de nouveaux équipements de production. * Assurer la conformité des processus aux normes de sécurité, environnementales et de qualité (ISO, etc.). * Collaborer étroitement avec les départements de production, de maintenance, de R&D et de qualité. * Gérer les projets d'amélioration des procédés, y compris la planification, le suivi du budget et le respect des délais. * Former et développer les compétences de votre équipe.
• Qualifications** * Diplôme d'ingénieur en génie des procédés, génie chimique, mécanique ou domaine connexe. * Minimum de 5 ans d'expérience en ingénierie des procédés dans un environnement industriel, avec une expérience significative en supervision ou gestion d'équipe. * Maîtrise des outils et méthodologies d'optimisation des procédés (Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, etc.). * Excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes et en analyse technique. * Capacité à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe dans un environnement dynamique. * Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais technique (écrit et oral). * Connaissance des logiciels de simulation de processus (par exemple, Aspen Plus, HYSYS) serait un plus. * Expérience dans l'industrie des pompes, de la compression ou de l'équipement rotatif serait un atout.
• What we offer you . Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

About the role Lagerarbetare – Självständig roll med varierade arbetsuppgifter Är du en självgående person som trivs med ansvar och ett praktiskt arbete? Vi söker nu en engagerad lagerarbetare som vill arbeta i en varierad och viktig roll i vår organisation. Nordic Water är ett ingenjörsföretag med passion för att utveckla innovativa, tekniska lösningar och produkter som revolutionerar vår bransch. Vattenrening är ett snabbt växande område där Nordic Water är en av de största aktörerna på en global marknad. Våra kunder finns över hela världen och försäljningen sker både direkt och via distributörer. Vår försäljning består i allt från enskilda produkter till större projekt samt eftermarknad Om rollen Som lagerarbetare hos oss arbetar du självständigt och har en central funktion i att serva olika delar av organisationen. Rollen är bred och innefattar både traditionellt lagerarbete och mer praktiska moment såsom att bygga emballage. Arbetsuppgifter
• Hantering av material och gods i lager
• Serva interna avdelningar med material och leveranser
• Bygga och anpassa emballage för transport
• Truckkörning och lastning/lossning
• Administrativa uppgifter kopplade till lagerhantering Kvalifikationer
• Erfarenhet av lagerarbete
• Truckkort
• God förmåga att arbeta självständigt och ta eget ansvar
• Praktisk läggning med viss hantverkskunskap (t.ex. att bygga emballage) Meriterande
• Erfarenhet av arbete i ERP-system
• Särskilt meriterande är kunskap i Pyramid What we offer you

• Collea – Gratis pension och försäkringsrådgivning

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role We have an exciting opportunity for a Spare Parts Business Owner to strengthen our aftermarket operations and accelerate growth across France and international markets. In this pivotal commercial and operational role, you will drive the development of the spare parts portfolio, enhance customer satisfaction, and ensure strong economic and operational performance. If you combine business acumen with solid technical understanding - and enjoy working at the intersection of sales, operations, and product strategy - this role offers an opportunity to make a significant impact. Based at our site in Saint-Quentin Your main tasks and responsibilities
• Manage the complete spare parts portfolio, including range definition, offer structure, pricing policy, and product life‑cycle decisions.
• Develop and execute the commercial strategy for spare parts in alignment with group policy, identify high‑potential business segments in collaboration with service teams.
• Define and implement pricing strategies, discount frameworks, and margin optimization measures, Lead initiatives aimed at improving profitability and competitiveness.
• Operational Coordination (≈50%): Collaborate closely with Logistics, Production, and Purchasing to ensure availability and reliability of spare parts.
• Optimize inventory levels, lead times, order processing, and prioritization, contributing to continuous improvement initiatives in forecasting, planning, and sourcing.
• Maintain KPIs and reporting including backlog, overdue backlog, lead time, workload, and warranty performance.
• Act as the central point of contact for domestic and international spare parts customers.
• Prepare monthly dashboards and drive progress plans based on performance insights. To succeed in this role, you will need
• English level B2.
• Understanding of industrial equipment such as pumps, rotating systems, turbines, or similar mechanical assemblies.
• Knowledge of spare parts characteristics, functions, constraints, compatibility, and substitution options.
• Ability to read and use technical documentation (drawings, BOMs, specifications, supplier references).
• Strong B2B business development experience in an industrial environment.
• Familiarity with spare parts sales processes: costing, quotation, negotiation, contracts, and T&Cs.
• Proficiency in pricing strategies, margin management, and bundled or kit‑based product offerings.
• Understanding of aftermarket service models (maintenance, retrofits, upgrades, parts). What we offer you
• A key role within a global and innovative industrial organization.
• The opportunity to shape and drive the spare parts business in strategic markets.
• A collaborative environment focused on technical excellence, operational reliability, and customer satisfaction.
• Strong professional development prospects in a company that values initiative, expertise, and cross‑functional teamwork. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The (Field) Service Team Lead is responsible for supervising professional-level employees in the field service team. This role sets day-to-day operational objectives, ensures adherence to procedures, and supports the delivery of high-quality technical services to customers. This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ professional-level roles. Ihre Aufgaben
• Fachliche Führung und Koordination der Servicetechniker sowie Begleitung der lokalen Servicekoordinatoren bei regionalen Themen
• Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen operativen Servicebetriebs in enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Einsatzplanung
• Eskalationsinstanz bei komplexen oder kritischen Serviceeinsätzen
• Überwachung und Weiterentwicklung der Servicequalität sowie Einhaltung von Sicherheits‑ und Qualitätsstandards (u. a. DGUV, ATEX)
• Durchführung und Begleitung von Safety Walks, Schulungen und technischen Unterweisungen
• Monitoring zentraler Service‑KPIs wie Auslastung, Reaktionszeiten und Qualitätskennzahlen
• Unterstützung bei technischen Fragestellungen, Fehleranalysen und Kundeneskalationen
• Enge Abstimmung mit dem Head of Service in allen personal‑ und organisationsrelevanten Themen
• Mitwirkung an der Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen und Strukturen im Field Service
• Perspektivische Weiterentwicklung in die Rolle des elektrischen Betriebsleiters (Zeithorizont 1–3 Jahre) Ihr Profil
• Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung zum Meister oder Techniker, Elektromeister zwingend erforderlich
• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im technischen Serviceumfeld; erste oder mehrjährige Führungserfahrung von Vorteil
• Erfahrung in industriellen Anwendungsbereichen, idealerweise in der Pumpen‑, Abwasser‑, Rechen‑, Filter‑ oder Gebläsetechnik
• Sehr gutes Verständnis für Arbeitssicherheit, Qualitätsanforderungen und technische Regelwerke
• Strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit ausgeprägter Kommunikations‑ und Teamfähigkeit
• Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands (bis ca. 30 %)
• Wohnort im Raum Bonn oder angrenzend What we offer you
• Abwechslungsreiche und verantwortungsvolle Aufgaben in einem professionellen Arbeitsumfeld
• Eigenständiges Arbeiten mit klaren Zuständigkeiten
• Zusammenarbeit in einem kollegialen Team
• Marktgerechte Vergütung
• Zugang zu einem Firmenwagen, auch zur privaten Nutzung
• Sichere Perspektiven in einem langfristig ausgerichteten Unternehmen
• JobRad‑Leasing
• Kostenfreie Getränke (Kaffee & Wasser), Obstkorb und vergünstigtes Mittagsmenü Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è un'azienda ingegneristica leader con un orgoglioso patrimonio di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per far crescere la tua esperienza e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che permettano una società più prospera e sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Stiamo cercando un Area Manager SEE (tutti i generi) per unirsi al nostro team in Austria. I tuoi principali compiti e responsabilità:
• Espansione e sviluppo del mercato nell'Europa sudorientale per i nostri gruppi di prodotti tecnicamente sofisticati
• Sviluppo di soluzioni sostenibili utilizzando l'intero portafoglio prodotti Sulzer
• Aumento della nostra presenza di mercato in nuovi segmenti
• Supporto ai nostri clienti chiave, nonché acquisizione di nuovi clienti, inclusa responsabilità di budget e costi
• Presentazione di offerte, negoziazione e completamento dei contratti, follow-up e supporto tecnico del Elaborazione degli ordini
• Formazione e presentazioni sui prodotti ai nostri rivenditori e distributori Cosa serve per avere successo in questo ruolo:
• Hai completato una formazione tecnica (apprendistato, HTL, FH, università), preferibilmente in ingegneria di processo, e idealmente hai già acquisito 2-3 anni di esperienza pratica in un'attività comparabile.
• Sei caratterizzato da un modo di lavorare strutturato, efficiente e orientato alle scadenze, combinato con un pensiero analitico e un alto livello di capacità di problem solving.
• Ottieni ottime capacità utente in MS Office, ma anche ottime competenze in tedesco e inglese e una patente di guida di classe B.
• La tua capacità di lavorare in squadra, affidabilità e capacità di lavorare sotto pressione completano il tuo profilo. Cosa ti offriamo Cosa ti offriamo noi:
• Libertà, fiducia e responsabilità per i compiti che ti vengono assegnati.
• Attraverso la nostra comunicazione aperta e onesta, basata su una gerarchia piatta e una cultura informale, creiamo un ambiente di lavoro piacevole e divertente.
• Le opportunità di formazione professionale e personale orientate alle necessità sono importanti per noi.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Er du opptatt av en bærekraftig fremtid og levende fjorder? Vil du lære og utvikle deg hver eneste dag på jobb? Motiveres du av å ha en salgsjobb som bidrar til renere vann og et bedre miljø? Som oss vet du at vann ikke bare er en ressurs – det er selve grunnlaget for alt liv. Og få ting gir større mening enn å jobbe med løsninger som sikrer at vannet renses, transporteres og forvaltes på best mulig måte. Du ikke bare forstår prosessene – du elsker dem. Enten det handler om flotasjon, mekanisk filtrering eller biologisk rensing, så er du hjemme. Du har gjerne vært tett på anlegg og prosesser tidligere i karrieren, og du vet hva som faktisk fungerer i praksis – ikke bare på papiret. Men du er ikke bare teknisk dyktig. Du er en relasjonsbygger som kundene raskt får tillit til, og du stiller alltid opp når de trenger deg. Salg gir deg energi – ikke fordi du selger, men fordi du løser problemer og skaper verdi for kunder som stoler på din faglige tyngde. Du trives i møte med mennesker, og du har et engasjement som smitter når du presenterer eller holder foredrag. Du er god på å legge planer, liker å kombinere selvstendighet med samarbeid, og mestrer digitale verktøy som en naturlig del av hverdagen. En hverdag som innebærer noe reising for å besøke kunder – nye som gamle – er noe du setter pris på. Høres dette ut som deg? Da gleder vi oss til å høre fra deg. Oppsummert håper vi at du er:
• En som har erfaring med B2B-salg og som blir motivert av lykkelig kunder
• Opptatt av å bygge tillit og være tilgjengelig for kundene
• Fleksibel og liker å styre hverdagen din selv
• Selvstendig og reiseglad
• Smart, engasjert og god på å løse problemer
• Strukturert og tydelig i kommunikasjonsformen – norsk er arbeidsspråket Hvem er vi tenker du? Og hva kan vi tilby akkurat deg? Hos Sulzer tror vi på kontinuerlig læring og mulighetene det skaper for fremtiden din. Vi jobber i team for å komme frem til de beste løsningene for våre kunder, og du vil ha ingeniører og fageksperter i ryggen som hjelper deg der det trengs. I Norge har Sulzer kontorer og verksteder i Asker, Bergen, Fredrikstad, Kristiansand og Trondheim. Vi har gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger. Vi tilbyr fleksible arbeidstidsordninger, og legger til rette for bruk av hjemmekontor. Du får firmabil, og det er ønskelig at du velger en miljøvennlig bil, på den måten bidrar du til å gjøre bedriften mer bærekraftig. Denne stillingen er svært sentral for selskapet vårt, så er vi mest opptatt av å finne det riktige mennesket, som vil trives og ønsker å vokse sammen med oss. Nøyaktig hvor du bor, er ikke så viktig. Søknadsfristen er søndag 14. juni , men vi vurdererer alle søkere fortløpende! What we offer you Vi har svært gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger. Vi tilbyr fleksible arbeidstidsordninger, og legger til rette for bruk av hjemmekontor. Det er tilgang til treningsrom i Fredrikstad og Asker. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

title: Senior Finance Business Partner - UK Nordics

titleByLocale.it: Senior Finanza Business Partner - UK Nordics
titleByLocale.en: Senior Finance Business Partner - UK Nordics
titleByLocale.de: Senior Finanzen Business Partner - UK Nordics
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Finance Business Partner - UK Nordics

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Siamo alla ricerca di un Senior Finance Business Partner commercialmente pensato per supportare il nostro business Servizi in tutta la regione del Regno Unito & Nordics. In questo ruolo strategico, si combinano competenze finanziarie profonde con un forte acume aziendale per guidare il processo decisionale, migliorare le prestazioni e garantire che gli insight finanziari sono incorporati a ogni livello dell'organizzazione. Come partner chiave per la leadership regionale, si svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nella definizione della direzione futura del business - aiutando a guidare la crescita sostenibile, la redditività e l'eccellenza operativa in più siti e linee di servizio. Il ruolo può essere basato presso le nostre strutture Birmingham o Leeds. Cosa farai:
• Sviluppare e rivedere piani strategici a livello regionale, aziendale o divisionale, fornendo informazioni finanziarie per sostenere la crescita a lungo termine e le strategie aziendali
• Stabilire e mantenere un quadro completo di gestione delle prestazioni per i team interfunzionali e geograficamente diversi
• Gestire i principali programmi di capitale e supervisionare la modellazione dei costi, dei prezzi e della redditività.
• Partner con leader senior, strategia di modellazione e allineamento finanziario con gli obiettivi aziendali.
• Sostenere le recensioni dei progetti e fornire una guida finanziaria esperta attraverso il ciclo di vita del progetto completo. Cosa porterai:
• Laurea in finanza, contabilità, amministrazione aziendale, o simili.
• Esperienza di 7-10 anni nella leadership nella finanza o nella pianificazione aziendale, idealmente all’interno dei servizi industriali, ingegneristici o industriali.
• Forte capacità di gestione degli stakeholder con la capacità di influenzare i decisori senior.
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione, traducendo complesse intuizioni finanziarie per il pubblico non finanziario.
• Avanzate competenze di MS Office; l'esperienza con Tagetik, Qlik Sense o sistemi ERP è un plus. Cosa ti offriamo
• Possibilità di avere un impatto significativo e guidare la strategia globale
• Ambiente di lavoro collaborativo e di supporto con un focus sull'innovazione e l'eccellenza.
• pacchetto di stipendio competitivo con benefici attraenti, regime pensionistico e programma di assistenza ai dipendenti.
• Eccitanti opportunità di crescita e di progresso professionale in un settore dinamico ed in evoluzione. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role We are looking for a commercially minded Senior Finance Business Partner to support our Services business across the UK & Nordics region. In this strategic role, you will combine deep financial expertise with strong business acumen to guide decision‑making, improve performance, and ensure financial insights are embedded at every level of the organisation. As a key partner to regional leadership, you will play a critical part in shaping the future direction of the business - helping drive sustainable growth, profitability, and operational excellence across multiple sites and service lines. • Partner with senior leaders, shaping strategy and ensuring financial alignment with business goals.
• Support project reviews and provide expert financial guidance through the full project lifecycle. What you’ll bring:
• Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or similar.
• 7–10 years’ experience in leadership in finance or business planning, ideally within the industrial, engineering services or manufacturing sectors.
• Strong stakeholder‑management skills with the ability to influence senior decision‑makers.
• Excellent communication skills, translating complex financial insights for non‑financial audiences.
• Advanced MS Office skills; experience with Tagetik, Qlik Sense or ERP systems is a plus. What we offer you What we offer you:
• Chance to make a significant impact and drive the global strategy
• Collaborative and supportive work environment with a focus on innovation and excellence.
• Competitive salary package with attractive benefits, pension scheme, and employee assistance program.
• Exciting opportunities for professional growth and advancement in a dynamic and evolving industry. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. • Chance, einen erheblichen Einfluss zu entfalten und die globale Strategie voranzutreiben

Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Dans ce rôle stratégique, vous combinerez une expertise financière profonde avec un sens fort de l'entreprise pour guider la prise de décision, améliorer les performances et veiller à ce que les connaissances financières soient intégrées à tous les niveaux de l'organisation. En tant que partenaire clé du leadership régional, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans l'orientation future de l'entreprise - contribuant à stimuler la croissance durable, la rentabilité et l'excellence opérationnelle sur plusieurs sites et lignes de services. Le rôle peut être basé sur nos installations de Birmingham ou de Leeds. Ce que vous allez faire:
• Élaborer et examiner des plans stratégiques à l'échelle régionale, de l'unité opérationnelle ou de la division, en fournissant des informations financières pour appuyer la croissance à long terme et les stratégies d'affaires;
• Établir et tenir à jour des cadres complets de gestion des performances pour les équipes interfonctionnelles et géographiquement diverses
• Gérer les grands programmes d'immobilisations et superviser l'établissement des coûts, la tarification et la modélisation de la rentabilité.

• Appuyer l'examen des projets et fournir des conseils financiers spécialisés tout au long du cycle de vie du projet. Ce que vous apporterez:
• Diplôme en finance, comptabilité, administration des affaires, ou similaire.
• 7-10 ans d'expérience en leadership en finance ou en planification d'entreprise, idéalement dans les secteurs industriel, des services d'ingénierie ou de la fabrication.
• Des compétences solides en gestion des parties prenantes avec la capacité d'influencer les décideurs supérieurs.
• Excellentes compétences en communication, traduisant des perspectives financières complexes pour les publics non financiers.
• Compétences avancées MS Office; l'expérience avec les systèmes Tagetik, Qlik Sense ou ERP est un plus. Ce que nous vous offrons
• La chance d'avoir un impact significatif et de conduire la stratégie mondiale
• Un environnement de travail collaboratif et solidaire mettant l'accent sur l'innovation et l'excellence.
• Ensemble de salaires concurrentiels comportant des prestations attrayantes, un régime de retraite et un programme d'aide aux employés.
• Possibilités de croissance et d'avancement professionnels dans une industrie dynamique et en évolution. Si vous êtes un penseur stratégique avec un sens fort des affaires et une passion pour le partenariat avec le leadership pour conduire la performance, nous aimerions entendre de vous. Sulzer est un employeur à chances égales. Nous croyons en la force d'un effectif diversifié et sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif. Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme l'un des meilleurs employeurs 2026 au Brésil, au Canada, en Chine, en Finlande, en Allemagne, en Irlande, au Mexique, en Suisse, en Afrique du Sud, au Royaume-Uni et aux États-Unis.

About the role Job Summary The Sr. (Field) Service Engineering Lead is responsible for installing, configuring, calibrating, and repairing technical products and systems at customer locations. The role includes diagnosing malfunctions, performing maintenance, and providing on-site training to customer personnel. This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. The Service Engineer & Field Auditor is responsible for delivering on-site technical expertise, auditing customer installations, and ensuring an outstanding customer experience throughout the project lifecycle. Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Sintesi del lavoro Il Service Center Manager è responsabile della supervisione di un team di professionisti tecnici nella fornitura di assistenza tecnica di campo ai clienti. Questo ruolo garantisce l'effettiva esecuzione delle operazioni di servizio, risolve complesse questioni tecniche e mantiene alti livelli di soddisfazione del cliente. Il manager svolge un ruolo chiave nell'impostazione degli obiettivi del team, nella gestione delle prestazioni e nel rispetto degli standard di servizio. Questo profilo di lavoro è destinato a People Managers di 4+ junior a ruoli esperti. Sommario: Responsabile per le attività di conduzione nel nostro servizio di garanzia e assistenza. Funzioni essenziali:
• Assistere la nostra base clienti, inclusi i nostri rappresentanti, distributori e centri di assistenza autorizzati con il loro servizio e le esigenze tecniche
• Leads campo iniziale problemi di tiro e expedites supporto tecnico e ingegneristico secondo necessità
• Assicurare la soddisfazione e la lealtà del cliente consultando, assistendo e risolvendo richieste, richieste e reclami, sia verbalmente che per iscritto
• Maniglie in entrata chiamate in modo efficace ed efficiente attraverso l'uso del servizio clienti proattivo e hanno la conoscenza e la capacità di gestire le chiamate generali di inchiesta, così come le chiamate tecniche
• Esibizioni forti competenze interpersonali, è positivo, piacevole, rispettoso e focalizzato sul cliente
• Crea un'esperienza soddisfacente per il cliente utilizzando tecniche di servizio clienti professionali, personalizzando e concentrandosi sull'aggiunta di valore
• Risolvere domande / preoccupazioni in modo efficiente ed efficace
• Avvia le autorizzazioni di restituzione e crea il file cliente

• Spedizioni di servizio e di garanzia tramite il sistema fino al completamento
• Segui procedure di qualità secondo ISO 9001.
• Obblighi di sicurezza:
• Tutti i dipendenti capiscono e sono in grado di spiegare la struttura e gli obiettivi del SBP.
• Tutti i dipendenti seguono le regole di sicurezza.
• Tutti i dipendenti hanno "il diritto e il dovere di intervenire" nel caso in cui una preoccupazione di sicurezza diventa evidente. Inoltre, l'accettazione di un intervento dovrebbe essere accettata in modo positivo in quanto avrebbe potuto evitare un incidente.
• Tutti i dipendenti sono tenuti a rispettare tutte le istruzioni di lavoro, le politiche e i segni o le istruzioni postate per quanto riguarda la sicurezza, compreso ma non limitato al corretto uso del DPI richiesto in ogni momento. About the role Job Summary The Service Center Manager is responsible for supervising a team of technical professionals in delivering field service engineering support to customers. • Assist our customer base including our reps, distributors and authorized service centers with their service and technical needs
• Leads initial field trouble shooting and expedites technical and engineering support as needed

Der Manager spielt eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Einstellung von Team-Zielen, der Verwaltung von Leistung und der Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Service-Standards. • Führen Sie erste Feldstörungen Schießen und beschleunigt technische und technische Unterstützung bei Bedarf

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle Résumé de l'emploi Le gestionnaire du centre de services est chargé de superviser une équipe de professionnels techniques dans la prestation d'un soutien technique aux clients. Ce rôle assure l'exécution efficace des opérations de service, règle les problèmes techniques complexes et maintient un niveau élevé de satisfaction de la clientèle. Le gestionnaire joue un rôle clé dans l'établissement des objectifs de l'équipe, la gestion du rendement et le respect des normes de service. Ce profil d'emploi est destiné aux gestionnaires de personnes de 4 ans et plus à des rôles d'experts expérimentés. Résumé : Responsable des activités dans notre service Garantie et pièces détachées. Fonctions essentielles :
• Aider notre clientèle, y compris nos représentants, distributeurs et centres de services agréés, avec leurs besoins techniques et de service
• Dirige le tir initial sur le terrain et accélère le soutien technique et technique au besoin
• Assurer la satisfaction et la fidélité de la clientèle en consultant, en aidant et en réglant les demandes, les demandes et les plaintes, tant verbalement que par écrit
• Gère les appels entrants de manière efficace et efficiente par le biais d'un service à la clientèle proactif et possède les connaissances et la capacité de traiter les appels d'enquête générale, ainsi que les appels techniques
• Exposer des compétences interpersonnelles fortes, est positif, agréable, respectueux et axé sur le client
• Crée une expérience satisfaisante pour le client en utilisant des techniques professionnelles de service à la clientèle, en personnalisant et en mettant l'accent sur la valeur ajoutée
• Résoudre les questions/problèmes de manière efficace et efficiente
• Initie les autorisations de retour et crée le dossier client
• Effectue des déterminations de garantie basées sur des évaluations effectuées par des rapports d'évaluation interne et externe du centre de service agréé
• Logs rapports aux unités de fabrication pour les réclamations de garantie de recharge arrière
• Accélérer le service et les commandes de garantie à travers le système jusqu'à la fin
• Suivre les procédures de qualité selon la norme ISO 9001.
• Obligations de sécurité:
• Tous les employés comprennent et sont en mesure d'expliquer la structure et les objectifs du SBP.
• Tous les employés suivent les règles de sécurité.
• Tous les employés ont « le droit et le devoir d'intervenir » en cas de problème de sécurité. En outre, l'acceptation d'une intervention devrait être acceptée de manière positive car elle aurait pu prévenir un accident.
• Tous les employés sont tenus de se conformer à toutes les instructions de travail, à toutes les politiques et à toutes les affiches ou instructions affichées concernant la sécurité, y compris, sans s'y limiter, l'utilisation correcte des EPI requis en tout temps. Responsabilités secondaires : · Résoudre les plaintes des clients · Exécute d'autres fonctions selon l'affectation Responsabilités en matière de surveillance · Aucune Qualifications · Diplôme collégial de préférence ou expérience professionnelle égale · 5 ans d'expérience en service à la clientèle · Fortes compétences en informatique, y compris mais non limitées à Windows XP / Microsoft Office / Utilisation du Web · Compétences organisationnelles supérieures · Capacité à plusieurs tâches, respect des calendriers et des échéances · Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante et de travailler en équipe · Fond mécanique dans l'équipement rotatif a plus Exigences physiques: · Levée jusqu'à 25 livres · Dactylographie Ce que nous vous offrons
• Temps libre payé concurrentiel
• 12 jours fériés payés par année
• Programme de bonus annuel
• Avantages médicaux, dentaires et de vision complets
• Société d'assurance-vie payée à court terme et à long terme
• 6% 401K ou Roth Company Match avec Vesting Immédiate
• Cotisations à la sécurité de retraite versées par l'entreprise après 1 an d'emploi
• Remboursement des frais de scolarité/assistance éducative
• Remboursement trimestriel de gymnastique Sulzer est un employeur à chances égales. Nous croyons en la force d'un effectif diversifié et sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail inclusif. Nous sommes fiers d'être reconnus comme un employeur de premier plan en 2026

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Lead (Field) Service Technician is responsible for installing, configuring, calibrating, and repairing technical products and systems at customer field locations. This role performs a variety of maintenance and technical support tasks and may provide onsite training to customer support personnel. This job profile is intended for experienced support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations. Résumé du poste** En tant que Technicien de Service (Field Service Technician) chez Sulzer Ensival Moret France SASU, vous serez responsable de l'installation, de la maintenance préventive et corrective, ainsi que du dépannage de nos équipements sur les sites de nos clients. Vous assurerez un service de haute qualité, garantissant la satisfaction client et le bon fonctionnement de nos produits. Responsabilités** * Effectuer des interventions de maintenance préventive et corrective sur les pompes, agitateurs et autres équipements Sulzer Ensival Moret. * Diagnostiquer les pannes et dysfonctionnements, proposer des solutions techniques et les mettre en œuvre. * Réaliser des installations et mises en service d'équipements neufs. * Former les clients à l'utilisation et à la maintenance de premier niveau des produits. * Rédiger des rapports d'intervention détaillés et précis (rapports techniques, feuilles de temps, etc.). * Gérer son stock de pièces détachées et outils de manière autonome. * Assurer un reporting régulier à son responsable et aux équipes internes (ventes, support technique). * Respecter scrupuleusement les règles de sécurité, les procédures internes et les normes en vigueur. * Participer à la veille technologique et à l'amélioration continue des processus.
• Qualifications** * Diplôme de niveau Bac+2/3 en maintenance industrielle, mécanique, électromécanique, ou équivalent. * Expérience significative (minimum 3 ans) en maintenance d'équipements industriels, idéalement dans le domaine des pompes ou des machines tournantes. * Solides connaissances en mécanique, hydraulique, électricité et automatisme industriel. * Capacité à lire et interpréter des schémas techniques (mécaniques, électriques, hydrauliques). * Maîtrise des outils de diagnostic et de mesure. * Autonomie, rigueur, sens de l'organisation et esprit d'équipe. * Excellentes aptitudes à la communication et au service client. * Permis de conduire B valide (déplacements fréquents sur le territoire national). * Maîtrise du français (écrit et oral) indispensable. * Des connaissances en anglais technique seraient un plus.
• What we offer you . Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Sales Engineering Specialist supports the sales process by providing technical expertise and helping customers understand how products meet their needs. This role bridges the gap between engineering and sales, ensuring technical accuracy and customer satisfaction. This job profile is intended for professionals who apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. Votre mission ? Assurer le développement des parts de marché et, par extension, du chiffre d’affaires en tenant compte des objectifs commerciaux définis et des instructions de travail en vigueur. Pour ce faire, vous devrez:
• Etablir et déployer un plan d’actions commerciales dans le cadre de la stratégie d’entreprise et des objectifs commerciaux qui lui sont impartis.
• Fidéliser son portefeuille Clients.
• Prospecter de nouveaux marchés ou nouveaux Clients.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Sulzer Flow is wereldwijd marktleider in de ontwikkeling en levering van onder andere pompen, roerwerken, vermalers, compressoren en beluchters in geselecteerde industriële markten, met name in olie & gas, energie, water, afvalwater en de papierindustrie. De Sulzer Water & General Industry Business Unit heeft vestigingen in Nederland en België en is in deze regio met ongeveer 50 medewerkers actief in de verkoop, installatie en service van bovengenoemde producten. Kom werken bij Sulzer als (Technisch) Werkvoorbereider en help mee in onze verdere groei en om onze service naar een next level te brengen. In deze rol ben je verantwoordelijk voor:
• Voorbereiden van onderhouds- en modificatiewerkzaamheden aan de installaties/machines of onderdelen hiervan
• Opstellen van werkpakketten inclusief tekeningen, materialen, veiligheidsinstructies en planningen
• Coördineren van werkzaamheden met klanten, eigen Field Service Engineers, Workshop Engineers en externe partijen
• Aanvragen en beoordelen van offertes van leveranciers en aannemers
• Bewaken van voortgang, kosten en kwaliteit tijdens de voorbereiding en uitvoering
• Ondersteunen bij storingsanalyses en het implementeren van structurele verbeteringen
• Zorgen voor naleving van veiligheids-, milieu- en kwaliteitsnormen (bijv. VCA, ISO, ATEX)
• Beheren van technische documentatie en onderhoudsplannen in het onderhoudsbeheersysteem of administratie. Om te slagen in deze rol, heb je nodig :
• MBO+/HBO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur richting Werktuigbouwkunde, Elektrotechniek, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar
• Aantoonbare ervaring in een industriële omgeving (bijv. industriële/communale waterzuiveringen, procesindustrie; chemie, food, pharma, metaal, energie)
• Kennis van industriële installaties, onderhoudsprocessen en technische regelgeving
• Ervaring met onderhoudsbeheersystemen en MS Office
• Bekend met LEAN, TPM of andere verbetermethodieken is een pré
• Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en organisatorisch sterk What we offer you Jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden: Sulzer biedt een uitstekend pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder:
• Een meer dan marktconform salaris
• Een prestatiebonusregeling
• Een royaal aantal vakantie en ATV dagen (38)
• Een solide pensioenregeling (PMT) Locatie: Je werkt je samen met je collega’s vanuit onze locatie in Maastricht- Airport en af en toe ook bij onze klanten in de Benelux. We werken in onze moderne locatie met eigen werkplaats in een informele sfeer op een professionele manier met elkaar samen. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

titleByLocale.fr: Ingénieur de conception mécanique Équipement de pression

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mansioni - Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. - Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile Descrizione - Siamo alla ricerca di un ingegnere meccanico a pressione attrezzature per unire il nostro team di impianti di processo nella divisione Chemtech. - Responsabilità chiave: - Creazione di specifiche attrezzature e disegni di layout secondo gli standard interni e internazionali applicabili, specifiche del cliente e accordi contrattuali - Lavorazione indipendente di attrezzature di processo e ordini di macchine con il supporto di acquisto, gestione di progetti di altri dipartimenti specializzati - Creazione indipendente di specifiche di acquisto e requisizioni di acquisto - Controllo di documenti dettagliati creati da fornitori esterni o clienti - Sostenere la gestione del progetto nell'attuazione di specifiche tecniche, regolamenti, qualità e scadenze - Coordinamento del progetto e comunicazione con i fornitori esterni - Controllo della qualità, dei costi e delle scadenze e coordinamento degli ordini parziali in collaborazione diretta con i fornitori - Supporto vendite - Partecipazione a compiti di miglioramento continuo
• Requisiti - Istruzione tecnica, ingegneria meccanica preferibilmente o un campo simile - Un minimo di cinque anni di esperienza nei recipienti a pressione e nella progettazione di attrezzature rotanti per applicazioni nell'industria chimica, farmaceutica o del petrolio e del gas - Il tuo know-how nelle applicazioni IT e MS Office è a un livello ragionevole - Sei un giocatore di squadra, orientato al cliente, ma anche usato per lavorare auto-religione - Le competenze comunicative e organizzative creano una base eccellente per questo ruolo versatile. - Inoltre, è necessaria attenzione ai dettagli, e si dovrebbe sentire a proprio agio a lavorare in team e progetti interdisciplinari - La fluidità in inglese è essenziale. Buone competenze tedesche sono di vantaggio Cosa? - Opportunità concreta di fornire un impatto misurabile in un'organizzazione in crescita - Ambiente internazionale con ottime opportunità di formazione e apprendimento - Compensazione attraente e piano di vacanza - Ottimi benefici sociali - Opportunità di sviluppo globali - Una cultura innovativa, vibrante e agile - Programma di assistenza ai dipendenti Contatto Sulzer è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo. Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society About the role We are looking for a Mechanical Design Engineer Pressure Equipment to join our Process Plants team in the Chemtech division. Key Responsibilities:
• Creation of equipment specifications and layout drawings according to internal and international applicable standards, customer specifications and contractual agreements
• Independent processing of process equipment and machine orders with support of purchasing, project management other specialized departments
• Independent creation of purchasing specifications and purchase requisitions
• Checking detailed documents created by external suppliers or customers
• Supporting the project management in the implementation of technical specifications, regulations, quality and deadlines
• Project coordination and communication with external suppliers.
• Quality, cost and deadline monitoring and coordination of partial orders in direct cooperation with the suppliers
• Sales support
• Participation on continuous improvement tasks To succeed in this role, you will need:
• Technical educational, preferably mechanical engineering or a similar field
• A minimum of five years of experience in pressure vessels and rotating equipment design for applications in chemistry, pharma or oil and gas industry
• Your know-how in IT and MS Office applications is on a reasonable level
• You are a team player, customer oriented but also used to work self-reliant
• Communication and organizational skills build an excellent basis for this versatile role. Moreover, attention to detail is needed, and you should feel comfortable working in interdisciplinary teams and projects
• Fluency in English is essential. Good German skills are of advantage What we offer you
• Concrete opportunity of delivering a measurable impact in a growing organization
• International environment with excellent opportunities for training and learning
• Attractive compensation and vacation plan
