descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role As the Shop Foreman you will play a critical role in overseeing daily operations, ensuring efficient job execution, maintaining high standards of safety and quality, and fostering employee development. This position serves as a key liaison between the service center, customers, and internal teams such as Sales and Purchasing. You will directly supervise craftsmen and be responsible for driving performance, accountability, and continuous improvement. ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:
• Review work scopes and time estimates, ensuring efficient job execution
• Maintain direct customer contact and address needs
• Provide technical coaching and problem-solving support to craftsmen
• Ensure adherence to SEMS procedures, OEM, and customer specifications
• Manage resources, quality, and safety on the shop floor
• Conduct performance reviews and provide employee coaching
• Ensure craftsmen have necessary resources for safe and efficient work
• Support employees in setting and achieving performance and career development goals
• Coordinate on-the-job training, mentoring, and technical development opportunities QUALIFICATIONS:
• 5+ years of Electro-Mechanical repair experience, pump industry preferred
• Strong leadership and communication skills
• Available for 10-hour workdays (Mon-Fri) with weekend on-call duties on a rotating basis
• Skilled in identifying nonconformance issues and driving corrective actions
• Collaborative mindset with the ability to work across Sales, Operations, and Support teams What we offer you
• 12 Paid Holidays
• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days
• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability
• 401K with 6% company match
• Employee Assistance Program
• Employee Wellness Program Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary Location: Colton, California The I&C Project Engineer is responsible for the design and execution of packaged control and power solutions from order kickoff through FAT and turnover. Typical scope includes control system design, MCCs, MV/LV VFDs, RVSSs, PLSs, RTUs, and field instrumentation. This role owns technical coordination, submittals, documentation, schedule/budget tracking for the I&C portion, and factory acceptance testing readiness and execution. The I&C Project Engineer is not responsible for installation, however, is responsible for customer engagement, witnessing FAT testing on location, etc. Location: Colton, California Travel Requirements & Working Conditions
• Travel: Up to 25–40% based on project needs (regional and occasional out-of-state).
• Typical travel purposes: Customer/site walks, design coordination meetings, pre-FAT reviews, customer witness FAT, inspections, interface meetings with the GC/EC/customer, troubleshooting, and post-shipment technical support meetings (non-installation).
• Duration: Most trips 1–3 days; occasional trips up to 1 week for major FATs or multi-package projects.
• Schedule flexibility: Ability to travel on short notice at times to support critical project milestones (e.g., customer witness FAT windows).
• Physical demands: Ability to work in shop and industrial environments around large equipment; may require standing/walking for extended periods, and climbing ladders/stairs.
• Site conditions: Exposure to industrial hazards (noise, dust, weather, moving equipment) while adhering to required PPE and site safety rules. Scope of Supply (Typical)
• Control system design (instrumentation and control architecture, integration, and interfaces)
• MCC lineups and associated controls
• Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs) and controls (as applicable)
• Reduced Voltage Soft Starters (RVSS) and controls (as applicable)
• RTUs / PLC panels (as applicable to contract)
• Field instruments (specified instruments and accessories)
• Switchboards (SWBD) as part of package supply (startup/energization excluded) Associated drawings, submittals, test documentation, owner trainings, and FAT execution Core Responsibilities 1) Control System Design (Primary Technical Ownership)
• Develop the overall control system approach based on project requirements, including:
• Control architecture (RTU/PLC/remote I/O concepts where applicable)
• Communications and integration philosophy (protocols, network topology, addressing strategy)
• Power and control interface requirements between MCC/VFD/RVSS/RTU and instrumentation
• Produce and/or review design deliverables as required by the contract and internal standards:
• I/O lists, instrument lists, control narratives/cause & effect (when required)
• Loop diagrams, termination drawings, and interconnects
• Panel drawings (wiring diagrams, layouts, BOMs) and integration details
• Network diagrams and communications mappings (when applicable)
• Ensure designs are buildable, testable (FAT-ready), and aligned with customer standards and project constraints.
• Coordinate design reviews and address comments to closure prior to shop release. 2) Project Execution & Coordination (Delivery Ownership)
• Own the I&C/controls portion of project execution: deliverables, schedule, budget awareness, and quality.
• Review contract documents and customer standards; translate requirements into a deliverables list and execution plan.
• Coordinate across internal engineering, integration teams, procurement, QA, and project stakeholders.
• Manage submittal flow: compile, review, and submit vendor data; track comments; close out resubmittals.
• Provide clear status updates; maintain action-item logs, decision records, and

Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Sales Engineer is responsible for supporting the sales process by providing technical expertise, assisting with product demonstrations, and preparing proposals. This role works closely with senior engineers and sales teams to ensure customer requirements are met. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. Job Summary** Responsible for driving sales and providing technical expertise for Sulzer's pump solutions within the utilities sector across South Africa, ensuring customer satisfaction and achieving sales targets. Job
• Responsibilities** * Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve and exceed sales targets for Sulzer pump products and services within the water, wastewater, power generation, and other utility industries. * Identify and cultivate strong relationships with key decision-makers, engineering consultants, contractors, and end-users within the utilities market. * Conduct technical presentations and product demonstrations to potential clients, effectively communicating the value proposition of Sulzer's solutions. * Perform detailed technical analysis of customer requirements, recommending appropriate pump selections and system configurations. * Prepare comprehensive technical proposals, quotations, and commercial offers in response to customer inquiries and tenders. * Negotiate contracts and terms of sale, ensuring mutually beneficial agreements for Sulzer and its customers. * Collaborate closely with internal teams, including engineering, project management, and after-sales service, to ensure seamless project execution and customer support. * Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and industry developments to identify new business opportunities and inform sales strategies. * Provide post-sales technical support and troubleshoot issues to ensure customer satisfaction and repeat business. * Maintain accurate sales forecasts, customer records, and activity reports within the company's CRM system. * Represent Sulzer at industry events, trade shows, and conferences to promote brand awareness and generate leads. * Adhere to all company policies, procedures, and safety regulations. Job
• Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field. * Minimum of 5 years of proven sales experience in the utilities sector, specifically with pumps, rotating equipment, or related fluid handling solutions. * In-depth technical knowledge of pumps, pumping systems, and their applications within water/wastewater treatment, power generation, and other utility environments. * Demonstrated ability to understand complex technical requirements and propose effective solutions. * Strong commercial acumen with a track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets. * Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills. * Proficiency in English, both written and verbal. * Ability to build and maintain strong customer relationships. * Self-motivated, results-oriented, and able to work independently as well as part of a team. * Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and CRM software. * Valid driver's license and willingness to travel extensively throughout South Africa.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Assembly Finishing Technician to join our manufacturing team. In this role, you will be responsible for the final blending, grinding, and polishing of cast pump impellers. Using a variety of pneumatic (air) hand tools, you will remove excess material, establish precise geometric radii, and achieve specified surface finishes critical to fluid dynamics and pump efficiency. Key Responsibilities
• Precision Grinding: Operate various air-powered grinding tools, die grinders, and polishing equipment to blend and finish internal and external impeller vanes.
• Blueprint & Spec Compliance: Read and interpret technical drawings, blueprints, and engineering specifications to ensure all contours, radii, and surface finishes meet strict tolerances.
• Quality Inspection: Use precision measuring instruments (such as radius gauges, calipers, and surface roughness testers) to self-inspect work and ensure quality compliance.
• Defect Removal: Identify and eliminate casting defects, burrs, sharp edges, and parting lines without compromising the structural integrity of the component.
• Equipment Maintenance: Perform routine daily maintenance on pneumatic tools, including oiling, changing out abrasive wheels/burrs, and reporting mechanical issues.
• Safety & Housekeeping: Maintain a clean, organized workstation and strictly adhere to all safety protocols, including the mandatory use of PPE (respirators, hearing protection, and face shields).
• Impeller Balancing : Execute single- and two-plane balancing of impellers to meet specified balance quality grades and customer requirements. Analyze imbalance conditions and apply corrective grinding while maintaining geometric integrity of critical features. Qualifications & Skills
• Experience: 1–3 years of experience in metal finishing, deburring, or precision grinding within a foundry, aerospace, or heavy machinery manufacturing environment.
• Tool Proficiency: Proven expertise using pneumatic die grinders, angle grinders, pencil grinders, and various abrasive media (carbide burrs, flap wheels, scotch-brite pads).
• Technical Literacy: Ability to read blueprints and understand geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T) related to radii and surface finishes (e.g., Ra values).
• Dexterity & Detail: High level of manual dexterity, hand-eye coordination, and a keen eye for visual defects.
• Education: High school diploma or equivalent; technical certification in welding, machining, or manufacturing is a plus. Physical Requirements
• Ability to stand, bend, and reach for extended periods (8+ hour shifts).
• Capability to lift and maneuver components weighing up to 50 lbs.
• Strong grip strength and tolerance for prolonged exposure to hand-arm vibrations from pneumatic tools.
• Ability to work comfortably in an environment with ambient noise and airborne dust (protective equipment provided). What we offer you
• Competitive Paid Time Off (3 weeks to start)
• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year
• Annual Bonus Program
• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits
• Company Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance
• 6% 401K or Roth Company Match with Immediate Vesting
• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1 year of employment
• Tuition Reimbursement/Educational Assistance
• Quarterly Gym Reimbursement Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

• Precision Grinding: Operate various air-powered grinding tools, die grinders, and polishing equipment to blend and finish internal and external impeller vanes.
• Blueprint & Spec Compliance: Read and interpret technical drawings, blueprints, and engineering specifications to ensure all contours, radii, and surface finishes meet strict tolerances.
• Quality Inspection: Use precision measuring instruments (such as radius gauges, calipers, and surface roughness testers) to self-inspect work and ensure quality compliance.
• Defect Removal: Identify and eliminate casting defects, burrs, sharp edges, and parting lines without compromising the structural integrity of the component.
• Equipment Maintenance: Perform routine daily maintenance on pneumatic tools, including oiling, changing out abrasive wheels/burrs, and reporting mechanical issues.
• Safety & Housekeeping: Maintain a clean, organized workstation and strictly adhere to all safety protocols, including the mandatory use of PPE (respirators, hearing protection, and face shields).
• Impeller Balancing : Execute single- and two-plane balancing of impellers to meet specified balance quality grades and customer requirements. Analyze imbalance conditions and apply corrective grinding while maintaining geometric integrity of critical features. Qualifications & Skills
• Experience: 1–3 years of experience in metal finishing, deburring, or precision grinding within a foundry, aerospace, or heavy machinery manufacturing environment.
• Tool Proficiency: Proven expertise using pneumatic die grinders, angle grinders, pencil grinders, and various abrasive media (carbide burrs, flap wheels, scotch-brite pads).
• Technical Literacy: Ability to read blueprints and understand geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T) related to radii and surface finishes (e.g., Ra values).
• Dexterity & Detail: High level of manual dexterity, hand-eye coordination, and a keen eye for visual defects.
• Education: High school diploma or equivalent; technical certification in welding, machining, or manufacturing is a plus. Physical Requirements
• Ability to stand, bend, and reach for extended periods (8+ hour shifts).
• Capability to lift and maneuver components weighing up to 50 lbs.
• Strong grip strength and tolerance for prolonged exposure to hand-arm vibrations from pneumatic tools.
• Ability to work comfortably in an environment with ambient noise and airborne dust (protective equipment provided). What we offer you

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Instrumentation & Controls (I&C) Project Engineer is responsible for the design and execution of packaged control and power solutions from order kickoff through FAT and turnover. Typical scope includes control system design, MCCs, MV/LV VFDs, RVSSs, PLSs, RTUs, and field instrumentation. This role owns technical coordination, submittals, documentation, schedule/budget tracking for the I&C portion, and factory acceptance testing readiness and execution. The I&C Project Engineer is not responsible for installation, however, is responsible for customer engagement, witnessing FAT testing on location, etc.. Travel Requirements & Working Conditions
• Travel: Up to 25–40% based on project needs (regional and occasional out-of-state).
• Typical travel purposes: Customer/site walks, design coordination meetings, pre-FAT reviews, customer witness FAT, inspections, interface meetings with the GC/EC/customer, troubleshooting, and post-shipment technical support meetings (non-installation).
• Duration: Most trips 1–3 days; occasional trips up to 1 week for major FATs or multi-package projects.
• Schedule flexibility: Ability to travel on short notice at times to support critical project milestones (e.g., customer witness FAT windows).
• Physical demands: Ability to work in shop and industrial environments around large equipment; may require standing/walking for extended periods, and climbing ladders/stairs.
• Site conditions: Exposure to industrial hazards (noise, dust, weather, moving equipment) while adhering to required PPE and site safety rules. Scope of Supply (Typical)
• Control system design (instrumentation and control architecture, integration, and interfaces)
• MCC lineups and associated controls
• Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs) and controls (as applicable)
• Reduced Voltage Soft Starters (RVSS) and controls (as applicable)
• RTUs / PLC panels (as applicable to contract)
• Field instruments (specified instruments and accessories)
• Switchboards (SWBD) as part of package supply (startup/energization excluded) Associated drawings, submittals, test documentation, owner trainings, and FAT execution Core Responsibilities 1) Control System Design (Primary Technical Ownership) Develop the overall control system approach based on project requirements, including:
• Control architecture (RTU/PLC/remote I/O concepts where applicable)
• Communications and integration philosophy (protocols, network topology, addressing strategy)
• Power and control interface requirements between MCC/VFD/RVSS/RTU and instrumentation Produce and/or review design deliverables as required by the contract and internal standards:
• I/O lists, instrument lists, control narratives/cause & effect (when required)
• Loop diagrams, termination drawings, and interconnects
• Panel drawings (wiring diagrams, layouts, BOMs) and integration details
• Network diagrams and communications mappings (when applicable) Ensure designs are buildable, testable (FAT-ready), and aligned with customer standards and project constraints. Coordinate design reviews and address comments to closure prior to shop release. 2) Project Execution & Coordination (Delivery Ownership)
• Own the I&C/controls portion of project execution: deliverables, schedule, budget awareness, and quality.
• Review contract documents and customer standards; translate requirements into a deliverables list and execution plan.
• Coordinate across internal engineering, integration teams, procurement, QA, and project stakeholders.
• Manage submittal flow: compile, review, and submit vendor data; track comments; close out resubmittals.
• Provide clear status updates; maintain action-item logs, decision records, and interface registers.
• Manage change

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Sr. Procurement Officer is responsible for managing procurement activities including sourcing, negotiating, and purchasing goods and services to support business operations. This role ensures compliance with procurement policies and contributes to cost optimization and supplier performance. This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Job location: Navi Mumbai / Coimbatore Main accountabilities and tasks:
• Implement Just-in-Time principles to ensure timely supply of all materials required for complete facility project manufacturing.
• Negotiate optimal pricing and commercial terms to secure cost-effective component supply and maximize profitability.
• Support tendering and sales teams by providing competitive quotations that strengthen pricing and delivery advantages.
• Monitor and follow up on placed orders to guarantee on-time delivery from external suppliers.
• Proactively address and resolve issues related to import/export processes in coordination with the logistics team.
• Establish supply agreements with key suppliers to secure preferential pricing and delivery commitments.
• Review and maintain optimal stock levels to ensure efficient inventory management on-site. Desired experience and qualifications: Work experience : 7 to 10 years Expertise: Buyer & Expediting Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical /Production Languages: English / Tamil /Hindi Soft skills: MS office, SAP & MIS reporting Other: Sound/ In-depth experience in casting ,Machining areas What we offer you 22 vacation days + 9 days Casual leave + 8 days Sick Leave + 13 days Festival holidays Defined contribution pension scheme Hospitalization insurance benefit On-site car parking Subsidized cafeteria Long service award Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Unisciti al nostro team di Sulzer Turbo Services, parte di Sulzer Services, che è uno dei fornitori indipendenti più avanzati al mondo di riparazione, revisione e manutenzione all'interno del settore turbine. Offriamo ai nostri clienti in tutto il mondo un supporto solido, orientato al cliente e flessibile per le loro turbine a gas. Unisciti al nostro orgoglioso e altamente qualificato equipaggio internazionale come Field Service Engineer per le turbine a gas industriali pesanti Il ruolo può essere basato in qualsiasi paese europeo con una presenza di Sulzer. In questo ruolo sarete responsabili per:
• Monitoraggio o gestione degli aspetti tecnici e della qualità delle revisioni e delle attività di servizio basate sulle specifiche tecniche
• Discutere le riparazioni e i metodi da effettuare con ingegneri e team di assistenza. Definire i fattori critici e stabilire la portata e i rischi
• Fornitura meccanica fuori sito e direzione tecnica e supervisione in loco durante gli eventi di manutenzione (ispezione, revisioni, messa in servizio) di Power Generation Facilities utilizzando turbine a gas prodotte da Siemens, Ansaldo, Alstom, General Electric e MHI
• Fornire meccanica fuori luogo e direzione tecnica in loco e supervisione durante gli eventi di manutenzione (ispezione) di proprietà del cliente Impianti che utilizzano attrezzature rotanti
• Assicurare l'installazione accurata / tiro guai / manutenzione & diagnostica delle turbine a gas industriali pesanti attrezzature rotanti secondo Sulzer Specifiche, istruzioni di ingegneria, disegni e istruzioni di processo
• Gestione delle attività del sito come la pianificazione/integrazione/monitoraggio delle risorse e dell'assistenza tecnica basata sull'ambito di lavoro contrattuale concordato
• Supervise i dipendenti del contratto, la manodopera fornendo indicazioni, istruzioni, monitorare la qualità e il progresso durante le revisioni della turbina a gas
• Il sostegno alle attività di servizio sul campo in un ruolo di back-office
• L'evoluzione dei servizi e dei prodotti relativi alle attrezzature rotanti Per avere successo in questo ruolo, avrete bisogno di:
• Laurea in ingegneria meccanica
• 5 anni di esperienza in attrezzature rotanti, ingegneria e manutenzione di turbine a gas
• Esperienza per comprendere e implementare disegni meccanici (sezione, costruzione, montaggio dwg, P&ID, allineamento specifica, procedura di lavaggio / soffiaggio, specifica di tubazioni, ecc.)
• Molto buone competenze linguistiche in inglese
• Un atteggiamento proattivo, flessibile e problem solving
• Eccellente capacità interpersonali e di comunicazione Cosa ti offriamo
• Possibilità di fare un impatto significativo e guidare la strategia globale attraverso la struttura di marketing.
• Ambiente di lavoro collaborativo e di supporto con un focus sull'innovazione e l'eccellenza.
• Eccitanti opportunità di crescita e di progresso professionale in un settore dinamico ed in evoluzione.
• Opportunità significative per i viaggi globali. Sulzer è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo. Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Join our Sulzer Turbo Services team, part of Sulzer Services, which is one of the world's most advanced independent providers of repair, overhaul, and maintenance within the turbine industry. We provide our customers worldwide with solid, customer-oriented, and flexible support for their Gas Turbines. Come join our proud and highly skilled international crew as a Field Service Engineer for Heavy Industrial Gas Turbines The role can be based in any European country with a Sulzer presence. In this role you will be accountable for:
• Monitoring or managing the technical aspects and quality of the overhauls and service activities based upon the technical specifications
• Discussing the repairs and methods to be carried out with engineers and field service team. Stating the critical factors and establishing the scope and risks
• Providing mechanical off site and on-site technical direction and supervision during maintenance events (inspections, revisions, commissioning) of customer owned Power Generation Facilities utilizing Gas Turbines manufactured by Siemens, Ansaldo, Alstom, General Electric and MHI
• Provide mechanical off site and on-site technical direction and supervision during maintenance events (inspections) of customer owned Facilities utilizing rotating equipment
• Ensure accurate installation/trouble shooting/maintenance & diagnostics of the rotating equipment heavy industrial gas turbines according to Sulzer Specifications, engineering instructions, drawings & process instructions
• Manage site activities like planning/integration/monitoring of resources and technical assistance based on agreed contractual work scope
• Supervise contract employees, manpower by providing directions, instructions, monitor quality and progress during Gas Turbine overhauls
• The support of field service activities in a back-office role
• The developments on rotating equipment related services and products To succeed in this role, you will need:
• A bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering
• 5 years’ experience in rotating equipment, Gas Turbines engineering and hands-on maintenance
• Experience to understand and implement mechanical drawings (section, construction, assembly dwg, P&ID, alignment specification, flushing/blowing procedure, piping specification, etc.)
• Very good English language skills
• A proactive, flexible, and problem-solving attitude
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills What we offer you

• Exciting opportunities for professional growth and advancement in a dynamic and evolving industry.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Sales Engineer is responsible for driving sales growth and expanding Sulzer’s market presence within the mining sector. The role combines strong technical understanding with commercial execution to position Sulzer as the preferred OEM partner for reliability, performance, and lifecycle value, while actively engaging with end users, EPCMs, consultants, and channel partners, particularly in greenfield and brownfield projects. Key Responsibilities 1. Business Development & Sales Growth
• Identify and secure new business opportunities in mining (open-pit and underground operations)
• Develop and execute strategic account plans for key mining customers
• Meet and exceed sales targets, order intake, and profitability objectives 2. Technical & Solution-Based Selling
• Develop and propose fit-for-purpose pump solutions aligned with customer operational requirements
• Support customers with:
• Equipment selection guidance
• System optimisation recommendations
• Performance improvement initiatives
• Conduct site assessments, condition reviews, and failure analysis support
• Collaborate with internal engineering and service teams to deliver reliable, high-performance solutions 3. Customer Relationship Management
• Build and maintain strong relationships with:
• Mine engineers
• Maintenance and operations teams
• Plant managers
• Procurement departments
• Position Sulzer as a trusted reliability partner , focusing on:
• Plant availability
• Reduced downtime
• Total cost of ownership
• Maintain regular engagement through site visits, technical discussions, and performance reviews 4. Channel, EPCM & Consultant Engagement
• Develop and manage relationships with:
• Channel partners and distributors (local service providers, resellers)
• EPCM companies (Engineering, Procurement, Construction Management firms)
• Consultants and design houses
• Drive early-stage engagement in greenfield and expansion projects , ensuring Sulzer solutions are specified
• Promote Sulzer as the preferred OEM in project specifications and tender documents
• Support partners with training, product knowledge, and technical guidance to strengthen market reach 5. Market Intelligence & Competitor Analysis
• Monitor competitor activities (local workshops, OEMs, and service providers)
• Analyse:
• Pricing structures
• Capabilities and offerings
• Customer value propositions
• Identify opportunities where Sulzer can differentiate through:
• Engineering expertise
• Reliability improvements
• Lifecycle cost advantages
• Provide feedback to management on market trends and risks 6. Go-To-Market Execution
• Implement Sulzer’s go-to-market strategy across assigned territory
• Promote value-based selling , focusing on performance, uptime, and long-term cost benefits
• Drive adoption of:
• Service agreements
• Reliability programs
• Condition monitoring solutions
• Leverage direct and indirect (channel) routes to market effectively 7. Tendering & Commercial Management
• Prepare and submit technical and commercial proposals
• Ensure alignment with client specifications and project requirements
• Manage pricing strategies to balance competitiveness and profitability
• Participate in negotiations and contract closure
• Ensure compliance with Sulzer’s commercial policies and risk frameworks 8. Installed Base & Aftermarket Growth
• Manage and grow Sulzer’s installed base within mining operations
• Identify opportunities for:
• Upgrades
• Retrofits
• Equipment replacement
• Drive aftermarket revenue through:
• Spare parts
• Repairs
• Long-term service agreements
• Position OEM parts as critical to performance, reliability, and risk reduction 9. Project Support & Execution Alignment
• Coordin

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Sales Engineer is responsible for supporting the sales process by providing technical expertise, assisting with product demonstrations, and preparing proposals. This role works closely with senior engineers and sales teams to ensure customer requirements are met. This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. To visit customers and promote Sulzer spare parts sales To coordinate with Sulzer CSS Industry Sales team and customers and assist to resolve the technical issues and win more parts/product sales. To analyze the installed base volume and find potential companies to appoint as CSS channel partners at those appropriate regions. To monitor, manage and support channel partners to enhance the Sulzer parts sales. To visit customer plants and submit technical and commercial proposals to replace inefficient older pumps for both Sulzer/competitor pumps to maintain sustainable installed base volume. To approach proactively with customers and submit quotes and technical proposals for parts sales and customer system upgrading using Sulzer Sense system. To visit customers and promote Sulzer TB seal sales and win orders. To attend customer complaints at site and resolve the customer complaints To troubleshoot and resolve the technical issues at the customer site To carry out installation supervisions and inspections at customer site and give feedback to the customer about possible To carry out testing and commissioning of the equipment at the customer site To conduct the customer trainings for installation, testing, commissioning, operation and maintenance of the equipment To report to CSS Manager on daily activities and weekly work schedules. Requirements
• Degree or Diploma In Electrical or Mechatronics or Mechanical Engineering
• Minimum 3 years working experience in Industry Pumps and various industry process systems would be preferable
• Market/product knowledge in various Industry products application and process would be preferable sales experience would be added an advantage.
• Willing to travel extensively within the country of appointment and other countries as and when required Valid Driving license What we offer you Career Opportunities Medical Benefit Saving Plan Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role We are looking for a Service Centre Manager to lead our Leeds Service Centre. This is a pivotal, leadership role shaping the future of our UK operations, combining strategic oversight, operational excellence, and cultural transformation. Our Leeds service centre brings together skilled specialists delivering overhaul, repair, and upgrade services for pumps, turbines, compressors, and other rotating equipment. Supporting customers across key sectors including power generation, renewables, water, and general industry, the team is focused on reliability, innovation, and delivering strong customer outcomes. Your main tasks and responsibilities:
• Own the P&L for the Leeds Service Centres, delivering expected returns while maintaining exceptional safety and customer satisfaction.
• Lead and role model strong health and safety behaviours, embedding a positive, proactive safety culture across both locations.
• Develop a future‑ready organisation, ensuring capability, workforce planning, and talent management are effectively aligned across the two sites.
• Execute business growth plans, identifying and realising market and product opportunities while effectively managing risk.
• Build, coach, and develop high‑performing management teams, ensuring consistency in standards, behaviours, and operational practices.
• Monitor, analyse, and report on performance, using key metrics to drive accountability and continuous improvement.
• Collaborate closely with Sales and Commercial teams to align operational capacity with customer requirements (SIOP).
• Embed compliance and operational excellence, ensuring both sites consistently follow best practices.
• Communicate strategy, progress, and results clearly, both within and across the wider regional operations organisation. To succeed in this role, you will need:
• Proven experience leading people in an operational environment, ideally across in an Service / Aftermarket / Industrial Engineering environment
• Experience in business management and P&L ownership,
• A track record of driving transformation, growth, or organisational change.
• Strong understanding of health, safety, and environmental requirements.
• LEAN/Continuous Improvement experience (desirable).
• NEBOSH qualification (desirable). What we offer you
• A competitive basic salary
• An annual bonus based on a combination of company performance and your individual contribution
• Private Medical Insurance
• Car / Car Allowance
• 33 days annual leave.
• Defined pension contributions.
• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.
• Discounted personal car leasing for you, your family, and friends.
• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.
• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.
• As a Bronze Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we welcome and support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers with policies for training, camps and deployment, plus a growing internal military network. Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Elevate la vostra carriera con un'opportunità appena creata a Sulzer, in quanto costruiamo una capacità di business Sales, Inventory & Operations Planning (SiOP) all'interno della nostra divisione Pumps, Parts & Retrofit (PPR). PPR si concentra sulla manutenzione e il miglioramento delle attrezzature rotanti critiche in settori come l'energia, l'acqua e la produzione. Operare in un ambiente di mercato dinamico significa che la domanda è meno prevedibile e i progetti spesso comportano l'ingegneria su misura o inversa, rendendo la pianificazione più complessa — e molto più interessante — che in un ambiente di produzione tradizionale. Come Analista commerciale di pianificazione dell'inventario e delle operazioni, vi aiuterà a plasmare questa capacità da zero, guidando il processo decisionale guidato dai dati tra le squadre nel Regno Unito, Europa e Africa. Connetterai più sistemi, migliorando la visibilità e consentendo una pianificazione più allineata e previsionale. Lavorando attraverso Salesforce, SAP, D365 e Qlik Sense, Tagetik e altri sistemi trasformerete i dati complessi in chiare e attuabili intuizioni che supportano le decisioni operative e strategiche in un ambiente in rapida evoluzione. Cosa farai
• Analizzare le tendenze della domanda utilizzando i dati CRM, collaborando strettamente con i team Sales, Service e Tendering
• Combina i dati delle prestazioni interne con informazioni sul mercato esterno per informare la pianificazione della domanda
• Valutare i dati sul lato dell'offerta in più entità di produzione, identificare rischi e opportunità
• Progettare e mantenere cruscotti e report che forniscono visibilità attraverso le pipeline di vendita e piani operativi
• Tradurre i dati in metriche e visualizzazioni significative per migliorare la previsione e il monitoraggio delle prestazioni
• Presenti approfondimenti e raccomandazioni nelle recensioni mensili di SiOP, azioni di guida e miglioramento continuo
• Stabilire e migliorare la governance dei dati, la coerenza e le migliori pratiche nei sistemi
• Collaborare in modo interfunzionale con Finanza, Operazioni e Vendite – allineare le squadre intorno ad una singola versione della verità Cosa stiamo cercando
• Esperienza comprovata (c.5+ anni) in un ruolo analitico, preferibilmente nell'ingegneria del negozio di lavoro, nell'ambiente di produzione o di servizio (ma non necessario).
• Forte esperienza con gli strumenti BI (Power BI e/o Qlik Sense), con la capacità di costruire cruscotti d'impatto
• Esperienza di lavoro con sistemi ERP/CRM (ad esempio SAP, D365, Salesforce)
• Forte modellazione dei dati e capacità di Excel
• Una mentalità curiosa e risolutiva dei problemi con la capacità di individuare le tendenze e sfidare i presupposti
• Confident stakeholder management skills, con esperienza che influenza le funzioni
• Confortevole lavoro in un ambiente veloce e meno strutturato in cui è possibile modellare i processi, non solo seguirli
• Volontà di viaggiare occasionalmente attraverso la regione EMEA Cosa ti offriamo
• Un ruolo a casa completamente remoto con viaggi occasionali in tutte le regioni.
• Uno stipendio base competitivo
• Schema di bonus personale annuale basato sull'azienda e sulle prestazioni personali
• Assicurazione medica privata
• 33 giorni di ferie annuali.
• Contributi pensionistici definiti.
• Accesso a Medicash che ti aiuta a coprire i costi di salute di tutti i giorni, come odontoiatria e fisioterapia, oltre a una gamma di vantaggi per il benessere.
• Supporto confidenziale tramite i programmi di assistenza ai dipendenti.
• Accesso agli sconti sullo stile di vita dello shopping e l'opportunità di richiedere l'iscrizione a Costco.
• Noleggio auto personale scontato per voi la vostra famiglia e gli amici.
• Long Service Awards che celebra il vostro impegno.
• Opportunità di apprendimento continua attraverso Sulzer Learning Pathways.
• In qualità di titolare del premio Bronzo del programma di riconoscimento dei datori di lavoro MoD Defence, accogliamo e sosteniamo veterani, reservisti e Volontari Cadet Adulti con politiche di formazione, campi e distribuzione, oltre a una crescente rete militare interna. Zolfo
descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Elevate your career with a newly created opportunity at Sulzer, as we build out a best-in-class Sales, Inventory & Operations Planning (SiOP) capability within our Pumps, Parts & Retrofit (PPR) division. PPR focuses on servicing and enhancing critical rotating equipment across industries such as energy, water and manufacturing. Operating in a dynamic aftermarket environment means demand is less predictable and projects often involve bespoke or reverse engineering, making planning more complex — and far more interesting — than in a traditional manufacturing setting. As a Sales Inventory & Operations Planning Business Analyst, you will help shape this capability from the ground up, driving data-led decision making across teams in the UK, Europe and Africa. You will connect multiple systems, improving visibility and enabling more aligned, forward-looking planning. Working across Salesforce, SAP, D365 and Qlik Sense, Tagetik and other systems you will transform complex data into clear, actionable insights that support both operational and strategic decisions in a fast-moving, evolving environment. What You will Be Doing
• Analyse demand trends using CRM data, partnering closely with Sales, Service and Tendering teams
• Combine internal performance data with external market insights to inform demand planning
• Assess supply-side data across multiple manufacturing entities, identifying risks and opportunities
• Design and maintain dashboards and reports that provide visibility across sales pipelines and operational plans
• Translate data into meaningful metrics and visualisations to improve forecasting and performance tracking
• Present insights and recommendations in monthly SiOP reviews, driving actions and continuous improvement
• Establish and improve data governance, consistency and best practices across systems
• Collaborate cross-functionally with Finance, Operations and Sales — aligning teams around a single version of the truth What We are Looking For
• Proven experience (c.5+ years) in an analytical role, preferably in job-shop engineering, manufacturing or service environment (but not necessary).
• Strong experience with BI tools (Power BI and/or Qlik Sense), with the ability to build impactful dashboards
• Experience working with ERP/CRM systems (e.g. SAP, D365, Salesforce)
• Strong data modelling and Excel capability
• A curious, problem-solving mindset with the ability to spot trends and challenge assumptions
• Confident stakeholder management skills, with experience influencing across functions
• Comfortable working in a fast-moving, less structured environment where you can shape processes, not just follow them
• Willingness to travel occasionally across the EMEA region What we offer you
• A fully remote home-based role with occasional travel across regions.
• A competitive basic salary
• Annual personal bonus scheme based on company and personal performance
• Private Medical Insurance
• 33 days annual leave.
• Defined pension contributions.
• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.
• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.
• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.
• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.
• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.
• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.
• As a Bronze Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we welcome and support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers with policies for training, camps and deployment, plus a growing internal military network. Sulzer

Sie verbinden mehrere Systeme, verbessern die Sichtbarkeit und ermöglichen eine ausgerichtete, zukunftsgerichtete Planung. • Bewährte Erfahrung (ca. 5+ Jahre) in einer analytischen Rolle, vorzugsweise in der Job-Shop-Engineering, Fertigung oder Service-Umgebung (aber nicht notwendig).

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sulzer est une entreprise d'ingénierie de premier plan avec un fier héritage d'innovation. Rejoignez notre équipe mondiale pour développer votre expertise et développer des solutions innovantes qui permettent une société prospère et plus durable. Sur le rôle Augmentez votre carrière grâce à une opportunité nouvellement créée chez Sulzer, alors que nous développons une capacité de vente, d'inventaire et de planification des opérations (SiOP) au sein de notre division Pumps, Parts & Retrofit (PPR). La RPP met l'accent sur l'entretien et l'amélioration des équipements rotatifs essentiels dans les industries comme l'énergie, l'eau et la fabrication. L'exploitation dans un environnement dynamique de marché secondaire signifie que la demande est moins prévisible et que les projets impliquent souvent une ingénierie sur mesure ou inverse, rendant la planification plus complexe — et bien plus intéressante — que dans un contexte de fabrication traditionnel. En tant qu'analyste commercial de l'inventaire des ventes et de la planification des opérations, vous aiderez à façonner cette capacité à partir de la base, en conduisant la prise de décision axée sur les données à travers les équipes au Royaume-Uni, en Europe et en Afrique. Vous connecterez plusieurs systèmes, améliorant la visibilité et permettant une planification plus alignée et tournée vers l'avenir. En travaillant avec Salesforce, SAP, D365 et Qlik Sense, Tagetik et d'autres systèmes, vous transformerez des données complexes en informations claires et exploitables qui soutiennent les décisions opérationnelles et stratégiques dans un environnement en évolution rapide. Ce que vous ferez
• Analyser les tendances de la demande à l'aide de données CRM, en partenariat étroit avec les équipes Ventes, Service et Appel d'offres
• Combiner les données internes sur les performances et les perspectives du marché extérieur pour éclairer la planification de la demande
• Évaluer les données relatives à l'offre dans plusieurs entités manufacturières, en identifiant les risques et les possibilités
• Concevoir et tenir à jour des tableaux de bord et des rapports qui offrent une visibilité sur l'ensemble des pipelines de vente et des plans opérationnels
• Traduire les données en mesures et visualisations significatives pour améliorer les prévisions et le suivi des performances
• Présenter des points de vue et des recommandations dans les examens mensuels des PON, les actions de pilotage et l'amélioration continue
• Établir et améliorer la gouvernance des données, la cohérence et les meilleures pratiques entre les systèmes;
• Collaborer de manière interfonctionnelle avec Finance, Opérations et Ventes – aligner les équipes autour d'une seule version de la vérité Ce que nous cherchons
• Expérience éprouvée (c.5+ années) dans un rôle d'analyse, de préférence dans l'ingénierie des ateliers, la fabrication ou l'environnement de service (mais pas nécessaire).
• Forte expérience avec les outils BI (Power BI et / ou Qlik Sense), avec la capacité de construire des tableaux de bord impactés
• Expérience de travail avec les systèmes ERP/CRM (par exemple SAP, D365, Salesforce)
• Forte capacité de modélisation des données et d'Excel
• Un état d'esprit curieux et résolvant les problèmes avec la capacité de repérer les tendances et de contester les hypothèses
• Compétences en gestion des parties prenantes avec une expérience influant sur l'ensemble des fonctions
• Travail confortable dans un environnement rapide et moins structuré où vous pouvez façonner les processus, pas seulement les suivre
• Volonté de voyager occasionnellement dans la région de l'EMEA Ce que nous vous offrons
• Un rôle entièrement isolé à domicile avec des déplacements occasionnels entre les régions.
• Un salaire de base compétitif
• Régime annuel de primes personnelles basé sur la performance de l'entreprise et personnelle
• Assurance médicale privée
• 33 jours de congé annuel.
• Cotisations définies.
• L'accès à Medicash vous aide à couvrir les frais de santé quotidiens comme l'optique dentaire et la physiothérapie ainsi qu'une gamme de avantages bien-être.
• Soutien confidentiel via les programmes d'aide aux employés.
• L'accès à des réductions sur le style de vie de divertissement shopping plus la possibilité de demander l'adhésion à Costco.
• Location de voiture personnelle à rabais pour vous votre famille et vos amis.
• Long Service Awards célébrant votre engagement.
• Des possibilités d'apprentissage continu grâce aux voies d'apprentissage Sulzer.
• En tant que titulaire du Prix Bronze du Programme de reconnaissance des employeurs de la Défense du Ministère de la défense, nous accueillons et soutenons les anciens combattants, les réservistes et les cadets adultes volontaires dans des politiques d'entraînement, de camps et de déploiement, ainsi qu'un réseau militaire interne croissant. Sulzer

Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary The Tendering Manager is responsible for managing a team of professionals in the preparation of technical and commercial proposals. This role ensures the accuracy and competitiveness of tenders and supports the sales process with technical expertise. 1. Deputizing for Regional Sales Director where appropriate 2. Ensure application of Sulzer tools and policies, procedures, codes of conduct and best practice guidelines 3. Mentoring, directing, motivating, supervising, and monitoring the performance of all members of the allocated team 4. Identify and initiate department training on a regular basis 5. Day to day review of enquiries in conjunction with the Regional Sales Director 6. Support, assist and initiate new client contract agreements as and when identified 7. Allocation of enquiries to the tendering resource ensuring optimum use of that resource in all groups. 8. Provide support during the pre-tender process starting from evaluating/assessing tenders, assessing risk factors to arrive at bid decisions, and estimating all the required material, equipment, and manpower needs to be able to arrive at reliable cost estimates for bidding spares, service to turnkey projects. 9. Study, analyze and evaluate tender documents and identify risk factors, ensure that technical terms comply with the relevant standards and coordinates with the Division Heads, and Regional Sales Director for the overall risk assessment and bid decision. 10. Overall responsibility to ensure that customer requirements are satisfied whilst meeting SPZA targets 11. Overall responsibility to ensure that tenders for PPR, PSC, EMS, TS & FE meet company commercial guidelines and have the necessary sign off in accordance with the delegation of authority guidelines 12. Overall responsibility together with the Regional Sales Director for maintaining the profit margin on SPZA tenders 13. Proactively engage with procurement to ensure competitive bidding is possible 14. Review and finalize project cost estimates as prepared by the Tendering Engineer in terms of the required material as per bill of quantities (BOQ), amount of work, material/ equipment/ and manpower requirements during the tendering phase; this includes all systems, products and services to client specifications/ requirements. 15. Finalize estimation of all direct and indirect costs and consolidate tender documents for management review and approval. 16. Ensure in conjunction with sales that the Preliminary eTOA and eTOA tool is utilized in line with the eTOA regulation requirements for tenders meeting this criteria 17. Overall responsibility to ensure that initiated projects meet company requirements in terms of selection, pricing, terms and conditions and lead time 18. Overall responsibility to ensure that Order Entry Documentation is completed in accordance with handover guidelines and procedures and company KPIs. 19. Ensure tender margins are accurate for order entry. 20. Overall responsibility to ensure that the sales team are adequately supported and that projects are launched in a timely and professional manner 21. Ensure that handover meetings with projects are effective and result in a smooth transition from pre to post order status 22. Provide all the necessary project clarifications/ information upon project award to the Project Manager as per the project budget; advises the Project Manager on contractual rights, remedies which has been taken into consideration during tendering. 23. Proactively engage and support company initiatives designed to promote a culture of safe working, environmental protection and continual improvement. 24. All other duties as relevant to the post.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Sulzer è leader globale nell'ingegneria dei fluidi, con oltre 180 anni di innovazione, operante in oltre 160 sedi in tutto il mondo e generando ricavi annuali superiori a 3,5 miliardi di franchi. All'interno dei nostri Servizi, siamo specializzati nella manutenzione, riparazione, aggiornamento e ottimizzazione di apparecchiature rotanti come pompe, turbine, motori e compressori. Lavoriamo con i clienti nei settori dell'energia, del petrolio e del gas, dei prodotti chimici, dell'acqua e dell'industria per mantenere l'infrastruttura essenziale in esecuzione in modo efficiente, affidabile e sostenibile, riducendo i tempi di fermo, estendendo la vita delle risorse e migliorando le prestazioni in tutto il mondo. Mentre continuiamo a rafforzare le nostre operazioni globali, stiamo ora cercando un Global Operational Excellence Development Manager per aiutare a guidare la trasformazione attraverso la nostra rete di servizi internazionale, incorporando le migliori pratiche, migliorando l'efficienza e migliorando l'esperienza del cliente in scala. In questo ruolo sarete responsabili per:
• Condurre e implementare iniziative di eccellenza operativa globale nel nostro business Servizi
• standardizzazione, ottimizzazione e digitalizzazione del processo di trasmissione attraverso catene di valore end-to-end
• Identificare e implementare opportunità per migliorare l'esperienza, l'efficienza e la redditività del cliente
• Partner con le parti interessate in tutte le regioni per tradurre la strategia in esecuzione
• Fornire progetti di trasformazione su larga scala in un'organizzazione globale e decentrata
• Metodologie del campione Lean e una mentalità di miglioramento continuo
• Sviluppare quadri, strumenti e governance per sostenere l'eccellenza operativa
• Collaborare tra vendite, operazioni e supply chain Per avere successo in questo ruolo, avrete bisogno di:
• Esperienza nell'eccellenza operativa / miglioramento continuo / gestione delle operazioni
• Consegna comprovata di progetti in organizzazioni internazionali, matrici
• Forte conoscenza dell'ottimizzazione dei processi, dei principi Lean e del miglioramento della catena del valore
• Esperienza con digitalizzazione dei processi e trasformazione IT-enabled
• Comprensione dei quadri di modellazione dei processi aziendali
• Forte impegno degli stakeholder e capacità di influenzare
• Familiarità con sistemi ERP (SAP/D365) e CRM
• Lo sfondo dei servizi industriali, della produzione o dell'ingegneria è preferito Desiderabile:
• Esperienza aziendale di servizio
• Strategia / Gestione della consulenza background
• Esposizione a macchine rotanti o mercati industriali Cosa ti offriamo
• Un ruolo ibrido con viaggi occasionali in tutte le regioni (30–40% di viaggi globali)
• Uno stipendio base competitivo
• Schema di bonus personale annuale basato sull'azienda e sulle prestazioni personali
• Assicurazione medica privata per te e partner attraverso Aviva.
• L'opzione di un'auto aziendale o di un'indennità di cassa
• 33 giorni di ferie annuali.

About the role Sulzer is a global leader in fluid engineering, with over 180 years of innovation, operating across more than 160 locations worldwide and generating annual revenues in excess of CHF 3.5 billion.. Within our Services legal entity, we specialise in the maintenance, repair, upgrade, and optimisation of rotating equipment such as pumps, turbines, motors, and compressors. We work with customers across energy, oil & gas, chemicals, water, and industrial sectors to keep essential infrastructure running efficiently, reliably, and sustainably—reducing downtime, extending asset life, and improving performance worldwide. As we continue to strengthen our global operations, we are now seeking a Global Operational Excellence Development Manager to help drive transformation across our international service network, embedding best practice, improving efficiency, and enhancing customer experience at scale. In this role you will be accountable for:
• Lead and roll out global operational excellence initiatives across our Services business
• Drive process standardisation, optimisation, and digitalisation across end-to-end value chains
• Identify and implement opportunities to improve customer experience, efficiency, and profitability
• Partner with stakeholders across regions to translate strategy into execution
• Deliver medium to large-scale transformation projects in a global, decentralised organisation
• Champion Lean methodologies and a continuous improvement mindset
• Develop frameworks, tools, and governance to sustain operational excellence
• Collaborate across Sales, Operations, and Supply Chain To succeed in this role, you will need:
• Experience in Operational Excellence / Continuous Improvement / Operations Management
• Proven delivery of projects in international, matrix organisations
• Strong knowledge of process optimisation, Lean principles, and value chain improvement
• Experience with process digitalisation and IT-enabled transformation
• Understanding of business process modelling frameworks
• Strong stakeholder engagement and influencing skills
• Familiarity with ERP (SAP/D365) and CRM systems

• Service business experience
• Strategy / Management consulting background

• A competitive basic salary
• Annual personal bonus scheme based on company and personal performance
• Private Medical Insurance for yourself and partner through Aviva.
• The option of a company car or cash allowance
• 33 days annual leave.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer è una società di ingegneria leader con un patrimonio orgoglioso di innovazione. Unisciti al nostro team globale per accrescere le tue competenze e sviluppare soluzioni innovative che consentano una società prospera e più sostenibile. Informazioni sul ruolo Siamo alla ricerca di un Product Manager per modellare il futuro di Industrial Water Treatment Sulzer Water Treatment Solutions è un luogo in cui le menti imprenditoriali crescono. Stiamo cercando un Product Manager per Industrial Treatm ent Solutions per modellare le ambizioni di crescita nel trattamento, un talento che è pronto a prendere la proprietà e fare un impatto reale. Stiamo ora cercando un Product Manager proattivo e focalizzato sul cliente per portare le nostre tecnologie globali collaudate in nuovi mercati regionali. In questo ruolo, si possiede l'adattamento e il lancio dei prodotti esistenti in offerte orientate a soluzioni locali. Lavorando a stretto contatto con i team globali e regionali, guiderai i trasferimenti tecnologici, localizzerai i prodotti alle esigenze di mercato e di regolamentazione, e garantirai la piena disponibilità commerciale tra vendite, operazioni e supporto alle applicazioni. Definirai la strategia regionale dei prodotti, insieme ai team locali che daranno informazioni sul mercato, coprendo le esigenze dei clienti, la concorrenza, i prezzi e le normative. Da questo, si costruirà una roadmap focalizzata, business case e KPI, regolare i corsi dove necessario. Potrai condurre la soluzione lancia, modellare proposizioni di valore e prezzi, e consentire ai team di vendita attraverso formazione, strumenti e supporto hands-on. Essendo un esperto di applicazioni di prodotto, lavorerai a stretto contatto con i clienti e gli specialisti interni, supportano i piloti e le implementazioni anticipate e trasformano il feedback in miglioramenti continui dei prodotti. Sei un auto-avviamento con forti capacità di comunicazione e una solida comprensione del trattamento delle acque industriali o soluzioni tecniche simili. L'esperienza nella gestione dei prodotti, nell'ingegneria dei processi, nello sviluppo aziendale o nelle vendite in un'organizzazione internazionale di matrice è altamente apprezzata. Fluency in inglese e la volontà di viaggiare sono necessari. A Sulzer, troverete un ruolo con reale influenza, varie sfide e spazio per crescere.
• Offriamo un ambiente collaborativo che valorizza innovazione, collaborazione e risultati. Questo ruolo si trova vicino a un ufficio di Sulzer in Europa e preferibilmente in Spagna, Italia, Germania o Francia. Per domande, si prega di contattare il responsabile di reclutamento Erik Edvardsson su erik . edvardsson @sulzer.com Si prega di osservare che questo è un processo di reclutamento in corso e che la posizione potrebbe essere riempita prima della data di chiusura dell'annuncio. Cosa ti offriamo TBD Sulzer è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Crediamo nella forza di una forza lavoro diversificata e ci impegniamo ad offrire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo. Siamo orgogliosi di essere riconosciuti come Top Employer 2026 in Brasile, Canada, Cina, Finlandia, Germania, Irlanda, Messico, Svizzera, Sud Africa, Regno Unito e Stati Uniti.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un responsable de produit pour les solutions de traitement industriel pour façonner les ambitions de croissance dans le traitement, un talent qui est prêt à prendre en charge et faire un impact réel. Dans ce rôle, vous serez propriétaire de l'adaptation et du lancement de produits existants dans des offres locales adaptées à la solution. En tant qu'expert en application de produits, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les clients et les spécialistes internes, soutiendra les pilotes et les déploiements précoces, et transformerez les commentaires en améliorations continues du produit. Vous êtes un ‐ débutant avec de solides compétences en communication et une solide compréhension du traitement industriel de l'eau ou des solutions techniques similaires. Pour toute question, veuillez contacter le responsable du recrutement Erik Edvardsson sur erik . edvardsson @sulzer.com Veuillez noter qu'il s'agit d'un processus de recrutement continu et que le poste pourrait être comblé avant la date de clôture de l'annonce. descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Senior VA-process & applikations specialist inom avdelningen för Global process & applikationsutveckling på Nordic Water Nordic Water avser nu tillsätta en nya tjänst, Senior VA-process & applikations specialist inom avdelningen för Global process & applikationsutveckling på Nordic Water tjänsten är baserade på vårt centralkontor i Göteborg Sulzer - Nordic Water Products AB, utvecklar, tillverkar och levererar maskiner och utrustning för vatten- och avloppsvattenrening. Vi har många års erfarenhet och är världsledande inom flera av våra specialområden med produkter såsom DynaSand kontinuerliga sandfilter, Johnson lamellseparator, DynaDisc skivfilter, DynaCloth fiberdiscfilter, DynaBelt bandfilter MevaScreen galler- & rensutrustning samt Zickert slamskrapor. Vi erbjuder såväl enskilda maskinkomponenter som integrerade system och lösningar. Vi har centralkontor i Göteborg samt kontor och serviceenheter i Mariestad, Helsingborg och Fjärås (Kungsbacka). Våra produkter säljs över hela världen genom ett nätverk av egna kontor, representanter och återförsäljare. Nordic Water Sverige omsätter ca 600 miljoner SEK och har ca 100 anställda. Vi erbjuder nu en tjänst med stora möjligheter att själv påverka arbetssätt och rutiner, och det lämnar stort utrymme för eget ansvar och utvecklingsmöjligheter. Som process & applikationsspecialist på Nordic Water kommer du att ingå i vårt kommersiella processdesign- team. Tjänsten är en specialist-tjänst inom produktsegmentet VA-process. Avdelningens huvudsakliga uppgifter är att svara för en fördjupad produkt- och process- & applikations kompetens inom produktområdet, och ge såväl kommersiell som produktorienterad support till den globala säljorganisationen. Fördjupad teknisk expertis, framtagning av nya dimensioneringverktyg samt processrelaterad applikationsguider utifrån företagets produkter och system till projekt över hela värden upptar stor del av arbetsuppgifterna i gruppen. Du kommer att arbeta på kontoret i Göteborg, men resor inom Sverige och internationellt kan förekomma. Flera av projekten kan vara mer av karaktären systemleveranser och därmed tekniskt komplexa, därför ser vi gärna att du har en god känsla för teamwork, samarbete och är utåtriktad.
• Projektleda, planera och genomföra strategiska undersökningar som utgör grunden för nya designverktyg för våra befintliga och nya produkter och applikationer.
• Verifiering och testning av dessa prov i fält (nationellt och utomlands)
• Ansvarig för datainsamling, samt bearbetning av stora dataserier slutsatser och presentation i detaljerade professionella rapporter. Ledarskap, affärsdriven problemlösning och utveckling är något som vi ser den sökande finner stort intresse av. För att lyckas i tjänsten ser vi gärna att du har:
• Relevant eftergymnasial utbildning, eller högre akademisk utbildning inom kemi eller likvärdig
• Gärna goda VA-kunskaper eller erfarenhet av liknande verksamhet är meriterande
• Teknikintresse och gärna praktisk/teoretisk erfarenhet.
• Initiativrik med kommersiellt sinne för teknisk problemlösning
• Strukturerad och har förmåga att självständigt leda och ta ansvar för och lösa komplexa uppgifter.
• Goda kunskaper i engelska i tal och skrift, övriga språk är meriterande.
• Körkort För ytterligare information och ansökan om tjänsten som Senior VA-process & applikations specialist , kontakta Mattias Feldthusen, Director Products +46 704 202156 E-post: mattias.feldthusen@sulzer.com Tjänsten skall tillsättas omgående och vi vill därför ha din ansökan snarast. What we offer you
• Friskvårdsbidrag 3000kr/år (E-passi)
• Collea – Gratis pension och försäkringsrådgivning
• Gratis kaffe och frukt
• Företagshälsovård med regelbundna hälsokontroller Sulzer is an equal opportu

Fördjupad teknisk expertis, framtagning av nya dimensioneringverktyg samt processrelaterad applikationsguider utifrån företagets produkter och system till projekt över hela värden upptar stor del av arbetsuppgifterna i gruppen. Du kommer att arbeta på kontoret i Göteborg, men resor inom Sverige och internationellt kan förekomma. Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Teknisk orderadminstratör Sulzer Pumps Sweden AB, Mölndal Teknisk orderadminstratör Hos oss skapas möjligheter att växa – nu söker vi en teknisk orderadministratör efter att tjänsten blivit ledig genom intern utveckling och karriär. Är du engagerad, noggrann, uppskattar adminstrativa uppgifter och dessutom har tekniskt intresse läs vidare, du kanske är den vi söker? Vi söker ytterligare en medarbetare till vårt orderteam i Mölndal, med fokus på att stötta våra kommun, industri och energi – kunder på den svenska marknaden. Sulzer utvecklar och tillverkar innovativa lösningar av högsta kvalitet och med senaste teknik inom pumpning, omrörning, luftning och service. Med en egen fabrik i Sverige samt tillgång till ett globalt nätverk av fabriker inom Sulzer erbjuder rollen daglig kontakt och ett nära samarbete med verksamheten, både nationellt och globalt. Du blir en del av ett större order- och offertteam bestående av totalt tio personer, varav hälften arbetar med order- och reservdelshantering, där vi nu söker en ny kollega. Tjänsten har ett tekniskt administrativt fokus med daglig kundkontakt och nära dialog med säljorganisationen. Det här kommer du att arbeta med: I rollen arbetar du med att ta emot och hantera förfrågningar på reservdelar, ta fram offerter samt föra dialog med kunder. Du ansvarar för att lägga in reservdels- och produktorder i SAP, vilket inkluderar konfigurering av produkter utifrån tekniska offerter – från enstaka order till större projekt. Arbetet innebär löpande kontakt med våra producerande enheter internationellt avseende bland annat orderstatus och leveranser. Du säkerställer att kunder får korrekt dokumentation, genomför leveransbevakning och hanterar reklamationer på ett strukturerat sätt. Rollen innebär även ett nära samarbete med och stöd till våra kundansvariga utesäljare. Du har daglig kontakt med svenska kunder och svenska liksom engelska - språket är en naturlig del av arbetet. Detta söker vi hos dig Vi söker dig som är serviceinriktad, noggrann och engagerad lagspelare som trivs i en administrativ roll med många parallella arbetsuppgifter. Du har en god teknisk förståelse och arbetar strukturerat även när tempot är högt. Vi ser gärna att du har: Teknisk utbildning på gymnasie- eller högskolenivå, alternativt motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet Erfarenhet av administrativt arbete i affärssystem, där SAP är meriterande Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift Förmåga att kommunicera professionellt med både kunder och kollegor Placeringsort Mölndal What we offer you
• Friskvårdsbidrag 3000kr/år (E-passi)
• Collea – Gratis pension och försäkringsrådgivning
• Gratis kaffe och frukt
• Företagshälsovård med regelbundna hälsokontroller Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Production Worker / Technician is responsible for assembling, testing, and inspecting products to ensure they meet quality and safety standards. This role supports the manufacturing process by identifying defects, maintaining equipment, and following production protocols.
This job profile is intended for support staff that follows established procedures and works under close supervision. Smaller/easier decisions are made autonomously. This role supports organizations of various sizes and is designed for individuals who enjoy hands‑on technical work, clear documentation, and contributing to high‑quality production and repair processes.
As part of the team, you will be responsible for inspecting, and testing products according to engineering specifications.

A key part of the role involves creating Job Books that guide mechanics on the shop floor, as well as producing 2D assembly forms and repair instructions used during mechanical inspections and repair activities. Once repair work is completed, you will be responsible for digitizing the Job Books to ensure accurate, organized records of all work performed.

Day‑to‑day, you will visually and mechanically inspect finished goods, identify and document any defects, and communicate issues to the appropriate teams. You’ll help maintain production and inspection equipment, follow all safety and quality procedures, and assist with basic troubleshooting or maintenance tasks as needed. Collaboration is important in this role, and you will work closely with team members to meet production goals and support continuous improvement.

To succeed, you should bring strong mechanical and technical aptitude, attention to detail, and comfort reading and following technical instructions or drawings. A high school diploma is required, and 1–2 years of experience working with turbomachinery is preferred. Familiarity with safety, inspection, and quality standards is helpful, along with good communication and teamwork skills. Just as important is a willingness to learn and grow within a manufacturing environment.

Technical proficiency is essential, particularly with AutoCAD and the Microsoft Office Suite. Experience with any 2D or 3D modeling tools—such as Blender, Polyworks, Fusion 360, SolidWorks, Maya, or 3ds Max—is also valuable and will support your success in creating clear, accurate documentation.

What we offer you

What we offer:

• 12 Paid Holidays
• 15 Paid Time off (PTO) Days
• Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
• 401k with 6% company match
• Employee Assistance Program
• Employee Wellness Program
• Bonus Programs. Based on company performance and individual performance.

New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
